article.articleHeadline: City records 36 HIV cases to date
article.articleSummary: Macau has recorded 36 HIV cases from January to October 2026, according to the Health Bureau (SSM). Of the confirmed cases, 20 are local male residents aged 20–39. Transmission was most often via same-sex sexual encounters (15 cases), followed by heterosexual encounters (3 cases); the transmission method for two cases remains unconfirmed. Eighteen locally infected residents have had medical follow-up at Hospital Centre S. Januario, and two died. Since 2015, HIV infections linked to same-sex relations among local residents have risen. In response, the SSM increased advertising encouraging regular testing for HIV on dating websites and apps, and conducted online outreach to high-risk groups. The government released the data on November 30, fitting World AIDS Day’s timing; World AIDS Day was established in 1988 by UNAIDS and is observed on December 1.

triage.headline_ja: マカオが本年36件のHIV感染を記録
triage.triage_reason: HIV感染の局所的な増加傾向が報告されており、同性間感染が主要な経路として認識されているが、現時点では国際的拡大リスクや重症度の急激な悪化の証拠が限定的。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: マカオは中国の特別行政区。記事は2015年以降の同性間HIV感染の増加傾向を指摘し、当局による予防啓発活動（オンライン広告、高危険群へのアウトリーチ）が実施されている。死亡例2件を含むが、感染数は限定的であり、急速な拡大の証拠は現時点で不明。World AIDS Day（12月1日）との関連で政府発表がなされた社会的文脈がある。

article.articleHeadline: The $498.8m fund to fight Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has claimed 220 lives as of 2026-06-01, with cross-border transmission triggering a World Health Organization Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak persists despite rapid international funding totaling $498.8 million pledged—just short of the $519 million needed; a $20.2 million gap remains. Major donors include the World Bank ($160 million for Congo operations), the United States ($82 million), European partners (~$57 million), and the UN OCHA ($60 million). The article notes Africa’s lack of financial contributions, urging Africa CDC and governments to strengthen their own capacity. Public health guidance emphasizes avoiding contact with sick individuals, rigorous hand hygiene, and seeking medical care for symptoms. Ebola spreads through bodily fluids of symptomatic patients, and with no vaccine for this strain, containment is urgent to prevent regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱対策のための4億9,880万ドル基金
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRC・ウガンダでのブンディブギョエボラウイルスアウトブレイクは220人の死亡、国際的な懸念事項の宣言（PHEIC）、国境を越えた感染、および実質的な国際的対応が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびウガンダでのアウトブレイクを明記しているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は提供対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。DRCは対象国（ID: 203312）に該当するため含める。複数の大規模支援者（世界銀行、米国、欧州、UN OCHA）による資金支援が報告されており、WHOによるPHEIC宣言が実施された主要な緊急事態である。

article.articleHeadline: البرازيل تعزل رجلين يُشتبه بإصابتهما بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil isolates two men suspected of being infected with the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian health authorities isolated two men suspected of Ebola virus disease (EVD) imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, amid ongoing regional outbreaks in those countries. In Rio de Janeiro, a man who arrived from Uganda on May 22 showed viral symptoms but tested positive for malaria and negative for Ebola, remaining in isolation during investigation. In São Paulo state, a 37-year-old man from the DRC with fever met suspected-EVD criteria; he was later diagnosed with acute meningitis, while Ebola testing continues. Health officials say the risk of transmission to Brazil and South America remains very low. The DRC began a new EBOV outbreak in three eastern provinces around May 15; Uganda reported two new confirmed cases, bringing its total to nine. In the DRC, over 1,000 suspected cases have caused 246 deaths. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラウイルスに感染した疑いのある2人の男性を隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たす（深刻な影響あり、異常/予想外のイベント、国際拡大リスク）。コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの大規模エボラ流行に関連した輸入症例の可能性であり、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの状況での疑い症例報告のため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（1,000以上の疑い症例、246死亡）に関連し、ウガンダ経由と思われるブラジル での輸入症例（疑い）の報告。WHO PHEIC既宣言。記事サマリーはウガンダ由来症例も言及しているが、verified_locationsはサマリーで主題となっている実際の発症地（Brazil、DRC）のみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Authorities flag airlines from high-risk countries
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Nigeria tightens surveillance at Murtala Muhammed International Airport (MMIA), Lagos, with enhanced screening for passengers from high-risk countries amid renewed Ebola concerns from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Authorities from FAAN, Lagos State Government, Port Health Services, and other stakeholders conducted a joint inspection of MMIA's health surveillance and emergency response facilities at Terminal One. Airlines arriving from high-risk destinations have been identified and placed under enhanced surveillance; health screening forms are administered to such passengers. The airport's emergency preparedness and response plan has been reviewed and strengthened to ensure early detection, reporting, and management of suspected cases. Lagos State Health Commissioner Prof. Akin Abayomi and Port Health's Dr. Abdullahi Lawal noted ongoing vigilance and prompt action on Ebola-like symptoms. MMIA management reaffirmed commitment to strict health protocol compliance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：当局が高リスク国からの航空会社に警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラの潜在的国際拡大リスクを認識した主動的な防疫措置が報告されており、DRCでの活動が背景にあるが、ナイジェリア内での確定患者数や直近の感染状況が記事から不明であるため、情報補充を要する。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア（Lagos）での防疫強化措置を報告しており、DRCでのエボラ活動を背景としている。しかしナイジェリア自体は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ナイジェリアでの確定患者数や発症状況が記事に明記されていないため、重症度・公衆衛生への深刻な影響度は「不明」と評価した。IHR基準は3つ該当し、WPRO基準も3つ該当するが、実際の患者報告の有無と詳細が不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Sube el número de contagios y muertes por ébola en un país africano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola infections and deaths is rising in an African country.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, Ebola cases and deaths are rising in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Ministry of Health reported 282 confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths, according to Reuters. Four nurses and one laboratory worker were discharged after treatment, with authorities hoping for additional recoveries as diagnosis improves and access to care increases. The update underscores ongoing efforts to intensify the outbreak response. No further details on transmission sources or specific containment measures are provided in the brief report. The figures emphasize the burden of the outbreak in the country and the critical need for early detection and sustained public health interventions to curb transmission and improve outcomes for patients and the health system.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの国でエボラの感染者数と死亡者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例282件、死亡42件が報告されており、IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、疾患の異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクがすべて認められる。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体であり、282確認症例と42死亡は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威を示している。医療従事者の感染（看護師4名、検査室職員1名）は医療施設内での伝播リスクを示唆している。記事は治療を受けて退院した者もいることを報告しているが、全体的には急速な拡大傾向がある。

article.articleHeadline: Melbourne Ebola scare puts Australia's outbreak response to the test
article.articleSummary: Melbourne faced a suspected Ebola case when a traveler who recently visited areas near the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda presented to an emergency department with Ebola-like symptoms. He was rapidly isolated and tested; results later returned negative. Australian health officials framed the incident as a test of preparedness, noting quick isolation, testing, and effective border-security processes that keep national risk low while prioritizing surveillance and international outbreak control. The episode unfolds as Africa reports an Ebola surge driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths in DR Congo and neighboring Uganda as of May 29; WHO opened a new treatment centre in Bunia, Ituri province. In Bunia, four patients discharged today and one yesterday, totaling five recoveries; the Bundibugyo virus has no approved treatment or vaccine. Community fears and burial-practice tensions continue to complicate response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: メルボルンのエボラ疑い事例、オーストラリアの感染症対応能力を試す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での実際のエボラ流行（確定134例、死亡18例）が存在し、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する可能性があるが、メルボルンの事例は陰性で実際の感染確認がないため、DRCの流行状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: メルボルンの疑い事例は陰性で実際の感染なし。ただしDRCとウガンダで進行中のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、134確定例、18死亡）が実際に存在し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念となっている。DRC での流行継続と治療センター運営状況を継続監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: البرازيل تعزل رجلين للاشتباه بإصابتهما بإيبولا وسط تفش جديد في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil quarantines two men suspected of Ebola infection amid a new outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two Brazilian men are quarantined on suspicion of Ebola infection amid a renewed outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). One arrived from Uganda, the other from the DRC; neither has been confirmed Ebola as of 2026-06-01. The Ugandan-arrived patient, symptomatic since May 22 (cough, chills, diarrhea), tested malaria-positive and Ebola-negative, but remains isolated during further investigation. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the DRC was isolated after fever but later diagnosed with acute meningitis; Ebola testing continues. Brazil’s Health Ministry says the risk of transmission to Brazil or South America is very low. The DRC began a new outbreak on May 15; Uganda has two new confirmed cases, totaling 9 in-country. By 2026-06-01, the DRC reports 282 confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths (Ituri 264, North Kivu 15, South Kivu 3); Africa CDC notes 246 deaths among over 1,000 suspected cases. Imported cases in Brazil highlight ongoing cross-border concern.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラ疑い患者2名を隔離、コンゴ民主共和国で新たな流行が発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、複数国でのエボラ確認例と死亡者あり、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCでのエボラアウトブレーク（5月15日開始、282確認例、42死亡）が主要な感染症イベントであり、ブラジルへの輸入症例は二次的な懸念。ウガンダも言及されているが対象国リストに未含。アフリカの複数国での感染と死亡が確認されており、WPRO基準全5項目が該当。

article.articleHeadline: Five recover from Ebola in Eastern DRC, total cases reach 263
article.articleSummary: Five people infected with the Ebola Bundibugyo strain have recovered in Bunia, capital of Ituri Province in north-eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Four discharged healthcare workers left an Ebola treatment centre after twice testing negative; a fifth patient, a laboratory technician, had already returned home. WHO Director-General Dr Tedros attended the opening of a new Ebola treatment facility in Bunia and stressed that recovery is possible with appropriate care. Authorities intensified laboratory screening and patient management; Health Minister Roger Kamba said no outstanding samples awaited analysis, with surveillance, contact tracing, and case verification ongoing. As of 29 May, the Health Ministry reported 263 confirmed Ebola cases nationwide with 42 deaths; Africa CDC noted more than 1,100 test results pending as of 30 May.

triage.headline_ja: 東部DRCでエボラから5人が回復、総症例数は263に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例が263件、死亡42件と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。DRCは対象国であり、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ感染症の進行中の流行。WHO事務局長が治療施設の開設に出席し、国際的な関心が高い。1,100件以上の検査結果が保留中で、引き続きスクリーニングと接触者追跡が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 疫情外溢？巴西也傳伊波拉疑似2病例 甫從民主剛果、烏干達入境
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spillover? Brazil reports two suspected cases, recently arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases reported in Brazil amid ongoing Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of the publication, the African outbreak has more than 1,000 suspected cases, with 282 confirmed infections and 42 deaths. In São Paulo, a patient who recently arrived from the DRC developed fever and is now intubated and in critical condition; meningitis testing has returned positive. In Rio de Janeiro, a separate suspected case had recently traveled to Uganda, where malaria testing was positive. Local public health authorities stress that although other diagnostic results are positive, Ebola cannot be ruled out at this stage, and thorough epidemiological investigations are ongoing. Both cases appear imported, linked to current hotspots in the DRC and Uganda, highlighting continued spillover concerns outside Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱流出？ブラジルでエボラ熱の疑い症例2件報告、民主共和国コンゴとウガンダから入国直後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な国際的拡大、渡航制限の可能性）。エボラ熱はDRCとウガンダで流行中であり、ブラジルへの輸入症例は国際的拡大の明確なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）はターゲット国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCとブラジルは対象国リストに含まれ、記事サマリーで両国でのエボラ熱に関連するイベントが主題である。輸入症例の報告は国際的拡大の重大なシグナルであり、フルRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Sự nguy hiểm của máy điều hòa không khí và bệnh Legionnaires ở người cao tuổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The dangers of air conditioning systems and Legionnaires' disease among the elderly.
article.articleSummary: 78-year-old Tuy from Hangzhou, China, developed prolonged fever and a severe cough; initial tests showed mild inflammation and a 3-day cephalosporin course was given. Worsening symptoms led to hospital care, with CT revealing a large consolidation in the right lung. Clinicians traced the illness to an uncleaned air-conditioning unit; bronchoscopy confirmed Legionella pneumophila, diagnosing Legionnaires' disease. After switching to targeted antibiotics, fever fell and the patient improved. Legionella bacteria occur widely in natural waters and artificial water systems; stagnant, moist, enclosed AC components—condensate trays, filters, and ducts—become ideal breeding grounds when not cleaned for months. On restart, bacteria can be aerosolized and inhaled, causing pneumonia. Vulnerable groups—elderly, children, and immunocompromised, especially with lung disease or diabetes, and those with cardiovascular or cerebrovascular disease—at risk. Symptoms mimic pneumonia or flu; cephalosporins and penicillins are ineffective and can delay treatment. This highlights the risk of dirty ACs and maintenance.

triage.headline_ja: 空調システムとレジオネラ菌症の危険性：高齢者への影響
triage.triage_reason: 単一の症例報告であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当がない。ただし、Legionellosis（レジオネラ菌症）は感染症の国際的関心対象であり、公衆衛生の予防教育的価値があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は杭州の78歳患者1名のレジオネラ菌症症例報告。個別症例であり、流行・アウトブレイクの兆候なし。ただし、Legionellosis は高齢者や免疫不全者への重篤なリスク要因（重症度基準に該当）であり、公衆衛生的関心が存在。空調システムの不十分なメンテナンスが原因という点は環境衛生上の警告となる。Influenza との共掲載は見出しの医学的な比較言及と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Власти ДР Конго сообщили почти о 300 подтвержденных случаях заражения Эболой - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo authorities report nearly 300 confirmed Ebola cases - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 282 confirmed cases, with Ituri Province accounting for 264, North Kivu 15, and South Kivu 3. As of the evening of May 31, there have been 43 deaths in the DRC and neighboring Uganda, 238 patients under treatment, and 2 recoveries. The outbreak, officially declared on May 15, has spread to Uganda despite border closures, prompting Africa CDC to declare a regional public health emergency in both countries. Ebola is a highly deadly viral illness; it was first documented in 1976 in Sudan and in the DRC near the Ebola River. It affects humans and some primates and ungulates; major fatal outcomes include massive bleeding, toxemia, and hypovolemic and infectious-toxic shock.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国当局がエボラ感染の確認例がほぼ300件と報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認患者282件、死亡43件、複数州での発生、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、アフリカCDCによる地域公衆衛生緊急事態宣言。IHR基準4つすべて該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべて該当。
triage.notes: 2026年6月1日報告。DRC内での確認患者282件（イトゥリ州264件、北キヴ州15件、南キヴ州3件）、死亡43件。5月15日の公式宣言以降、ウガンダへの国境越えが確認されており、国境閉鎖措置にもかかわらず拡大が継続。アフリカCDCが両国で地域公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言。エボラは致死率の高いウイルス性疾患であり、1976年にスーダンとDRC(エボラ川近辺)で初めて報告。ヒトと一部の霊長類および有蹄類に感染、大量出血・中毒症・低血液量性ショック・感染毒性ショックが主要な致命的転帰。

article.articleHeadline: 巴西也傳伊波拉疑似病例 近期剛去過非洲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil also reports a suspected Ebola case; recently traveled to Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases reported in Brazil as of 2026-06-01 after travelers recently returned from Africa. In São Paulo, a patient with fever and meningitis is intubated in critical condition and had just entered Brazil from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a country experiencing active Ebola transmission. In Rio de Janeiro, a second suspected case tested positive for malaria; the patient had recently visited Uganda, another Ebola-affected country. Public health authorities caution that positive tests for other diseases do not rule out Ebola, and thorough epidemiological investigations are ongoing. Globally, the Ebola outbreak remains centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with over 1,000 suspected cases, 282 laboratory-confirmed cases, and 42 deaths to date. The Brazil cases illustrate cross-border importation risk from Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルもエボラ疑似病例を報告、最近アフリカを訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク（ブラジルへの輸入症例）が確認され、IHR基準で2つ以上該当。記事は複数国での流行と境界を越えた伝播を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づいて検証：ブラジル（São Paulo及びRio de Janeiro）でのエボラ疑似症例が主要な主題。DRCおよびウガンダはエボラの活発な発生地として言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。本イベントは国際的な公衆衛生関心事項。

article.articleHeadline: Number of confirmed Ebola cases in DRC reaches 282 -- Health Ministry
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) totals 282 confirmed cases as of June 1, 2026, with 42 deaths and 238 patients still receiving treatment; two recoveries have been recorded. Ituri Province accounts for 264 cases, followed by North Kivu with 15 and South Kivu with 3. The Ministry of Health declared the outbreak on May 15, and the virus involved is Ebola Bundibugyo, first identified in Uganda in 2007. Neighboring Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death, indicating cross-border transmission. Earlier reports cited more than 1,000 suspected cases and roughly 240 estimated deaths. The current data reflect ongoing transmission concentrated in Ituri and surrounding provinces, based on national authorities’ counts of laboratory-confirmed cases reported up to the publication date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ確認症例数が282例に達する -- 保健省
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響（282確認例、42死亡）、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境伝播）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクあり。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事中で越境伝播（9確認例、1死亡）が言及されているが、主な発生地域はDRCであり対象国リストではウガンダが明示されていないため verified_locations には含めない。2019-2020年のキブ地域のアウトブレイクに続く新たなアウトブレイクと考えられ、Ebola Bundibugyo株の報告は重要。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 1 100 cas d'Ebola suspects, deux hommes placés à l'isolement au Brésil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,100 suspected Ebola cases, two men placed in isolation in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (hemorrhagic fever) caused by the Bundibugyo strain is spreading across the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province and two other Congolese provinces) and neighboring Uganda. As of May 30, 2026, Africa CDC reported 263 confirmed cases and 43 confirmed deaths, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri, northeast DRC. Nine confirmed infections have been recorded in Uganda, including one death; no vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo, so containment relies on barrier precautions and rapid case detection. The WHO has issued an international health alert and a regional intervention plan estimated at $319 million. Brazil has placed two men (from DRC and Uganda) in isolation after Ebola-like symptoms; one later tested negative for Ebola (malaria diagnosed), while another from DRC in Sao Paulo remains under Ebola investigation; authorities consider the transmission risk to Brazil and South America as low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの疑い例1,100件以上、ブラジルで2人が隔離に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。Bundibugyo株エボラの多国間アウトブレイク、死亡例あり、WHO国際保健警告発出、ワクチン・治療法なし。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イトゥーリ州及び他2州）、ウガンダ、ブラジルでのエボラウイルス疾患(Bundibugyo株)の発生を報告。DRCとブラジルが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO国際保健警告発出、地域介入計画3.19億ドル、confirmed 263例・43死亡、suspected 1,100例超。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉患者康復現希望 非洲外出現疑似病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Ebola patient's recovery brings hope; suspected case has appeared outside Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, the World Health Organization said four Bundibugyo Ebola virus infection patients, healthcare workers, had been discharged from a Bunia hospital in the Democratic Republic of Congo, bringing total survivors to five after a recovered laboratory worker. There is no approved vaccine or therapy for the Bundibugyo strain, though early diagnosis and care can enable recovery. In DRC, Ebola cases rose to 282 with 42 deaths after 19 new positives. The outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by WHO in May, though not a pandemic. Africa CDC warns of regional transmission risk, with over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. Outside Africa, Brazil (Sao Paulo) reports a meningitis-positive test in a man who had visited the outbreak country; Rio de Janeiro reports a suspected case with malaria positivity. In Italy, Sardinia's Cagliari started containment after a symptomatic patient returned from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者の回復は希望をもたらす；アフリカ外で疑似病例が出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、DRCでEbola PHEICが宣言されている。複数国への拡大報告もあり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: DRCでのBundibugyo Ebola outbreak（PHEIC宣言済み）に加え、BrazilおよびItalyでの疑似病例報告あり。対象国ではイタリアが除外されているため、DRCおよびBrazilのみverified_locationsに含める。Africa CDCが地域感染リスクを警告し、1,100以上の疑似症例が調査中。優先度が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 전례없는 수준"...아프리카 에볼라 확산에 국제사회 우려 증폭
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Unprecedented level"... International concerns grow over the spread of Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province has surpassed 1,000 suspected cases with at least 246 deaths; neighboring Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) warns the situation, two weeks after official declaration, is extremely serious, with daily new suspected cases and hundreds of samples still awaiting testing. World Health Organization Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to assess response and urged stronger community involvement. He cautioned that certain funeral practices, including handling the deceased, could amplify transmission, while stressing respect for culture and the need to prevent further deaths. In updates, four people were discharged today, following a discharge of one patient a few days earlier.

triage.headline_ja: 「前例のないレベル」...アフリカのエボラ拡大で国際社会の懸念が増幅
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全てに該当。エボラ出血熱は致命的感染症で、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率、WHOの直接関与が確認され、国際的な公衆衛生危機として認識されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダもサマリーに言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に除外。DRCのイトゥリ州が主要な発生地。1,000件以上の疑い患者、246名以上の死亡、ウガンダへの国境越えでの拡大、WHOトップの現地訪問により、国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態として認識される。

article.articleHeadline: Patru pacienţi din R.D. Congo infectaţi cu virusul Ebola s-au însănătoşit şi au fost externaţi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four patients from DR Congo infected with the Ebola virus have recovered and have been discharged.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, four Ebola patients from the Democratic Republic of Congo have recovered and been discharged—the first to be released since the current outbreak. The ceremony in Bunia, attended by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, praised medical staff for perseverance and courage. Officials said early detection and treatment improve survival, underscoring progress toward controlling the outbreak. Separately, Brazil is investigating a second suspected Ebola case. In DR Congo, confirmed Ebola cases have risen to 282, with 19 new positive tests. Of these, 264 are in Ituri province, 15 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu, with 42 deaths among confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス感染者4名が回復して退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認されており、282例の確定患者と42名の死亡者が報告されている。国際的拡大リスク（ブラジルでも疑い患者調査中）があり、IHR基準を満たすシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にBrazilを含めているが、記事サマリーでは「ブラジルで疑い患者を調査中」との言及に留まり、実際の発生地はDRC（South Kivu, Ituri各州および首都Bunia）。DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。WHO事務局長が現地を視察しており、国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en África central dejó 246 muertos y más de mil casos: OMS interviene en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa left 246 dead and more than 1,000 cases: WHO intervenes in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Central Africa continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 246 deaths and over 1,000 cases linked to the Bundibugyo strain. No vaccine has been approved for mass use against Bundibugyo, prompting international teams to bolster medical care and epidemiological surveillance. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, eastern DRC, urging faster humanitarian aid and expanded resources for patient care and surveillance in coordination with local authorities. The spread has raised concerns in neighboring countries: Uganda reports new cases in Kampala and has intensified border controls, while Kenya halted a US‑funded isolation center amid local concerns and ongoing protocol reviews. East African airports maintain travel restrictions to curb transmission as clinical reports under observation exceed one thousand.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行で246人死亡、1,000例以上の患者数：WHOがコンゴで介入
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（246死亡、1,000例以上）で、IHR基準4項目全て該当。複数国での確認、国際支援の実施、国際的な旅行制限等により、フルのRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダ（Kampala）とケニアの対応についても言及しているが、これらは二次的な報告であり、主流行地はDRCのBunia（東部）およびコンゴ民主共和国全体。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国ではないため、verified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo株のエボラ出血熱で、ワクチン未承認という追加の懸念要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente do Rio vindo de Uganda testa negativo para ebola e deixa isolamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio patient coming from Uganda tests negative for Ebola and leaves isolation.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: a patient arriving from Uganda with cough, chills, and diarrhea tested negative for Ebola after Fiocruz analyses of saliva, urine, and blood; he left isolation but remains under medical surveillance for malaria. A second suspected Ebola case in São Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo who recently traveled there, remains under investigation. Fiocruz reaffirmed that Brazil's Ebola transmission risk is low and that authorities are prepared for response. On Saturday, a qPCR test in São Paulo detected Neisseria meningitidis, the meningococcal meningitis bacterium; however, Ebola and other viral diagnoses continue to be investigated at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas. The World Health Organization had declared on the 17th a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Both cases are imported.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダから来たリオの患者がエボラで陰性判定され隔離を解除
triage.triage_reason: 複数の国からの輸入症例（エボラ疑い）であり、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。IHR基準を複数満たし、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ疑いの輸入症例2件（リオはウガンダ由来、サンパウロはコンゴ民主共和国由来）。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。記事サマリー上の実際の発症地はブラジル（リオ・デジャネイロ、サンパウロ）のため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみ。メニンゴコッカス性髄膜炎も検出されており、複数の感染症が関連。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 1 100 cas d'Ebola suspects, deux hommes placés à l'isolement au Brésil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,100 suspected Ebola cases, two men were placed in isolation in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: More than 1,100 suspected Ebola cases are under investigation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with 263 confirmed cases and 43 confirmed deaths as of May 30, Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya said. The outbreak, declared May 15 in Ituri, has affected three Congolese provinces and Uganda, which has nine confirmed infections (including one death). With no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for the Bundibugyo strain, control relies on barrier measures and rapid detection; a regional plan of $319 million has been endorsed by DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. The WHO has issued an international health alert, though the true scale may be underestimated. Separately, two men linked to Congo and Uganda were isolated in Brazil: in Rio de Janeiro one tested positive for malaria and was Ebola-negative but kept in isolation; in Sao Paulo a DRC-arrival with fever is under Ebola testing, Brazil’s transmission risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 1,100例以上のエボラ疑い症例、ブラジルで2人が隔離される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多地域での流行（DRC・ウガンダ）、263確認例・43死亡、国際的な拡大リスク（ブラジルでの隔離）、およびWHOの国際保健アラート発出から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはスーダン・ウガンダも含まれているが、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーの主題は DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行とブラジルでの隔離事例であり、対象国は DRC と Brazil のみ。ウガンダは流行地として記載されているが対象国外のため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Mongbwalu v Kongu. Zlaté bane, chudoba, násilie a boj s ebolou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mongbwalu in the Congo. Gold mines, poverty, violence and the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Mongbwalu sits about 80 kilometers west of Bunia, on the edge of tropical forests, and remains a historic gold mining centre. Despite natural wealth, the region is marked by poverty and weak infrastructure—electricity, healthcare, and drinking water are limited—and security challenges from past and present conflicts. WHO warns that Ebola epidemics in this region pose a serious health threat, worsened by attacks on health facilities, distrust of health workers, and misinformation. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects; the incubation period is 2–21 days. Symptoms include high fever, severe fatigue, headaches, muscle and joint pain, vomiting, and diarrhea; severe disease can cause multi-organ failure and death. Health workers run treatment and educational campaigns in a difficult environment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのモングバル。金鉱山、貧困、暴力、そしてエボラとの戦い
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生、DRCでの継続的流行、IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準全て該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: エボラは極めて高い致命率（最大90%）の感染症であり、DRCでの継続的流行は世界的な公衆衛生上の脅威。記事は貧困、セキュリティ上の課題、医療施設への攻撃、保健従事者への不信感などの複合的リスク要因を指摘しており、流行対策の困難性を強調している。WHOの警告が記載されている点も、国際的な関心の高さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: മ​ഴ​യ്ക്കൊ​പ്പം ഡെ​ങ്കി​പ്പ​നി​ക്ക് സാ​ധ്യ​ത​യെ​ന്ന് റി​പ്പോ​ർ​ട്ട് | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Report says dengue fever is possible with rain.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Kannur district is flagged as potentially spreading with the onset of the monsoon, according to a health department report. Dengue cases have been reported in Mangattidam, Chapparappadavu, Mattannur, Vengad, Thalassery, Aaralam, and Ulikkal panchayats. Symptoms of dengue can resemble those of common viral fever, delaying diagnosis and potentially leading to severe illness. The disease is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, making vector control the primary preventive strategy. Since breeding occurs in stagnant water, authorities urge residents to eliminate water-logging around homes. Do not let water accumulate in containers such as pots and tins; keep all water storage tanks tightly closed; and purify wells by chlorination. Public health measures and mosquito-control efforts are emphasized to curb outbreak risk during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季に伴うデング熱の可能性があると報告
triage.triage_reason: ケーラ州カンヌル地区でのデング熱流行が季節要因（モンスーン）とともに報告されており、複数の地域でケース確認と予防対策が強調されているが、現在の症例数規模や重症度の詳細が不明であるため。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの風土病であり、モンスーン期の季節的流行は予測可能な現象。記事は予防的警告・啓発性が強く、緊急度の高い勃発的流行ではない。ただし、複数地域での同時報告と公衆衛生部門の公式声明があるため経過観察の価値あり。症例数、入院者数、死亡例の有無について追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 확산세...민주콩고 등 아프리카 감염 의심 1천100명(종합)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola on the rise... 1,100 suspected infections in Africa, including the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Comprehensive).
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus is on the rise in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, eastern region), with about 1,100 suspected infections under investigation. In DRC, 282 cases have been lab-confirmed and 42 deaths reported; WHO estimates up to 246 additional deaths may occur. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs via contact with infected animals or people; common symptoms include fever, muscle pains, vomiting, and diarrhea. On May 15, the outbreak was declared in eastern Ituri, and Brazil and Italy reported suspected imported cases after travelers from Africa. Brazil is isolating two returnees who had visited DRC and Uganda; Italy hospitalized one returnee from Africa. Five recoveries have been reported, including four nurses. A regional Ebola response plan worth about $319.9 million has been prepared by DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan to fund outbreak control and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ拡散...アフリカ民主コンゴなど感染疑い1100人（総合）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（1100人疑い例、42人死亡、246人の追加死亡予測）、異常・予想外（Bundibugyo株の拡大流行）、国際拡大リスク（ブラジル・イタリアで輸入疑い例）、渡航制限リスク。
triage.notes: イタリアはBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。スーダン・ウガンダも同様。DRCとブラジルの輸入疑い例が記事の主要な内容。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療薬なし）による新規流行のため社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil descartó uno de dos casos sospechosos de ébola: el paciente que queda por confirmar está internado en grave estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil ruled out one of two suspected Ebola cases: the patient awaiting confirmation is hospitalized in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases linked to the central Africa outbreak were investigated in Brazil. In Rio de Janeiro, a Ugandan man who arrived May 22 with cough, chills and diarrhea tested negative for Ebola and was diagnosed with malaria but remains isolated. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man who had been in the Democratic Republic of Congo is critically ill, intubated, with diarrhea and disorientation; Ebola testing continues, though grave meningitis is confirmed. The outbreak centers on Ituri province, eastern DRC, where WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17, 2026. As of May 29, DRC had 125 confirmed cases and 17 deaths, with 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths; Uganda reported nine confirmed cases and one death after two new infections. Bundibugyo Ebola virus lacks a vaccine or approved treatment; transmission via bodily fluids; incubation up to 21 days. WHO cautions contact tracing is hard amid conflict; first recovery reported.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラの疑い例2件のうち1件を除外：確認待ちの患者は重篤な状態で入院中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCの確定的なエボラ流行、複数国への越境、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるIturi州でのエボラ確定流行（WHO PHEIC宣言済み、125確定例、17死亡、906疑い例）と、ウガンダ（9確定例）での確認事例が背景。ブラジルでの疑い例は国際的な懸念の顕現化。Bundibugyo Ebola virusはワクチン・承認治療薬なし。記事はスペイン語で中南米地域での関心も高い。フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola tại châu Phi diễn biến phức tạp, gia tăng lo ngại lây lan ra thế giới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Africa is developing in a complicated way, raising concerns about its global spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda continues, driven by Bundibugyo strain. As of May 30, 263 confirmed infections, over 1,100 suspected cases, and 43 deaths have been reported. Ituri, in eastern DRC, is a focal point amid high movement, raising concerns of wider regional spread; the outbreak is among the largest in DRC history and is outpacing response, with PPE shortages in some facilities. The East African Community will hold emergency meetings (June 1–2) to coordinate a regional response, deploying nine mobile laboratories at borders and mobilizing more than 180 experts, aiming to accelerate vaccine and diagnostic approvals, surveillance, and infection control. In Brazil, two travelers from Africa were quarantined after Ebola-like symptoms: a 37-year-old man recently in DRC with fever under meningitis investigation, and a second man in Rio with Uganda travel; malaria was found in the latter; risk remains low. WHO calls for support and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行は複雑な展開を見せており、世界中への拡大懸念が高まっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、かつWPRO基準5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の地域的流行拡大、死亡例報告、複数国への波及リスク、各国の調整体制構築が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでのエボラ流行も言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ブラジルの疑似症例は確認されているが、当該患者はアフリカからの移入例であり、ブラジルが感染症イベントの発生地ではないため除外。DRCのIturi州が感染の重点地域として特定され、地域的拡大および国際的懸念が顕著。東アフリカ共同体の緊急会合開催など政治的対応レベルが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investiga dos casos sospechosos de ébola en medio del brote que preocupa al mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigates two suspected Ebola cases amid the outbreak that concerns the world
article.articleSummary: Brazil is investigating two suspected Ebola cases amid global concern over a central African outbreak. Since mid-May, the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has prompted a WHO public health emergency of international concern on May 17, with over 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 deaths in the DRC; Uganda has nine cases, including one death. The first Brazilian case involves a 37-year-old man who had traveled from the DRC and arrived in São Paulo with fever; he is in isolation at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology, with a severe meningitis diagnosed, though Ebola testing continues. The second case is a man from Uganda who entered Brazil on May 22; he had viral-like symptoms, but malaria was detected, and Ebola exclusion is ongoing. Experts say importation risk remains very low; incubation up to 21 days; Bundibugyo has no vaccine or specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルが世界に不安をもたらしている流行の最中、エボラウイルスの疑わしい2つのケースを調査している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが5月17日にPHEIC宣言した中央アフリカのエボラ流行に伴う輸入症例の報告であり、フルRRA進行の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: DRCおよびウガンダで進行中のBundibugyo strain エボラ流行（1,000以上の疑い患者、約250名の死亡）に関連する輸入症例報告。WHOがPHEIC(Public Health Emergency of International Concern)を5月17日に宣言済み。ブラジルの2症例は検査確認中であり、現段階では他の診断（髄膜炎、マラリア）が挙げられているが、エボラ除外診断が進行中。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はブラジルでの検査事例であり、ウガンダは背景情報のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: استنفار صحي في البرازيل بعد الاشتباه بحالتي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health alert in Brazil after two suspected Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Brazilian health authorities have isolated two men suspected of Ebola infection amid heightened precautions as Ebola continues to spread in parts of Africa. One man, who arrived from Uganda and is in Rio de Janeiro, initially presented with cough, chills, and diarrhea; malaria was confirmed and Ebola was ruled out, though he remains under medical observation during ongoing investigations. The second case involves a 37-year-old man who arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and is in Sao Paulo state with fever; tests identified an acute form of meningitis, while Ebola testing continues. Brazil's Health Ministry said the risk of transmission to Brazil and wider South America remains very low despite increased alert levels tied to outbreaks in Congo and Uganda. The Congo outbreak has caused hundreds of deaths with thousands of suspected cases, prompting WHO to declare a public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダとコンゴからの入国者がエボラ疑い症例として隔離 ブラジルで警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのエボラ疑い症例は既に除外されており、実際の症例ではない。ただしアフリカでのエボラ流行（コンゴ・ウガンダ）が進行中で、国際的な関心が高い状況のため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の疑い症例は既に除外された（マラリア確定、髄膜炎診断）。ただしコンゴ・ウガンダでの進行中のエボラ流行（数百人の死亡、数千人の疑い症例、WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済）が国際的文脈として存在。ブラジルへの伝播リスクは低いと当局評価。フルRRA不要だが続報監視は推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil monitors 2 patients for possible Ebola infection in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro
article.articleSummary: Two patients in Brazil are under monitoring for possible Ebola infection in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. As of 2026-06-01, São Paulo's health authorities report a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo with fever; he has been diagnosed with meningitis and is in serious condition. In Rio de Janeiro, a Belgian man who arrived from Uganda showed symptoms (cough, chills and diarrhoea) and has tested positive for malaria; authorities say he could still harbor Ebola. Safety protocols were activated and test results for both patients are expected next week. A confirmed Ebola case would be the first outside Africa since the outbreak that has affected DR Congo, which reports about 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths; Uganda has nine confirmed cases and one death. The strain involved is Bundibugyo; Ebola spreads by direct contact with bodily fluids, and bats are natural reservoirs.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、サンパウロとリオデジャネイロで2人の患者をエボラ感染の可能性で監視中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。エボラウイルスはアフリカ外での確認されれば歴史的な公衆衛生危機となる。
triage.notes: 記事はサンパウロとリオデジャネイロの2人の患者がエボラ感染の可能性で監視中と述べている。発生地域にDRC（203312）とウガンダが含まれているが、記事の主題はブラジルでの可能性のある症例の監視であるため、DRCとウガンダは確認された発生地ではなく、患者の渡航元・感染源の地域として記述されている。このため verified_locations はブラジル（3469034）のみとする。ブラジルでのエボラ確認は、アフリカ外での初の事例となる可能性があり、極めて高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: ผอ.อนามัยโลก "เปิดศูนย์รักษาอีโบลาแห่งใหม่" เผยมีผู้ติดเชื้อหายดีเพิ่มเป็น 5 ราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General opens a new Ebola treatment center, reveals recovered cases have risen to five.
article.articleSummary: June 1, 2026 — In the Democratic Republic of Congo's eastern Ituri Province, Bunia becomes the center of an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. A new Ebola Treatment Center opened in Bunia as five patients have recovered from Bundibugyo Ebola; four were discharged today and one yesterday. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus underscored ongoing work on vaccines and treatments, but stressed that recovery is possible with early care and community involvement. Official figures show 906 suspected Ebola infections and at least 223 suspected deaths; neighboring Uganda reports 9 infections and 1 death. MSF warns the outbreak is spreading faster than the response and calls for immediate expansion of testing, rapid aid deployment, and sustained access to medical supplies. Tedros reiterated that early medical care can stop transmission and that all citizens should participate in outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が新しいエボラ治療センターを開設、回復者が5人に増加したことを明らかに
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（高致死率）の確認と急速な拡大が報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」「国際拡大リスク（隣国ウガンダへの波及）」に複数該当。MSFが対応速度の不足を警告する懸念材料もあり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはウガンダも含まれていますが、記事サマリーではウガンダは「隣国」として二次的に言及されており、主な発生地はDRC東部のイトゥリ州ブニアです。DRCのみを verified_locations に含めます。エボラ（Bundibugyo strain）は高い致死性と感染性を持つ疾患であり、226人以上の死亡が報告されている点は極めて深刻です。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief rallies community in Congo's Ebola response | Honolulu Star-Advertiser
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, triggers intensified international response. On May 31, World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus toured the Evangelical Medical Center (CEM) to oversee containment efforts and coordinate the response as agencies ramp up activities to stop transmission. The Reuters report describes it as a new Ebola outbreak, with WHO leadership and field teams playing a central role in Bunia. No case or death counts are cited in the article. The published June 1, 2026 piece underscores ongoing public health mobilization around the Ituri outbreak, emphasizing coordination among international partners to support Congo's response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴのエボラ対応で地域社会に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）のDRC Ituri州での新規アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。WHOが現地対応を主導し、国際的な強化対応が進行中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain EBolaの新規アウトブレイク。記事では症例数・死亡数が明記されていないが、WHOの最高指導者による現地視察と国際的対応強化が述べられており、公衆衛生上の重大性が高い。DRCのIturi州Buniaが発生地域として特定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mistenkt ebolatilfelle i Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Brazil
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Brazil: A man from the Democratic Republic of Congo is isolated in São Paulo with fever amid suspicion of Ebola transmission; he has been diagnosed with severe meningitis, but it is not yet confirmed if Ebola is the cause. A Ugandan man is also isolated in Rio de Janeiro after showing virus-like symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea) but tested negative for Ebola; malaria has been confirmed, and isolation continues. Africa CDC reports 1,077 suspected Ebola cases in the ongoing outbreak, with 246 deaths. First cases were reported in the DRC, which on Sunday night raised confirmed cases to 282, including 42 deaths, and several cases have been reported in neighboring Uganda. Limited treatment and testing capacity in the region means the true number of infections may be higher, the WHO warns.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで疑い例のエボラ熱患者を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱という高リスク病原体の疑い例がブラジルで報告され、国際的な地理的拡大の懸念がある。同時にウガンダとコンゴでの活動的なアウトブレイクがあり、IHR基準3つ以上に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames IDがリスト内に見当たらないが、記事サマリーに明記されており文脈上重要。DRCでのアウトブレイク継続（282確定例、42死亡）とブラジル・ウガンダでの輸入症例は国際的拡大の実例を示唆。WHOの警告も記載。

article.articleHeadline: Congo expands Ebola testing as outbreak's real scale eludes officials
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 260 confirmed Ebola cases linked to the Bundibugyo strain, with Bunia identified as the epicenter. The outbreak has spread across more than a dozen health zones in three provinces. Uganda has recorded nine cases, including one death. International health organizations warn the epidemic could be spreading faster than responders can fully assess, noting hundreds of samples are still awaiting testing. In response, Congo is expanding testing to better estimate the outbreak's real scale. Health Minister Roger Kamba said U.S. health authorities will support the country's use of an experimental antibody treatment in a mid-stage trial to determine efficacy, calling the therapy promising. The expanded research and cross-border transmission underline the need for rapid containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ検査を拡大、感染拡大の実態が当局の把握を上回る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、確認された国際的な拡散（ウガンダへの越境感染）、高死亡率、検査待ち数百件の未確認症例があり、実感染数が報告数を大幅に上回る可能性が指摘されている。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境感染（9例、1死亡）も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo株による260確認症例、複数保健ゾーン・3州への拡大、実感染数が報告数を大幅に上回る可能性、検査待ち数百件が緊急度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la RDC et l'OMS intensifient la coordination de la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the DRC and the WHO intensify coordination of the outbreak response.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and the World Health Organization (WHO) intensified operational coordination, resource mobilization, and community engagement against Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo strain in the north‑east and east of the DRC. Cases continue to be reported in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, prompting strengthened surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, infection prevention, patient care, and active case and contact tracing, with equitable delivery of interventions. Community trust and leadership are essential, with dialogue among community leaders, youth and women’s groups, religious figures, and civil society to promote preventive measures such as handwashing, early health care, and reliable information sharing. The Bundibyo strain lacks an approved vaccine or specific treatment, but public health measures remain effective and clinical trials for candidate vaccines and treatments are underway, supported by Africa CDC, the UN system, and partners to interrupt transmission and bolster regional health security.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国とWHOが流行対応の調整を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）がDRCの複数州で継続的に発生しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）を満たすとともに、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、流行性、管理性）。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大シグナルとして、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病は、予防接種またはワクチンが承認されていないため、特に懸念される。DRCの複数地域（Ituri州、South Kivu州）での継続的な症例報告、並びにWHOとDRCの公式な調整強化は、シグナルの信頼性が高い。Africa CDC、国連システム、国際的パートナーが対応に関与しており、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Минздрав ДРК: Число подтвержденных случаев заражения вирусом Эбола превысило 280
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC Ministry of Health: The number of confirmed Ebola virus infection cases has exceeded 280
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo total 282. The outbreak is predominantly in Ituri Province with 264 cases, while North Kivu has 15 and South Kivu 3. There have been 42 deaths; 238 patients are under treatment and 2 have recovered. The DRC Ministry of Health officially declared the outbreak on 15 May. The disease is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain first identified in Uganda in 2007. The update underscores ongoing transmission, with most cases concentrated in Ituri Province, according to the Health Ministry via Report. The article does not mention vaccination status or any exported/imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国保健省：エボラウイルス感染確認症例数が280例を超過
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例282例、死亡42例という深刻な公衆衛生影響、複数州での発生という異常性、ウガンダでの株の歴史的背景による国際的拡大リスク、及び渡航制限リスクが認識される。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにUgandaが含まれているが、サマリーではUgandaは2007年の株の初期検出地として言及されるのみで、現在の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州）である。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとする。本イベントはフルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Một số bệnh nhân ở Congo hồi phục khi dịch Ebola lan ra nhiều nước
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Some patients in Congo recover as the Ebola outbreak spreads to many countries.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 282 confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain, with 5 recoveries (four nurses and a laboratory worker) and 19 new positives, signaling ongoing transmission. WHO has designated the Bundibugyo outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though it has not reached pandemic status; no licensed vaccine or treatment exists, but survival is possible with good medical care, per Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during a May visit to Bunia. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under regional investigation. The outbreak is the 17th in Congo and the third-largest since Ebola’s discovery. Imported/exported cases surface: Brazil (São Paulo) reports a fever patient from the DRC later diagnosed with meningitis, and Rio de Janeiro reports a suspected case with malaria; neither excludes Ebola. Italy (Cagliari, Sardinia) activated a response for a suspected Congo-return case.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの患者の一部が回復、エボラ流行が多くの国に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WHO が PHEIC 指定、複数国で輸入症例報告、コンゴでの継続的な感染伝播が確認されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: イタリア（カリャリ）での疑い例報告も記載されているが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC での継続的な新規発症（19名）と PHEIC 指定により、国際的な強い関心と支援体制が必要な状況である。ブンディブギョ型エボラは第17回目の流行で第3位の規模。

article.articleHeadline: 심상찮은 에볼라 확산세...아프리카서 감염 의심 사례 1100여명
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming Ebola spread... about 1,100 suspected infection cases in Africa.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo virus is spreading, with 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, centered in Ituri Province. As of May 30–31, about 1,100 people were under investigation for suspected infection, with an estimated 246 deaths among this group. Transmission occurs through contact with infected animals or humans; there is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo virus. A regional outbreak plan totaling $319 million has been prepared by DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. The Ituri outbreak was declared on May 15. Suspected imported cases have been reported in Brazil and Italy: two Brazilians returning from Congo and Uganda are in isolation, and one Italian patient is hospitalized. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced five recoveries, including four nurses, and emphasized ongoing vaccine and treatment development.

triage.headline_ja: 懸念される エボラの拡散... アフリカで感染疑い例が約1100人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、予想外の多数事例、国際的拡大の実績と明確なリスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPRO基準でも全項目該当。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルのリスク疾患であり、複数国での確認事例とワクチン・治療法の不在が重大な懸念。
triage.notes: DRCがイベントの主要発生地であり、ブンディブギョウイボラウイルスによる新規アウトブレイク。ウガンダとの地域的連携対応中。ブラジルとイタリアでの輸入症例は確認されたが、記事サマリーの詳細検証に基づき、対象国リスト内での実際のイベント発生地はDRCとブラジルのみに限定。イタリア（対象国外）での症例は検出に留める。282確認例、42死亡、1100人以上が調査対象という拡大規模は極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 확산세...민주콩고 등 아프리카 감염 의심 1천100명
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spread on the rise... 1,100 people in Africa suspected of infection, including the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola contagion is rising in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with about 1,100 suspected infections under investigation as of May 30. In the DRC, 282 laboratory-confirmed cases and 42 deaths have been reported. The outbreak is caused by the Ebola virus Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or therapy exists. Transmission occurs via contact with infected animals or people and can involve consuming contaminated animal meat; symptoms include fever, muscle pains, vomiting and diarrhea. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said that 1,100 people are being investigated and estimated up to 246 deaths. He urged nations to move at outbreak speed and cautioned against relying solely on external funding. International attention includes probable cases in Brazil and Italy: two in Brazil who had visited the DRC and Uganda, and one in Italy with travel history to Africa. Five people recovered, including four nurses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大中...民主コンゴなどアフリカで感染疑い1,100人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確定例282件・死亡42件、疑い例1,100件の報告。国際的拡大リスク高く（ブラジル、イタリアで輸入例），WHOが公式声明。対象国DRC内で急速な感染拡大が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはBrazil、Italy、Ugandaが含まれるが、これらは輸入例または接触者調査対象であり、実際の主要な発生地はDRC。DRC内での急速な感染拡大が記事の主題。エボラウイルスBundibugyo株による新興感染症イベント。ワクチン・治療薬が現在利用不可という深刻な状況。WHOが高いレベルでの対応を呼びかけている点から社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda shuts Congo border over Ebola surge
article.articleSummary: Uganda closed its border with the Democratic Republic of Congo for four weeks over an Ebola surge, with exceptions for humanitarian operations, security personnel, and essential cargo. Uganda reports seven confirmed Ebola Bundibugyo cases and one death; Congo’s Ituri province, the outbreak epicenter, has more than 900 suspected cases and over 220 deaths. Any cross-border entrants must undergo a mandatory 21-day self-isolation. The measure aims to strengthen public health protection and demonstrate containment leadership, but it disrupts cross-border trade and humanitarian supply chains along the Congo–Uganda corridor. The border closure tests East Africa’s emergency health infrastructure to contain a geographically expanding epidemic before it reaches Uganda’s densely populated interior.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ熱の急増に対してコンゴとの国境を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限）に該当し、エボラ出血熱という高リスク病原体による複数国での確認症例、死亡者、さらに国境閉鎖という政治的措置を伴う。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、国際的支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのイトゥリ州が震源地で900以上の疑い例と220人以上の死亡が報告されており、ウガンダでも7例の確認症例と1死亡が確認されている。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大の初期段階であり、迅速な対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Brésil: deux hommes présentant des symptômes possibles d'Ebola placés à l'isolement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil: two men with possible Ebola symptoms placed in isolation.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), a country with more than 100 million inhabitants. Two men—one from the DRC and one from Uganda—presented symptoms compatible with Ebola and were placed in isolation as a precaution. The report provides no confirmed case counts, laboratory results, or identified infection source. The situation underscores ongoing Ebola risk in the region and the authorities’ immediate containment response to suspected cases while awaiting diagnostic confirmation. No deaths or patient outcomes are mentioned in the excerpt. Published on June 1, 2026, the article centers on initial isolation actions rather than detailing outbreak scale or transmission dynamics, with no information on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル：エボラウイルスの可能性のある症状を示す2人の男性が隔離された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の疑い例報告は自動的にシグナル認識対象であり、DRCでの発生宣言と複数国への拡大懸念からフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはDRCとウガンダが記載されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ宣言と疑い例報告。ウガンダについては『1人がウガンダ出身』という個人属性の記述であり、ウガンダでの実際の発生地として扱わない。見出しと本文はブラジルでの隔離措置に言及しているが、サマリーではブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCは対象国リスト（203312）に含まれるため含める。

article.articleHeadline: Число официально подтверждённых случаев заражения Эболой в ДРК достигло 282
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of officially confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC has reached 282.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ministry of Health reports 282 officially confirmed Ebola cases. Ituri province has the vast majority with 264 cases; North Kivu and South Kivu report 15 and 3 cases respectively. The death toll stands at 42, with 2 recoveries and 238 patients under treatment. The update, cited by TASS, indicates the outbreak remains centered in Ituri. A Ugandan physician based in Kampala, Dr. Elijah Kiiza, claimed that Ebola deaths in Uganda exceed WHO figures. The figures underscore the geographic distribution and ongoing burden in eastern DRC, despite containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ確認患者数が282人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤な感染症であり、確認患者282人・死亡42人の大規模発生は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示すとともに、ウガンダへの拡大兆候があり国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダのカンパラの医師がウガンダでのエボラ死亡数に言及しているが、サマリーの主題は「DRCでの発生」であり、ウガンダでの実際の確認患者数や発生は明記されていない。したがってDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。エボラウイルス病は接触感染により拡大するため、地理的拡大リスク（隣国ウガンダへの拡大兆候）が高く、国際的対応が必要である。

article.articleHeadline: طبيب يحذر من ارتفاع وفيات الإيبولا في أوغندا وسط تضارب بالأرقام الرسمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor warns of rising Ebola deaths in Uganda amid discrepancies in official figures.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, a Kampala clinician says Ebola deaths in Uganda may exceed World Health Organization tallies, which list only one confirmed death. Field data suggest additional fatalities not yet in official counts, warning that the toll could rise as the outbreak continues. The WHO earlier declared the current outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with active Ebola foci in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo near Uganda’s border. Fears persist about cross-border spread amid surveillance and contact-tracing challenges in rural areas. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that conflict in eastern DRC severely hampers containment, calling for an immediate ceasefire as Ituri province’s outbreak overwhelms response capacity. Local authorities also reported a fresh Ebola outbreak amid concerns over rising deaths and difficulties containing it without improved security.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がウガンダのエボラ死亡数の増加に警告、公式統計に矛盾がある中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の死亡数不一致、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目全て該当。WHOが既に国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言しており、社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認フォーカスはDRC東部（Ituri州）に加えウガンダでも発症報告あり。公式死亡数（1名）と現地医療従事者による報告の不一致、国境越境伝播のリスク、紛争による対応阻害が複合的に存在。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。信頼性の高いシグナルであり、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, hantavirus: UAE residents urged to follow travel advisories amid global outbreaks
article.articleSummary: UAE authorities urge travelers amid Ebola and hantavirus outbreaks, advising against non-essential travel to Ebola-affected countries Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan. The National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority (NCEMA) and the Ministry of Health and Prevention (MoHAP) say the UAE’s public health situation remains stable, with active surveillance and readiness. UAE emphasizes preparedness, including monitoring and hospital infection-control training. Experts urge reliance on official guidance and warn against social-media rumours. Ebola is not airborne; transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of a symptomatic patient, with early symptoms such as fever, fatigue, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting and diarrhoea, and onset up to 21 days post-exposure. Hantavirus is also monitored. Travelers should check official advisories, practice good hygiene, carry sanitiser, stay hydrated, have travel insurance, and seek medical care promptly if symptoms arise during or after travel, informing clinicians of travel history.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、ハンタウイルス：世界的アウトブレイクの中、UAEの住民に渡航勧告に従うよう促告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な複数国での同時アウトブレイク（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）が確認され、IHR基準で国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が認められ、政府・国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラアウトブレイクが確認されている国はDRC、ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）、南スーダン（Republic of Sudan）。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。UAE（対象国外）はアウトブレイク報告国ではなく、渡航勧告を発出している国。記事配信日が2026年6月と未来日付のため、シミュレーション・予測情報の可能性があるが、内容は現実的なエボラ多国間アウトブレイク情報として評価。複数の高リスク国での同時流行は国際的な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Patient In Italy Hospital Awaits Test Results
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy, after a patient returned from Congo and became symptomatic; the patient is isolated in the Infectious Diseases department at Santissima Trinita hospital. Ebola samples were collected and sent to Rome by air ambulance for analysis by Spallanzani, Italy's National Institute for Infectious Diseases, with results expected to be reviewed on Sunday evening. The Ministry of Health is coordinating with Sardinia's local authorities and Spallanzani to monitor evolution; protective procedures have been activated at Is Mirrionis hospital. In response to the Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BVD strain) outbreak in Congo and neighboring Uganda, Italy is sending a team from Spallanzani to Congo to assist with outbreak response and strengthen monitoring and control. Prime Minister's Office urged Europe to boost border surveillance coordination with common rules for arrivals from affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア病院のエボラ患者、検査結果を待機中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴからの帰国者による疑い患者がイタリアで検出され、国際的な拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、および渡航制限リスクを示唆。IHR基準3つ該当。
triage.notes: イタリアはWPRO対象国ではないため、verified_locationsに含めない。記事の主題はコンゴのエボラ流行との関連で、イタリアは疑い患者の検出地点に過ぎない。コンゴでのBundibugyo Ebola virus (BVD strain)流行が主要な懸念。ウガンダも記事で言及されているが、主たるイベント発生地としての描写に欠けるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hơn 1.100 ca mắc sốt xuất huyết, Lâm Đồng kích hoạt các biện pháp phòng, chống dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,100 dengue fever cases; Lam Dong activates prevention and control measures.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Lam Dong Province, Vietnam, totals 1,126 cases with 10 active outbreaks as of 27 May 2026, including 48 new cases in week 21. Hotspots span Đạ Huoai, Bảo Lộc, Di Linh, Tánh Linh, Đức Linh and Bắc Bình. Although the count eases modestly vs. last year, vector indices exceed risk thresholds ahead of the rainy season, prompting intensified control. The Department of Health mandates rapid outbreak containment: 100% of outbreaks resolved within 48 hours of identification, coupled with integrated measures—larval source reduction, adult mosquito spraying, environmental hygiene campaigns, and ongoing vector surveillance pre- and post-intervention. Weekly larval-control campaigns in outbreak areas, and biweekly activities during peak months (April–November). Health facilities should bolster surge capacity and early detection of warning signs. Community mobilization is emphasized through local authorities and groups (Women’s Union, Youth League, police) to eliminate breeding sites, invert water containers, cover tanks, and promote personal protection against mosquitoes.

triage.headline_ja: 1,100件以上のデング熱患者、ラムドン省が予防・対策措置を発動
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのラムドン省におけるデング熱の多数症例報告（1,126件）は、IHR基準「異常性」および「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」に該当。WPRO基準では「重症度（複数ホットスポット、10個の活発なアウトブレイク）」「流行しやすさ（ベクター指数がリスク閾値を超過、雨季前）」に合致し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ラムドン省（Tỉnh Lâm Đồng）が記事の主要な発生地域。複数の地区（Đạ Huoai、Bảo Lộc、Di Linh等）で同時多発的なアウトブレイクが確認されている。ベクター指数（蚊の幼虫指数）がリスク閾値を超過しており、雨季到来前の拡大リスクが高い。政府レベルでの対応措置（48時間以内の封じ込め目標、媒介生物対策、地域動員等）が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR CONGO-BUNIA-EBOLA-PATIENTS-RECOVERY
article.articleSummary: Five patients infected with Ebola Bundibugyo virus have recovered in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Four of the recovered patients are medical workers discharged from an Ebola treatment center in Bunia after testing negative twice for Ebola; another patient, a laboratory worker, had already returned home, according to the DRC's National Institute of Public Health. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia on May 31, 2026, amid ongoing outbreak response efforts. The updates come as the international health community monitors the situation in Ituri Province. The five recoveries mark a positive step in Bunia's outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国ブニア：エボラ患者5名が回復
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の発生がIturi州で継続中であり、IHR基準3つ以上該当。国際的な健康関心（WHO事務局長の現地訪問）も高く、国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスBundibugyo型は致死的な病原体であり、記事中で「ongoing outbreak response efforts」と述べられており、現在も発生が継続中。WHO事務局長による5月31日の現地訪問は国際的な関心の高さを示唆。医療従事者の感染・回復も報告されており、医療システムへの潜在的脅威あり。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Gerak Cepat Pemkab Bolmong Tekan Risiko DBD di Wilayah Terdampak Banjir Bandang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bolaang Mongondow Regency Government's Rapid Response to Curb Dengue Fever Risk in Areas Affected by Flash Floods
article.articleSummary: After floods in Bolaang Mongondow Regency, North Sulawesi, Indonesia, health authorities launched an aggressive dengue prevention campaign. On May 31, 2026, the Bolmong Health Office conducted mass fogging in flooded settlements, including Solimandungan Satu and Solimandungan Dua in Bolaang district, to interrupt Aedes mosquito breeding. A six-member rapid-response team surveyed remaining floodwater and carried out vector control, while health workers promoted Clean and Healthy Living Behaviors (PHBS) to residents, urging them to drain standing water, tightly cover drinking water storage, and remove debris that could harbor mosquitoes. Dengue fever (DBD) is the primary concern, but officials warned of other post-disaster risks such as diarrhea, acute respiratory infections (ISPA), skin diseases, and leptospirosis. Residents were advised to seek medical care if fever, diarrhea, or cough develops after the floods. The emergency response aligns with a 14-day disaster emergency status for floods and flash floods from May 27 to June 9, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ボラアン・モンゴンドウ県政府による洪水被害地域のデング熱リスク抑制への迅速な対応
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア北スラウェシ州における洪水後のデング熱およびレプトスピラ症のリスク増加が報告されており、ベクター対策と啓発活動が展開されている。ただし現在のところ確定症例数や死亡報告がないため、IHR基準は明確には満たされていない。追加情報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 洪水による蚊の繁殖環境増加がデング熱とレプトスピラ症のリスク要因となっている。当局が積極的な媒介者対策と住民啓発を実施中。確定症例・死亡数が記事に記載されていないため、重症度は現在不明。今後の症例報告に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള: മൂന്നു രാജ്യങ്ങളിലേക്ക് യാത്ര ഒഴിവാക്കണം | Ebola: Avoid travel to three countries
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Avoid travel to three countries.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, this UAE travel advisory states that, amid the Ebola virus disease situation, UAE citizens and residents should avoid travel to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and the Republic of South Sudan unless travel is essential. The guidance from the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs reflects ongoing Ebola-related public health concerns in those countries and seeks to minimize exposure for travelers departing the UAE. Those already present in these nations are urged to exercise extreme caution and to strictly follow health-safety guidelines. The report does not provide any case counts, symptoms, or laboratory confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：3カ国への渡航を回避すべき
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国での継続的な発生に関する公式渡航勧告であり、IHR基準（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はUAEの渡航勧告であり、ウガンダとスーダンでのエボラ発生も言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。具体的な症例数は不記載だが、複数国での継続的なエボラ発生状況を示す公式政府渡航勧告として、国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC says over 1,100 suspected Ebola cases in Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: 263 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as of Saturday, with 43 confirmed deaths. More than 1,100 suspected Ebola cases remain under investigation in these two countries. Africa CDC director-general Jean Kaseya disclosed the figures in a Financial Times editorial, noting ongoing activity in the outbreak across the cross-border region. On the preceding Thursday, Africa CDC had reported 246 suspected deaths from Ebola. The data underscore a continuing cross-border situation between DRC and Uganda, with a substantial number of suspected cases awaiting confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがコンゴとウガンダでの疑い例を含む1,100例以上のエボラ患者が存在すると報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は最高度のリスク病原体であり、263確認患者、43死亡、1,100以上の疑い例、国境を越えた拡大という状況は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクのいずれもが顕著。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダ両国での発生が記載されているが、対象国はDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱は致死率が極めて高く、国境を越えた拡大が確認されている点で国際的関心も極めて高い。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: عدد المشتبه بإصابتهم بفيروس إيبولا يتجاوز 1100 في الكونغو وأوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people suspected of being infected with the Ebola virus exceeds 1,100 in Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Over 1,100 people are suspected of Ebola virus infection in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 246 deaths reported. In Brazil, two men have been isolated as suspected Ebola cases: a 37-year-old traveler from the DRC in São Paulo state, and another man from Uganda quarantined in Rio de Janeiro. The São Paulo patient, who presented with fever meeting suspected-case criteria, was later diagnosed with an acute meningitis, but Ebola testing remains ongoing. The Rio de Janeiro case, who arrived from Uganda on May 22 and showed viral symptoms such as cough, chills, and diarrhea, tested positive for malaria; Ebola status remains under investigation. Authorities say the risk of transmission to Brazil and South America remains very low while investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダでエボラウイルス感染が疑われる人数が1,100人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外性）。DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行（246死亡）は重大で、ブラジルへの輸入事例確認は国際的拡大の初期兆候。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダも流行地として明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルの輸入事例（DRC渡航者、ウガンダからの渡航者）は対象国リストに含まれるため含める。エボラ流行の主要発生地はDRC・ウガンダであり、DRCのみが対象国に該当。

article.articleHeadline: WHO calls for ceasefire to contain Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo attributed to a rare strain; the World Health Organization has called for an immediate ceasefire to enable humanitarian access and outbreak containment. As of 1 June 2026, nearly 1,000 suspected Ebola cases have been reported with more than 100 deaths. Uganda closed its border with Congo yesterday, contrary to WHO guidance that border closures could push people into informal crossings and raise cross-border transmission risk. The article emphasizes urgent public health response and access to care, but provides no laboratory confirmation details, symptoms, or identified infection source. No further information on imported/exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク抑制のための停戦を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱による約1,000件の疑い患者・100名以上の死亡が報告されており、ウガンダの国境閉鎖により政治的緊張も高まっている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体。記事ではウガンダの国境閉鎖が言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの発生。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。WHOの人道的アクセス要請と軍事紛争との関連性が抑制困難性を示唆。laboratory confirmation欠落も懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള: ജാഗ്രതയിൽ ബ്രസീൽ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Brazil on alert.
article.articleSummary: Brazil on alert as a person suspected of Ebola is under observation in São Paulo after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient, who had feverish symptoms, is in isolation; if tests confirm Ebola, it would be Brazil's first-ever case. The outbreak origin remains in Congo, with confirmed transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda totaling over 1,030 cases and more than 240 deaths. No cases have been confirmed outside Congo and Uganda. The circulating strain is the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there are no vaccines, no specific treatments, and no rapid diagnostic tests currently.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ブラジルが警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス疾患という重篤な感染症の国境越え疑い事例であり、ブラジルで初症例となる可能性があるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い患者がDRC滞在歴ありでブラジル・サンパウロで隔離中。ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、記事サマリー上での主題はDRCとブラジルのため、ウガンダは除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・特異的治療・迅速診断法なし）という予防手段の限定的な現況が懸念を増す。

article.articleHeadline: البرازيل تعزل رجلين يُشتبه بإصابتهما بفيروس إيبولا... - الوكيل الإخباري
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil isolates two men suspected of being infected with the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Brazilian authorities isolated two men suspected of Ebola: one arrived from Uganda, the other from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The Ugandan-arrival, who entered Brazil on May 22, developed feverish, flu-like symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea). Health officials later reported malaria positive and Ebola negative, though he remains isolated during ongoing testing. In Sao Paulo state, a 37-year-old man who had traveled from the DRC—where a new Ebola wave is reported—exhibited fever and symptoms meeting the suspected-Ebola case definition and was quarantined at an infectious-disease institute. He was subsequently diagnosed with acute meningitis; Ebola testing continues. The health ministry states the overall risk of transmission to Brazil and South America is very low. The report also notes active Ebola activity in the DRC’s eastern region and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、エボラウイルス感染の疑いがある2人の男性を隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。対象国ブラジルにおける複数の疑い事例、DRC発症例の報告、国際的な人の移動を伴うため、シグナルとして識別する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダに由来する症例についても言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはリストに含まれ、記事で新規エボラ波が報告されている重要な発生地として記述されている。ブラジルでの症例は複数の疑い例（マラリア陽性、急性髄膜炎確定）を含む。エボラ検査は継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil.- El congoleño hospitalizado en Brasil con síntomas de ébola...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil - The Congolese man hospitalized in Brazil with Ebola symptoms.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil — A 37-year-old man from the Congo, hospitalized at the Emílio Ribas Institute in São Paulo with Ebola-like symptoms, has tested positive for meningococcal meningitis by blood PCR but remains isolated as Ebola investigations continue. The patient reportedly traveled recently from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the Ebola outbreak has caused 43 deaths and over 263 confirmed cases; Uganda has reported positives and one death. A second case in Rio de Janeiro concerns a Belgian national who had been in Uganda. He presents viral symptoms but has been diagnosed with malaria; he remains isolated while Ebola testing proceeds. Brazil’s Rio de Janeiro health authorities activated the Ebola protocol, transferring him to the Evandro Chagas National Institute of Infectious Diseases for further testing to rule out Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル - エボラ様症状でブラジルに入院したコンゴ人がメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎で陽性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当。複数の高リスク感染症（エボラ、メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎）の同時報告、DRCからの最近の渡航歴、複数国への国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダでもエボラ確認、ベルギー人患者の存在）により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブラジル（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）での患者報告が主題。DRCおよびウガンダはエボラ流行の発生地として言及されているが、本イベント報告の主体はブラジルでの患者診断である。したがってverified_locationsはBrazilのみ。複数疾患の同時検出（メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎確定、エボラ検査進行中、マラリア）および高い死亡率を伴うDRCエボラ流行との関連性が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Posible caso de ébola activa protocolos de aislamiento en Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible active Ebola case: isolation protocols in Italy.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease precautionary case in Italy: Health authorities activated containment protocols after a man in Cagliari, Sardinia, was suspected of possible Ebola infection and isolated in a hospital, with Spallanzani hospital in Rome coordinating. The patient had returned from Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an outbreak is ongoing, arriving in Rome then flying to Sardinia. He reported fever and mild cough during a couple of days after the flight. He remains in isolation, and officials say the risk of Ebola in Italy remains very low. Investigations continue to determine exposure and status; no confirmed case has been declared. The case underscores cross-border vigilance amid an active DRC outbreak, with monitoring by local health authorities and the hospital.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアでエボラ疑い患者が発生し、隔離プロトコルが発動
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の疑い患者がDRCの活動的アウトブレイクから国際渡航により検出された。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク、および予想外の事象である。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 患者がDRCの活動的アウトブレイク地域（Kinshasa）から国際渡航（ローマ経由でサルデーニャ到着）で検出された疑い患者である。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないが、発生源はDRCの確認されたアウトブレイクであり、国際的な感染症の移動を示す重要なシグナル。確定症例は未だ宣言されていないが、DRCの活動的アウトブレイクに関連した国際的な懸念事案として優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疑似病例擴及非洲外 巴西、義大利接連通報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola suspected cases spread outside Africa; Brazil and Italy report in quick succession.
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected cases outside Africa rise as Brazil and Italy report possible infections while Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri) and Uganda remain hotspots. As of May 31, WHO Secretary-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the hardest-hit Ituri province amid containment efforts. In Brazil, two suspected cases: a São Paulo man who returned from the DRC with fever and a positive meningitis test—he is isolated and under investigation; a Rio de Janeiro Belgian man who had traveled to Uganda tested positive for malaria, with other illnesses later diagnosed. Italy also reported a suspected case. WHO cautions the global spread risk remains low but ongoing monitoring for non-African cases continues. Ebola reservoirs include wildlife, notably fruit bats, with human transmission via blood, secretions and other body fluids; MSF warns of unusually high case numbers early in the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス疑似病例がアフリカ外に拡大 ブラジル、イタリアが相次いで報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルスの国際的な疑似症例報告であり、未確認だが国外拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響の可能性がある。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供した発生地域には欧州（Italy）が含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事サマリーでUgandaが言及されているが対象国外のため除外。DRCとBrazilの疑似症例が確認されており、これが対象国内での実際の発生地点。WHOが国外拡大リスク「低い」と評価しているが、複数国での疑似症例報告と高ウイルス性からIHR基準4項目全て該当と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Footprint Widens as Officials Race to Gauge Epidemic's True Scale
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, Congo's Ebola outbreak in the conflict-hit eastern region is widening as health authorities struggle to trace exposed contacts and determine the epidemic's true scale. The apparent geographic footprint has expanded to 22 affected health zones. Response challenges reflect insecurity and strained health capacity, hampering surveillance and data collection. Officials are racing to map transmission chains, confirm cases in laboratories, and quantify deaths while the outbreak's total burden remains uncertain. The spread to more zones indicates potential broader transmission beyond initial hotspots, complicating efforts to allocate resources and implement containment measures. Ongoing case finding, contact tracing, and laboratory confirmation are critical to understanding the outbreak's scope and guiding public health responses in eastern Congo.
