triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染域が拡大、当局が流行規模の把握に奔走
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が複数健康ゾーン（22ゾーン）に拡大しており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニングでも「重症度」「流行可能性」「管理可能性」に複数該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年6月現在のコンゴ東部エボラ流行。感染域が22ヘルスゾーンへ拡大、接触者追跡と確認検査が困難な状況。武力紛争地域での対応課題が多く、死亡数を含む流行規模が不明確。国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）5名埃博拉患者痊愈 _光明网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Ebola patients have recovered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola patients have recovered in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. By May 29, the DRC had cumulative 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths. By May 31, five patients in Bunia had recovered, with Ebola treatment centers and isolation measures in place as the eastern outbreak continues. On May 31, World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to assess the situation. The report underscores ongoing transmission in Ituri Province, highlighting a persistent outbreak despite progress in patient recoveries and continued international/public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者5名が回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでの継続的なエボラ流行、263例の確認患者、42名の死亡、WHO事務局長による現地視察など、重大性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行の継続的な状況を報告。263例の累積患者、42名の死亡、イトゥリ州での持続的な感染が確認されている。WHO事務局長による現地視察は国際的な関心の高さを示す。患者5名の回復は進展を示すが、流行は続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев заражения Эболой в ДРК достигло 282 // Новости НТВ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC has reached 282.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have risen to 282, with 264 in Ituri Province, 15 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu. Of the 282 cases, 42 have died, 238 are currently receiving treatment, and 2 have recovered. The Ministry of Health provides the nationwide tally and provincial distribution. The outbreak is occurring in the DRC and Uganda, reflecting cross-border transmission concerns. The World Health Organization previously characterized the event as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though not a pandemic; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus later expressed concern about the speed and scale of spread. The high concentration of cases in Ituri highlights an ongoing active transmission with significant burden on health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定患者数が282人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの確定患者282人、死亡42人、DRC・ウガンダでの国際的拡大、WHO PHEIC指定済みで渡航制限リスク高い。
triage.notes: エボラはフィロウイルス科の最高リスク病原体。DRCはサマリーで明確に主題となっており、ウガンダも言及されているが、詳細な患者情報はDRCに集中。WHOによるPHEIC認定済みで既に国際的対応が進行中。死亡率（14.9%）と患者数の急速な増加が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 78岁老人开空调过夜肺变白了 警惕军团菌感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 78-year-old man left the air conditioner on overnight; his lungs turned white. Be vigilant for Legionella infection.
article.articleSummary: Legionella pneumophila–associated pneumonia is linked to poorly cleaned air conditioning units in China as temperatures rise. A 78-year-old woman developed high fever and severe cough after sleeping with an uncleaned AC since winter; imaging showed extensive right-lung consolidation. Bronchoalveolar lavage confirmed Legionella pneumophila, and targeted therapy led to improvement. In Wuhan, 32-year-old Mr. Zhang had fever, muscle pain and a dry cough after three days of using a dormant AC; diagnosed with Legionella pneumonia and recovered after treatment. A Beijing–Shenzhen survey found 88% of residential AC cooling fins exceeded bacterial standards (≈40x) and 84% exceeded mold standards. In Hunan, a driver using an unclean car AC also developed Legionella pneumonia. The report urges vigilance for Legionella infection in pneumonia patients with AC exposure and stresses regular cleaning of AC systems.

triage.headline_ja: 78歳の老人がエアコンを一晩つけっぱなしにして肺が白くなった 軍団菌感染に警戒を
triage.triage_reason: レジオネラ症は既知の感染症であり、複数の地域での散発事例の報告である。情報不足により重症度・疫学的意義の全体像が不明確なため、段階的な評価が必要。
triage.notes: レジオネラ症は季節性・環境由来の既知感染症であり、IHR基準2つ以上には達しないが、WPROスクリーニング基準では3項目が該当（重症度・環境曝露の継続性・流行しやすさ）。中国内の複数地域（武漢、北京、シンゼン、湖南等）での報告で地理的広がりを示すが、クラスターの確認や公衆衛生当局の介入状況が記載されていない。エアコン清掃不十分による環境汚染が根本原因と指摘されており、管理可能性は高いと考えられるが、高齢者や免疫低下患者への影響が懸念される。続報で症例数増加傾向や公式な公衆衛生対応の有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo dan Kebijakan Sekolah Tetap Buka
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak in Kongo and Policy for Schools to Remain Open
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, the Democratic Republic of Congo faces an Ebola outbreak, with the government deciding not to close schools despite the health crisis. Health Minister Roger Kamba said education would continue, with preventive measures to curb transmission, so children are not penalized twice. The announcement, reported by Anadolu Agency, signals a policy to keep schools open while boosting infection control and surveillance in educational settings. No case counts or specific cities are provided in the report. The stance reflects a priority on educational continuity during an Ebola outbreak rather than shutting down schools, aligning public health precautions with ongoing learning.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行と学校開放政策
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生報告であり、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク・異常性に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では高い重症度と流行可能性を示唆。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは具体的な患者数や発生地域の詳細が不記載。エボラ出血熱の報告そのものが極めて深刻な感染症であるため、詳細情報不足でもピックアップ判定は妥当。学校開放方針は感染制御の観点から注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lo speleologo bloccato a oltre 100 metri, caso sospetto di Ebola in Italia, nuovi scioperi e le altre notizie da sapere per iniziare la giornata
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The speleologist trapped more than 100 meters underground, a suspected Ebola case in Italy, new strikes, and other news you need to know to start the day.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy: an Italian citizen of Congolese origin developed Ebola-like symptoms after returning from Congo. The patient was picked up by 118 and transported to Santissima Trinità hospital for evaluation; samples will be examined by the Spallanzani Institute. World Health Organization data indicate the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is continuing to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths reported in the DRC to date. This incident highlights ongoing regional Ebola activity as of June 1, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 洞窟探検家が地下100メートル以上に閉じ込められている、イタリアでエボラの疑い例、新たなストライキなど、一日を始めるために知っておく必要があるニュース
triage.triage_reason: イタリアでのエボラ疑い例はIHR基準を複数満たし（異常性、国際的懸念）、WPROスクリーニング基準も該当する（異常/予想外、重症度リスク、管理可能性の疑問）。DRC・ウガンダでの継続的な流行と関連し、国際的なシグナル価値がある。
triage.notes: イタリアでのエボラ疑い例は記事の一要素であり、主要な流行はDRC・ウガンダで継続中。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはイタリアが含まれているが、対象国リストに無いため verified_locations からは除外。DRCは対象国であり、Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイク継続の報告があるため重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: México se blinda por casos de ébola ante el Mundial de Fútbol
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico braces for Ebola cases ahead of the FIFA World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Mexico, the United States, and Canada coordinate Ebola surveillance ahead of the FIFA World Cup, deploying airport screening, enhanced review of travel itineraries, and exposure checks before boarding with ongoing surveillance for suspected cases. Temporary entry bans apply to international travelers who have recently been in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan; a 21‑day isolation for contacts is required before travel, though the DR Congo team is exempt as they’re already isolated in Belgium. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports over 900 suspected cases and more than 220 deaths; Uganda reports six cases and one death. Ten African countries are considered at risk per the African Union. WHO warns the outbreak is extremely grave; Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no approved vaccines, unlike Zaire ebolavirus. The DR Congo team will base in Houston with matches in Houston, Guadalajara, and Atlanta; Viva Aerobús imposed a 60‑day travel ban starting May 28 for travelers from those countries.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコはFIFAワールドカップを前にエボラ患者に備える
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での流行対応であり、IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクに該当。WHOの警告と複数国での検査実施が確認され、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはメキシコ、米国、カナダ、スーダン、ウガンダ、ベルギーが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC内での流行とその国際的対応であり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダ、スーダン、ベルギーは対象国リストに含まれていない。米国はDRCからの輸入症例対応だが、記事の主要な感染症イベントはDRC内での流行。エボラウイルス病はIHRで通報対象疾患であり、複数の重症死亡と国際的な旅行制限措置から判定はPICKUP。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疑似病例擴及非洲外 巴西、義大利接連通報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola suspected cases spread beyond Africa; Brazil and Italy report in succession.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, Ebola virus disease remains centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with Brazil and Italy reporting suspected cases in succession. In Brazil, a man returning from the DRC to São Paulo developed fever and meningitis and is isolated; meningitis testing was positive, but Ebola confirmation awaits further testing. A second case in Rio de Janeiro, a Belgian national who had travelled to Uganda, tested positive for malaria; officials note other diseases do not exclude Ebola and investigations continue. Italy had earlier reported suspected cases. The WHO still regards global spread as unlikely but will monitor non-African suspected cases. MSF warned of unprecedented early-case numbers. The outbreak response is led by WHO Director-General Tedros with a visit to Ituri Province, DRC. Ebola persists in wildlife reservoirs (notably fruit bats) with human transmission via bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑似病例がアフリカ外に拡大 ブラジル、イタリアが相次いで報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。確定例ではなく疑似例だが、複数国での報告と対象国（DRC、ブラジル）での発生により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月1日付（未来日時）で、DRCとウガンダでのエボラウイルス病の流行中にブラジルとイタリアで疑似例が報告されたという内容。対象国リストからはDRCとブラジルのみが verified_locations に該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。イタリアも対象国外のため除外。現時点での確定例はないが、WHOが注視している状況を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: À Bunia, quatre malades ont réussi à vaincre le variant Bundibugyo et à retrouver la santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: In Bunia, four patients have managed to overcome the Bundibugyo variant and regain their health.
article.articleSummary: Four healthcare workers in Bunia, Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, have recovered from the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, raising the total survivors to five in the current outbreak. The patients were treated symptomatically with a combination of antibiotics and other drugs used as if addressing malaria, as there is no vaccine or approved therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola. They were among those infected by the virus now under control, with their recovery celebrated during a visit by WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who praised frontline workers. Hospitalization began around May 16 for 10 days, and one nurse described the ordeal and the loss of colleagues. While the sign of progress provides hope that the outbreak can be stopped, health teams emphasise the need for a vaccine and approved treatments to break transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のブニアでエボラ出血熱：4人の患者がブンディブギョ型の克服に成功し、健康を回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当（重症度、流行のしやすさ、管理可能性）。エボラ出血熱は国際的に懸念される第一級の感染症であり、WHOトップによる現地視察も報じられている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（EBOV）のブンディブギョ株（BDBV）の発生。記事はDRC東部イトゥリ州ブニアで4人の回復例を報じており、ワクチンおよび承認された治療法の欠如が継続的な課題として強調されている。WHO事務局長による現地視察が報じられており、国際的関心が高い。本アウトブレイクの管理可能性に対する懸念があり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: ''백신도, 치료제도 없다''...민주콩고서 에볼라 감염의심 1,100건
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "There is neither a vaccine nor a treatment" ... 1,100 suspected Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), including eastern Ituri Province where declared May 15, continues with a high suspected-case load. As of May 31, about 1,100 people are under investigation for Ebola infection; 282 laboratory-confirmed cases in the DRC and 42 deaths reported. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who visited the DRC, notes around 1,100 suspected infections under scrutiny with an estimated 246 deaths. Five people have recovered, including four nurses. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Ebola virus (ebolavirus) yet. Transmission occurs via contact with infected animals or humans; symptoms include fever, myalgia, vomiting, and diarrhea. Uganda and South Sudan, alongside the DRC, have proposed a $319 million regional outbreak plan. Suspected cases have also been reported in Brazil (two travelers who visited DRC/Uganda) and Italy (one traveler) after travel to Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 「ワクチンも、治療薬もない」...民主コンゴでエボラ感染疑い1,100件
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模発生であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。確認患者282名、死亡42名、疑似患者1,100名で、国際的な感染報告（ブラジル、イタリア）があり、WHOも対応中。
triage.notes: イタリアはAPI発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに無いため除外。スーダンおよびウガンダは発生地域に列挙されているがサマリーではウガンダが地域計画への参加国として言及されており、直接的なEVD発生の報告がないため除外。本事例は明らかなシグナルであり、フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: У двох великих містах Бразилії спостерігають за хворими, в яких виявили схожі на вірус Ебола симптоми
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In two major Brazilian cities, they are monitoring patients with symptoms similar to those of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, health authorities in Brazil are monitoring two patients in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro for possible Ebola virus disease (EVD). In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo presented with fever and Ebola-like symptoms; initial tests were negative, but he remains isolated in a specialized infectious disease facility as a precaution. In Rio de Janeiro, officials activated safety protocols after a man from Uganda exhibited Ebola-like symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea); the city later reported the patient tested positive for malaria, with the case kept under control. São Paulo authorities stressed that despite suspicions, medical assessments indicate the risk of Ebola infection in Brazil and South America remains very low. MSF has warned that the speed of Ebola spread is deeply concerning.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの2つの大都市でエボラウイルスに似た症状の患者を監視中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の国際的な懸念事例（患者がDRC・ウガンダからの渡航者）であり、IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスク、ならびにWPRO基準の異常性・管理可能性が該当。社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、患者はDRC・ウガンダからの渡航者であり、ブラジルでエボラ様症状で監視されている。1例は陰性、1例はマラリア確定だが、引き続きエボラの可能性を考慮した対応が取られている。MSFの警告も記載されており、国際的懸念が高い。ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めず、DRCとブラジルのみ列挙。フルのRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: À Bunia, quatre malades ont réussi à vaincre le variant Bundibugyo et à retrouver la santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: In Bunia, four patients have managed to overcome the Bundibugyo variant and regain their health.
article.articleSummary: Four healthcare workers infected with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in Bunia, Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, have recovered, bringing total survivors to five in the current outbreak. Despite the absence of a vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, these patients received symptomatic care—antibiotics and other drugs used for malaria—and were hospitalized, with one case spanning ten days of care starting on May 16. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa, hailed the recoveries as a hopeful sign that the outbreak can be stopped and thanked frontline health workers for their sacrifices. The recoveries were documented at the Bunia Evangelical Medical Center, underscoring the urgent need for a vaccine and approved therapies to interrupt transmission and curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：ブニアで、4人の患者がブンディブギョ亜種を克服して健康を取り戻した
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクがDRCで発生しており、IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、WHO事務局長による現地視察など高い国際的関心がある。
triage.notes: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクはDRC東部イトゥリ州ブニアで確認。4人のヘルスワーカーが回復したことは報告されているが、アウトブレイク自体は継続中。WHO事務局長がキンシャサを訪問し、復興を「有望な兆し」と評価。ワクチンと承認された治療法の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: 巴西疑似伊波拉病例增至二 一人检测呈阴但仍须隔离
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola cases in Brazil rise to two; one person tested negative but still under quarantine.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province (Djugu district), a man died from Ebola, with Red Cross personnel disinfecting his home on May 24 before body removal. Africa CDC notes that since May 15, DR Congo has reported over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and about 250 deaths. Brazil reports two imported cases under quarantine with Ebola-like symptoms. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man who recently traveled to the Congo developed fever and other signs and was isolated at the Instituto de Infectologia; he has been diagnosed with severe meningitis and is undergoing Ebola screening. In Rio de Janeiro, another 37-year-old man who arrived from Uganda on May 22 exhibited cough, chills, and diarrhea; malaria tested positive, while Ebola testing was negative but he remains isolated pending investigation. Brazilian authorities emphasize ongoing assessment; no confirmed Ebola transmission in Brazil. Uganda, neighboring DR Congo, has reported infections and a death."}

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの疑似エボラ病例が2件に増加；1人は検査で陰性だが依然隔離中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。アフリカのエボラ大流行に伴う国際的な二次感染リスクの警告シグナル。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州での活動的なエボラ流行（1,000件以上の疑似症例、約250死亡）が背景。ブラジルへの症例輸入は、アフリカ-南米間の渡航リンクを示す国際的リスク。ウガンダも隣接地域での感染報告。マラリア陽性例も含まれるが、主論点はエボラの国際的拡散懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Cộng đồng Đông Phi họp khẩn để phối hợp ứng phó dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East African Community holds emergency meeting to coordinate the Ebola outbreak response
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, 263 Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases have been confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with over 1,100 suspected cases under verification and 43 deaths, all linked to the Bundibugyo strain. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya calls for rapid activation of national emergency mechanisms and sustained, long‑term epidemic preparedness, noting international support is most effective when aligned with African strategies. The outbreak is the 17th major EVD event in the DRC, centered in Ituri province in the east, a high‑mobility area raising cross‑border risk. The East African Community will hold emergency meetings on June 1–2 to coordinate regional response, including nine mobile laboratories at borders, a rapid‑response team of 180+ experts, enhanced infection prevention, and expedited vaccine/diagnostic approvals with WHO and ACDC. Brazil reports two imported cases: a 37‑year‑old man recently from the DRC in São Paulo with fever and suspected Ebola (testing underway); and another man in Rio de Janeiro linked to Uganda, malaria‑positive and under investigation. Overall risk to Brazil/South America is very low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイク対応を調整するための東アフリカ共同体による緊急会議
triage.triage_reason: 確認症例263例、死亡43例を伴う活発なエボラ出血熱の多国間アウトブレイク。国際的拡大リスク（ブラジルへの輸入症例2例）、国境を越えた高リスク地域、地域レベルの公式な緊急対応開始により、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでも確認症例があると明記されているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルは輸入症例（São Paulo、Rio de Janeiro）が確認されているため含める。DRCはIturi州中心地で国境地域の高流動性が確認され、国際的拡大リスク高。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Patients Recover From Rare Ebola Strain, WHO Chief Says
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from a rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, WHO confirming on May 31. The first recovery was released on Friday, with four more scheduled for release on Sunday. As of May 30, at least 43 deaths and 263 people infected with the Bundibugyo strain are reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, while Africa CDC records more than 1,100 additional cases under investigation. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain; clinicians report that symptomatic treatment can support recovery. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus attended the opening of a Ebola treatment center in Bunia, DRC, urging patients to seek care early. Dr. Davin Ambitapio and Pierre Akilimali expressed optimism about controlling the outbreak with support. In 2014–2015, convalescent plasma transfusions were used experimentally, per National Library of Medicine, and Uganda allowed exemptions for authorized Ebola response teams and essential operations under health screening.

triage.headline_ja: 5人の患者が稀なエボラ株から回復、WHO事務局長が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（43死亡、263人感染）、異常・予想外な発生、国際的拡大リスク（DRC/ウガンダ）の3項目が該当。複数国での発生と未承認治療による医療対応の課題があり、フルRRA進行の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事内で患者発生地として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。Bundibugyo株エボラは稀な株であり、治療法・ワクチンなしという深刻な状況。WHOの高レベル対応（事務局長の現地視察）が既に開始されている。アフリカCDCによる1,100以上の追加調査中ケースについても、より詳細な情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉疫情5人康復　巴西義大利現疑似病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five people have recovered from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; suspected cases reported in Brazil and Italy.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports five Ebola recoveries in Bunia, Ituri Province, DR Congo: four healthcare workers and a laboratory staff member have recovered. DR Congo’s total Ebola cases rise to 282 with 42 deaths after 19 new confirmed cases. The outbreak—the 17th in DR Congo and the third-largest since discovery—has spread beyond capacity, with Africa CDC noting over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. In May, WHO designated the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, alongside Uganda. Abroad, Brazil’s Sao Paulo sees a Congo-national man who recently returned and developed fever; suspected Ebola-linked meningitis reported. Rio de Janeiro records a second suspected case in a traveler to Uganda, later diagnosed with malaria; Ebola not ruled out. In Italy, Sardinia’s Cagliari hospitalizes a patient who returned from DR Congo; suspected-case protocols are active.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国でエボラ疫情が5人康復、ブラジルとイタリアで疑似症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC指定済みのエボラアウトブレイク。282症例、42死亡、1,100以上の疑似症例が調査中であり、国際的な拡大リスクと複数国への既存の確認・疑似症例が存在。
triage.notes: イタリア（Cagliari, Sardegna）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダも記事で言及されているが、主要な発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事サマリーに基づき、実際に症例が確認・報告されているDRCとブラジルのみを検証対象地として採用。WHO PHEIC指定済みで、Africa CDCが監視中の第3規模のアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Confirms Ebola Recoveries Amid Growing Fears Over Rare Untreatable Virus
article.articleSummary: Five patients infected with a rare Ebola strain have recovered in the eastern Congo outbreak. Four were discharged today and one the day before yesterday. WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the recoveries during the inauguration of a new Ebola treatment centre in Bunia, Ituri province. The developments offer a hopeful sign amid fears surrounding the rare strain, even as scientists continue work on vaccines and approved treatments that remain under development. The outbreak center remains Bunia, Ituri province, Congo, highlighting ongoing transmission and the need for strengthened treatment infrastructure as public health authorities monitor containment efforts. No total case or death figures are provided in the update.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、稀なエボラ株に対する懸念が高まる中、エボラ回復例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。稀なエボラ株の東部コンゴでの発生は異常・重症疾患であり、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 稀なエボラ株系統の東部コンゴ（イトゥリ州ブニア）での継続的な流行。WHOが新たな治療センターの開設を発表し、ワクチンおよび承認済み治療薬の開発が進行中。総患者数・死亡数の情報は記事では提供されていない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。

article.articleHeadline: WHOトップ、エボラ拡大地域を訪問　国際社会の追加支援要請　コンゴ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief visits Ebola-affected regions as international community appeals for additional support in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading rapidly in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri Province, prompting the World Health Organization's director-general, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, to visit the region on May 30, 2026. The mission aims to mobilize international support to curb the outbreak. Tedros urged continued international assistance and stressed that effective containment requires strong government leadership and active community engagement, with solidarity for affected communities. The report notes the outbreak is expanding but does not provide case or mortality counts. There is no mention of laboratory confirmation or the infection source in the text. The emphasis is on coordinated action, public health measures, and sustained funding from the international community to control transmission in Ituri and broader eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: WHOトップ、エボラ拡大地域を訪問　国際社会の追加支援要請　コンゴ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大、国際的な支援要請、感染症制御の必要性という点で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的懸念が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事は東部コンゴ（イトゥリ州）でのエボラウイルス病の急速な拡大を報告。WHOトップの現地訪問、国際支援要請という高い政治的・公衆衛生的関心がある。ただしケース数や死亡数の具体的データは記事に記載されていない。フルリスク評価で詳細情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: इटली में इबोला का संदिग्ध मामला, कांगो से लौटे मरीज को आइसोलेशन में रखा गया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Italy; patient who returned from Congo has been placed in isolation.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, Italy reports a suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia: a patient who recently returned from Congo is isolated in Santissima Trinità Hospital’s Infectious Diseases Unit. Ebola testing has been performed; samples are to be analyzed at Rome’s Spallanzani Institute to confirm infection. The case is considered imported from Congo; the patient shows symptoms and is under hospital quarantine with safety measures in place. No laboratory confirmation yet. Italy is dispatching a Spallanzani team to Congo to assist outbreak response and strengthen surveillance and control of Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BEBV) outbreaks in Central Africa, including Uganda. The government has urged the EU to boost border surveillance and harmonize rules for travelers from affected regions, sending letters to EC President Christodoulides, European Council President Costa, and EU Commission President von der Leyen.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアでエボラの疑い例、コンゴから帰国した患者が隔離中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」の3基準に該当。エボラウイルスの国際的移動、EU全体への懸念がある。
triage.notes: イタリアはWPRO対象国に含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。ただしエボラの発生地はコンゴとウガンダ（中央アフリカ）であり、イタリアは輸入例の受け入れ国。WPRO基準評価は対象国リスト外のイベントであるため参考値。IHR基準に基づき PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: El congoleño hospitalizado en Brasil con síntomas de ébola da positivo en meningitis pero permanece aislado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congolese man hospitalized in Brazil with Ebola-like symptoms tests positive for meningitis but remains isolated.
article.articleSummary: June 1, 2026 updates from Brazil: In Rio de Janeiro, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo admitted with Ebola-like symptoms has tested positive for meningococcal meningitis by blood PCR; he remains isolated at the Emílio Ribas Institute in São Paulo after recent travel to the DRC, as authorities continue further laboratory and genomic analyses. A second case in Rio involves a Belgian national who had been in Uganda and presented with fever-less viral symptoms (cough, chills, diarrhea) but was found to have malaria; he remains isolated while Ebola testing is awaited and is being treated at the Evandro Chagas Institute in Rio de Janeiro. Brazilian health authorities activated their Ebola security protocol. The Congo outbreak has caused 43 deaths and over 263 confirmed cases in the DRC, with Uganda reporting positives and one death.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスのような症状で入院していたコンゴ人男性がブラジルで髄膜炎検査で陽性、隔離継続中
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク感染症（エボラ、髄膜炎、マラリア）の同時発生、DRC発のシグナル感染者がブラジルで検出され国際拡大の懸念あり。IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、重症度、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: DRCのエボラ流行（43死亡、263症例以上）からブラジルへの国際移動で複数疑い患者が検出された重要なシグナル。髄膜炎およびマラリアが除外診断として報告されているが、エボラ確定診断待機中。ブラジル保健当局がエボラセキュリティプロトコル発動。ウガンダでも関連陽性1死亡報告あり。国際的な懸念が高く、RRA詳細評価推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 巴西密切监测两宗疑似埃博拉病毒病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil closely monitors two suspected Ebola virus disease cases.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola virus disease cases are under close watch in Brazil: a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in São Paulo with fever, and a Belgian national who had arrived from Uganda in Rio de Janeiro with cough, chills and diarrhea. Lab results are due next week to confirm Ebola; if confirmed, these would be the first Ebola infections identified outside Africa since the Congo (Kinshasa) outbreak began. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is implicated, with no approved vaccine and roughly a one-in-three fatality rate. Congo (Kinshasa) reports over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths; Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. In Brazil, the São Paulo patient tested positive for meningitis and the Rio de Janeiro patient for malaria, though co-infection with Ebola cannot be ruled out. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids. WHO chief Tedros is visiting Ituri; MSF warns of a rapidly evolving situation; global risk remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルが疑似エボラウイルス病2症例を密接に監視
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルスのアフリカ外初の確認可能性、高い致命率、複数国への曝露経路があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリー上、エボラウイルス感染の疑い事例がブラジル（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）で報告されており、DRC及びウガンダからの曝露経路を示唆。UgandaはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による outbreak が進行中で、確認されればアフリカ外初となる可能性が指摘されている。WHOも高い関心を示しており、国際的な対応が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Turun Langsung ke Pusat Wabah Ebola di Kongo, Kasus Melonjak dan Penyebaran Lebih Cepat dari Penanganan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Directly Deploys to Ebola Outbreak Epicenter in Congo, Cases Surge and Transmission Outpaces the Response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, centered on Bunia) involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. WHO reports 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths linked to the outbreak; neighboring Uganda has 9 cases and 1 death. The epidemic has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, heightening cross-border concerns. Doctors Without Borders warns this is among the fastest-spreading Ebola episodes on record and calls for expanded testing, rapid deployment of healthcare workers, and reliable logistics. The situation is hindered by security threats from armed groups including the ADF (ISIS-aligned) and local militias, plus community resistance to safe burials, with at least three attacks on health facilities. International support includes EU medical aid to Bunia and US assistance of $80 million (total aid >$112 million). WHO Director-General Tedros urged rethinking travel bans to preserve transparency and reporting.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴのエボラ流行中心地に直接展開、症例数急増し感染拡大が対応を上回る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国にまたがる急速な拡大、高い死亡率、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的な懸念が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク感染症であり、本事例はBundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、高死亡率(24.6%)、複数州への拡大、ウガンダへの越境感染、高速な伝播、医療施設への攻撃による対応阻害など複合的に深刻。WHO事務局長が国際的に言及し、EU・米国による大規模支援（1億2000万ドル超）が展開中。UgandaはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: इटली में इबोला का संदिग्ध मामला, कांगो से लौटे मरीज को आइसोलेशन में रखा गया - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Italy; patient who returned from Congo has been placed in isolation
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Italy after a recent return from Congo. A patient in Cagliari, Sardinia, is isolated with Ebola-like symptoms; an Ebola test has been performed and samples will be tested at Rome's Spallanzani Institute. The patient is hospitalized in the Infectious Diseases Department at Santissima Trinità Hospital in Rome; samples are being sent by air to Rome for confirmation. Mirionis Hospital has implemented all standard safety precautions for such cases. Italy’s government states the case has prompted ongoing coordination with Sardinia’s local health authorities and the Spallanzani institute, with continuous monitoring. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s office says Italy has urged Europe to strengthen border surveillance and cross-border coordination to prevent spread. A team of Spallanzani experts will be sent to Congo to assist outbreak response and surveillance, focusing on Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BVD) activity in Congo and neighboring Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアでエボラの疑い例；コンゴから帰国した患者が隔離されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の重大な影響を持つ、異常かつ予想外で、国際的な拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイタリアでの疑い例について述べているが、実際の発生地域（イベント源）はコンゴとウガンダのエボラ流行である。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsに含めない。DRCはリスト対象国であり、本イベントの実質的な発生源として含める。イタリアからのコンゴへの専門家派遣も確認され、国際的な関与が明確。

article.articleHeadline: 부천시, 에볼라 확산에 해외여행 주의 당부...유입 차단 총력 - 신아일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bucheon City Urges Caution on Overseas Travel Amid Ebola Outbreak... All-Out Efforts to Block Importation
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, Bucheon City urges heightened precautions for overseas travel amid an Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in parts of Africa. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern as cases rise, and Korea's KDCA designated five countries as priority quarantine zones: Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province), Uganda, South Sudan, Ethiopia, and Rwanda. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has imposed a travel ban on Ituri, while health authorities emphasize personal precautions: avoid contact with infected wildlife or their meat and maintain strict hygiene. EVD spreads via contact with blood or body fluids of infected persons or animals such as fruit bats, monkeys, or chimpanzees. Upon return, travelers should accurately complete the Health-Question Form (Q-CODE) and report fever or symptoms within 21 days to quarantine or public health authorities. Bucheon will continue information provision and preventive campaigns to prevent importation.

triage.headline_ja: 부천시, 에볼라 확산에 해외여행 주의 당부...유입 차단 총력 (部川市、エボラ拡散に海外旅行注意促促...流入遮断に全力)
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHO PHEIC宣言されたエボラウイルス病の国際的な流行事象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域には韓国（Republic of Korea、Bucheon-si、Gyeonggi-do）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はアフリカのエボラ発生（特にDRC Ituri Province）であり、韓国は対応・警告を発出している国である。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。スーダン、エチオピア、ルワンダはリスト対象国に含まれないため除外。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Pesakit pulih Ebola di DRC mula meningkat sedang jangkitan disyaki dicatatkan di luar Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola survivors in the DRC are on the rise as suspected infections are recorded outside Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 282 confirmed Ebola cases (Bundibugyo strain) and 42 deaths, with 19 new positive tests. Four nurses and one laboratory worker in Bunia, Ituri region have recovered and were discharged, bringing total recoveries to five. WHO earlier declared this Bundibugyo outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; there is no licensed vaccine or treatment, though good medical care can save lives. The outbreak is Congo’s 17th and the third largest, with warnings of regional spread and more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation globally. Outside Africa, suspected cases in Brazil (Sao Paulo) and Rio de Janeiro are travel-linked; in Sao Paulo a man from the DRC recently visiting Africa presented with fever and was suspected of meningitis, with Ebola not ruled out, and in Rio the patient had been to Uganda and malaria was detected. In Italy’s Cagliari, protocols were activated for a symptomatic patient returning from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者の回復が増加する一方で、アフリカ外での感染が疑わしく報告されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。WHO が Public Health Emergency of International Concern を宣言した Bundibugyo エボラ株の流行で、アフリカ外での疑わしい感染（ブラジル、イタリア）が報告されており、重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクがすべて存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC でのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）確定患者282名、死亡42名を報告し、WHO が PHEIC を宣言している状況を述べている。ブラジル（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）での疑わしい症例は travel-linked であり、イタリア・カリャリでも symptomatic patient が報告されている。対象国リストに基づき、verified_locations には DRC と Brazil のみを記載した。イタリアとウガンダは対象国に含まれていない。Bundibugyo は世界的に著名な高リスク病原体であり、アフリカ外での疑わしい感染報告は PHEIC 段階での国際的な危機管理対象である。

article.articleHeadline: EAC to hold emergency health ministers' meeting over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Emergency actions: The East African Community (EAC) schedules an extraordinary virtual meeting of health ministers on June 1–2 to coordinate a regional response to the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Outbreaks are reported in the DRC and Uganda, with the epicenter in eastern DRC’s Ituri province, including Bunia. The EAC aims to strengthen preparedness through enhanced surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, infection prevention and risk communication, to prevent cross-border transmission, in cooperation with Africa CDC and WHO. Planned interventions include nine mobile laboratories at border points, a pool of more than 180 rapid-response experts, health-worker training, and PPE plus a regional framework to fast-track vaccines and diagnostics. As of May 29, DRC reported 263 confirmed cases and 42 deaths; five recovered in Bunia, four workers discharged, one laboratory worker at home. More than 1,100 test results were pending as of May 30.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行に対して東アフリカ共同体が保健大臣の緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認事例と死亡が報告され、国境を超えた伝播の懸念がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の爆発的流行。DRCで263例確認、42死亡。ウガンダにおいても流行が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。EACが地域的な対応を調整中で、国際的な関与度が高い。ワクチンがない株系統であることが懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Infertility in women: From genital TB to chlamydia - 4 Severe infections that can reduce your chances of conceiving
article.articleSummary: Hidden infections—particularly Chlamydia and Gonorrhea—are common, often asymptomatic drivers of infertility in women. If untreated, these STDs can trigger pelvic inflammatory disease, tubal blockage, and reduced natural conception. Genital Tuberculosis (TB) is described as an unexpectedly common cause of multiple IVF failures in India, with uterine lining damage hindering embryo implantation. Chronic vaginal infections (recurrent yeast infections or bacterial vaginosis) disrupt the vaginal environment and can impair fertility. Recurring urinary tract infections may signal pelvic issues and shorten fertile windows when medical help is delayed. Early warning signs include unusual vaginal discharge and pelvic pain. Dr. Ila Gupta notes these infections, along with hormonal factors, are frequently overlooked risks to fertility; timely medical evaluation is important to protect reproductive health and improve pregnancy outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 女性の不妊症：性器結核からクラミジアまで—妊娠の可能性を低下させる4つの深刻な感染症
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は女性の不妊症と感染症の関連性に関する健康啓発記事であり、アクティブな感染症の流行・発生イベントではない。特定の疾患流行の報告、集団発生、公衆衛生危機を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は医学教育記事/健康啓発コンテンツであり、感染症の流行やアウトブレイク報告ではない。インドで性器結核が言及されているが、具体的な新規患者数、確認症例、流行の報告はなく、一般的な医学情報として提示されている。したがってシグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: News: Uganda to continue anti-ADF operations despite Ebola o
article.articleSummary: Uganda will continue joint operations with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) against the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) despite the Ebola outbreak in DRC. UPDF spokesperson Chris Magezi said there have been no requests to halt operations, as the ADF persists in killing and abducting civilians in eastern DRC. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, on May 28, 2026, urged armed groups to declare a ceasefire to enable health workers to access affected communities and help contain Ebola. Ugandan and Congolese troops have conducted joint operations since November 2021, with Ugandan authorities stating they will maintain Ebola prevention measures and standard operating procedures during operations. Ghebreyesus described the Ebola outbreak as very complex, noting conflict, insecurity, displacement, food shortages, and community mistrust hindering containment and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ流行中もADF対抗作戦を継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生がDRCで確認され、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダとの国境接触）が該当。WPROスクリーニングでも異常性・重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさが該当し、複数国に関わる複雑な状況のため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCでのエボラ発生とウガンダとの国境地域での共同軍事作戦継続が主題。WHOの懸念声明やエボラ発生の複雑性（紛争、不安定性、住民の不信）が強調されている。発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、サマリーではDRCでの発生が主で、ウガンダは作戦継続国として記載されているため、両国をverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Italy investigates suspected Ebola case as patient returning from Congo placed in isolation
article.articleSummary: A suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy involves a patient who recently returned from Congo and is now hospitalized in isolation. The symptomatic patient has undergone an Ebola test, with samples sent to Rome for analysis by Spallanzani (Italy’s National Institute for Infectious Diseases) on Sunday evening. The Health Ministry says it is coordinating with Sardinia’s local health authorities and Spallanzani to monitor the situation. Authorities have asked for stronger European border surveillance amid the outbreak. Laboratory confirmation is not yet available; results are pending. The case is described as imported, linked to travel from Congo, and the patient remains isolated at a hospital facility to prevent transmission while the investigation proceeds.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアがコンゴからの帰国患者によるエボラ疑似患者を調査、隔離措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国境越え輸入症例は極めて高リスクイベント。実験室確認待ちの段階であるが、疑似症例の存在自体が優先対応を要する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、患者はコンゴから帰国後イタリアで隔離されているが、実際の感染症イベント（発症・検査の対象）はコンゴでの曝露に起因している。イタリア国内の疑似症例は輸入症例であり、発生地はDRC。対象国リストに基づきDRCのみ verified_locations に含める。実験室確認待ちのため、今後の検査結果が重要。エボラの可能性と国際的な健康安全保障への懸念からPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: 本轮埃博拉疫情首批康复者出院 5名患者痊愈
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First batch of Ebola outbreak survivors discharged; five patients have recovered.
article.articleSummary: Five survivors discharged from Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking the first confirmed recovery from this round of Bundibugyo ebolavirus infection. On May 31, four healthcare workers left an Ebola treatment center after two consecutive negative tests; another recovered laboratory staff member had been discharged on May 29 after two negatives. Disinfection occurred on May 25 in Bunia. As of May 29, Congo reported 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths in this outbreak; as of May 30, over 1,100 suspected cases remained under investigation. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists yet, but vaccine and therapeutic research is underway, and timely, high-quality medical care can enable recovery even without targeted therapies.

triage.headline_ja: 本轮エボラ疫情首批康復者出院 5名患者痊愈（今期エボラ流行の第一陣回復患者が退院、5名患者が完治）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。進行中のDRC大規模エボラ流行（263確認例、42死亡、1,100以上の疑似例）は監視継続が必要。
triage.notes: DRC Ituri Province（Bunia）での進行中のエボラ流行。本記事は回復例の報告だが、背景として263確認例・42死亡・1,100以上の疑似例が存在する大規模流行。WHOも言及しており国際的関心が高い。継続的な監視必要。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴとウガンダのエボラ疑い例、1100件に アフリカCDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola cases in Congo and Uganda reach 1,100 - Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda exceed 1,100, according to Africa CDC Secretary-General Jean-Kaseya in a May 31 Financial Times op-ed. As of May 30, confirmed infections were 263 with 43 deaths; about 1,100 suspected cases remain under verification. Africa CDC had on May 28 reported 246 Ebola deaths. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has no approved vaccines or therapies and relies on preventive measures to curb spread. Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan health ministers approved a $319 million regional response plan. Kaseya urged rapid, continent-wide action and criticized dependence on external funding, calling the outbreak a major test for Africa CDC and the African Union, and warning this will not be the last outbreak. WHO recently declared the Congo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダのエボラ疑い例、1100件に アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間流行で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み、死亡者43名、疑い例1,100件以上の大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴとウガンダのエボラアウトブレイク。対象国リストではDRCのみに該当（203312）。ウガンダ（226074）はサマリーに言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。南スーダン（スーダン）も提及されているが、同様に対象国外のため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言、Bundibugyo ebolavirus、確認症例263名・死亡43名、318.75億ドルの地域対応計画承認など、重篤性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brazilia: Rezultate negative pentru unul dintre cei doi bărbaţi care prezentau posibile simptome de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil: Negative results for one of the two men who presented with possible Ebola symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Two men from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda with Ebola-compatible symptoms were placed in isolation in Brazil on June 1, 2026; Ebola infection is not confirmed in either. In Rio de Janeiro, a man who arrived from Uganda on May 22 presented feverish, respiratory, and diarrheal symptoms and tested positive for malaria; Ebola tests were negative, though he remains isolated as investigations continue. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man from DR Congo with symptoms compatible with Ebola was isolated at the Emilio Ribas Institute. Brazilian authorities say the risk of transmission in Brazil and South America is low. The DRC declared a new Ebola outbreak on May 15; Uganda reported two more cases on Friday, bringing its total to nine. Africa CDC records 246 Ebola-related deaths from over 1,000 suspected cases in DRC; WHO has issued an international health alert.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル：エボラウイルスの可能性のある症状を呈していた2人男性の1人が陰性結果
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラアウトブレイク拡大、複数国での確認、WHOアラート発令により国際的な関心度が高い。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイクはDRC発生、ウガンダでの確認、ブラジルへの輸入症例。WHOが国際保健警告を発令。ウガンダ（対象国外）での症例増加も関連情報。DRCでの死亡数246名、疑い例1000例以上という深刻な状況が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Caso sospetto di Ebola a Cagliari. Il paziente è rientrato dal Congo. Sottoposto ai test, è in isolamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected case of Ebola in Cagliari. The patient has returned from Congo. He has been subjected to tests and is in isolation.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy: a Congolese resident who returned from Kinshasa developed fever and was isolated after transport to Santissima Trinità hospital. An armed PPE response cordoned streets near Largo Carlo Felice and Piazza Yenne; a diagnostic test was performed and the sample sent to Spallanzani in Rome for results; if positive, the patient would be transferred to a Rome facility. The Health Ministry said authorities are monitoring the situation and Italy’s overall risk remains very low. The patient had flown from Kinshasa via Cairo, arriving in Cagliari and calling emergency services. An ordinance requires monitoring for anyone from the Democratic Republic of Congo or Uganda within 21 days prior to arrival. Bundibugyo Ebola strain drives the outbreak in Congo and Uganda; WHO reports about 1,100 suspected, 263 confirmed, and 43 deaths, with no targeted vaccines and no rapid large-scale tests. This is the second suspected Ebola case in Italy, after a Spallanzani case tested negative.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリで疑い例のエボラ出血熱。患者はコンゴから帰国。検査対象となり隔離中
triage.triage_reason: イタリアで報告された疑い例だが、症例は原発地（コンゴ）からの帰国者であり、IHR基準では異常性・国際的拡大リスク・貿易制限リスクが該当。WPRO基準では異常性、重症度、流行性が認められ、社会的・政治的関心も高まっている。対象国DRCでの大規模流行背景とイタリアでの2例目報告により、フルRRA検討が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは複数の国（イタリア、エジプト、ウガンダなど）を位置情報として返しているが、記事サマリーの主題は（1）DRCのキンシャサで流行中のBundibugyo Ebolaが背景にあり、（2）患者はDRCからイタリアへ移動した帰国者である。実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCであり、イタリアの例は輸入症例（疑い例）である。従ってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。イタリア・エジプト・ウガンダは地理的関連性のみで除外。

article.articleHeadline: इटली में इबोला का संदिग्ध मामला, कांगो से लौटे मरीज को आइसोलेशन में रखा गया | Heatwave Grips Rome
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Italy, a patient who returned from Congo has been placed in isolation | Heatwave grips Rome
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, Italy's Health Ministry is investigating a suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, the capital of Sardinia, after a patient who recently returned from Congo developed symptoms and is in isolation. The patient is hospitalized in the Infectious Diseases Department of Santissima Trinità hospital; Ebola testing has been performed and samples have been sent by air ambulance to Rome's Spallanzani Institute for confirmation. The hospital has implemented all safety measures for such cases. The Health Ministry says it is coordinating with Sardinia's local health agencies and the Spallanzani Institute and monitoring the situation closely. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's office said Italy will dispatch a team of Spallanzani Ebola experts to Congo to assist with outbreak response and strengthen monitoring and control, and urged stronger border surveillance across Europe. The authorities note recent Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BVD strain) outbreaks in Congo and neighboring Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアでエボラ疑い症例、コンゴから帰国した患者が隔離下に置かれた | ローマを襲う熱波
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）を複数満たす。対象国（DRC）での発生と欧州への輸出症例の報告は、WPRO及び国際的スクリーニング基準でシグナル特性が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはイタリア（対象国外）とコンゴ（DRC、対象国）が含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題は『コンゴでの感染拡大に起因するイタリアへの輸出症例の検査と対応』であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCである。イタリアは検査・対応の拠点であるが、原発地ではない。首相がコンゴへの支援派遣を言及していることからも、主要な関心は原発地のDRCの状況にある。

article.articleHeadline: В Бразилии и Италии расследуют предполагаемые случаи заболевания лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Brazil and Italy, suspected cases of Ebola fever are being investigated.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola cases are under investigation in Brazil and Italy after travel to Africa. In São Paulo, a man with meningitis and in Rio de Janeiro, a patient with malaria were reported; in both cases Ebola cannot be ruled out, as the São Paulo patient recently visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Rio de Janeiro patient had been to Uganda. In Cagliari, Sardinia’s capital, Italy, a patient with Ebola-like symptoms was hospitalized after returning from Congo. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, four nurses treated for Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo strain were discharged from a Bunia hospital after recovery, with another lab worker also recovered, bringing total recoveries to five. Congo now reports 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths after 19 new positives, with over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. As of 2026-06-01, authorities stress early diagnosis and access to care to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルとイタリアでエボラ熱の疑い例を調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC、ブラジル両国で確認疑い例あり。WPRO基準も複数該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーから、DRCでのエボラ確定282例・死亡42例の既知流行に加え、ブラジル（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）およびイタリア（カリアリ）で、アフリカ渡航後の疑い例が報告されている。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めず。渡航関連の国際的拡大リスクが高く、ピックアップはWHO通知基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil monitors 2 patients for possible Ebola infection
article.articleSummary: Brazil monitors patients for Ebola infection in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. A 37-year-old man from DR Congo exhibited fever in São Paulo, and a Belgian man who arrived from Uganda showed cough, chills and diarrhoea in Rio de Janeiro. Laboratory results are expected next week. If confirmed, they would be the first Ebola cases detected outside Africa since the DR Congo outbreak began. DR Congo reports more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths; Uganda has nine confirmed cases and one death. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, a strain with no proven vaccine and roughly one-third fatality. The Brazilian patients have other diagnoses—meningitis in São Paulo and malaria in Rio—though Ebola cannot be ruled out. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; animal reservoirs include fruit bats. MSF warns of an alarming spread; WHO says spread remains unlikely; Tedros continues visit to Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、エボラ感染の可能性がある2人の患者を監視中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク（アフリカ外への初の疑い例）、DRC及びウガンダでの継続的なアウトブレイク（1000件以上の疑い例、246人以上の死亡）、および複数国（Brazil, DRC, Uganda）への地理的拡散により、IHR基準3項目以上及びWPRO基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでのアウトブレイク状況にも言及しているが、現在の疑い例の患者監視はブラジル（São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro）とDRCが主要な発生地である。Bluedot APIが返した他の地域（Africa大陸、Uganda）については、実際のイベント発生地域としてではなく、背景情報として記載されている。ブラジルでの2例が「アフリカ外での初の疑い例」であり、国際的な流行拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: EU and WHO scale up action to respond to the Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda trigger intensified EU–WHO action to rapidly contain transmission, protect communities and bolster regional preparedness. The European Union commits €15 million in humanitarian funding, with €5 million allocated to WHO, to scale up surveillance, infection prevention and control, community engagement, and continuity of essential health services, aiming for rapid, coordinated response and strengthened preparedness in neighboring countries. The EU’s Humanitarian Air Bridge will deliver 100 tonnes of emergency supplies to eastern DRC, including medicines, protective equipment, infection-control material, tents and frontline operational gear. Through €1.5 million in co-financing to the WHO AFRO Regional Emergency Hub in Dakar, 6.3 tonnes of medical supplies were deployed to the DRC, comprising sample collection kits, viral hemorrhagic fever kits (PPE), medications and surge capacity of expert teams. WHO regional directors emphasize cross-border collaboration, surveillance, genomic sequencing and vaccine research, with diagnostics and countermeasures supported under the EU Global Health Resilience Initiative.

triage.headline_ja: EU and WHOはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）とウガンダのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対応するための行動を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に極めて重大な病原体であり、DRCおよびウガンダでの確認アウトブレイク、国際的支援（EU資金€15百万）の投入、地域を越えた対応の必要性が明記されている。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行性・管理困難性すべてに該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはDRC、Uganda、Senegal（Dakar）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクである。対象国リストでは203312（DRC）のみが該当。Ugandaおよびセネガルは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラ出血熱は致死性が高く、国際的な関心が極めて高い。EU、WHO、アフリカ地域機関による大規模な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola footprint widens as officials race to gauge epidemic's true scale
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo widens to 22 health zones across Ituri (14), North Kivu (7) and South Kivu (1), up from 13. As of May 30, 2026, the Congo National Institute of Public Health reports 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with 19 new infections that day. The origin is Mongbwalu in Djugu; the outbreak has spilled into conflict-affected areas with mass displacement and weak health infrastructure. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment; early symptoms mimic malaria and typhoid, delaying laboratory confirmation. Transmission chains are hard to trace, with contact-follow-up around 45%. Testing backlogs were cleared and hundreds of suspected cases reclassified, but response suffers shortages of medicines, PPE and funding. Eleven suspected patients fled a hospital in Bambu; five more escaped isolation facilities. Uganda reports nine related infections, illustrating cross-border spread. Authorities emphasize community trust and engagement to control spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ足跡が拡大、当局が流行の真の規模を測定するために競争中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全てに該当。Bundibugyo Eボラウイルスの東部DRCでの急速な地理的拡大（22保健地域、うち14がIturi、7がNorth Kivu）、282確認例42死亡、ウガンダへの国際的越境感染、ワクチン・治療法なしの高リスク病原体による重大な公衆衛生危機。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域にはイタリア（Veneto州、Bambu）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらは主題ではなく、イボラの主な発生地は東部DRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）。ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。記事の主題は明らかにDRCのエボラ流行の拡大であり、高い緊急性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola lây lan với tốc độ 'chưa từng có'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads at an unprecedented speed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri region) is unfolding at an unprecedented pace, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. The World Health Organization reports 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths, with the DRC Ministry of Health confirming 282 positives and 42 deaths. Nearby Uganda has 9 infections and 1 death; Brazil is isolating two men who recently returned from the region after fever, cough, and diarrhea, though initial tests are negative. Ongoing control efforts are hampered by armed conflict in Ituri and local mistrust, with aid workers facing shortages and violence at treatment sites. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus urged a ceasefire to save lives, emphasizing that patients can recover with timely care. Transmission is from fruit bats to humans, then via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, malaise, myalgia progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, multi-organ failure. No vaccine or specific treatment exists; EU and US support has been mobilized, while Vietnam assesses risk as low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が「前例のない」速度で拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間越境流行であり、重症度・死亡率が高く、国際的拡大と渡航制限のリスクが顕著である。
triage.notes: DRC（イトゥリ地域）が主流行地。ウガンダは対象国外であるため除外。ベトナムは記事内で「リスク低」と評価しているが、患者監視体制が展開されているため verified_locations に含めた。ブラジルは返国者2名の疑似症患者を隔離中で、初期検査は陰性だが疫学的リンクがあるため含める。EU・米国の支援が動員されており、国際的な関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情恐「衝出非洲」！　巴西、義大利出現疑似病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak feared to spill out of Africa! Suspected cases detected in Brazil and Italy.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province). As of May 31, 2026, 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths; 19 new infections reported since the latest tally. Five recovered: four healthcare workers and a laboratory staff member. WHO designates Bundibugyo EBOV outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) for DRC and Uganda. There is no vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo EBOV; emphasis on early diagnosis and isolation. Bodies remain highly infectious post-mortem; safe handling mandated. MSF notes hundreds of samples awaiting testing and serious resource shortages. Global concern grows with 1,100+ suspected cases under investigation; outbreak is DRC’s 17th EBOV outbreak and the third-largest in half a century, with fears of regional spread. Suspected cases detected in Brazil (São Paulo) and Italy (Cagliari, Sardinia); a Rio de Janeiro patient with malaria positive but Ebola not ruled out.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が「アフリカを脱出」する恐れ！ブラジルとイタリアで疑似患者が検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的拡大兆候、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。DRCのBundibugyo EBOV outbreak（PHEIC指定）における初の域外流出疑い例であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはイタリアも含まれているが、記事本文・サマリーではイタリアの疑似患者は言及されているものの、主な流行地はDRCであり、ブラジルでの疑似患者が主要な国際的拡大兆候として記載されている。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCとブラジルのみ。ウガンダもDRC隣国で地域的に関連があるが、サマリー上では単にWHO PEICの地理的範囲として言及されているため除外。Bundibugyo EBOV（まれな株）のPHEIC指定と初の認定域外流出疑い例は、国際的関心が極めて高い。
