article.articleHeadline: Europa, în pericol să devină zonă de risc pentru un virus transmis de țânțari: "Sistemele de sănătate trebuie să se pregătească
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Europe at risk of becoming a mosquito-borne virus risk zone: "Health systems must prepare themselves."
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya, a mosquito-borne viral disease transmitted mainly by Aedes aegypti (and the Asian tiger mosquito, Aedes albopictus), faces expanding risk as temperatures rise and habitats shift north. A Chinese-led study projects Europe’s Central region, Northeast North America, and East Asia as future hotspots. Currently 139 countries/regions are high-risk (about 21.3% of global land). Warmer temperatures accelerate viral development in mosquitoes, enabling transmission 4–5 times faster within 18–28°C. Globally, local transmission has been reported in 114 countries; most cases in temperate regions are travel-associated. In 2025, PAHO reported 502,264 chikungunya cases and 186 deaths across 41 countries/territories, with around 284,000 disability-adjusted life years lost. Projections using IPCC scenarios indicate risk persists through 2100. Health systems must prepare: monitor vectors, train clinicians, reinforce mosquito control, and deploy rapid interventions before outbreaks, prioritizing the UK, Germany, United States, China, and Japan before 2040.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパが蚊媒介性ウイルスのリスク地域になる危険性：「保健システムが準備する必要がある」
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアは国際的な拡大リスクが高く、複数の対象国（中国、日本）における将来的な流行予測がある。異常性と管理可能性の問題から、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な焦点は気候変動に伴うチクングニアの拡大予測であり、中国（上海を含む）が研究主導国として言及されている。日本・米国・ドイツ・英国は将来のリスク地域として優先順位付けされているが、現在の実際の発生地域（verified_locations）は記事サマリー上では中国のみが特定できる。2025年のPAHO報告書に基づく402例以上の死亡実績があり、公衆衛生的影響は深刻。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള മഹാമാരി ആഫ്രിക്കയ്ക്ക് പുറത്തേക്ക്; ബ്രസീലിലും രോഗലക്ഷണങ്ങള്‍ കണ്ടെത്തിയതോടെ ലാറ്റിന്‍ അമേരിക്കയില്‍ അതീവ ജാഗ്രത; കോവിഡിന് ശേഷം ലോകം വീണ്ടുമൊരു മഹാമാരി ഭീതിയില്‍; നിലവിലുള്ളത് 'ബുന്ദിബുഗ്യോ'... | news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola pandemic spreads beyond Africa; Brazil also reports symptoms, Latin America on high alert; after COVID, the world is once again in fear of a pandemic; the current outbreak is 'Bundibugyo'.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain is spreading from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Brazil, with Latin America on high alert as of 2026-06-01. Africa has reported over 1,000 cases and about 250 deaths. The highly virulent virus, for which no effective vaccine exists, spreads via contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or wildlife; major symptoms include severe fever, body pains, and bleeding from eyes, nose, ears, and mouth. The World Health Organization warns that border closures may hinder transparency, while several countries have imposed travel bans: Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan restricting entry for non-U.S. citizens; Rwanda and Uganda have fully closed their borders. In Brazil, two suspected cases are under watch: a 37-year-old man from the DRC moved to São Paulo is in isolation after Ebola-like symptoms; another suspected case reported in Rio de Janeiro. Uganda-born case under monitoring; authorities urge vigilance to prevent cross-continental spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラパンデミックがアフリカを超えて拡大；ブラジルでも症状が報告され、ラテンアメリカは厳重警戒中；COVID後、世界は再びパンデミック恐怖に直面；現在の流行は「ブンディブギョ」株
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生上の影響：1,000例以上、250例の死亡；異常性：ブンディブギョ株の国際拡大；国際的拡大リスク：DRCからブラジルへの拡大；渡航・貿易制限：複数国が渡航禁止を実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。社会政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはスーダン、ルワンダ、ウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは確定例がDRC（発生地）とブラジル（2件の疑い例）のみであるため、verified_locationsに含めない。ただし記事内でウガンダとルワンダの渡航禁止が言及されているため、今後の続報で確定例の報告がないか注視が必要。配信日が2026-06-01で時間軸が未来のため、シミュレーション記事またはフィクションの可能性も考慮すること。

article.articleHeadline: تدعو منظمة الصحة العالمية إلى التعاون المجتمعي للحد من تفشي الإيبولا في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization calls for community engagement to curb the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ituri province faces a Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Community engagement is stressed as burial protocols clash with local rites, triggering protests and attacks on health centers in Bunia. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyo virus, but patients can recover with care; five have recovered and four more were to be discharged. As of 1 June 2026, the outbreak totals include 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths; 282 laboratory-confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with 19 new positives. Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. International aid includes EU medical supplies and US support increasing to $112 million. MSF warns the true size remains unknown, with hundreds of samples untested. Brazil is monitoring two possible imported Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, later tested negative.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行抑制のための地域社会の参加を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な異常・予想外事象、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。PHEIC宣言されたエボラ出血熱の確認事例が200例超で、ウガンダへの国際的拡大と複数国での警戒が認められる。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥーリ州でBundibugyo株エボラの流行が確認。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダへの二次感染あり。ブラジルでは輸入症例の可能性として複数検査が実施されたが陰性との記載があるため、実際の発生地はDRCが主。ウガンダの記載が発生地域に含まれていないため検証対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilance Without Panic: How Prepared Is India To Handle An Ebola Outbreak? | Outlook India
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the World Health Organization, prompting India's intensified preparedness as of May 25, 2026. The Health Ministry reports enhanced surveillance at airports and other entry points, with standard operating procedures issued to states and union territories covering traveller screening, quarantine protocols, clinical management, laboratory testing, and infection-control measures. The ministry has directed the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), civil aviation authorities, and state governments to maintain readiness for tracking, testing, and surveillance. No case counts or local transmission details are provided in the briefing. The focus remains on rapid detection, isolation, contact tracing, and clear administrative coordination to support tracking and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 警戒と冷静さのバランス：インドはエボラ流行にどの程度対応できるか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラがPHEIC宣言され国際的関心が高いが、インドでの実際の患者発生や地域感染の報告がなく、対応準備状況のみの記事であるため。追加情報により判定変更の可能性あり。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの対応準備状況を扱うものであり、インドでの実際のエボラ患者発生や地域感染の報告は含まれていない。WHOがエボラをPHEIC宣言し国際的な関心は高いが、本記事の主題はインドの予防的備備体制であり、実際の発生イベントではないため、スクリーニング基準該当数は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: January arrivals plunge due to Covid-19 outbreaks in neighboring cities
article.articleSummary: January 2026 Macau visitor arrivals reached 694,430, a 15.4% MoM drop driven by Covid-19 outbreaks in the Zhuhai–Macau region and tighter border controls. The SAR shortened negative NAT validity for entrants from Zhuhai to deter spread. Despite the month’s dip, arrivals rose 24.7% YoY. Same-day visitors totaled 450,428 (+56.5% YoY); overnight visitors 244,002 (-9.3%). Average length of stay fell to 1.3 days (-0.3). Mainland China visitors numbered 642,016 (+29.4% YoY), including 167,771 under the Individual Visit Scheme; Hong Kong contributed 44,380 and Taiwan 7,896. Separately, casino gross gaming revenue declined 20.3% MoM to MOP 6.34 billion, reflecting the impact of the outbreaks and border measures. This period underscores ongoing Covid-19 variant concerns shaping travel and tourism policy in Macau. Keywords: outbreak, border control, NAT, Macau, Zhuhai.

triage.headline_ja: 隣接都市のCOVID-19流行により1月の到着者数が急減
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は珠海・マカオ地域のCOVID-19流行による観光客数の減少であり、流行そのものの大規模発生や重症度の増加ではなく、社会経済的影響の報告である。IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも明確には該当せず、シグナルとしてのピックアップは不要。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19流行の報告というより、マカオの観光統計と経済指標（カジノ収益）の低下を主題としている。珠海・マカオのCOVID-19流行が存在することは示唆されるが、具体的な症例数、死亡数、重症度については記述されない。国境措置の強化は既知の対策であり、新たなシグナルではない。Taiwan（1668284）はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは台湾の流行そのものは述べられていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ask The Vet | Canine Distemper Virus
article.articleSummary: Canine distemper virus (CDV), an RNA morbillivirus, drives Macau’s viral season. Although parvovirus has surged in notoriety, CDV remains a deadly canine pathogen that can affect dogs of any age, with puppies most at risk. Clinical signs are variable: some dogs have a transient fever and reduced appetite, while others develop a systemic illness with nasal/ocular discharge, coughing, fever, vomiting and diarrhea. Neurologic signs may appear one to a few weeks after infection, and survivors can show retinal damage, corneal discoloration, or hyperkeratosis of the nose or foot pads. Diagnosis relies on ELISA for antigens, immunofluorescent testing on white blood cells or conjunctival swabs, and CSF antibodies with elevated protein; radiographs may show pneumonia but are not definitive. There is no specific treatment; vaccination starts at about 6 weeks and is boosted every 3–4 weeks until 12–16 weeks to overcome maternal antibodies. Virus is shed in all secretions and is contagious for weeks; environmental stability is limited; disinfectants such as quaternary ammonium compounds (TH4, Vircon) are effective.

triage.headline_ja: 獣医に聞く | イヌジステンパーウイルス
triage.triage_reason: 記事は獣医学的な一般情報提供であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではなく、疾患名と発生地域の不一致がある（古典的豚コレラではなくイヌジステンパーについて記述）。動物への影響のみで公衆衛生への実質的な懸念がない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した疾患名（Classical Swine Fever）と記事サマリーの内容（Canine Distemper Virus）に乖離あり。記事はペット犬の一般的な医学情報であり、流行イベント報告ではない。マカオは香港同様にChinaに含めて検証したが、本記事はシグナル検出の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: บราซิล เฝ้าระวังเข้ม หลังพบ 2 ผู้ต้องสงสัย อาจติดเชื้ออีโบลา
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil tightens surveillance after two people suspected of having Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil trigger tightened surveillance in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo presents with fever in São Paulo; a Belgian man who traveled from Uganda shows cough, chills, and diarrhea in Rio de Janeiro. Lab results are expected next week; confirmation would make them the first Ebola cases outside Africa since the outbreak began in DRC. However, both patients have been diagnosed with other illnesses — meningitis in the Congolese-origin patient and malaria in the Belgian-origin patient — though officials say Ebola remains possible. The outbreak stems from the rare Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine. In DRC, over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. MSF warned of rapid spread; WHO continues assessment from Ituri, noting global spread remains unlikely.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、エボラ出血熱の疑い例2人が判明後、監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱はアフリカ外での確認例となる可能性があり、国際的懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーではブラジルでのエボラ疑い例が主題。DRCはアウトブレイクの原発地として言及されている。ウガンダはソース記事の2次情報（患者の渡航歴）としてのみ記載されており、ウガンダでの新規発症イベントが主題ではないため除外。エボラ出血熱がアフリカ外で確認されれば国際的に極めて重大な懸念となるため、PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: 백신 없는 변종 확산 '초비상'...의심환자 벌써 1,100명
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of a vaccine-free variant 'Code Red'... 1,100 suspected cases already.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) persists, with 282 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections and 42 deaths to date. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya says about 1,100 people are under investigation for suspected Ebola as of May 30, with an estimated 246 deaths among suspected cases. The outbreak was officially declared in eastern Ituri on May 15. Outside Africa, Brazil and Italy have reported suspected cases linked to travel to the region: Brazil has two returnees in isolation after visiting the DRC and Uganda, and Italy has one person hospitalized with suspected infection after traveling in Africa. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no approved vaccine or therapy yet; transmission occurs via contact with infected animals or humans. Recovery is possible, with five discharged (including four nurses), as noted by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンなし変異株の拡散『初警報』...疑い患者すでに1,100人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、かつWPRO基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の確認感染282例・死亡42例に加え、疑い患者1,100人が調査中であり、ワクチン・治療法なしという点で深刻。国際的に既に複数国での輸入症例が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はZaire株と異なる稀な変異株であり、承認ワクチン・治療法がない点が特に懸念される。DRC（イトゥリ州）での発生が主であるが、ブラジルとイタリアでの輸入症例報告あり。サマリー上でブラジルは確認されているため verified_locations に含める。イタリアは対象国リストに非該当のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Measles | Health Bureau urges employers to vaccinate non-residents
article.articleSummary: Measles in Macau remains active despite 2014 eradication certification. The Health Bureau urges employers of non-resident workers (TNRs), especially from the Philippines and Vietnam and those in childcare, to vaccinate if their vaccination history is unclear. Vaccination is preferred at private hospitals/clinics, but public centers offering under MOP 100 are available; TNRs must present a blue card, Health Bureau user card, and a work contract. In the first three months of 2019, Macau recorded eight measles cases (five imported, three linked to importation). Latest cases include a Kiang Wu Hospital physician who contracted measles after treating a patient, and a Nepalese TNR at Macau Jockey Club, with two additional suspected cases awaiting confirmation. Year-to-date totals indicate a near tripling versus all of 2018, which had three imported cases. Measles is highly contagious; in adults it can cause encephalitis and pneumonia, with a mortality rate of 1 in 100 to 1 in 1,000.

triage.headline_ja: 麻しん | 衛生局が非居住者へのワクチン接種を促す
triage.triage_reason: 麻しんはIHR基準において異常性（2014年根絶認定後の再活動）と国際的拡大リスク（輸入例複数）を示しており、WPROスクリーニングでも重症度（脳炎・肺炎・死亡リスク）と流行性（高い感染力、医療従事者感染あり）に該当。対象国（マカオ含む中国）での事例として確認される。
triage.notes: 記事ではマカオ（中国特別行政区）での麻しん活動が主題であり、フィリピン・ベトナム・ネパールからの非居住労働者が感染源または対象とされている。2014年の根絶認定後の再出現は異常性を示す。2019年第1四半期に8例（輸入5例、輸入関連3例）が報告され、2018年通年（3例）の3倍近い。医療従事者の感染事例、ネパール国籍労働者の感染確認など、ヒト-ヒト感染と複数国間の拡大リスクが明確。

article.articleHeadline: इटली में इबोला का संदिग्ध मामला, कांगो से लौटे मरीज को आइसोलेशन में रखा गया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Italy; patient who returned from Congo placed in isolation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected in Italy: a patient who recently returned from Congo is in isolation in Cagliari, Sardinia. The Ministry of Health reports ongoing investigation; symptoms are present; Ebola testing has been performed, with samples sent to Rome's Spallanzani Institute for confirmation. The patient is hospitalised in the Infectious Diseases Department of Santissima Trinità Hospital; samples for confirmation were transported by air ambulance to Rome. The Ministry says it is in contact with Sardinia’s local health agencies and the Spallanzani Institute, with constant monitoring. Italy's government is sending a team of Spallanzani experts to Congo to assist outbreak response and strengthen surveillance and control. They note recent Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in Central Africa (Congo and Uganda). Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's office has called for stronger cross-border monitoring and coordination within Europe to reinforce Europe-wide safeguards.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアでエボラの疑い症例、コンゴから帰国した患者が隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク（コンゴで検出、イタリアで疑い症例）と、国境を超えた監視体制強化への政府レベルの関心により、IHR基準2項目以上、WPRO基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイタリアでの疑い症例に関するものであるが、GeoNamesリストの対象国はDRCのみ。実際の発症地はコンゴ（DRC）とウガンダ。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただし、国際的な感染拡大リスクと先進国での検出という点で高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Αρνητικός στον ιό ο ένας από τους δύο ασθενείς που τέθηκαν σε απομόνωση στη Βραζιλία - Κρούσμα και στην Ιταλία - tempo24.news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: One of the two patients who were placed in isolation in Brazil tested negative for the virus - A case in Italy as well - tempo24.news.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda remains active as of 1 June 2026, with three DRC provinces affected and >1,100 suspected cases under investigation; 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths reported, per Africa CDC, as the WHO maintains a global health emergency. In Italy, a Sardinia resident who recently returned from DRC is isolated in Cagliari; samples are under testing at Rome’s Lazzaro Spallanzani Institute, with the health ministry affirming very low nationwide risk. In Brazil, two men are in isolation seeking evaluation for Ebola: a 37-year-old in São Paulo with fever (later linked to meningitis while tests continue to exclude Ebola) and another Ugandan arrival in Rio de Janeiro with cough, chills and diarrhea; Ebola lab results were negative for the latter, who remains in isolation during full assessment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: ブラジルで隔離された2人の患者のうち1人がウイルス陰性 - イタリアでも症例 - tempo24.news
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC・ウガンダでの活動的なエボラ流行、263確定症例・43死亡、複数国への広がり、WHO緊急事態宣言が存在する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した地域にはイタリア・ウガンダも含まれているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC（主流行地）とブラジル（疑似症例の報告）が対象国かつ記事サマリーで主題。ウガンダはDRCの流行に関連しているが対象国でないため除外。この流行はWHOの継続的な公式監視対象であり、DRC・ウガンダでの活動的な感染症イベントと確認される。

article.articleHeadline: UAE issues public health travel advisory over Ebola outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: 1 June 2026 advisory: UAE's Ministry of Foreign Affairs urges UAE nationals and residents to avoid non-essential travel to Ebola-affected Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and South Sudan amid an evolving Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak. Travelers are advised to follow local health and safety instructions and exercise utmost caution. UAE nationals abroad are encouraged to register in the Twajudi service and to contact the Ministry in emergencies at +97180024. The advisory reflects the government's commitment to citizen safety abroad and reinforces adherence to all travel advisories issued by MoFA during the EVD situation in Africa. Officials emphasize vigilance for UAE communities abroad.

triage.headline_ja: UAEがアフリカのエボラ出血熱流行に関する公衆衛生旅行警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高致死性の感染症が複数国で流行中であり、国際的な渡航制限が発令されている。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国、南スーダンでのエボラ流行を明記しているが、対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国（ID:203312）のみが該当。ウガンダ（ID:226074）と南スーダン（ID:366755）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。UAEの旅行警告は公式な国際的対応を示す重要な指標。

article.articleHeadline: ทำความรู้จัก 'ไวรัสอีโบลา โรคติดเชื้ออันตรายที่มีอัตราการเสียชีวิตสูง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Get to Know the Ebola Virus: A Dangerous Infectious Disease with a High Mortality Rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda have intensified; as of 26 May 2026, over 900 suspected cases and 220 deaths have been reported, driven by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) lineage. The three major filoviruses are EBOV, SUDV, and BDBV, with BDBV causing this surge. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or body fluids or contaminated surfaces, and infectiousness begins with symptom onset; deceased individuals remain contagious through bodily contact. Incubation is 2–21 days. Early diagnosis by PCR or serology improves survival. Treatments include monoclonal antibodies approved for Ebola virus disease (mAb114/ansuvimab and REGN-EB3/Inmazeb) plus supportive care; vaccines exist for EBOV only, not for BDBV or SUDV. Thailand has border advisories restricting travel from DRC and Uganda with a 21-day quarantine; no Ebola cases reported in Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスについて知る：高い死亡率を持つ危険な感染症
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべて該当。アフリカでのエボラ流行とタイでの警戒措置は国際的懸念事項。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行は記事の主題。タイは地域検証では対象国であり、記事で国境警告と隔離措置が明記されているため含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。懸念される高い死亡率（900疑い症例中220死亡、約24%）、BundibugyoウイルスによるBDBV系統、ワクチン未対応の病原体系統。タイでの積極的な渡航制限・隔離政策は国際的な懸念を反映。

article.articleHeadline: 从医者到患者再到康复者 -- -- 刚果（金）首批埃博拉患者痊愈
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From healer to patient to survivor — the Democratic Republic of the Congo's first Ebola patients have recovered.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia. As of May 29, 2026, 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths reported, with over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation as of May 30. No approved vaccine or specific antiviral therapy exists; standard care is provided. Four local healthcare workers diagnosed with Ebola were discharged on May 31 after two consecutive negative tests, becoming the first survivors in this outbreak; a laboratory worker had earlier recovered. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri on May 30, praising recoveries as proof the outbreak can be contained, while warning the situation remains grave. Officials stress the need for treatment capacity, contact tracing, and vigilance amid misinformation and fear in the community.

triage.headline_ja: 医療者から患者、そして回復者へ――コンゴ民主共和国の初のエボラ患者が完治
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス）のアウトブレイク。確認症例263件、死亡42件、疑い例1,100件以上と公衆衛生への深刻な影響あり。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、国際的な関心も高い（WHO事務局長視察）。
triage.notes: DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないが、エボラウイルスは極めて高いリスク病原体であり、国際保健規則（IHR2005）の通知義務疾患。WHO事務局長の直接訪問、確認症例263件と死亡42件、1,100件以上の疑い例という規模から、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Verdachtsfall in São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in São Paulo, Brazil, reported on 1 June 2026. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo who recently returned from a home visit developed Ebola-like symptoms—high fever, disorientation, and diarrhea—and was placed in isolation at the Emílio-Ribas Institute, a leading infectious diseases hospital. He remains under observation while laboratories seek to confirm or exclude Ebola infection. Early results identified malaria infection and a bacterium that can cause meningococcal meningitis, underscoring that Ebola-like symptoms may have other causes. The patient is intubated and in serious condition. The Democratic Republic of Congo is battling a northeast Ebola outbreak, with Ituri province affected; authorities say confirmed Ebola cases nearly doubled over two days. World Health Organization officials and MSF have described the situation as concerning, highlighting ongoing containment and investigation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのサンパウロで疑われるエボラ出血熱患者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からブラジルへの国際移動に伴う疑い患者の報告。IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク該当。複数疾患（エボラ、マラリア、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎）の並行検査と厳格な隔離管理が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国から帰国した37歳男性。サンパウロの感染症専門病院（Emílio-Ribas Institute）に隔離中。初期検査でマラリアと髄膜炎菌を検出。エボラ感染の確認待機中。DRCではイトゥリ州で活発なエボラアウトブレイク進行中（2日で確認症例ほぼ倍増）。WHO・MSFが懸念を表明。国際的な連携が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果（金）5名埃博拉患者痊癒　本輪疫情首現康復病例 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Ebola patients have recovered in Congo (Kinshasa); first recoveries reported in this outbreak
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola patients have recovered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa), in Ituri Province’s capital Bunia, marking the first recoveries in this outbreak. Four healthcare workers were discharged from a Bunia Ebola treatment center on May 31 after two consecutive negative Ebola virus tests; a laboratory worker who also had two negative tests was discharged on May 29. WHO says these are the first confirmed recoveries of Bundibugyo ebolavirus in this outbreak. Bundibugyo virus, one of six Ebola viruses, typically starts with fever and can progress to bleeding, complicating early diagnosis. As of May 29, the Congo Ministry of Health reported 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros noted there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments yet; however timely, high-quality medical care can enable recovery. This is DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976, reflecting persistent challenges linked to ecology, conflict, and healthcare access.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ（キンシャサ）でエボラ患者5名が回復　本輪流行で初の回復事例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い死亡率を持つPathogens of Concern であり、DRCでの確認例263件・死亡42件は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示し、国際的拡大リスクも存在。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な公衆衛生メッセージは回復事例の報告であるが、基礎情報として263確定例・42死亡が報告されており、進行中の活発な流行を示唆している。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルスの6種の1つ）による流行であり、DRCの17番目の流行発生（1976年以降）。ワクチン・特異的治療未承認だが、早期診断・支持療法により回復可能との情報提供がなされている。WHOが公式声明を出している。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | Africa CDC and WHO Push Back Against Ebola-Related Travel Restrictions
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC (Ituri) has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda reports nine cases with one death linked to travel from DRC. As of May 28, Congolese health authorities logged 1,031 total cases (906 suspected, 125 confirmed) and 240 deaths; first case reported May 27 in Oicha, Beni. WHO raised the national risk to very high. Fifteen countries—including the United States, Canada, the Bahamas, Jordan and Bahrain—imposed travel restrictions; Uganda closed its land border with DRC on May 28. Africa CDC and WHO condemned the measures as unhelpful. Africa CDC’s response plan totals $318.97 million over six months, with $264.97 million for direct operations in DRC/Uganda and $54 million for preparedness in 10 high‑risk countries. Trials are planned for MBP134, Maftivimab and remdesivir; vaccines are being assessed for cross-strain use. Separately, Mozambique unveils a $500 million plan to eliminate cholera by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: 週間保健レポート | アフリカCDCとWHOがエボラ関連の渡航制限に対抗
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常で予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。複数国での複合的な感染症イベント（エボラとコレラ）であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) with 1,031 total cases (125 confirmed) and 240 deaths as of May 28, 2026. Uganda reports 9 cases with 1 death linked to DRC travel. Multiple countries implemented travel restrictions; Uganda closed border with DRC. WHO raised risk to very high. Africa CDC response plan: $318.97 million over 6 months. Vaccine trials and therapeutic interventions underway. Mozambique separately planning cholera elimination by 2030. Bluedot地域フィールドに米国、カナダ、ジョルダン、バーレーン等が含まれているが、サマリーではこれらは渡航制限を実施した国として記載され、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。対象国リストのうちDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Rapid spread of Ebola disease outbreak in DR Congo "deeply alarming"
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, escalates rapidly as WHO chief Tedros visits the epicenter. MSF deputy director of operations Dr. Alan Gonzalez warns the outbreak is deeply alarming, noting more cases appearing quickly after declaration and hundreds of samples still untested. This outbreak involves Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments and is difficult to diagnose due to limited testing capacity. Borders and airport closures are delaying critical medical supplies, humanitarian aid, and specialized personnel. MSF calls for immediate expansion of testing and rapid, coordinated scale-up of overall response, with guaranteed access for aid and staff. Emphasis on community trust, engagement, and involvement to ensure care seeking and outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴにおけるエボラ病アウトブレイクの急速な拡大が「深刻に懸念される」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施中）。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスで治療法・ワクチンなく、WHOトップ訪問、MSF警告など国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスは致死率が高く、承認されたワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない。国境・空港閉鎖により医療供給が滞る中での急速拡大は極めて懸念される。WHOテドロス事務局長の訪問、MSF警告など国際的関心が最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: Rainy season raises risk of cholera, malaria outbreaks - GHS warns
article.articleSummary: Cholera, typhoid fever, dysentery, malaria, yellow fever, and dengue fever risks rise in Ghana as the rainy season begins. The Ghana Health Service warns floods and poor sanitation can contaminate water sources with fecal matter, heightening waterborne transmission, while stagnant water in discarded containers fuels mosquito breeding for malaria, yellow fever and dengue. Vegetables grown near water bodies may become contaminated if not washed thoroughly. No case counts or outbreaks are reported. Preventive actions urged: keep surroundings clean, remove water-collecting containers, wash fruits and vegetables with clean water plus salt or vinegar, and wash hands with soap under running water. Food vendors should source from approved suppliers and separate raw from ready-to-eat foods; health certificates for handlers should be up to date. Residents should keep doors and windows closed during floods, clear bushes, and raise belongings to reduce animal habitats.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季はコレラ、マラリアの流行リスクを高める - GHSが警告
triage.triage_reason: 複数の水媒介・蚊媒介感染症の潜在的リスク増加を警告していますが、現在のところ確認された症例や流行は報告されていません。予防的警告段階のシグナルとして経過観察が適切です。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の感染症リスク警告であり、実際の患者数や確認された流行は報告されていません。WPROスクリーニング基準では長期曝露リスク（雨季の継続的な環境汚染）と流行しやすさ（水媒介・蚊媒介、不十分な衛生インフラ）が該当しますが、IHR基準には該当しないため、WATCHレベルの判定としました。

article.articleHeadline: El sector porcí acumula sis mesos de pèrdues des de l'esclat de la crisi de la pesta porcina - 3CatInfo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The porcine sector has accumulated six months of losses since the swine fever outbreak - 3CatInfo
article.articleSummary: Since the first African swine fever (ASF) case was declared on 28 November last year, the swine sector in Catalonia has endured six months of losses, totaling about €243 million in Catalonia (Lleida accounts for ~60% of production) and €900 million nationally. Mercolleida’s reference price is €1.29 per kg live weight, roughly €0.10 below production costs (€1.37–€1.40/kg); late-2025 prices reached €1.787/kg, up 27% from the previous period but still not covering costs. For a 115-kg pig, losses of about 12–13 kg remain at the slaughterhouse. Sector leaders call for subsidized financing via ICO and measures to reduce wild boar populations, especially in Collserola, with ASF not declared over until a year without new cases. Exports have reoriented toward Europe, Korea, and Vietnam; Philippines reopened, while Japan and Mexico stay blocked; Brazil’s cheaper pork pressures margins. Consumer pork prices in Europe remain high, and short-term gains may occur in summer, but costs persist.

triage.headline_ja: 豚コレラの危機勃発から6ヶ月、養豚産業が損失を蓄積 - 3CatInfo
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラは動物衛生上の重要な疾病であり、複数の対象国（ベトナム、フィリピン、ブラジル）での発生または影響が報告されている。国際的な貿易影響と長期曝露の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事はスペインのカタルーニャ州での豚コレラ発生による経済的影響に関するものだが、ベトナム、フィリピン、ブラジルなど複数の対象国への輸出規制と国際的な影響が明記されている。ASFは畜産業に対する重大な脅威であり、国際貿易への多大な影響を伴っている。

article.articleHeadline: Comunidad de África Oriental coordina estrategias para combatir ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East African Community coordinates strategies to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: June 1, 2026: The East African Community (EAC) is coordinating a regional response to an Ebola outbreak that began in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has spread to Uganda and South Sudan. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in Ituri province, eastern DRC. A virtual EAC meeting on 1 June 2026, with sessions on 2 June, will align containment measures across member states. Planned actions include deploying nine mobile laboratories at border areas and key entry points, including Beni and borders with Kenya, South Sudan, Burundi, Tanzania, Rwanda, and Uganda. Secretary-General Stephen Mbundi says coordination with partner states, Africa CDC, and the World Health Organization is strengthening. The programme also covers training to improve clinical management of high-risk infectious diseases, including Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカ共同体がエボラ対策の戦略を調整
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の国際的な地域的アウトブレイク、複数国への拡大、強力な社会政治的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの発生が主題であり、Bundibugyo株がIturi州で5月15日に公式宣言されたと明記されている。南スーダンとウガンダへの拡大が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。EAC全体の地域的対応の枠組みが構築されており、9つの移動実験室の配備と複数国での国境検査実施が計画されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola disease: MSF scales up response to rapidly evolving outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo virus, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. As of May 28, 2026, 125 confirmed cases, 906 suspected cases, and 223 suspected deaths reported across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu; Ituri accounts for >90% of suspected cases, with rising numbers in Mongbwalu and Rwampara. Testing capacity is limited with hundreds of samples awaiting processing; isolation and care capacity are insufficient, hindering rapid response. MSF, with the Ministry of Health, is scaling up: constructing a 65-bed Ebola treatment center in Ituri; supporting Mongbwalu and Fataki hospitals; Bunia isolation at Salama Hospital; an 80-bed center in Goma; and establishing two centers in Bukavu and Lwiro in South Kivu. Infection prevention training and community surveillance are underway amid insecurity and displacement that strain health services and risk delaying care for non-Ebola conditions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：MSFが急速に進化する流行への対応を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は致死性が高く公衆衛生への影響が深刻、ブンディブギョウイルスによる異常な発生、国際的拡大リスク（ルワンダでの確認も記載）、渡航・貿易制限の可能性あり。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）東部でのエボラ出血熱流行が主題。ルワンダは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー内ではルワンダでの発生確認は明記されておらず、DRCからの地理的近接性のみ。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。検査能力不足、医療体制不備、紛争による治安悪化が対応を複雑化させており、管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, 5 livelli di rischio e centri sanitari: il piano del governo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Five Levels of Risk and Health Centers: The Government's Plan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk management plan: Italy implements a five-level Ebola risk scheme with mandatory declarations for travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Fiumicino Airport is designated as a national health hub; regional infectious-disease reference centers will operate in each region, with a National Reference Center at Spallanzani Hospital in Rome. The measures aim to manage risks linked to Ebola outbreaks in Congo and Uganda, which WHO Africa Region reports as about 1,100 suspected cases, 263 confirmed, and 43 deaths. A new suspected case has emerged in Italy: a symptomatic Congolese citizen resident in Cagliari, who recently returned from Kinshasa via Cairo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、5つのリスクレベルと保健センター：政府の計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行がイタリアへ波及した疑い例が報告されており、複数国にまたがる状況。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはイタリア（対象国リストに含まれない）、エジプト（対象国リストに含まれない）、ウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行に対するイタリアの対応」であり、実際の流行発生地は対象国リストの中ではDRCのみ。イタリアで報告されたのは疑い例（イタリア国内での流行ではなく、DRC滞在後の輸入例）。

article.articleHeadline: 사망자만 246명...WHO가 주목한 에볼라 확산 상황 [지금이뉴스]
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll at 246... the Ebola outbreak that the WHO has been monitoring [Now News].
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Africa CDC estimating 1,100 suspected cases and 246 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain spreads via contact with an infected person or animal and causes fever and vomiting. With the outbreak severe, the DRC and neighboring nations have urgently mobilized large-scale response plans worth about 480 billion won. In Brazil and Italy, three individuals who recently visited Africa were isolated on suspicion of infection, raising concerns about cross-continent spread. The World Health Organization reported that five patients, including a nurse with confirmed infection, have recovered and been discharged. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasized that the absence of a dedicated vaccine or treatment does not mean Ebola patients cannot recover.

triage.headline_ja: 死者246人...WHOが注視するエボラ感染拡大状況 [今ニュース]
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による大規模流行（疑い例1,100件、死亡246人）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、アフリカ域外（ブラジル、イタリア）への感染者流出の報告により国際的拡大リスクが高い。WHOが監視報告している重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいてDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）が主要な発生地域で、ブラジルとイタリアでは「アフリカ訪問後に疑い患者として隔離」と述べられており、実際の発症地がアフリカ（DRC）であることは明確。verified_locationsはDRCとBrazilのみとする（イタリアは対象国リスト外）。ワクチン・治療法の欠如という重大な管理上の制約が記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO thông báo tin vui giữa dịch Ebola tại CHDC Congo năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Announces Good News Amid Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 2026
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola patients recovered from the Bundibugyo strain in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, marking the first cures in the current outbreak. Four were discharged today, with one released yesterday, announced by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on May 31 at the opening of a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia, Ituri province. There is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo; patients recovered through symptomatic care—IV fluids, antiemetic support, and pain relief. The outbreak remains challenging: cases have spread beyond Ituri into North Kivu and South Kivu, with suspected spread to Uganda—hundreds of suspected cases and some deaths reported. Security disruptions from armed groups (ADF, M23) and attacks on health facilities and burial practices hinder response. Authorities stress community engagement and early medical care; reports of suspected cases in Brazil have not been confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国エボラ出血熱流行の中で朗報を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の回復事例、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。明確なシグナルとしてフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUgandaとBrazilも含まれているが、記事サマリー内容の精査により以下のように判定：Uganda は『疑い例が報告されている』との記載であり、確認済みの発生地ではなく、同時にWPRO対象国ではない；Brazil は『疑い例の報告が確認されていない』と明記。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の回復事例は医学的に注目されるが、一方で新規患者・死亡事例、保健施設への攻撃、複数州への拡大が継続している点で深刻。セキュリティ環境の悪化（武装勢力ADF、M23による攪乱）は対応困難性を高める。

article.articleHeadline: Thi lớp 10: Giám đốc Sở GD-ĐT TP.HCM đến phòng thi động viên thí sinh mắc bệnh lao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Grade-10 entrance exam: Director of Ho Chi Minh City Department of Education and Training visits the exam room to encourage students with tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: On June 1, 2026, during Ho Chi Minh City's first Grade-10 entrance exam after the provincial-city consolidation, Doan Thi Diem Secondary School in Nhiêu Lộc Ward hosted a student with tuberculosis. Nguyễn Văn Hiếu, director of the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Education and Training, visited the exam room to encourage the TB patient, who was provided a separate testing room and a dedicated assistant. The day’s schedule included Vietnamese Literature (120 minutes) and a Foreign Language (90 minutes), with Mathematics (120 minutes) on June 2, and additional tests for specialized classes (150 minutes). The event highlights accommodations for students with infectious diseases within the city’s education system while maintaining standard assessment procedures.

triage.headline_ja: 10年生入試：ホーチミン市教育訓練局長が結核患者の受験生を励ましに試験会場を訪問
triage.triage_reason: 結核患者の受験生1名が試験会場で受験することについての教育上の対応に関する報道。公衆衛生上の危機的影響、国際的拡大リスク、感染症の異常な発生パターンなしと判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核という感染症に関連しているが、感染症のアウトブレイクや異常な発生を報告するものではなく、既に診断されている個別患者の教育的配慮に関する行政対応の報道である。感染症危機管理の対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola cases rise to 282; WHO requests to reconsider travel restrictions
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths; Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. Brazil is monitoring two suspected cases in Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo. A Bunia treatment centre with 24 beds (expandable to 60) has yielded five recoveries, four of whom are health workers; these are among the first documented recoveries in the current Congo outbreak. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urges reconsideration of travel bans and border closures, arguing such measures hinder response and erode trust, despite Ebola being designated a Global Health Emergency. The Indian government has increased airport surveillance. Treatments and vaccines for Bundibugyo virus are not yet available, highlighting ongoing needs for treatment access, containment, and continued surveillance and lab confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者数が282人に増加、WHOが渡航制限の再検討を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の確認例282例、死亡42例という重大な公衆衛生影響、複数国への国際的拡大、WHOが国際保健緊急事態を宣言した異常事象、国境措置の協議による国際政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、DRC（Bunia治療センター等での確認例282例）とUgandaが主要な発生地。Brazilは疑い症例2例が報告されているため対象国として含める。Indiaは空港監視強化の実施国として含める。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOが国際保健緊急事態を既に宣言しており、フルRRA対象案件。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, cordoni sanitari e vigili del fuoco: specialisti in azione a Cagliari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, quarantine cordons and firefighters: specialists in action in Cagliari.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola infection in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy. A Congolese national, resident of Cagliari, who recently returned from Kinshasa with a layover in Cairo, presents symptoms compatible with Ebola. Protocols have been immediately activated to remove the person from the residence and transport them to hospital, with quarantine cordons and firefighters involved in the response. The patient has been admitted, placed in isolation at the appropriate health facility, and is under continuous medical supervision. The Sardinia Region is in ongoing contact with the Ministry of Health, local and national health authorities, Civil Protection, and the Spallanzani Institute in Rome, where the virus test will be performed to confirm infection. As of now there is no confirmed case; results from Rome will determine positivity and guide further measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、隔離措置と消防士：カリアリで専門家が対応
triage.triage_reason: 疑い症例が複数の国にまたがる国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念（エボラ）であり、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当する可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国のキンシャサから帰国した者であり、DRCが原発地。イタリア・エジプトは経由地および疑い症例の報告地。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。イタリア・エジプトは対象外のため verified_locations に含めない。記事公開日が2026年6月という将来日付だが、シグナルトリアージの評価に影響しない。

article.articleHeadline: طبيب: عدد الوفيات الحقيقي بسبب إيبولا في أوغندا أعلى من إحصاءات الصحة العالمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor: The true death toll from Ebola in Uganda is higher than global health statistics
article.articleSummary: Dr. Eliya Kiza in Kampala says the Ebola death toll in Uganda exceeds World Health Organization tallies, which count a single death in the country. Responding to WHO’s latest data, he told Novosti that newer fatalities have occurred. On May 17, the WHO declared the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), near Uganda, a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The outbreak’s epicenter lies in Ituri Province, on the border with Uganda; health authorities first detected alarms on May 5, with experts noting transmission may have begun weeks earlier. Ebola is among the most deadly viral hemorrhagic diseases, with fatality rates ranging from 25% to 90% depending on the strain and health response. It spreads from wildlife to humans and, via bodily fluids or contaminated tissues, between people; Africa has faced multiple waves, including the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic with over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 医師：ウガンダのエボラ死亡者数は世界保健機関の統計より多い
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のPHEIC宣言済み事象であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。DRCとウガンダの国境地域での流行で国際的拡大リスク高く、致死率25～90%の極度に重症な病原体である。
triage.notes: 2026年6月配信だが、記事実質は2026年5月17日のWHO PHEIC宣言（DRCイトゥリ州でのエボラ流行）を主題としている。記事では実際の死亡者がWHO統計より多い可能性を指摘。ウガンダは隣接地域での確認例を示唆しており、両国が検証地域として妥当。DRCはGeoNames ID 203312で対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Over 1,100 Suspected Ebola Cases In Africa, 43 Dead So Far, Health Body Urges Wider Response
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in eastern DR Congo and Uganda: Africa CDC reports 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths as of Saturday, with over 1,100 suspected infections across the two countries. This follows a WHO international health alert weeks earlier. Africa CDC had also noted 246 suspected deaths. MSF calls the outbreak 'deeply alarming,' warning the true scale remains unknown as transmission accelerates. The outbreak spans three Congolese provinces and Uganda, with Ituri province identified as the worst-affected region. In response, DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan ministers adopted a $319-million regional action plan. WHO chief Tedros visited Ituri to bolster coordination, funding, and community engagement. Separately, in Brazil, a 37-year-old man who had travelled to DR Congo presented with fever as a suspected case; later evaluation revealed meningitis. A second Brazilian patient tested positive for malaria; Ebola was not indicated.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラの疑い例が1,100件以上、43人が死亡 - 保健機関が広範な対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間爆発的流行で、重篤な死亡者、国際的拡大リスク、社会政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri州含む）とウガンダでのエボラ流行を主題としており、両国の保健相による3億1900万ドルの地域行動計画採択、WHO事務局長のIturi訪問等の国際的対応も記載されている。ブラジルの事例は後発的な記載であり、エボラ陰性確認済み。対象国リストから、DRC（203312）のみが実際の流行地として verified_locations に含まれる。ウガンダはGeoNamesリストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Quatre nouveaux malades d'Ebola guéris à Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four more Ebola patients cured in Bunia
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Four more Ebola patients treated at the Centre médical évangélique (CME) in Bunia were declared cured on May 31, 2026, bringing the total recoveries to five since the government declared the outbreak about 17 days earlier. All cured patients are nurses at CME Bunia, including one woman, who contracted Ebola while performing duty. Medical director Calvin Ambitapio said survivors received symptomatic care—treating malaria-like symptoms and using antibiotics—and after several days of observation and daily testing, the latest results were negative. He emphasized there is no specific Ebola treatment or vaccine yet, but symptomatic management can lead to recovery. Jeanne Alasha, health adviser to the provincial governor, urged residents to trust medical services as the outbreak is addressed.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでエボラ患者4人が治癒
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の進行中の流行であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に複数該当し、また医療従事者の感染が確認されている点で管理可能性に懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月1日配信で、DRCのイトゥリ州ブニアでのエボラ流行を報道している。医療従事者（看護師を含む）の職業上の感染が記録されており、医療施設内での感染拡大リスクがある。政府が約17日前に流行を宣言しており、進行中の対応状況と言える。記事で言及されているマラリアは症状管理の文脈であり、独立した流行ではなく、エボラの診断過程での鑑別対象として記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak exposes community health gaps
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain. As of 27 May, DRC reports over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths; Uganda reports seven cases and one death. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May amid high insecurity in eastern DRC and porous borders, increasing regional risk. The most urgent issue is whether investments in community-based surveillance exist to detect outbreaks early, since detection often occurs five to seven days after symptoms begin, enabling spread before alert. Community surveillance with door-to-door monitoring can shorten detection to hours and trigger rapid response. Evidence: 2022 Uganda Ebola reduced detection to 24–48 hours; 2018-2020 DRC Ebola saw community alerts drive the response. Diagnostics and risk communication remain critical; rapid point-of-care tests exist but underutilized due to incentives; FIND should accelerate access.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ出血熱の流行がコミュニティヘルスの課題を露呈
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的感染の危険性、WHO緊急事態宣言、1000件以上の疑い患者と246件の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのBundibugyo Ebola出血熱の流行が主題。Uganda（Bundibugyo は技術的にはDRCの地域）も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。WHO は2026年5月17日に国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、国際対応の重要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 263 إصابة مؤكدة و43 وفاة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونجو وأوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths from Ebola virus in Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of May 31, 2026, 263 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 43 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected infections under investigation. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain and is the seventh Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the third-largest since the disease's discovery, outpacing many global response efforts. World Health Organization has declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Health workers report shortages of basic supplies, including masks, and say the virus has circulated for weeks before detection, hampering containment. John Nkengasong, director-general of Africa CDC, wrote in the Financial Times urging rapid activation of national emergency systems and sustained investments in outbreak preparedness, emphasizing that international support is most effective when aligned with African strategies and governance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスでコンゴとウガンダで263例の確定患者と43例の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は致死性が高く公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、国際的な拡大リスクが明確であり、WHOがPHEIC宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴとウガンダの両国の発生を述べているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言し、国際的支援の必要性が明記されている。1,100例以上の疑い例があり、検出前に数週間流行していた点は封じ込め困難を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, l'epidemia Bundibugyo nell'ombra dei tagli Usaid
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, the Bundibugyo outbreak under the shadow of USAID cuts
article.articleSummary: June 1, 2026 — Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, north‑east) and neighboring Uganda persists as the country’s seventeenth Ebola event. Ebola, discovered in 1976, can kill up to 50% of those infected; Bundibugyo is rare and poorly studied, with no adequate tests, vaccines, or therapies. The response is hindered by conflict and limited lab capacity: samples must travel about 1,700 km to Kinshasa’s INRB for confirmation. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. US funding cuts compound challenges: USAID closed last year and cut Congo funds by about 80%; CDC Atlanta’s capacity reduced; IRC reports suspected cases in DRC and Uganda rising ~103% in 96 hours. As of May 27, CDC Africa logged 1,077 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths in DRC; WHO, by May 29, counted 129 confirmed cases and 18 deaths across both countries. Oxford is pursuing a new vaccine, with animal testing anticipated in 2–3 months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、ブンディブギョ流行がUSAID削減の影に隠れる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク・WHO PHEIC宣言）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、高い社会的関心あり。フルRRA進行を推奨。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認されるイベント発生地はDRC（Ituri州、キンシャサ）およびウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bluedotの発生地域にはGeorgia/Atlantaも含まれるが、これらは記事サマリーでは米国の支援・検査能力削減の背景要因として言及されているのみで、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）、1,077の疑い患者・246の疑い死亡（DRC）、129の確定患者・18の死亡（両国）、エボラ致死率50%、ブンディブギョ亜型の稀少性と検査・ワクチン・治療法の欠如、紛争による対応の阻害、ウガンダとの国境越え拡大のため高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DRC escalates as conflict hampers response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak of Bundibugyo strain in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri) escalates as conflict disrupts containment. As of mid-May outbreak, at least 10 confirmed deaths and around 220 suspected deaths, with hundreds of suspected cases reported. The World Health Organization warns the crisis is worsened by armed clashes that disrupt health services and hamper access to patients and contacts. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is visiting Kinshasa region to press for humanitarian access and ceasefires to enable vaccination trials and patient care. Vaccines and treatments for Bundibugyo strain are under evaluation, with no approved options yet. The epicentre is Ituri, where fighting has displaced millions and affected outbreak response. The analysis highlights the collision of disease and conflict as the main containment barrier, requiring security arrangements alongside medical interventions. International agencies urge immediate ceasefires to accelerate containment.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ感染症アウトブレイクが拡大、紛争が対応を阻害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、およびWPRO基準5項目全て該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク、230人以上の死者、紛争による対応困難、ワクチン・治療法の未承認、国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの大規模アウトブレイクであり、紛争の影響により通常の感染症対応が大きく阻害されている。WHOトップが現地訪問、国際機関が即時停戦を要求するなど国際的な関心が極めて高い。ワクチン・治療法が未承認であるため医学的な対応選択肢も限定的である。

article.articleHeadline: WHO urges review of Ebola travel restrictions - Pakistan Today
article.articleSummary: 134 confirmed Ebola cases and 18 deaths have been recorded in the current Congo-Uganda outbreak, with the Bundibugyo strain concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Cumulative cases since the May 15 declaration exceed 1,000. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged countries to review travel restrictions, warning curbs may deter transparent reporting and community-led responses. Canada and the United States have restricted travel for residents of Congo, Uganda and South Sudan; Rwanda and Uganda have limited travel from Congo, with Rwanda barring entry to foreign nationals who passed through Congo in the prior 30 days. Brazil is monitoring two suspected Ebola cases: Sao Paulo – a Congolese man with fever; initial tests negative, isolated. Rio de Janeiro – a Ugandan man with viral symptoms; malaria later confirmed; case under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはエボラ出血熱の渡航制限の見直しを促す - Pakistan Today
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な国際的拡大、複数国の渡航制限）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性で該当。国際的に関心が高い」。
triage.notes: 記事は南キブ州およびイトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱の発生（DRC）を主題としており、ブラジルはサーベイランス段階での疑い症例報告地。対象国リストに含まれる地域のみ verified_locations に含めた。South Sudan、Rwanda、Uganda、Canada、US、Sudanは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Ebola patients recover in DRC as WHO chief urges trust, open borders
article.articleSummary: Five patients infected with the Ebola Bundibugyo virus have recovered in Bunia, Ituri Province, DRC; four medical workers were discharged after two negative tests, and a laboratory worker had already returned home. WHO Director‑General Tedros attended the opening of a new Ebola treatment center and stressed that, despite no licensed vaccine or specific treatment yet, timely medical care enables recovery. As of May 29, the DRC reported 263 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with more than 1,100 test results pending as of May 30. The outbreak spans Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; authorities aim to contain it within three provinces with a four-to-six month horizon. Testing capacity has grown to about 200–300 tests per day from around 900 samples tested. Tedros urged trust, coordinated public messaging, and open borders, warning that bans could hinder the response; suspected cases were investigated in Brazil and Italy, and Kenya debated the quarantine facility plan following a court ruling.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ患者5人が回復 WHO事務局長が信頼と国境開放を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の確定患者263例・死亡42例を伴う進行中のアウトブレイク。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的拡大リスク（疑似症例がブラジル・イタリアで調査中）と渡航制限リスク（ケニアでの検疫施設計画にも波及）が確認される。フルリスク評価（RRA）に進むべき。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIがBrazil、Italyを発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーでは「疑似症例が調査された」と記載されており、確認されたアウトブレイク発生地はDRCのみ。Kenya も同様に疑似症対応の検疫計画であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外。DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: União Africana alerta para mais de 1.100 casos suspeitos de ebola: 'Devemos agir na velocidade da epidemia'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Union warns of more than 1,100 suspected Ebola cases: "We must act at the pace of the epidemic."
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, the African Union warns of an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, with more than 1,100 suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Laboratory-confirmed cases total 263, with 43 deaths reported. Health ministers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan approved a US$319 million response plan to address the outbreak. Jean Kaseya of the African Union stressed the urgency to act at the pace of the epidemic and noted that the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus currently has neither a vaccine nor a specific treatment. The report underscores rapid, coordinated action and resource mobilization across the affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合、1,100件以上のエボラ疑い患者を警告：「流行のペースで行動する必要がある」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の多数患者、複数国での国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株でのワクチン・治療法がない状況で、確定患者263名・死亡43名、疑い患者1,100名超の大規模流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示される発生国はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リスト内ではDRC(203312)のみ該当。South Sudan(スーダン)も言及されているがサマリー上では健康大臣会議参加国として記載され、具体的な発生事例は記載されていないため除外。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法がない点が特に懸念。アフリカ連合による3.19億米ドル対応計画承認、迅速な国際協力の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: 巴西疑似伊波拉病例增至2 1人检测呈阴但仍须隔离 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola cases in Brazil rise to 2; one person tested negative but still must be isolated.
article.articleSummary: Two individuals in Brazil remain under isolation as suspected Ebola virus disease cases as of June 1, 2026. A 37-year-old man who recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo developed fever and Ebola-like symptoms and was quarantined at the São Paulo Institute of Infectious Diseases; he has since been diagnosed with severe meningitis, with further Ebola testing ongoing. A second man who arrived in Rio de Janeiro from Uganda on May 22 presented with cough, chills and diarrhea; malaria testing was positive, while Ebola testing was negative, though he remains isolated during investigations. Brazilian health authorities, including São Paulo state and the Health Ministry, are conducting laboratory confirmation and surveillance for imported exposures from Ebola-affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの疑似エボラ病例が2例に増加、1人は検査が陰性だが隔離継続が必要
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な輸入事例で、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）からの輸入事例であり、公衆衛生当局の対応が進行中で、渡航に関連した感染症リスク管理が活動している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、ブラジルの2例の疑似エボラ患者は、DRCおよびウガンダからの輸入事例。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。現在進行中の検査・隔離対応により、単なる感染症報告ではなく公衆衛生対応イベントとして扱う。マラリア陽性例も報告されているが、主要なシグナルはエボラに関連する輸入リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Déclaration conjointe du Gouvernement de la République démocratique du Congo et de l'OMS concernant l'épidémie de maladie à virus Ebola causée par la souche Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Joint statement by the Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the WHO on the Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, the Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and the World Health Organization (WHO) report an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, with cases and deaths in Ituri Province and spillover into Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu. Following a Bunia mission led by Health Minister Dr. Samuel Roger Kamba and high-level WHO engagement, surveillance, laboratory analyses, and patient care are being intensified to interrupt transmission. The response is nationally led, with provincial coordination in Ituri and neighboring provinces, and backed by the WHO and UN system. Community engagement is central, including dialogue with local leaders, women, youth, religious figures, and the private sector to co-create culturally appropriate interventions. Although there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, essential public health measures can slow spread; randomized controlled trials for vaccines and therapies are planned. Priorities include early detection, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, IPC, community awareness, and maintaining primary health services and open borders to expedite supplies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国政府とWHOによるブンディブギョ株エボラウイルス病アウトブレイクに関する共同声明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準で複数該当し、ブンディブギョ株エボラの新規アウトブレイク報告は高リスクシグナル。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラの新規アウトブレイク報告。イツリ州で複数の症例・死亡が確認され、ノール・キヴ州およびスッド・キヴ州への二次伝播を報告。政府・WHO・国連システムによる統合対応が開始されている。ライセンス取得済みワクチンや特異的治療法がないため、公衆衛生対策への依存度が高い。多くの懸念要因が複合している高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола е неудържим вирус, може да достигне и Бразилия - Новини от Dnes.bg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is an unstoppable virus; it could reach Brazil as well.
article.articleSummary: June 1, 2026 — Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) surpasses 1,000 cases and 250 deaths, driven by Bundibugyo virus; no vaccine exists. MSF warns the outbreak is unfolding faster than relief work can respond, with uncertain scale. Two suspected Ebola cases are under investigation in Brazil: a 37-year-old man from the DRC isolated in São Paulo after compatible symptoms; Rio de Janeiro authorities imposed emergency measures after a Ugandan visitor presented viral symptoms. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids or infected wildlife; symptoms include nausea, rashes, and bleeding from ears, eyes, nose, and mouth. The World Health Organization urges against border closures to avoid discouraging transparent reporting, even as the United States bars entry of non-US citizens from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, and Rwanda and Uganda closed borders. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasizes the need for transparency to save lives.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは制御不能なウイルスであり、ブラジルにも到達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で該当。複数国での疑い事例と対象国ブラジルでの検査対象事例により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行（1,000症例超、250死亡、Bundibugyo型）が主要なシグナル。ブラジル（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）での2件の疑い事例が国際的拡大リスクを示唆。複数国での渡航制限措置が実施されている。記事配信日時が2026年6月1日となっているため、将来予測シナリオまたはテスト記事の可能性があるが、シグナル評価は記事内容に基づき実施。

article.articleHeadline: 确诊病例增至282例｜世卫：刚果（金）伊波拉疫情5人康复　未来可望更多人病愈 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed cases rise to 282 | WHO: Five people have recovered from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; more people are expected to recover in the future - International - Live
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-01, the World Health Organization reports 4 Bundibugyo Ebola cases among healthcare workers in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo have recovered, with a lab worker also recovering this week, bringing total recoveries to 5. The DRC has 282 confirmed Ebola cases to date, with 42 deaths after 19 new confirmed cases this week. Brazil and Italy are investigating suspected cases linked to travel to the outbreak region. Earlier this month, WHO declared the DRC and Uganda Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia and noted there is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola, though survival improves with good medical care. This is DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak and the third largest since discovery; Africa CDC reports more than 1,100 suspected cases awaiting investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 確定患者数282例に増加｜WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情で5人が回復　今後さらに多くの患者の治癒が期待される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョ・エボラの公衆衛生上の重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限リスクが確認されている。WHOが既に公式にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言している。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスはワクチンも承認された治療法も存在しない。DRC内での患者数282例（死亡42例）、1,100以上の疑い例が調査中。ブラジルとイタリアで渡航関連の疑い例が報告されており、国際的な拡大の兆候がある。WHOはすでにPHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: 雨後病媒蚊暴增！家中「這些積水死角」快清除　防治關鍵一次看 - 健康新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the rain, disease-carrying mosquitoes surge! Quickly remove these standing-water hotspots in your home — the key to prevention and control at a glance.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports 64 confirmed dengue cases through May 25, 2026: 1 locally acquired and 63 imported, mainly from Southeast Asia; Indonesia leads with 19, Maldives 14, and Vietnam 8. A domestic case marks Taiwan’s first local transmission; with the rainy season, mosquito breeding and community spread risk rise. The CDC urges elimination of standing water using the ‘巡、倒、清、刷’ approach: inspect indoor/outdoor areas, discard or drain unused containers (tires, cans, tarps, bottles, plant saucer bases); for large discarded items, request cleaning services; scrub or invert items; weekly brush of water-storage containers’ inner walls to remove eggs. Globally, dengue exceeded 1.02 million cases and 300 deaths by April 2026, with outbreaks in the Americas (Brazil, Bolivia) and rising cases in Vietnam, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, East Timor, Cambodia, and Laos. Travelers with fever and dengue-like symptoms should seek care and report travel history to doctors; returnees should inform airport quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: 雨後病媒蚊暴增！家中「這些積水死角」快清除　防治關鍵一次看
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で国内感染1例を含む64例の確定症例が報告され、東南アジア地域での大規模流行（インドネシア19例、モルジブ14例、ベトナム8例）が背景にある。雨季によるネッコ媒介感染症の流行拡大リスク、国際的拡散の可能性、および公衆衛生当局による積極的な予防啓発活動が確認される。IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事はアジア地域のデング熱流行を報告しており、台湾での国内感染例発生（初の地域感染）とともに、東南アジアからの輸入症例が多数報告されている。対象国リスト内では、ベトナム、インドネシア、ブラジルが記事サマリーで明示的に言及されている流行地域である。カンボジア、ラオスも言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。スペイン（カナリア諸島）の記載は本記事の主題ではなく参考情報のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Lagos Airport Reviews Emergency Response, Tightens Passenger Monitoring
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-01, Lagos' Murtala Muhammed International Airport (MMIA) intensified Ebola surveillance as authorities respond to renewed Ebola concerns from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Federal Airports Authority of Nigeria (FAAN), Lagos State health officials and Port Health Services conducted a joint inspection of MMIA facilities to evaluate detection, monitoring and response capabilities and strengthen preventive measures against importation. The visit involved Lagos State Health Commissioner Prof. Emmanuel Akinola Abayomi, MMIA Airport Manager Olatokunbo Arewa, FAAN and Port Health leaders, among others. The emergency preparedness plan was reviewed; comprehensive risk assessments completed; airlines from high-risk destinations flagged for enhanced monitoring; passenger screening forms are being administered on designated flights; and concrete responsibilities were assigned. FAAN and the Nigeria Civil Aviation Authority continue coordinated compliance with international health regulations, underscoring ongoing readiness to detect, report, and respond swiftly to any Ebola threat at MMIA.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: ラゴス空港が緊急対応を見直し、乗客監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は致命的感染症であり、DRCからの輸入リスク対応としてのナイジェリア空港での強化監視体制構築は国際保健上重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで検出されたLagos/Lagos State/DRC/Nigeriaは対象国リストに含まれていません。記事はナイジェリア（ラゴス空港）とDRCの両国にまたがるイベントですが、両国ともWPRO対象国外のため verified_locations は空配列とします。ただしエボラ出血熱の国際的リスクが高いため、PICKUP判定としています。

article.articleHeadline: ++ Ebola, negativo il test del paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo ++ - Notizie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, negative test for the patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola test negative for the patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo. The Italian Ministry of Health says the risk in Italy remains very low. Analyses were performed at Rome’s Spallanzani Institute. The patient returned to Italy on May 30, developed some symptoms, called 118, and was transported to the biocontainment unit at Santissima Trinità Hospital in Cagliari for diagnostic workup per established protocols. The ministry remains in contact with Sardinia’s health authorities. No infection detected; Ebola ruled out. The report underscores ongoing vigilance for travelers from Ebola-affected regions and confirms swift containment procedures. No further details on symptoms or exposure are provided. Imported case risk to Italy is currently minimal, with continued monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、コンゴから帰国したサルデーニャの患者の検査が陰性
triage.triage_reason: 患者の検査が陰性でエボラ熱感染が除外され、イタリアのリスクは極めて低いと評価されている。実際の感染症発生ではなく、単なる疑い例の検査結果報告であるため、フルRRAの対象ではない。
triage.notes: 本報告はイタリアへの輸入疑い例（陰性）であり、対象国はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれていない。エボラ検査陰性判定により実感染症事例ではなく、公衆衛生上の具体的な脅威は認められない。DRCでの発生そのものについては言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, test negativo per il paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo. I sintomi e il ricovero, cosa è successo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, negative test for the patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo. The symptoms and hospitalization, what happened.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola test for a patient who returned to Sardinia from the Democratic Republic of the Congo was negative, according to the Italian Health Ministry. The man, who landed in Italy on May 30, developed symptoms the following day, and was taken by 118 to biocontainment at Santissima Trinità Hospital in Cagliari for diagnostic workup, with analyses conducted by Rome’s Spallanzani Institute. The Health Ministry stressed that the risk to Italy remains very low. An ordinance sets entry declarations for arrivals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with a 24-hour requirement to declare origin for the 21 days prior. It defines five risk levels (very low to very high) based on exposure and symptoms, guiding surveillance, quarantine, or biocontainment transport. Fiumicino airport is designated as a national health hub; regional infectious disease reference centers support rapid case identification and centralized management.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴから帰国したサルデーニャの患者の検査は陰性。症状と入院、何が起こったか
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い患者が検出されたが、検査結果は陰性で直接的なリスクは低下。ただし国際的な疫学的関心と感染症サーベイランス体制の実装状況から継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国から帰国し、イタリアで検査を受けたが、検査結果は陰性。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。コンゴ民主共和国はエボラの流行地域であり、疑い患者の発生は報告すべきシグナルだが、検査陰性により直接的な脅威は軽減。ただしサーベイランス体制の整備と渡航者スクリーニングが実施されていることから、公衆衛生対応の観点では重要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجل 282 إصابة مؤكدة بفايروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records 282 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-01, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 282 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases, including 42 deaths. Data released by the Ministry of Communications and Media show 264 cases in Ituri Province, 15 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu. The update indicates a heavy geographic concentration of cases in Ituri, with smaller outbreaks in the neighboring eastern provinces. The brief does not provide additional context on transmission chains, exposure sources, or public health responses, and it does not specify timelines for new infections beyond the current tally. This reporting reflects the latest eastern DRC outbreak activity as of 2026-06-01.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスの確定症例282件を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（282確定例、42死亡）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクの3基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準においても重症度（死亡例あり）、流行しやすさ、管理可能性すべて該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い死亡率と国際的懸念を伴う一級感染症。東部DRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州）での多地点発生を示唆。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo tests negative.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease: A man who returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Sardinia tested negative for Ebola. He arrived in Italy on Saturday, May 30, developed mild symptoms, and was transported under biocontainment to the Santissima Trinità hospital in Cagliari after contacting emergency services. The Ebola test was performed yesterday at Rome’s Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases and returned negative. The patient remains in routine contact with Sardinian health authorities, and officials reiterate that the risk of transmission in Italy remains very low. This event underscores continued surveillance for imported infections, with no confirmed Ebola case reported in Italy to date.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：コンゴから帰国したサルデーニャの患者が陰性
triage.triage_reason: 患者はエボラウイルス検査で陰性となり、確認事例ではない。イタリアではエボラ確認例がなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 患者は疑似例であり、検査で陰性が確認されている。記事はDRCでの流行を扱っておらず、イタリアへの輸入事例の監視を記録したもの。DRCにおけるエボラの発生状況に関する情報は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il test del paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the patient's Ebola test is negative after returning to Sardinia from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola test on a patient who returned to Sardinia from Congo was negative. The Italian Ministry of Health notes that Ebola risk in Italy remains very low. Tests were conducted at the Spallanzani Institute in Rome. The patient arrived in Italy on Saturday, May 30; on Sunday, after developing some symptoms, he called 118 and was taken to the biocontainment unit at Santissima Trinità Hospital in Cagliari for the necessary diagnostic assessments, in line with current protocols. The negative result follows careful laboratory confirmation, and authorities maintain that the national risk is still very low. The case involves travel from Congo to Sardinia; no Ebola infection has been confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴから帰国した患者のテスト結果は陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い事例であるが、検査結果が陰性で確定症例ではなく、イタリアにおけるリスクは極めて低いと当局が確認。IHR基準・スクリーニング基準の該当がない。

article.articleHeadline: 雨後病媒蚊暴增！家中「這些積水死角」快清除　防治關鍵一次看 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the rain, vector mosquitoes surge! Quickly clear these stagnant-water pockets in your home. The key to prevention and control at a glance.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports 64 confirmed dengue cases as of May 25, 2026, with 1 locally acquired and 63 imported from Southeast and South Asia—Indonesia leads with 19 cases, followed by the Maldives (14) and Vietnam (8). This is the first local case of the year, occurring as the rainy season begins; warmer, wetter conditions will boost Aedes mosquito breeding and raise community transmission risk. The Centers for Disease Control Taiwan urges households to eliminate standing water and follow the ‘Sweep, Empty, Scrub, and Store’ approach: remove unused containers (tires, cans, bottles, plant trays); for large waste like bathtubs or aquariums, arrange cleanup; scrub items to remove eggs and invert or cover stored items; weekly scrubbing of water-storage containers’ inner walls. Protection includes light-colored long-sleeved clothing and government-approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR3535). Seek prompt medical care for fever, headache, or muscular/joint pain and report travel history; returning travelers with dengue symptoms should inform airport quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: 雨後病媒蚊暴增！家中「這些積水死角」快清除　防治關鍵一次看
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのデング熱確定症例64例（うち1例が地域内感染）の報告、インドネシア・モルディブ・ベトナムからの流入症例が主要因。季節条件による感染拡大リスク上昇、地域内感染開始の兆候、複数国での並行流行がWPRO基準を満たし、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 台湾はBluedot APIで記載されているが対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。しかし、イベントの主要な特徴はベトナムとインドネシアから台湾への症例流入である。ラニーニャ条件下での蚊媒介感染病シーズン開始、地域内感染開始という異常な徴候が認められ、複数国での並行流行パターンがWPRO基準全て（5/5）および IHR基準3項目を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Ninh lên phương án phòng chống dịch bệnh Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quang Ninh lays out a plan to prevent and control Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: Quang Ninh Province, Vietnam, issued directive 2129/UBND-VHXH to prevent and control Ebola virus disease. The plan targets border towns and gates, especially near frontiers, to ensure readiness with trained personnel, supplies, chemicals, equipment, and transport; establish 24/7 disease surveillance and rapid-response teams; train health workers in surveillance, investigation, and outbreak management; develop quarantine and border-control plans; and maintain ready resources to respond to any suspected cases. The Department of Health will coordinate infection prevention in healthcare facilities and oversee staff training. Public communication will inform travelers and residents about the disease and preventive measures to prevent panic. International context: WHO reports that as of May 26, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 125 confirmed Ebola cases, 17 deaths, 906 suspected cases, and 223 suspected deaths, with spread across eastern regions amid conflict. UNICEF has shipped over 100 tons of relief via EU flights to DRC, including PPE, medicines, and sanitation supplies, aiding about 100,000 people, and allocated over $6.5 million to field operations and water/sanitation efforts.

triage.headline_ja: クアンニン省がエボラ出血熱の予防・制御計画を策定
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの確認されたエボラ症例125例・死亡17例という深刻な公衆衛生影響、ベトナムでの予防的対応という予想外の展開、国境地域での感染拡大リスク、および複数対象国での懸念のため、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラの活動的な流行（確認症例125例、死亡17例、疑い症例906例）が対象国内で記事の主題として述べられている。ベトナムはDRCの流行に対する予防的対応を実施している。WPROスクリーニング基準はすべて該当。フルRRA実施の優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il test del paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo - Cinque Colonne Magazine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the patient's Ebola test came back negative after returning to Sardinia from the Congo - Cinque Colonne Magazine
article.articleSummary: Ebola test negative for a patient who returned to Sardinia, Italy, from the Congo. Analyses were conducted at Rome’s Spallanzani Institute and confirmed by the Health Ministry. The patient arrived in Italy on May 30, 2026, after traveling from Kinshasa with a layover in Cairo, and developed symptoms on arrival in Sardinia. He was transported under biocontainment to the Santissima Trinità Hospital in Cagliari for diagnostic workup after contacting emergency services (118). The Ministry stated that Italy’s overall risk remains very low, with Sardinian and national health authorities maintaining close coordination. The negative result was reported on May 31, 2026. The case highlights ongoing vigilance for travelers from Ebola-affected regions, with no indication of further infections at this time.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、コンゴから返国したサルデーニャの患者の検査が陰性 - Cinque Colonne Magazine

triage.notes: 本事例はエボラ曝露の疑い事例であるが、検査結果が陰性であり、実際の確定感染症ではない。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはエボラの流行国であり、エボラ感染地域からの帰国者の健康監視は重要だが、本事例は医学的には解決している。記事の日付が2026年6月となっており、将来日付である点に留意。

article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda reports 263 laboratory-confirmed cases as of May 30, 2026, according to Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya. The outbreak remains ongoing across both countries, signaling continued transmission in East Africa. The report provides only the case count and does not include deaths, specific symptoms, infection sources, or laboratory confirmation methods beyond confirmation. It underscores the need for sustained regional surveillance and cross-border coordination, though no details on vaccination campaigns or public health interventions are given. This update offers a concise snapshot of the current Ebola situation in the DRC and Uganda for readers tracking infectious disease outbreaks.
