triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているのはDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダでのエボラ病確認。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため除外。モザンビークは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでは言及なし。263例の確認症例、継続的な伝播が指摘されており、東アフリカでの地域的拡大のリスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Homens com possíveis sintomas colocados em isolamento no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Men with possible symptoms placed in isolation in Brazil
article.articleSummary: Two men in Brazil—one from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and one from Uganda—were placed in isolation after presenting symptoms compatible with Ebola; no virus confirmed in either case. In Rio de Janeiro, a man who arrived from Uganda on May 22 exhibited fever, cough, chills and diarrhea; malaria tested positive and Ebola tests were negative, though he remains in isolation while investigations continue. In São Paulo, officials are assessing a suspected Ebola case in a man who recently traveled to the DRC; he was isolated after fever but later showed a severe meningitis and Ebola testing remains ongoing. Authorities regard the risk of introduction to Brazil as very low due to no local transmission and no direct flights from Africa; monitoring for fever and recent travel to the DRC and close contacts is advised. The DRC outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain (30–50% fatality; no licensed vaccine or approved treatment). Africa CDC cites 246 deaths and over 1,000 suspected cases; Uganda reports two additional cases, total nine, with the virus detected in three DRC provinces and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ブラジルで疑わしい症状のある男性が隔離される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのエボラ疑い事例は IHR 基準で異常性・予想外性が高く、DRC 発生地での Bundibugyo 株（30-50% 致死率）による大規模流行との関連で国際的拡大リスクがある。スクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的関心も存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、ブラジル（Rio de Janeiro、São Paulo の両都市）および DRC でエボラ関連イベントが実際に発生・確認されている。Uganda は発生地域に含まれているが、記事では「Uganda から到着した患者はマラリア陽性でエボラ陰性」と述べられており、Uganda 自体でのイベント主題ではなく、渡航元の記載のみのため verified_locations には含めない方が正確。ただし Africa CDC による統計では Uganda で 9 例（検出 3 例）が報告されており、情報の完全性を考慮すると含める選択肢も有るが、サマリー主題はブラジルと DRC に集中しているため現状の判定とする。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the rain, disease-carrying mosquitoes surge! Quickly clear these standing-water hotspots in your home. Key prevention and control at a glance.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Taiwan totals 64 confirmed cases by May 25, 2026: 1 locally acquired and 63 imported from Southeast and South Asia (Indonesia 19, the Maldives 14, Vietnam 8). The domestic case arrives as the rainy season begins; higher rainfall and heat boost Aedes mosquito breeding and community transmission risk. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention urges the public to implement the four-action approach—patrol, discard, clean, brush—by inspecting indoor/outdoor spaces, removing unused containers, scrubbing or inverting large items, and weekly brushing of water-storage containers. Personal protection includes wearing light-colored long sleeves/pants and using approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, or IR-3535). Seek prompt medical care for fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, and myalgia/arthralgia, and report travel history; returning travelers with dengue-like symptoms should notify border quarantine. Globally, dengue exceeded 1.02 million cases and 300+ deaths by April 2026, with activity rising in the Americas and parts of Asia (Vietnam, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, East Timor).

article.articleHeadline: RT-Duits: Ebola-Verdachtsfall in São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RT-Duits: Suspected Ebola Case in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case reported in São Paulo, Brazil, an imported concern from the Democratic Republic of Congo. A 37-year-old man who recently returned from his homeland is isolated at Emílio Ribas Institute after presenting at the emergency department with high fever, disorientation, and diarrhea and is described as seriously ill and intubated. Ongoing laboratory investigations have detected a malaria infection and a bacterium associated with meningococcal meningitis, but Ebola cannot be ruled out until Ebola-specific tests confirm or exclude infection. The patient remains in isolation while diagnostic workup continues. The Democratic Republic of Congo is battling an Ebola outbreak in the northeast, notably Ituri province, with spillover to a neighboring country. MSF described the situation as concerning, and WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to assess the outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Menyesatkan: Pandemi Virus Hanta 2026 Telah Diprediksi Sejak 2022
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Misleading: The 2026 Hantavirus Pandemic Has Been Predicted Since 2022.
article.articleSummary: Misleading social-media posts claimed a 2026 hantavirus pandemic, citing a Soothsayer X account active since 2022. Hantaviruses were identified decades earlier: the Hantaan virus was isolated in 1978 from rats around the Hantan River in South Korea and later classified in the Hantavirus genus in 1981. A 1993 outbreak of hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) in the western United States sickened 53 people across 14 states. Transmission occurs mainly via inhalation of dust contaminated with rodent urine, droppings, or saliva, unlike SARS-CoV-2, which spreads via droplets. Al Jazeera characterizes the structural differences—coronavirus with spike proteins vs hantavirus with a lattice-like glycoprotein—helping explain lower hantavirus transmissibility. Incubation: COVID-19 2–14 days; HPS 7–20 days. The post originated in the Philippines and resurfaced in May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 誤解情報：2026年ハンタウイルスパンデミックは2022年から予測されていたと主張
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はファクトチェック記事であり、ソーシャルメディアの誤解情報を検証する内容。実際の新規ハンタウイルス発生イベントではなく、歴史的背景と誤情報の否定が主題である。
triage.notes: 本記事はファクトチェック/検証記事（Tempo.co「CEK FAKTA」セクション）であり、2026年のハンタウイルスパンデミック予測という誤解情報がフィリピンで発生したとの言及がある。ただし、実際の現在進行中の感染症イベント、患者発生、公衆衛生対応の報告ではなく、歴史的情報と誤情報の検証に関する記事である。シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: MS registra 6.360 casos confirmados de chikungunya - Agência de Noticias do Governo de Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul records 6,360 confirmed chikungunya cases - Government News Agency of Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports chikungunya and dengue updates for the 20th epidemiological week of 2026. Chikungunya: 12,811 probable cases with 6,360 confirmed in SINAN; 21 deaths confirmed across Dourados, Bonito, Jardim, Fátima do Sul, Douradina, Guia Lopes da Laguna and Itaporã, with 12 victims having comorbidities. There are 80 confirmed chikungunya cases in pregnant women; two deaths remain under investigation. Dengue: 5,126 probable cases and 1,077 confirmed; no dengue-related deaths reported or under investigation. In the last 14 days, Ladário shows average incidence of confirmed dengue. Vaccination: 223,322 dengue doses administered locally; MS has received 241,030 doses from the Ministry of Health. The vaccine schedule consists of two doses at a three-month interval, recommended for ages 10–14 years (11 months 29 days), the group with the highest dengue hospitalizations (6–16 years). Authorities advise against self-medication and to seek health units for symptoms. Boletins: Chikungunya SE20-2026; Dengue SE20-2026.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州、チクングニア確認患者6,360件を記録

article.articleHeadline: ++ Ebola, negativo il test del paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo ++

article.articleSummary: Ebola test negative for a patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo. The Ministry remains in contact with health authorities in Sardinia. No confirmed cases or further exposure details are provided; the report underscores ongoing vigilance for Ebola among travelers returning from the Congo, with measures in place to manage potential imported cases.

article.articleHeadline: ++ Ebola, negativo il test del paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo ++ - Ultima ora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Test of patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo is negative - Breaking News
article.articleSummary: Ebola test for a patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo is negative, with Italy’s Ministry of Health stating the risk in Italy remains very low. Analyses were conducted by Rome’s Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases. The patient arrived in Italy on Saturday, 30 May, and after developing symptoms contacted emergency services and was admitted under biocontainment to the Santissima Trinità hospital in Cagliari for diagnostic workup, in line with current protocols. The ministry is maintaining contact with Sardinia’s health authorities. This update, as of 1 June 2026, confirms no active Ebola infection detected in this import case.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴからサルデーニャに帰国した患者の検査は陰性 - 速報
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの輸入例であり、IHR基準のうち「異常・予想外」および「国際的拡大リスク」に該当する可能性があるが、患者は陰性判定されており、イタリアの公衆衛生当局が適切に対応している。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCからイタリアへの輸入例であり、DRCが実際の発生地。イタリアは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。患者は既に陰性判定を受けており、現在の感染リスクは低い。ただしエボラウイルス輸入例は注視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : deux cas suspects détectés au Brésil, un autre en Italie, après l'alerte internationale de l'OMS : Actualités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: Two Suspected Cases Detected in Brazil, Another in Italy, After WHO's International Alert: News.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases detected in Brazil and another in Italy after WHO alert on May 31. In Brazil, two men—one from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and one from Uganda—are in isolation in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro after fever, cough, and diarrhea; contact tracing under way. In Rio, a Belgian national who returned from Uganda is hospitalized; malaria diagnosed, Ebola testing pending. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the DRC is treated as a suspected case. In Sardinia, Italy, a person returning from the DRC with Ebola-like symptoms is hospitalized; Italian authorities say national risk remains very low, while Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni seeks EU border coordination for June 18–19. Since May 15, the DRC has reported about 250 deaths; Africa CDC notes spread to Uganda; WHO alert coincides with the first recovery in the DRC on May 29. Tests pending; investigations ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：WHOの国際警報後、ブラジルで2つの疑似症例、イタリアで1つ検出されたニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて深刻で予想外の国際的拡大であり、WHOが国際警報を発した。複数国での疑似症例検出と死亡報告がある。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアのサルデーニャでの症例も述べているがイタリアは対象国リストにないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでの約250死亡（5月15日以降）とウガンダへの拡大がWHO警報の根拠。ブラジルの疑似症例はDRCおよびウガンダからの渡航者であり、国際的な移動との関連が明らかである。

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയില്‍ വീണ്ടും കോവിഡ് ഭീതി; ആറാട്ടുപുഴയില്‍ ഒരു കുട്ടിക്കുകൂടി ഷിഗെല്ല സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; ജില്ലയില്‍ അതീവ ജാഗ്രതാ നിര്‍ദ്ദേശം | news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 fear returns in Alappuzha; one more child tests positive for Shigella infection in Arattupuzha; district on high-alert advisory.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, Alappuzha district in Kerala reports a fresh COVID-19 case in Vallikunnath, ending a prolonged period without confirmed infections. In Arattupuzha, a child has tested positive for Shigellosis, bringing the district’s Shigella tally to five; the patient is receiving specialized care at Kayamkulam Taluk Hospital and is reported stable. Concurrent outbreaks of dysentery and Shigellosis have prompted authorities to extend the reopening of schools and Anganwadis in Arattupuzha panchayat by 15 days. Health officials warn that COVID-19 spreads via the air and urge heightened precautions. Common symptoms include fever, sore throat, body aches, headache, fatigue, cough, shortness of breath, muscle pain, nausea, and vomiting. On Sunday, 88 people sought treatment for dysentery and 164 for fever; the previous day 133 dysentery cases were reported. Containment and sanitation measures have been intensified district-wide.

triage.headline_ja: アーラップーッパで新たなCOVID-19恐怖; アラットゥプーッパでシゲラ感染の子どもが1人追加確認; 県全体で厳重警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目以上該当（異常性・重症度、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数項目該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）。社会的・政治的関心が高い（学校閉鎖措置、当局の警告）。
triage.notes: COVID-19とShigellosis（赤痢）の同時発生。記事は2026年6月1日のケーララ州アーラップーッパ地区での報告。COVID-19は長期間の新規感染なし後の確認、Shigellosis患者は増加傾向（5例に）。当局は学校・幼児施設の再開を15日間延期し、衛生措置を強化。複数の感染症が同時進行している点とヒト-ヒト感染の懸念から、フルRRA対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les femmes plus vulnérables à la contagion par Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Women more vulnerable to Ebola transmission.
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, women are identified as the most vulnerable to Ebola transmission amid the outbreak, because traditional caregiving roles place them at the bedside of patients. They tend to bathe, feed, and wash soiled clothing for sick relatives, increasing exposure. Furaha Elisabeth, director of the Karibuni Wa Maman gynecology clinic, described this risk. A May 22 statement from ONU Femmes notes women have been disproportionately affected by Ebola for five decades, and concerns that the current outbreak may follow the same pattern. As of June 1, 2026, the government reports 282 confirmed Ebola cases, with 264 in Ituri Province. The report highlights transmission dynamics within households and the need for targeted protection of women and girls, amid ongoing outbreaks in the Ituri region including Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：女性がエボラ感染でより脆弱
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常、国際的拡大リスク）。確認症例282件、死亡率示唆。女性の脆弱性に関する社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確定症例282件（Ituri州264件）が報告されており、進行中のアウトブレイク。記事は女性の脆弱性に焦点を当てているが、実質的には活動的なエボラ感染症のイベント。DRC以外の対象国への言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: بهبودی چهار نفر از ابولا در کنگو جشن گرفته شد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The recovery of four people from Ebola in Congo was celebrated.
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola virus disease patients, nurses in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, have recovered, announced on 1 June 2026. The World Health Organization celebrated the recovery on Sunday with Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, noting these are the first Bunia survivors due to early diagnosis. During his visit to the DRC, Tedros met government officials and tribal leaders and reported handing over the key to a new Ebola diagnosis and treatment center to local authorities, urging prompt testing and care. In the current outbreak that has persisted for more than a month, only five people have recovered so far. Congo and Uganda are among the most affected countries, with over 1,100 suspected Ebola cases, 263 confirmed cases, and 43 deaths reported to date. The report highlights early detection as a critical factor in preventing fatalities in this ongoing crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラからの4人の回復が祝われた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認された流行が進行中であり、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する。DRCおよびウガンダで1,100件以上の疑い症例、263件の確認症例、43人の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの具体的な患者症例が明記されていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。DRCでの流行は進行中（1ヶ月以上継続）で、WHOが対応を強化している状況が明らかである。回復例の報告は肯定的だが、全体的には深刻な流行状況が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Clínicas de ebola são incendiadas no Congo; entenda os motivos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola clinics are set on fire in Congo; find out why.
article.articleSummary: Attacks on Ebola treatment centers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have heightened concerns after the WHO designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. On May 21, a treatment center in eastern DRC was burned, with two additional facilities hit the same weekend. Beyond stopping transmission, authorities stress countering misinformation spread via social media that Ebola is fake or that aid groups profit from the crisis; responses include radio, church, and WhatsApp campaigns and empowering local leaders with motorcycles to relay correct information. Funeral rituals, a major transmission risk because corpses remain contagious for about a week, are being reformed: controlled, PPE-protected funerals with sealed bags and limited attendance (often 50). Families may observe ceremonies through transparent bags to ease grief. Past West African outbreaks attributed up to 80% of cases to funerals in Sierra Leone and 60% in Guinea.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ治療センターが放火される；その理由を理解する
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のWHO公式PHEIC指定による国際的に重大な感染症危機。治療センターへの攻撃により対応が阻害され、葬儀慣習による高い伝播リスク、SNS上の誤情報拡散による管理困難性が認められ、複数のIHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）での発生を主題としている。発生地域にGuineaとSierra Leoneが含まれているが、サマリー上では過去のアウトブレイク事例としての言及のみであり、現在の発生地はDRCのみ。WHOによるPHEIC指定という国際的に最高レベルの警告が既に発出されており、治療施設への暴力的攻撃による対応能力低下、葬儀慣習による著しい伝播リスク、SNS上の誤情報による管理困難性など、複合的なリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Women at greatest risk from DRC Ebola outbreak, health workers warn, as confirmed cases rise
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with women bearing the greatest risk due to frontline caregiving roles. UN Women notes women have been overrepresented in Ebola deaths for decades, and during 2018-2019 two-thirds of reported cases were women and girls. Health workers warn the pattern may repeat as PPE shortages leave female nurses and caregivers more exposed, risking transmission to their children and households. As of 31 May 2026, 282 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC, predominantly in Ituri province, with 15 in North Kivu and 3 in South Kivu. Uganda has confirmed nine cases. Five patients have recovered. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus opened a new treatment centre in Bunia, the capital of Ituri, highlighting ongoing response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ流行で女性が最大のリスク、保健労働者が警告、確認症例増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準も複数該当。確認症例282件、死亡者あり、ウガンダでも9件確認。WHO事務局長による対応センター開設など国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）が記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダはDRCの流行の二次的拡大として9件が確認されたに留まり、主題はDRCでの流行である。GeoNames IDリストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC（203312）のみ対象国リストに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高いリスクを持つ病原体であり、確認症例282件、複数州での流行、隣国への拡大、PPE不足による医療従事者への曝露増加など複合的なリスク要因が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il caso sospetto in Sardegna. Nuovi contagi in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Suspected case in Sardinia is negative. New infections in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola: A traveler returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in Sardinia tested negative for Ebola after developing symptoms, with biocontainment at Santissima Trinità Hospital, Cagliari. Diagnoses were conducted by Italy's National Institute for Infectious Diseases Lazzaro Spallanzani (Rome), and the Health Ministry stated the Ebola risk in Italy remains very low. In the DRC, the outbreak persists: 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with 19 new infections. Geographic distribution among confirmed cases: Ituri 264, Nord Kivu 15, Sud Kivu 3. The report underscores ongoing transmission in the DRC and highlights the importance of surveillance for possible imported cases in Italy.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：サルデーニャの疑い例は陰性。コンゴで新規感染
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ熱流行（282確定例、42死亡、継続的な伝播）はIHR基準を満たし（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、イタリアへの輸入例検出はWPRO基準（流行適性、管理可能性）も満たす。引き続き国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの進行中のエボラ熱流行に焦点を当てており、イタリアの疑い例は陰性と確認された。DRCの282確定例と継続的な伝播が主要な懸念。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil, Italy monitor patients for Ebola as travellers return from Africa
article.articleSummary: Brazil and Italy monitor suspected Ebola Bundibugyo cases after travellers returned from the DRC and Uganda. In Brazil, a Sao Paulo man with suspected Ebola also tested positive for meningitis; a Rio de Janeiro patient, recently in Uganda, tested positive for malaria. Both cases remain under investigation. In Italy, a symptomatic patient in Cagliari, Sardinia, who had returned from Congo, triggered Ebola protocols. The DRC outbreak has 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with 19 new positives, and now spans 22 health zones across three eastern provinces, originating in Mongbwalu, Djugu. WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Four nurses and a laboratory worker in Bunia have recovered, bringing total recoveries to five. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; transmission occurs via bodily fluids and contact with infected animals. If confirmed outside Africa, Brazil/Italy cases would be the first outside Africa since the outbreak began.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、イタリアがアフリカからの帰国者をエボラ出血熱で監視
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ以上該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの国際的危機事案。
triage.notes: DRC発生地のエボラ・ブンディブギョ感染症がアフリカ域外（ブラジル・イタリア）の患者にも検出された事例。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。イタリアのCagliari症例はサマリー内で述べられているが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。記事の主題は DRC での発生とそのアフリカ外への波及であり、対象国ではブラジルのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Allarme Ebola a Cagliari: un paziente rientrato dal Congo con sintomi compatibili. Scattati i protocolli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in Cagliari: a patient returning from the Congo with symptoms compatible with Ebola. Protocols activated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy, after a Congolese resident returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa) with Ebola-like symptoms. The traveler, who had layovers in Cairo and arrived from Rome, developed fever and prompted emergency protocols. On May 31, authorities deployed in via Manno with protective gear; the patient was transported to the Santissima Trinità infectious diseases center for diagnostics. A military helicopter will collect samples at Elmas airport for analysis at Rome’s Spallanzani Institute, with results expected overnight (May 31–June 1, 2026). If positive, immediate transfer to Spallanzani is planned. The Health Ministry confirms Ebola testing and ongoing assessments; the patient remains in isolation. Coordination ongoing with local Sardinia authorities and Spallanzani; authorities emphasize the overall risk to Italy is very low.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでのエボラ警戒：コンゴから帰国した患者がエボラ互換症状で検出。プロトコル発動
triage.triage_reason: 疑い患者が確認され、国際的な移動（DRC→エジプト→イタリア）を伴っており、IHR基準3項目該当。異常性、重症度（発熱症状）、国際的拡大リスクが認識される。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国から帰国者であり、イタリアおよびエジプト経由での国際移動を伴っている。記事はエボラの疑い症例として報告されており、検査結果待機中。イタリアはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。当初警戒段階だが、確定診断前のため継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cagliari, sospetto caso di Ebola in città: negativo il test sul sangue del paziente rientrato dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cagliari, suspected case of Ebola in the city: blood test on the patient who returned from the Congo is negative.
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected in Cagliari with blood tests at the Spallanzani Institute in Rome returning negative for a 46-year-old Italian citizen originally from Congo, who arrived in Elmas from Rome after a Kinshasa trip and presented fever, headache and other Ebola-like symptoms. The Ministry of Health said Italy’s risk remains very low. The patient remains under close observation at the Santissima Trinità hospital; his wife is in home isolation under ASL monitoring. Emergency services responded after a late-night call; the man was located around 15:30 and transported with appropriate facilities prepared. Border health offices did not block him at Fiumicino because the journey included a layover in Cairo, i.e., arrival from Egypt. Laboratory confirmation shows no Ebola infection and the patient’s condition is described as good.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリ市でエボラ疑い事例：コンゴから帰国した患者の血液検査は陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い事例であり異常/予想外かつスクリーニング基準に該当するが、既に検査結果は陰性で感染は確認されていない。情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはイタリア（対象国外）も含まれているが、エボラ感染が確認された国はコンゴ民主共和国のみ（患者の出発地）。イタリアでの疑い事例は既に検査で陰性が確認されており、実際の感染イベントは発生していない。WPROスクリーニング対象地域にはDRCのみが該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Ibyo wamenya kuri Ebola ishobora guhitana umwe muri babiri bayanduye
article.articleSummary: Ebola is a filovirus causing severe hemorrhagic fever in humans and animals, with fruit bats implicated as the reservoir. It was first identified in 1976 near Zaire (DRC) at Yambuku and in Sudan; the name honors the Ebola River. Early outbreaks were highly deadly, with fatalities over 80% in some cases. Six Ebola species exist: Zaire ebolavirus (notably deadly and linked to 2014–2016 outbreaks in Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), Sudan ebolavirus, Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo, Uganda; reappeared in DRC and Uganda), Taï Forest ebolavirus (Ivory Coast, 1994), Reston ebolavirus (Reston, Virginia; mainly animals and some humans), Bombali virus (Sierra Leone bats; no confirmed human cases). Major outbreaks: 1995 Kikwit, DRC; 2000–2012 Uganda; 2018–2020 North Kivu/Ituri, DRC with over 2,000 deaths. Before 2019, no universal vaccine; vaccines against Zaire ebolavirus and monoclonal antibodies reduced mortality in some patients; infection control remains critical in fragile health systems.

triage.headline_ja: エボラについて知られていることは、感染した2人に1人を殺す可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラウイルスの一般的な背景情報・歴史的事実の教育的な説明であり、現在進行中の新規感染症イベントの報告ではない。具体的な現在の患者数、発生地の指定、流行の兆候を示す新しい情報を含まない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数の歴史的発生地を含める一方、記事サマリーは教育的な内容で、現在の感染症イベントの報告ではなく、エボラウイルスに関する一般知識の提供に過ぎない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Caso sospetto di ebola in Sardegna, il paziente è negativo al test: l'annuncio del Ministero della Salute
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Sardinia, the patient tested negative: the announcement by the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Sardinia tested negative. A 46-year-old man returning from the Congo developed fever and headache after arriving in Italy via Cairo on May 30, landing at Cagliari Elmas. He was transported to Santissima Trinità hospital in Cagliari under biosafety containment for diagnostic workup per current protocols. Analyses were conducted at the Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases in Rome; the test result was negative for Ebola. The Ministry of Health said Italy's risk remains very low and that authorities remain in contact with Sardinia’s health bodies. The patient’s wife is in home isolation under ASL monitoring. The report notes the man was not detained at Rome’s Fiumicino airport for border health screening because his itinerary included a stopover in Cairo, i.e., he was arriving from Egypt. The patient is in good condition.

triage.headline_ja: サルデーニャ州での疑い症例のエボラ患者は検査で陰性：保健省の発表
triage.triage_reason: 疑い症例が検査で陰性と確定されたため、実際の感染症イベントではない。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準は該当しない。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴから帰国後にイタリアで隔離されたが、エボラ検査は陰性で確定されている。イタリアとエジプトは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみを記載。公衆衛生への実質的脅威はない。

article.articleHeadline: 暑假旅遊旺季來到 竹縣府加強防治登革熱宣導
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the peak of the summer travel season arrives, Hsinchu County Government intensifies dengue fever prevention and awareness campaigns.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever prevention in Hsinchu County, Taiwan, is intensified ahead of the summer travel peak. The county held dengue prevention education for 80 participants from government agencies, schools, and clinics to reinforce community-wide vector control. Nationwide, by May 25, 2026, 64 confirmed dengue cases were reported; only one was locally acquired, with 19 imported from Indonesia. Hsinchu County reported 21 cases, including two confirmed, both imported from Indonesia. Experts Professor Huang Jing-ji and nurse Jiang Xue-mei discussed dengue epidemiology, vector-control practices, travel-related strategies, and breeding-site inspection and chemical-control notes. Public guidance emphasizes the four-step approach—inspect, drain, clean, and scrub—for home containers such as flower-pot saucers, water barrels, discarded tires, and roof gutters. Those with fever, headaches, muscle or joint pain, or rash should seek prompt medical care and report travel history to aid diagnosis and outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 夏休み旅行シーズンの到来に伴い、新竹県政府がデング熱の防止と啓発活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の輸入症例が報告されており、インドネシアからの輸入が相当数（19件）であるが、現在のところ地域の公衆衛生への深刻な影響が限定的であり、国際拡大の直接的リスクは不明。情報充実待ちで継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 台湾はWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。インドネシア（id:1643084）は記事内で輸入症例の出所として言及されているが、インドネシアにおける現在の発生状況の詳細は記事サマリーに記載されていないため、インドネシアも対象外とした。デング熱は蚊媒介感染症として流行しやすく、夏季の旅行シーズンにおける二次感染のリスクがあるため、WPROスクリーニング基準の「prolonged_exposure」「epidemic_prone」に該当。ただし、IHR基準に該当せず、社会的・政治的関心は高いものの、情報不足の段階であるため「WATCH」判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il test del paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo tests negative.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, imported suspected case in Italy: A Congolese national resident in Cagliari, Sardinia, returned May 30 from Kinshasa via Cairo and landed in Sardinia. After developing fever, he called 118 and was taken under biocontainment to the Santissima Trinità Hospital in Cagliari's infectious diseases unit for diagnostic workup. The Italian Red Cross activated the containment protocol; police, firefighters and local authorities supported the scene. The patient, who had traveled from the Congo to Italy, was isolated in the infectious disease center while tests were performed. Blood samples collected at the hospital were analyzed by the Spallanzani Institute in Rome. With Civil Protection support and coordination by the Prefecture of Cagliari, a military helicopter transported the samples to Rome for testing. Results returned negative for Ebola, and the Ministry of Health said Italy’s risk remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：コンゴから帰国したサルデーニャの患者の検査が陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い症例の輸入で異常・予想外であり、WPROスクリーニング基準を満たすが、検査結果が陰性であり、公開情報での社会的関心の程度が不明確。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月1日配信で、イタリアへのエボラ疑い症例の輸入事例を報告している。患者はコンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）から帰国したコンゴ国籍者で、サルデーニャで発熱後に隔離され、検査結果は陰性。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみがverified_locationsに該当。イタリアは対象国外であるため除外。検査結果が陰性であることから現在のリスク低減は確認されるが、輸入症例の検出プロセスとして監視継続の価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Tín hiệu phục hồi tích cực của bệnh nhân nhiễm chủng hiếm gặp Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Positive signs of recovery in a patient infected with the rare Bundibugyo strain
article.articleSummary: Five patients have recovered from Ebola virus Bundibugyo strain in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. No approved treatment or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; these are the first recoveries in the current outbreak. On 31 May, during the opening of a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia, Tedros announced that four more patients would be discharged today, after one discharge on 29 May. The 100-bed center, with 45 beds ready, will treat all Ebola cases in Bunia and nearby areas, with staff from Kinshasa to operate it. Early detection and timely care are linked to higher survival. The WHO Global Preparedness Monitoring Board warns Africa and the world remain underprepared for the next pandemic, urging sustained investment in surveillance, health workforce, equitable vaccine access, finance, and political attention, alongside data autonomy for African institutions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱: レアなブンディブギョ株に感染した患者の回復の積極的な兆候
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当。エボラウイルス（治療法・ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株）の集団発生が報告され、複数の患者が回復しており、WHOが公式に発表。国際的な感染拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株は治療法・ワクチンが未承認であり、現在の流行における初の回復事例。WHOが新たなエボラ治療センターの開設と患者の治療状況を公式に発表。アフリカ地域全体の準備不足が警告されており、国際的な関心が高い。DRC内のブニア（イトゥリ州）とキンシャサでの対応が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dotarła do Ameryki? Niepokojące doniesienia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has Ebola reached America? Disturbing reports.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases are under investigation in Brazil, raising questions about transmission to the Americas. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows possible Ebola symptoms; in Rio de Janeiro, a Ugandan man is under observation. Neither case has been laboratory-confirmed. The current outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine; infection occurs through contact with bodily fluids and can cause fever, nausea, a rash, and bleeding from the nose, mouth, eyes or ears. The WHO does not advise closing borders, citing detection challenges, though the United States has barred entry of third-country nationals from DRC, Uganda and South Sudan, and Rwanda and Uganda have closed some borders. MSF warns this could become one of the most serious Ebola outbreaks; 906 probable Congo cases and 223 deaths per WHO, while Africa CDC cites over 1,000 probable infections and 246 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がアメリカに到達した？懸念される報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで未確認のエボラ疑似症例2件が報告され、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限のリスク」に該当。複数国が既に国境制限を実施し、WHOも注視している状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは南米へのエボラ出血熱の初期侵入を示唆。ブラジルの2件の疑似症例は未確認だが、DRC出身者とウガンダ人が関係し、感染源地域（DRC・ウガンダ）との関連性が示唆されている。複数国の国境制限措置が既に実施されており、WHOとAfrica CDCが監視を継続中。現在のBundibugyo ebolavirus株はワクチンがなく、致死率が高い歴史を持つため、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Brésil: placement à l'isolement de deux hommes présentant des symptômes possibles d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil: Two men placed in isolation after presenting with possible Ebola symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Two men, one from Uganda and one from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), were placed in isolation in Brazil after presenting symptoms compatible with Ebola, though Ebola testing was negative for the Uganda case. In Rio de Janeiro, the man who arrived May 22 from Uganda exhibited cough, chills and diarrhea; malaria was detected, and Ebola tests were negative, with isolation continuing pending investigation. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the DRC showed symptoms compatible with viral hemorrhagic fevers and was isolated at the Emilio Ribas Institute of Infectious Diseases; he was diagnosed with a severe meningitis, while Ebola testing remained pending. The Health Ministry says the transmission risk in Brazil and South America is low. Congo reports 246 deaths among over 1,000 suspected cases; the WHO has triggered an international alert, with Uganda reporting nine confirmed cases (two new on Friday) and three Congolese provinces affected.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル：エボラの可能性のある症状を示した2人の男性が隔離措置を受ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で4つ該当（異常性、重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）。WHOの国際警報が発令されており、対象国（DRC、ブラジル）での確定例と疑い例がある。
triage.notes: DRCでエボラウイルス病の進行中の流行があり（246死亡、1000以上の疑い例）、WHOが国際警報を発令している。ウガンダからブラジルへの患者移動は国際的拡大の懸念を示す。ブラジル国内の伝播リスクは低いと評価されているが、検査結果待機中の症例があり、クロスボーダー伝播のリスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Sardegna, negativo il test dell'uomo rientrato dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Sardinia: the test of the man who returned from the Congo is negative.
article.articleSummary: Test for Ebola on the patient who returned from Congo to Sardinia is negative. As of 1 June 2026, Italy's Ministry of Health announced that analyses performed at Rome's Spallanzani Institute confirmed the patient, who landed in Sardinia on 30 May after visiting Congo, did not have Ebola despite presenting symptoms. The individual was transferred to the Santissima Trinità Hospital in Cagliari under biocontainment for diagnostic workup, per protocol. The Ministry notes ongoing contact with Sardinian health authorities and reiterates that the risk to Italy remains very low. No Ebola infections or related deaths are reported in Italy at this time; authorities will continue monitoring for any additional exposures.

triage.headline_ja: サルデーニャのエボラ：コンゴから帰国した男性の検査は陰性
triage.triage_reason: 疑似症例が確認されたが検査結果は陰性であり、イタリアでのエボラ感染例はなく、リスクは低い。IHR基準は該当せず、単なる疑い例の陰性確認報告である。
triage.notes: イタリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。記事の主題はコンゴからイタリア（サルデーニャ）に帰国した患者の検査結果であり、DRCでのエボラ流行を示唆するものではない。陰性確認報告のため感染症危機としては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو إلى 282 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in Congo rise to 282 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 282 confirmed Ebola infections, with 19 new cases recently recorded. Infections are concentrated in Ituri (264), North Kivu (15), and South Kivu (3), underscoring ongoing transmission in eastern provinces. Total deaths linked to confirmed cases reach 42. This outbreak is the 17th Ebola event in the DRC and is described as the largest in decades. The World Health Organization has classified this outbreak, along with Ebola cases in Uganda, as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling international concern and prompting calls for strengthened response measures to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者数が282例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、DRCおよびウガンダで確認され、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）に指定。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク、重大な公衆衛生影響、および異常性が明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCでの症例確認が主体であり、ウガンダは言及されるのみ。ただしWHOがDRC/ウガンダの両国の事例をPHEICに指定している点は重要。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。17番目のエボラ流行で「数十年間で最大」との記述から異常性・重症性が明確。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Un virus tropical transmis de țânțari amenință Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A tropical mosquito-borne virus threatens Europe.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya virus poses rising risk in Europe as warming expands mosquito habitats. Currently, 139 countries/territories are at risk, with local transmission reported in 114. Climate models indicate a northward shift toward temperate regions, notably Central-Northern Europe, Northeast North America, and East Asia, due to expansion of vectors such as Aedes aegypti and the Asian tiger mosquito (Aedes albopictus). Warmer temperatures (18–28°C) accelerate viral development in vectors, increasing transmission speed by about 4–5× and raising outbreak likelihood where vectors establish. Global data show 2025 Pan American Health Organization figures: over 500,000 chikungunya cases and 186 deaths across 41 countries/territories. Travel-associated cases already seed locally transmission in some regions. Preparedness measures include vector surveillance, medical staff training, enhanced insect control, and pre-outbreak intervention plans, with priority surveillance for the United Kingdom, United States, Germany, China, and Japan before 2040.

triage.headline_ja: 熱帯蚊媒介ウイルスがヨーロッパを脅かす
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアウイルスの国際的拡大リスク、複数地域での局所伝播の報告、気候変動による媒介蚊の北上予測により、IHR基準3項目該当。温暖化に伴う媒介蚊生息域の北上により先進国への拡大が指摘され、国際的な公衆衛生上の影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではチクングニアウイルスの全世界的な拡大リスクについて述べられており、特に気候変動により中央・北ヨーロッパ、北東北米、東アジアへの北上が指摘されている。対象国リストではChina（東アジア）のみが該当する実際の発生地域として確認可能。記事では2025年パンアメリカン保健機構のデータとして50万例以上の症例と186死亡が報告されており、114の国・地域で局所伝播が確認されている。ただし、記事は主に将来予測と予防措置に焦点があり、現在の具体的な流行状況は限定的に記載されている。優先監視対象として英国、米国、ドイツ、中国、日本が挙げられている。

article.articleHeadline: ++ Ebola, negativo il test del paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo ++ - Notizie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the patient's test is negative after returning to Sardinia from the Congo - News
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-related travel case in Sardinia, Italy, from the Congo yielded a negative Ebola test. The brief from Sarda News states the patient returned to Sardinia and tested negative for Ebola; no further clinical details, symptoms, exposure history, or case counts are provided. The post appears on a Sardinia-focused blog that notes it is not a formal newspaper and is updated without a fixed schedule. No confirmed cases, transmission information, or laboratory confirmation beyond the negative result are mentioned. Published on 1 June 2026, the item serves as a minimal update about an imported traveler rather than an in-depth medical bulletin.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴから帰国したサルデーニャの患者の検査が陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的移動例であり異常性は認められるが、検査結果が陰性で確定例がなく、臨床的詳細が極めて不足している。情報成熟度が低いため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: サマリーから実際のイベント発生地はDRC（エボラ感染の疑いがある患者の由来地）であり、イタリア・サルデーニャは輸入例の検査地点。発生地域フィールドに含まれるサルデーニャはWPRO対象国ではなく、イタリアも対象国外であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。検査が既に陰性で確定患者がないため、直ちにPICKUPするには根拠が不足しているが、エボラウイルスの国際的移動ケースであることと情報不足から、WATCH段階での続報確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: ابولا در کمین هواداران فوتبال | جام جهانی بدون تماشاگر می‌شود؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola lies in wait for football fans | Will the World Cup be held without spectators?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease looms over the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America as millions of fans travel to the United States, Canada, and Mexico. Health experts warn ongoing Ebola outbreaks in Africa could seed international spread. The rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has been identified only in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, with over 220 deaths reported. The World Cup’s scale—about 5.5 million spectators, including thousands from the DRC—raises the risk that an infected traveler could attend and prompt rapid containment responses, though experts say the likelihood is not zero and not high. The WHO notes the DRC outbreak is stretching current response capacity, and more than 2,000 individuals who had contact with suspected Ebola patients remain unidentified, untraced, or untested, complicating surveillance and control during the event.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがサッカーファンを待機中 | ワールドカップは観客なしで開催されるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。進行中のアフリカでのエボラアウトブレイクが2026年ワールドカップ（北米開催）を通じた国際的感染拡大のリスクを提示。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年ワールドカップ開催国（米国、カナダ、メキシコ）における潜在的リスクを論じているが、実際の現在のエボラアウトブレイク発生国はDRC（対象国）とウガンダ（対象国外）のみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株の特定、220人以上の死亡報告、2,000人以上の追跡未確認接触者という深刻な状況が記述されている。国際会議を通じた感染拡大リスクが具体的に示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Italia, c'è il verdetto del test sul paziente rientrato dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Italy: the test result for the patient who returned from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola scare resolves with negative test in Italy. A Congolese citizen living in Cagliari returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo on May 30; within about 24 hours he developed suspicious symptoms and alerted emergency services, prompting immediate transfer to a high-containment hospital unit in Cagliari. Blood samples were sent to the Spallanzani Institute in Rome for definitive testing, which excluded Ebola infection. The patient remains under observation in Sardinia for symptoms attributed to another condition. The episode highlighted a biosafety concern: the traveler had a layover in Cairo before arriving in Italy via Fiumicino, potentially allowing return to Sardinia under standard protocols without Health Ministry attention. The Health Ministry confirmed the negative result, ending the immediate Ebola scare for now.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアのエボラ：コンゴから帰国した患者の検査結果
triage.triage_reason: エボラ感染が確定的に除外された陰性事例。公衆衛生的な実質的脅威はなく、国内ではエボラ患者が発生していない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはエボラ疑い患者の検査結果が陰性であったことを報じるもの。イタリアではエボラ患者の発生がなく、実質的な感染症危機ではない。DRCは患者の渡航出発地として言及されているが、発生地としては該当しない。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。バイオセーフティプロトコルの課題は指摘されているが、IHR基準やスクリーニング基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kimondta a járványügyi vezető: gyorsabban terjed a pusztító vírus, mint ahogy a világ reagálni tudna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Chief Epidemiologist Declared: The Devastating Virus Is Spreading Faster Than the World Can Respond.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda reports 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with five recoveries. Four nurses at Bunia hospital and a laboratory worker have recovered, bringing total recovered to five, highlighting that early diagnosis and proper care improve survival. Over 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation as regional spread remains a concern. The WHO had earlier declared an international public health emergency for Congo and Uganda. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, but appropriate medical care can be life-saving. Outside Africa, suspected cases have emerged in Brazil (São Paulo) and Italy (Cagliari, Sardinia); a Congolese returnee in Sardinia prompted Ebola protocols, while a Rio de Janeiro patient with prior Uganda exposure and a meningitis diagnosis in São Paulo are under assessment—importation risk is considered very low.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学の責任者が宣言：破壊的なウイルスは世界が対応できるよりも速く拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱が282確定例・42死亡で国際的拡大（ブラジル・イタリアへの輸入例報告）、WHO緊急事態宣言済み、ワクチン・特異的治療なし。深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際流行、渡航制限リスク高。フルRRA優先度：最高
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれるが、記事サマリー上の主要な確認例（282例・42死亡）の大部分はDRC由来と記載されているため、確認地（主要流行地）はDRCとした。ブラジル輸入例は検査中でリスク低評価だが、国際流行兆候として重要。イタリアはGeoNames対象国外のため除外。WHO緊急事態宣言・複数国での輸入例・高い管理難度・ハンガリー国家疫学責任者による公開発言が社会・政治的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Лихорадка Эбола распространилась на еще более обширную территорию Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever has spread to an even larger area of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Congo has expanded to 22 medical zones across three provinces, up from 13, as testing delays and data revisions cloud the true scale. The fast-moving outbreak is one of the most severe in years, hitting conflict zones with weak infrastructure. A new strain has no approved vaccine and has infected nine people in neighboring Uganda. Authorities and the World Health Organization warn that containment hinges on trust and local community engagement. As of May 30, 2026, 282 lab-confirmed cases and 42 deaths have been reported, with 19 new infections in the last 24 hours. Insecurity has reduced contact tracing to about 45%; families refuse post-mortem testing, and shortages of medicines and funding hinder relief, driving patients to flee hospitals. Cross-border transmission to Uganda underscores import/export concerns.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱がコンゴのさらに広い地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPRO基準5項目全て該当。多国間拡大（DRC→Uganda）、高死亡率、ワクチン未対応株、紛争地帯での急速な蔓延により、国際的な公衆衛生危機の特性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの越境伝播が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ該当。282確定症例、42死亡、接触者追跡の大幅な低下（45％）、医療施設からの患者逃亡、医薬品・資金不足が特徴的。ワクチン未対応株の存在が付加的リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Пятеро больных Эболой выздоровели в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Ebola patients have recovered in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Five patients infected with the Ebola Bundibugyo virus have recovered in Bunia, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Four were healthcare workers discharged from the Ebola treatment center after two negative Ebola tests; the remaining patient, a laboratory technician, has returned home. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus attended the opening ceremony of a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia and welcomed the recoveries, noting continued need for vaccines and therapies. Congo has intensified laboratory testing and patient management in affected areas; health authorities report no samples awaiting analysis and ongoing epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing, and case investigation. As of May 29, the DRC reported 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者5人がコンゴ民主共和国で回復
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を持ち、DRCで263確認症例と42死亡が報告されている。IHR基準で少なくとも2つ（公衆衛生上の重大な影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の報告記事。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの流行が継続中。DRCが対策を強化（ワクチン、治療センター開設、検査体制の整備）していることが示唆されているが、263確認症例と42死亡という重大な流行状況が存在。国際的関心も高く、WHO事務局長の現地訪問も報道されている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 暑假旅遊旺季來到 竹縣府加強防治登革熱宣導
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the peak summer travel season arrives, Hsinchu County Government strengthens dengue fever prevention and awareness campaigns.
article.articleSummary: During the peak summer travel season, Hsinchu County Government reinforces dengue prevention and awareness campaigns. An education training for about 80 participants from government agencies, schools, and clinics aims to empower families and communities to curb mosquito risks. The program covers dengue status, vector-control principles, international travel health strategies, breeding-site inspections, and chemical-control considerations. As of May 25, 2026, Taiwan reports 64 confirmed dengue cases nationwide (1 local, the rest imported from Southeast or South Asia), with Indonesia contributing 19 cases. Hsinchu County records 21 reported cases, including 2 confirmed imported from Indonesia. Speakers Huang Jingji of the National Center for Mosquito-Borne Disease Prevention and Control and Jiang Xuemei of the CDC Northern District Control Center share practical cases and emphasize the four-step home prevention: Inspect, Dump, Clean, Cover. Residents should eliminate standing water—flower-pot saucers, barrels, tires, roof gutters—and seek medical care for fever, headache, or rash, with travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 暑假旅遊旺季來到 竹縣府加強防治登革熱宣導（夏休みの旅行シーズンに突入、新竹県政府がデング熱予防・啓発活動を強化）
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアは対象国リストに含まれるものの、本記事の主題は台湾の予防啓発キャンペーンであり、現在のデング熱流行規模は限定的（台湾全体で64例、地域的収束傾向）。継続的な経過観察が必要だが、フルRRA実施の閾値には達していない。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な内容は台湾での予防啓発キャンペーンであるが、インドネシアから輸入症例が報告されており（19例）、国際的なデング熱リスク背景がある。ただし、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に台湾は含めない。インドネシアのデング熱の基礎疫学情報が不足しているため、継続的な監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Предполагаеми случаи на ебола в Бразилия, докато ДР Конго отчете над 1000 заразени
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola cases in Brazil as DR Congo reports more than 1,000 people infected.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases prompted isolation in Brazil as the Democratic Republic of Congo reports an outbreak. In Sao Paulo, a 37-year-old man who recently traveled to the DRC was hospitalized at the Emilio Ribas Institute after fever and Ebola-like symptoms; he remains in isolation while labs continue to rule out Ebola, with a severe meningitis diagnosis made. In Rio de Janeiro, another patient who arrived from Uganda on May 22 was isolated after cough, chills and diarrhea; Ebola tests were negative, though malaria was confirmed; he will stay under observation until all checks are complete. The DRC outbreak has produced over 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 deaths since May 15, with Uganda reporting confirmed infections and one death. WHO cautions the true scope may be larger, while Brazilian officials say the risk of Ebola entering or spreading in Brazil and South America remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでエボラの疑い例が報告される一方、コンゴ民主共和国では1000人以上の感染を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつ対象国複数での確認と社会的関心の高さからPICKUP判定。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）での1000件超の疑い例・約250人の死亡が確認され、ウガンダでも確認例あり。ブラジルではサンパウロとリオデジャネイロで疑い例2件が隔離されたが、ラボ検査でエボラは除外（髄膜炎、マラリア確定）。しかし国際的な二次伝播リスクと世界的な関心が高く、フルRRAの実施が必須。Bluedot発生地域にウガンダが含まれていたが、サマリーから確認症例の記載があるため対象国リストにはないものの言及記録として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: EAC Health Ministers Hold Crisis Meeting
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-01, East African Community health ministers convened an extraordinary two-day virtual crisis meeting to coordinate a regional response to the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain, with cases confirmed in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death, with hundreds of contacts under surveillance. The DRC reports 125 confirmed cases and 17 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, with transmission concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The EAC has intensified regional coordination and preparedness, with prior emergency interventions including an EAC Crisis Meeting and Technical Working Groups on communicable diseases and on harmonising regulations for Ebola vaccines, therapeutics and diagnostics. The meeting seeks to strengthen surveillance, cross-border screening, lab testing, information sharing, and emergency response systems to curb regional spread amid ongoing cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：EAC保健大臣が危機会談を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイクで複数国に確認、死亡例あり、地域的危機対応が発動されている。
triage.notes: Ugandaはサマリーに明記されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを検証済み位置として記録。複数省（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）で確認され、DRC側で125確定例、17死亡、906疑似例。Uganda側9確定例1死亡。EAC地域危機会談開催により、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Inside Ebola's raging epicentre, little can stop the virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola devastates a remote Congolese town as medical teams, operating with limited supplies, struggle to curb a surge of deaths and infections. In the cramped Ebola ward, a five-year-old boy lies on a bare mattress, a tissue stuffed in his nose to stanch persistent bleeding, while his father watches with a hunted look. A few beds away lies the body of Christiane Bahati, 21, who had died seven hours earlier and whose shoes remain tucked under the bed as wailing relatives gather outside. The description highlights overwhelmed frontline facilities and the human toll of the outbreak, with no laboratory confirmation details or exact case counts provided in this excerpt. The scene underscores hemorrhagic symptoms and the urgency faced by caregivers amid limited supplies and fragile infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が猛威を振るう中心地で、ウイルスを止められるものは何もない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR通知疾患であり、DRCでの流行は公衆衛生への重大な影響、重症度（死亡例あり）、医療施設の過負荷、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク等の複数基準に該当する。国際的な懸念と支援ニーズが明らかである。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確定流行である。記事は医療施設の資源不足、死亡例の具体的描写、および医療スタッフの対応困難を強調しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の危機を示唆している。フル Risk Assessment (RRA) を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 부천시, 에볼라 유행지역 중점검역관리지역 지정...방문 자제 권고
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bucheon City designates Ebola outbreak area as a priority quarantine management zone... urges the public to refrain from visiting.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks in Africa led WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. In Korea, the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency designated five countries as priority quarantine management areas: Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province), Uganda, South Sudan, Ethiopia, and Rwanda; the foreign ministry also imposed a travel ban on Ituri. Bucheon City urged residents to avoid travel to these countries, practice strict personal hygiene, and avoid wildlife contact. On return, individuals should complete a health status questionnaire and report fever or related symptoms within 21 days to 1339 or their local health center. Ebola transmits via direct contact with infected animals or blood and body fluids, with initial symptoms of fever, fatigue, muscle pain, and headache, and possible vomiting, diarrhea, or bleeding. City official Song Jeong-won urged vigilance and prompt reporting to prevent community spread.

triage.headline_ja: 부천시, 에볼라 유행지역 중점검역관리지역 지정...방문 자제 권고（仙川市、エボラ流行地域を重点検疫管理地域に指定...訪問自粛を勧告）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的拡大、WHO PHEIC宣言、渡航制限実施）。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク感染症であり、DRCでの発生確認と国際的な対応開始により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが韓国（Republic of Korea）を含めているが、記事サマリーの主題はアフリカのエボラ流行であり、韓国は対応措置（検疫指定、渡航禁止）を実施している側である。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）済みで、DRC Ituri州での確認とUganda、South Sudan、Ethiopia、Rwandaへの拡大が記載されている。ウガンダ、南スーダン、エチオピア、ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WORLD IN BRIEF:Brazil probes suspected Ebola cases, Africa Ebola tally hits 263, Ghana passes anti LGBTQ bill and other stories
article.articleSummary: 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths have been recorded across DR Congo and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation as health authorities warn the outbreak is spreading faster than response efforts. In DR Congo, 19 new confirmed infections raise the total to 282, largely centered in Ituri with additional cases in North and South Kivu. Brazil is investigating two suspected Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro involving travellers from DR Congo and Uganda; patients have tested positive for other illnesses, but Ebola has not been ruled out. If confirmed, these Brazil cases would be the first Ebola detections outside Africa since the current outbreak began. The report highlights ongoing transmission risks and the need for rapid laboratory confirmation and public health surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 世界トピック速報：ブラジルがエボラ疑い例を調査、アフリカのエボラ死亡者263人に、ガーナが反LGBTQ法を可決その他
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（282確定例、43死亡、1100以上の疑い例）とブラジルでの初のアフリカ外での疑い例報告は、国際的脅威度が極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはブラジルの複数地域が含まれているが、記事サマリーではブラジルは疑い例調査段階であり、確定例の発生地はDRC（イトゥリ、南キブ、北キブ）とウガンダ。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため検証済みロケーションから除外。ただし、ブラジルでの疑い例報告は国際的拡大を示す重要なシグナル。多数の死亡例（43）、高い患者数、急速な拡大傾向、および対応能力不足が確認される。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo test sull'italiano rientrato dal Congo. Ma in Africa...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, negative test for the Italian who returned from the Congo. But in Africa...
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, an Italian who returned from the Congo tested negative for Ebola; the test was done at Spallanzani in Rome after the patient, who arrived in Sardinia on 30 May, developed symptoms and was hospitalized in Cagliari under biocontainment; Italy's risk remains very low. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola confirmed cases rose to 282 with 42 deaths after 19 new positives: 264 in Ituri, 15 in North Kivu, 3 in South Kivu. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus visited Bunia and stressed community trust and safe burials to contain spread. The outbreak, the 17th since 1976, is caused by Bundibugyo, for which no vaccines or approved treatments exist; cases have spread from Ituri to North and South Kivu. Health authorities and partners are increasing surveillance, contact tracing, and patient care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴから帰国したイタリア人の検査は陰性。しかしアフリカでは...
triage.triage_reason: DRC でエボラ確定症例が 282 例に増加し 42 人が死亡している進行中の流行であり、IHR 基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常な拡大、国際的に拡大するリスク）に複数該当するとともに、WPRO スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedot API に付与された発生地域にはイタリア（ローマ、カリャリ、ラッツィオ、サルデーニャ）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC でのエボラ流行である。イタリアの症例は検査陰性で既に除外されている。DRC は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。これは第 17 回流行（1976 年以降）であり、Bundibugyo ウイルス（ワクチンや承認治療なし）が複数州に拡大している。

article.articleHeadline: Masuki Musim Kemarau, Dinkes Sumsel Imbau Warga Waspada DBD hingga ISPA, Gencarkan PHBS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Entering the Dry Season, South Sumatra Provincial Health Office Urges Residents to Be Vigilant Against Dengue Fever and Acute Respiratory Infections, Intensify PHBS.
article.articleSummary: Entering the dry season (May–October) in South Sumatra, the provincial health office warns of rising dengue fever (DBD) and acute respiratory infections (ISPA), plus diarrhea, typhoid, conjunctivitis, heatstroke, skin diseases, measles, and rubella. In Banyuasin, Musi Banyuasin (Muba), and OKI, limited access to clean water heightens risks. Dengue remains likely as Aedes aegypti breeds in stored water in containers (tubs, drums, dispensers) during water shortages. DBD symptoms include high fever for 2–7 days, red skin rash, muscle and joint pains, and nausea. ISPA is a concern due to smoke from forest and land fires, with cough, runny nose, sore throat, and shortness of breath potentially leading to pneumonia, especially in children and the elderly. Water scarcity elevates diarrhea (more than three stools/day) and typhoid risk; conjunctivitis may spread in dry, dusty conditions, notably among schoolchildren. Heatstroke risk rises with daytime highs above 34°C, causing dizziness, hot dry skin, dehydration, and possible fainting. Authorities urge intensified PHBS (clean and healthy living).

triage.headline_ja: 乾季へ向けて、南スマトラ州保健局が住民にデング熱と急性呼吸器感染症への警戒を呼びかけ、PHBS（清潔で健康的な生活習慣）の強化を促進
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（デング熱、風疹、はしか、チフス）が季節的リスク上昇に伴い言及されているが、具体的な患者数や死亡者、急速な拡大を示す情報が記事から確認できず、主として予防啓発のニュースであるため。IHR基準および社会的関心の判定に情報不足があり、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的リスク警告と予防啓発が主眼で、現在の流行・アウトブレイクの確認ではない。乾季による水アクセス制限が複数感染症（デング、チフス、下痢）のリスク要因として述べられており、長期曝露と流行しやすさの基準に該当。ただし具体的な患者数、死亡者、病院負荷に関する情報がないため重症度は不明。インドネシアは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il test del paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: test negative for patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola test negative for a patient who returned to Sardinia, Italy, from Congo. The test was conducted on May 31, 2026 at Rome's Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases and yielded negative results. The patient arrived in Italy on May 30, 2026, and after developing symptoms, contacted emergency services and was transferred to the Santissima Trinità di Cagliari hospital under a biocontainment unit for diagnostic workup per established protocols. The Ministry of Health remains in close contact with Sardinia's health authorities, with ongoing coordination and enhanced surveillance. Health officials stress that, despite travel history, the risk of Ebola transmission in Italy remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴから帰国したサルデーニャの患者の検査結果が陰性
triage.triage_reason: 患者のエボラ検査が陰性と判明し、実際の患者発生がない。イタリアは対象国に含まれず、DRC発生地も本シグナルの主題ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はコンゴからの帰国者が疑いケースとして報告されたが、検査で陰性が確認された事例報告である。実際のエボラ患者発生ではなく、対象国内での発生イベントもない。イタリアは監視対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄多地插登革熱警戒旗 10天查獲上百陽性容器 ｜ 公視新聞網 PNN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever warning flags raised in multiple areas of Kaohsiung; over 100 positive containers found in 10 days | Public Television News Network PNN
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever alert raised in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, after the first domestically acquired case in Qianzhen District on May 23. By late May, authorities deployed 95 dengue-control lamps for 10 consecutive days, capturing 320 adult Aedes mosquitoes and identifying 104 positive containers. Expanded testing of 744 residents found no new locally acquired cases. Dengue-warning flags were placed in Ersheng and Sanduo neighborhoods as part of the alert zones, with residents urged continuous vigilance over plant pots and drainage. Separately, the Hongren Resource Recovery Site, long sanctioned for cleanliness issues, faced repeated penalties (71 fines) and was ordered cleared by May 28; the landowner terminated the lease, licenses were canceled, the site sealed, and cameras installed. No imported/exported cases are reported. Overall, ongoing domestic transmission risk and public health measures are continuing in Kaohsiung as of June 1, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄多地に登革熱警戒旗が立てられる　10日間で100以上の陽性容器を発見｜公視ニュースネットワーク
triage.triage_reason: 台湾カオフシオン地域における登革熱の局所的な国内感染事例が確認されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行易性）で複数該当する。ただし情報が限定的（死亡例や重症化の記載がない、国際的拡大の明確な証拠がない）であるため、WATCH段階で続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 台湾（台北・高雄など）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。記事内にChongqing Shi（中国）の地名が含まれているが、サマリーの主題は台湾の登革熱事例であり、中国での発生報告はない。国内感染が確認された異常な事態であり、蚊媒介感染症の流行易性は高いが、現在のところ限定的な感染規模（104陽性容器、100人超の検査で新規患者なし）であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当がない。情報の充実度がやや低いため、WATCH判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Sardegna, rientra l'allarme sanitario: test Ebola negativo sull'uomo tornato dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sardinia, the health alert returns: Ebola test negative for the man who returned from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On June 1, 2026, Ebola tests for a Congolese-born resident who had returned to Sardinia from the Congo were negative. In Cagliari, health authorities activated maximum-safety protocols after the patient showed symptoms compatible with Ebola; his home and street were isolated, and medical staff in protective gear collected samples and transported him to Santissima Trinità Hospital. Samples were sent to the Spallanzani Institute in Rome for testing, with results announcing no Ebola infection early that morning. Earlier, at the end of May, Ebola swabs were negative for two people who had returned to Lombardy from Uganda with fever. The Sardinia alert appears resolved based on these negative results.

triage.headline_ja: サルデーニャ州で健康上の警戒が解除：コンゴから帰国した男性のエボラ検査は陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い例が報告されたが、すべて検査結果が陰性であり、確定患者は存在しない。記事は警戒解除を伝えるもので、実質的な感染症イベントではない。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはイタリアの複数地域が含まれているが、サマリーから判断するとイベントの主題は DRC およびウガンダからの帰国者の疑い例であり、確定患者ではない。すべての検査結果が陰性であるため、シグナルとしての価値は低い。対象国のうち DRC のみがサマリー上で言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Cases Rise to 263 as Government Intensifies Surveillance and Border Screening
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak rises to 263 confirmed cases across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with 42 deaths and 2 recoveries. May 29 situation report shows Ituri as the epicenter with 245 cases, North Kivu 15, South Kivu 3. In a single day, 54 new confirmed and 60 new suspected cases were recorded. 95 patients are in isolation; 6 deaths occurred in treatment centers on May 29. Lab data: 70 samples analyzed, 54 positive (77.1% positivity). Contacts identified total 3,200, but only 967 are actively monitored (30.22%). Surveillance and testing capacities have been expanded; more than 18,000 travelers have been screened at entry points. Cross-border coordination intensified with the East African Community to prevent regional spread, as Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi and South Sudan express concern. Public is urged to report suspected cases via toll-free emergency number 151.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ患者数が263人に増加、政府が監視と国境スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当する高リスク感染症イベント。エボラウイルス病は国際的な懸念事項であり、複数国での確認と地域的な拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（南キブ州、イトゥリ州、北キブ州）でのエボラ発生を主題としており、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。短期間での症例急増（54新規確認＋60疑い例/日）、死亡率、接触者追跡の不完全性（30.22%のみ）、および地域的な拡大懸念が強く、国境スクリーニング強化とコミュニティ通知体制が構築されている点から、高優先度のシグナルとして判定。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تدابير الصحة العامة فعالة فى إبطاء انتقال إيبولا والشفاء التام - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Public health measures effective in slowing Ebola transmission and complete recovery - Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: WHO and the Democratic Republic of Congo government report an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, centered in Ituri Province with cases and deaths in North Kivu and South Kivu. A high-level mission to Bunia reaffirmed commitments to protect health across Ituri and the country. Despite the absence of a licensed vaccine or specific treatment, proven public health measures—surveillance, laboratory testing, patient care, early isolation, contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, infection prevention in facilities, and strong community engagement—are slowing transmission and enabling potential recovery. Randomized controlled trials of candidate vaccines and therapeutics are underway. Ongoing challenges include timely case finding, tracing contacts, safe burials, and clear risk communication. The response emphasizes maintaining primary health care, strengthening health-system resilience, and ensuring open borders for supplies and personnel, with coordinated efforts by the DRC government, WHO, Africa CDC, and UN partners.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：公衆衛生対策はエボラ出血熱の感染伝播を遅延させ、完全回復に有効 - セブンスデイ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱はIHR指定疾患であり、公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性を有する。DRCでのアウトブレイクは継続監視対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるアウトブレイク。イトゥリ州中心だが、北キブ州および南キブ州にも症例あり。WHOおよびDRC政府による高レベル対応が進行中。ワクチン候補および治療薬の臨床試験が進行中。当該地域の安定性、接触者追跡、安全な埋葬実施等の課題が継続。

article.articleHeadline: Υπό εξέταση κρούσμα Έμπολα στη Σαρδηνία: Ιταλός επισκέπτης από το Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Sardinia: Italian visitor from Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Italian citizen who recently returned from Congo is hospitalized in Sardinia with concerns of a suspected Ebola case. The patient was admitted to the hospital in Cagliari and placed in isolation; initial symptoms are described but not specified. Diagnostic samples will be sent to the Lazzaro Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases in Rome for laboratory confirmation. The Italian Ministry of Health says the risk of a large Ebola outbreak in the country remains very low, and authorities continue active surveillance. The report has raised local and national anxiety, but officials urge calm and adherence to guidance from health experts. This case reflects an imported potential infection from Congo and underscores ongoing vigilance by the health system.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア・サルデーニャ州でエボラ疑い患者：コンゴからの帰国者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ発症のエボラ輸入疑い患者であり、IHR基準3つ該当する（重篤度、異常性、国際的リスク）。ただしイタリアは対象国でなく、DRCのみがverified_locationsに該当。記事サマリーでは検査確認前の疑い患者段階であり、患者数・死亡情報が不明であるため、確認検査結果の続報を要観察する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はイタリアの輸入疑い患者ですが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを列挙。患者の臨床重症度・具体的症状は記事では「initial symptoms are described but not specified」とあり不明。DRCでの発症者数・流行状況についても記事では明記されていない。検査結果確認待ちの段階であるため、確認検査の結果報告（陽性確定また陰性）の続報が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Meningitis en Brasil y alerta por posible ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis in Brazil and alert over possible Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, São Paulo health authorities announced a 37-year-old Congolese man hospitalized with symptoms compatible with Ebola tested positive for meningococcal meningitis by blood PCR. Despite the meningitis diagnosis, he remains isolated due to Ebola risk; he arrived in Brazil after recently returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo, and is being subjected to further laboratory and genomic testing at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas in São Paulo. The outbreak in the DRC has caused 43 deaths and over 263 confirmed cases; Uganda has reported cases and one death. Separately in Rio de Janeiro, a Belgian national who had traveled to Uganda is being monitored; he has malaria, but remains isolated while Ebola PCR results are awaited. The Rio de Janeiro Health Department activated the Ebola protocol and referred the patient to the Evandro Chagas Institute for continued isolation until Ebola is ruled out.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでの髄膜炎とエボラ可能性による警戒
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数の高リスク感染症（エボラ、髄膜炎）の同時発生、DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行との関連、ブラジルへの国際的波及リスク。
triage.notes: アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ）での確認されたエボラ流行（43死亡、263確定症例）から、ブラジルへの感染者流入が確認された重大事象。DRCの患者がブラジルでエボラ検査待機中であり、並行してリオデジャネイロでもウガンダ渡航歴のあるベルギー人がエボラ疑い監視下にある。複数国での同時活動性リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il test del paziente rientrato dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the test of the patient who returned from Congo is negative.
article.articleSummary: Ebola test on a patient returning to Sardinia from Congo is negative, with analyses performed at Spallanzani in Rome. The man, who had gone to visit relatives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, arrived in Italy on May 30 and soon after developed symptoms. He contacted emergency services and was taken to the Santissima Trinità di Cagliari under biocontainment for diagnostic workups per protocol. The Health Ministry confirmed the negative result and said the risk in Italy remains very low. Travel chronology: departure from Kinshasa with a layover in Cairo; on arrival at Fiumicino he was reported as coming from Egypt, then he traveled to Cagliari where he became ill with high fever and called 118. Sardinian authorities continue monitoring the situation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：コンゴから帰国した患者の検査が陰性
triage.triage_reason: 患者の検査結果が陰性で、イタリアでのエボラ熱感染は確認されなかった。懸念される公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的な拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはコンゴ民主共和国からイタリアへの帰国患者に関するが、検査結果が陰性であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。イタリアは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。Bluedot APIが検出したイタリアおよびエジプトの位置情報は、患者の移動経路を示すものであり、これらの国での発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: è negativo il test per ebola effettuato ieri sul paziente rientrato in sardegna dal congo il ...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola test performed yesterday on the patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo on ... is negative.
article.articleSummary: Ebola test on the patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo on May 30, 2026, was negative. Analyses were conducted by Rome's Spallanzani Institute. After reporting some symptoms, the patient called 118 and was transported under biocontainment to Santissima Trinità Hospital, Cagliari, for diagnostic workup, in line with prevailing protocols. The individual had arrived in Italy on May 30; the test on June 1, 2026, showed no Ebola virus. The Health Ministry said the risk in Italy remains very low and maintains contact with Sardinia’s health authorities. No infection was confirmed, and authorities continue routine monitoring and coordination. This incident underscores vigilance for travel-related exposures, with laboratory confirmation ruling out Ebola and ongoing precautionary measures in place.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴから帰国した患者のエボラウイルス検査は陰性
triage.triage_reason: 患者のエボラウイルス検査が陰性確定であり、感染事例ではない。イタリアは対象外国であり、DRCでの新規感染・拡大も報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアで報告された疑似症例の検査結果報告であり、実際のエボラ感染事例ではない。DRC（対象国）での新規感染・拡大の報告もなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。発生地域にDRCが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCでの現在の感染状況には言及されておらず、過去の渡航歴の記載のみである。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: شفاء 5 حالات من الإيبولا و1100 حالة مشتبه فى إصابتها - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 5 recoveries from Ebola and 1,100 suspected cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia in the east as a focal point. The outbreak has reached 282 laboratory-confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with 19 new infections reported. WHO says five people have recovered from Ebola in the latest update: four nurses in Bunia and one laboratory worker previously announced, bringing the total recoveries to five. This is the seventh Ebola outbreak in DRC since discovery, and the third-largest on record for the country. The PHEIC was declared in mid-May for DRC and Uganda. Separately, Brazil and Italy are probing suspected Ebola cases in travelers; Africa CDC cautions that more than 1,100 suspected cases remain under investigation, signaling ongoing regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ出血熱から5人が回復し、1,100人の疑い患者がいる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例282例、死亡42例を伴う大規模地域流行であり、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する。PHEICが既に宣言されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示した発生地域にはItalyとBrazilが含まれているが、サマリーでは両国は疑い患者の探査国であり、実際の流行地はDRCとウガンダである。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみに該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを列挙。PHEICが5月中旬に宣言済みの既知事案と思われるが、6月1日の最新報告として継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Infos27 : Riposte contre Ebola : la fin de l'épidémie espérée d'ici
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infos27: Ebola response: the end of the outbreak hoped for soon.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, affecting Ituri (Bunia), Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu, marks the 17th epidemic in the region. Authorities with the WHO target containment within four to six months, aiming to end transmission across the three provinces. In Bunia, Ituri, four more patients were cured and discharged from treatment centers, underscoring that early care saves lives and survivors can aid community sensitization. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, with plans for clinical trials tailored to this lineage. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus attended the ceremony for the recovered. The Congolese government and OMS report intensified coordination: operational responses, epidemiologic surveillance, patient care, and resource mobilization, with community leaders and risk-communication at the core. The United States remains the leading donor (over $162 million). Minister Patrick Muyaya engaged Bunia leaders to counter misinformation and rumors that hinder interventions.

triage.headline_ja: Infos27：エボラ対応：数ヶ月以内の流行終息が期待される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を持つ一級感染症であり、継続的な流行監視・対応が必要。
triage.notes: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラ流行は同国17番目の流行。Ituri州（Bunia）、Nord-Kivu州、Sud-Kivu州で複数州にわたり発生。Bundibugyo株によるもので、WHO及びコンゴ政府は4～6ヶ月以内の終息を目標としている。米国が主要ドナーで国際的支援が実施中。流行継続中であり、ウイルス血症患者からのヒト-ヒト感染が発生しているため、WPRO基準全5項目に該当する高リスク事象である。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ назвал способ остановить смертоносную вспышку Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief named a way to stop the deadly Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province’s Bunia as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls for community involvement, stressing it is everyone’s responsibility amid protests over body-management rules. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no vaccine; patients can recover with early medical care. Five patients in Bunia have recovered and four were to be discharged after an earlier discharge. WHO records 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths in the DRC; Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. Confirmed DRC cases rise to 282 with 42 deaths after 19 new positives. Ongoing fighting between armed groups in Ituri hampers aid efforts and prompts calls for a ceasefire to protect civilians. Brazil monitors two travelers in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro; one tests negative, the other remains under investigation. This is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak; Africa CDC urges rapid national response and sustained preparedness. U.S. aid reaches $112M; EU and others have provided support.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラウイルスの致命的な流行を止める方法を述べた
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラウイルス流行は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（906疑い症例、223死亡）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで9症例、ブラジルで監視中）があり、IHR基準に複数該当。実際のアウトブレイク対応として国際支援も進行中。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは症例報告の一部として言及されており、主要な流行地はDRCのIturi州Bunia。ブラジルは旅行者の監視段階でアウトブレイク地ではないが、国際的拡大リスクの文脈で記載。DRCは対象国リストに該当。ブラジルも対象国リストに該当し、監視対象として記事で言及されているため両国を verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ceppo Bundibugyo di Ebola preoccupa il mondo, cos'è, come si cura e quanto è pericoloso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola worries the world: what it is, how it is treated, and how dangerous it is.
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare orthonovirus with no approved vaccines or targeted treatments. The epicenter is Ituri province in northeastern DRC, bordering Uganda, with the virus reaching Goma; Uganda reports imported cases from Congolese patients. As of 30 May, there are 243 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths in DRC and Uganda, with 1,100 suspected cases. Bundibugyo differs from the Zaire strain; historical mortality is 25-50%, higher where care is limited. Transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids; funerals pose a critical amplification risk. No licensed vaccines or therapies exist for Bundibugyo; control relies on isolation, contact tracing, quarantines, PPE, and safe burials. UNICEF mobilized about 50 tons of aid; a suspected patient returning to Sardinia from Congo tested negative in Rome; risk in Italy deemed low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱のブンディブギョ株が世界を懸念させる：それは何か、どのように治療され、どの程度危険か
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言した進行中の多国間エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）で、致死率25-50%のブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法なし、国際的拡大リスク高、渡航制限リスク高。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはイタリア（ローマ、サルデーニャ）も含まれているが、記事サマリーによると疑い患者の検査は陰性でイタリアのリスクは低い。本イベントの実質的な発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州、ゴマ）およびウガンダ（輸入症例）であり、DRCのみを対象国として verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: KLM cancels Uganda flights due to Ebola restrictions
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-01, KLM cancelled two Amsterdam-Entebbe flights with a Kigali layover due to Ebola-related travel and entry restrictions. The Entebbe area near Kampala, Uganda, is not currently an active risk zone, but restrictions affecting travelers who recently passed through Entebbe, including crew, prevent continuing with planned routes. The cancellations reflect broader international responses to an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain; the WHO has declared it a public health emergency of international concern, though not a pandemic emergency. The U.S. has introduced enhanced travel screening and entry restrictions to mitigate spread. Related notes include Air France diverting a Paris-Detroit flight after a passenger from the DRC boarded in error, and Emirates advising travelers to check destination entry requirements amid Ebola-related measures.
