KLM said it will continue monitoring the situation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ制限によりKLMがウガンダ便をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での検出と国際的な公衆衛生への影響が確認されており、IHR基準の3つ以上に該当。WHO公式宣言により国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラ発生の中心はCentral Africaおよび記事で明示されたDRCとされている。ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリーではEntebbe（ウガンダ）は「currently not an active risk zone」と明記され、主な発生地はDRCと中央アフリカの範囲内。対象国リストに基づきDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: KLM cancels Uganda flights due to Ebola restrictions | New Straits Times
article.articleSummary: KLM canceled two Amsterdam–Entebbe flights (with a Kigali layover) due to travel and entry restrictions tied to Ebola outbreaks in Central Africa. Entebbe is in Uganda; the airline noted the area is not presently an active risk zone, but measures restricting people who recently traveled through Entebbe, including crew, prevent operation of planned routes. The two flights were slated for Saturday and Monday. The Ebola outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda; the World Health Organization has declared it a public health emergency of international concern, though not a pandemic. The situation has prompted enhanced travel screening and entry requirements in several countries, with broader advisories and related disruptions such as diverted flights and accompanying alerts from carriers."}

triage.headline_ja: KLM、エボラ出血熱の制限措置によりウガンダ便をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）はDRC・ウガンダで発生し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。国際的な渡航制限・経営活動への影響が既に生じている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラはDRC・ウガンダで複数地域にて確認。既にWHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。国際航空便のキャンセル、渡航入国制限が複数国で実施されている。オランダ（アムステルダム）は影響国として記載されるが、主要な発生地ではなくエボラの二次的な波及地として扱われているため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع الإصابات المؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا إلى 282 حالة بالكونغو الديمقراطية - صوت الأمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in confirmed Ebola virus infections to 282 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Voice of the Nation
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease case counts in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 282 confirmed infections. Health authorities, with support from international organizations and humanitarian partners, are intensifying response efforts to contain the outbreak. Measures include expanding treatment centers, enhancing contact tracing, and broadening community awareness campaigns to reduce transmission. The outbreak is described as one of the largest Ebola waves seen in the DRC in recent years, raising concerns about potential spread to new areas if containment is not achieved quickly. The article highlights strong collaborative action between national public health authorities and international partners, underscoring the urgency of rapid case identification, isolation of patients, and public health messaging to curb further spread. The situation remains actively monitored as of the published date, 2026-06-01.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス確認感染者が282例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生上極めて深刻で、282例の確認患者を有する大規模なアウトブレイクはDRCにおいて異常・予想外であり、国際的な拡大リスク・渡航・貿易制限リスクが高い。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは致命率の高い出血熱であり、282例の確認患者数は重大なイベント。記事サマリーに「DRCで近年最大規模のエボラ波の一つ」「新しい地域への拡大リスク」と明記されており、国際機関の支援も記述されている。全スクリーニング基準5つ該当し、シグナルとして識別。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Οι πρώτες αναρρώσεις φέρνουν ελπίδα, αλλά ύποπτα κρούσματα εκτός Αφρικής προκαλούν ανησυχία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The first recoveries bring hope, but suspected cases outside Africa raise concerns.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, involving Bundibugyo strain; hundreds of confirmed and suspected cases reported by WHO; first recoveries discharged from hospitals boost hope; early diagnosis and supportive care improve survival. However, suspected cases in Italy and Brazil in the last 24 hours trigger global alerts; no evidence of wide international transmission yet, but airports, hospitals, and public health services are on heightened surveillance for potential export via air travel. The Bundibugyo variant lacks an approved vaccine, complicating containment; response relies on rigorous contact tracing, patient isolation, and community education. The outbreak unfolds in eastern DRC amid armed conflict, population displacement, and health system shortages; international organizations warn that without adequate funding and global support, the challenge will intensify in coming months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：初めての回復例が希望をもたらしているが、アフリカ外での疑い例が懸念を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での散発的報告であり、IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際拡大リスク）。検証対象国ではDRC内での確認発生があり、Brazilでの疑い例も報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。国際的な監視強化が進行中であるため、シグナルとしてピックアップ対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRC東部での確認されたエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）が主要な発生地であり、同時にイタリアとブラジルでの24時間以内の疑い例が報告されている。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため検証対象外。DRCはエボラの歴史的発生地だが、Bundibugyo株のアウトブレイクおよび国際的な散発例の報告は現在の懸念を増幅している。ワクチン未承認亜種であることが対策を複雑化させている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Un nouveau centre de traitement d'Ebola inauguré à Bunia | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | A new Ebola treatment center inaugurated in Bunia | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: New Ebola treatment center inaugurated in Bunia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, by WHO Director-General Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus amid ongoing resurgence linked to the Bundibugyo strain. The facility aims to improve patient intake, isolation, and clinical follow-up, and to bolster detection, treatment, and surveillance to curb transmission. The response faces the absence of a vaccine and no approved treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. Six patients have recovered since the resurgence, with certificates issued to confirm non-infectious status. The outbreak has produced hundreds of suspected cases and more than 200 suspected deaths in the DRC, with Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu among the hardest-hit provinces. The new site augments government and international efforts to strengthen healthcare infrastructure and frontline response.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアで新しいエボラ治療センターが開設される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重症度、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の流行は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）による流行。数百の疑似患者、200人以上の疑似死亡例。ワクチン未利用、治療法未承認。WHO事務局長による新施設開設はエボラ対応の国際的重要性を示す。新しい治療センターの開設は流行対応の強化を示唆するが、同時に流行が継続・拡大していることを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية : تدابير الصحة العامة فعالة فى إبطاء انتقال إيبولا والشفاء التام - صوت الأمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Public health measures are effective in slowing the transmission of Ebola and achieving complete recovery.
article.articleSummary: DRC and World Health Organization reaffirm joint commitment to protect health of residents in Ituri Province and the broader country amid an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. A Bunia visit by Health Minister and Communications Minister, alongside WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, underscores intensified surveillance, laboratory testing, and patient care to slow transmission and pursue full recovery. The national response emphasizes local collaboration, international support, and leveraging community trust, leadership, and engagement with women, youth, religious leaders, and the private sector. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment currently; randomized controlled trials of vaccine candidates and therapeutics are underway. Ongoing challenges include early case finding, isolation, contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, infection prevention in health facilities, and risk communications. Borders should remain open to facilitate medical supply and personnel flow.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）：公衆衛生対策はエボラウイルスの伝播を遅らせ、完全回復を実現するのに効果的
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による進行中の感染症アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスクの3項目に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目に該当。DRCの対象国リストに含まれ、国際支援（WHO Director-General訪問）が実施されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（EboBun）による進行中のアウトブレイクがIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州で確認されている。WHO事務局長による現地訪問、ワクチン候補と治療薬の臨床試験実施、複数の公衆衛生的課題（早期症例発見、隔離、接触追跡、安全な埋葬、医療施設での感染予防）が報告されている。記事は2026年6月1日配信であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイク対応を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 史上第三大伊波拉疫情！當地習俗與文化成防疫阻礙　還有醫療設施遭攻擊 - 國際新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The third-largest Ebola outbreak in history! Local customs and culture hinder epidemic prevention, and medical facilities have been attacked.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the Ebola outbreak intensifies in Ituri Province, with suspected cases surpassing 1,000. Since early May, the epidemic has caused at least 246 deaths, including three Red Cross volunteers who died handling bodies due to insufficient PPE. Médecins Sans Frontières warns the outbreak’s true scale remains unclear, with hundreds of samples still awaiting testing. The DRC health ministry reports 1,028 suspected cases, of which 225 are laboratory-confirmed, making this the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history by confirmed and suspected cases. Local communities facing food insecurity and armed conflict resist prevention measures; traditional burial practices involving touching the deceased accelerate transmission. Three treatment facilities were attacked over the weekend. The African Union estimates $265 million is needed to contain the outbreak in DRC and Uganda, plus $54 million to bolster neighboring countries’ preparedness, with costs likely to rise.

triage.headline_ja: 史上第三大エボラ疫情！当地の習俗と文化が防疫の障害に、医療施設が攻撃を受ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確認・疑い例を合わせて史上3番目の規模）で、IHR基準4項目全て該当。深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダ），渡航制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: Uganda は発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリー上では DRC（Ituri Province）が主要な発生地であり、Uganda は財政支援の対象国として言及されているのみ。サマリーから Uganda での実際の患者発生は明記されていないため、verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙した。WHO事務局長の現地入り、医療施設への攻撃、PPE不足、埋葬慣行による感染拡大など、複数の懸念要因が認められる。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 확산 우려 증폭...의사회 "전례없는 수준" - 미주 한국일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerns over Ebola spread intensify... Medical association says it's at an unprecedented level - Korean American Daily.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's eastern Ituri province faces an Ebola outbreak with suspected cases surpassing 1,000 and at least 246 deaths. Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death linked to the outbreak. MSF deputy director Alan Gonzales told BBC on May 30 that the situation is extremely serious two weeks after official declaration, with the highest surge in reported cases in a short period, and field response unable to keep pace. Border and airport restrictions are hampering outbreak control and delivery of humanitarian supplies. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to assess the response. The situation underscores unprecedented transmission dynamics and the urgent need to strengthen surveillance and containment measures to avert cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ拡散懸念増幅...医師会「前例なき水準」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死亡例多数、国境を越えた拡大リスク高く、国際的な対応が必要な重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州）が主要な発生地で1,000件超の疑似症例と246死亡を報告。ウガンダは隣国で9例の確認症例が言及されているが、DRCの流行が主体であり、ウガンダはDRCの流行に関連する事例として記載されている。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO事務局長がイトゥリを訪問し、MSF関係者が「前例なき」水準と述べており、高いレベルの国際的注視を集めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il test del paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: patient's test negative on return to Sardinia from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola testing in Italy on 1 June 2026: a Congolese resident who returned to Sardinia from Congo tested negative after analyses at Spallanzani Institute in Rome. The patient, who arrived in Italy on 30 May 2026 from Kinshasa with a layover in Cairo, developed symptoms and was moved to a biocontainment unit at Santissima Trinità Hospital in Cagliari for diagnostic workup. Italian Health Ministry notes the national risk remains very low. This negative result follows another negative test on a surgeon who had recently returned from Congo after treating a patient later confirmed positive for Ebola; two additional cases identified and still in isolation at Milan’s Sacco Hospital also remain negative. Italy has issued precautionary travel controls for travelers from Congo and Uganda: must declare origin within 24 hours if they spent time in affected areas during the 21-day incubation; flights with at-risk passengers must land at Rome’s Fiumicino health hub; regions must designate reference centers, with five risk levels guiding measures from monitoring to biocontainment transport.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：コンゴから帰国したサルデーニャの患者の検査が陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の確定例が対象国（DRC）で発生しており、イタリアへの輸入例が検出されている。複数の疑似例が陰性化しているものの、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にイタリア、エジプト、ウガンダが含まれているが、サマリーではDRCが疾病発生源であり、イタリアはあくまで輸入例の検出地。対象国リストに基づき、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。複数の疑似例が陰性化しているため、現在のイタリアでの直接的な感染リスクは低いが、DRC側の状況継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El paciente aislado por sospecha de ébola en Cerdeña (Italia) da negativo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The patient in isolation for suspected Ebola in Sardinia (Italy) tests negative.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, Italy reports a negative Ebola test for a Sardinia-based patient who had returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The individual, whose nationality was not specified, was placed in isolation at Cagliari’s Santissima Trinità hospital after presenting symptoms. Two other travelers recently returned from Uganda and tested at Milan’s Sacco Hospital also yielded negative results. Italy’s Health Ministry maintains that the national risk remains very low and will issue updates as the epidemiological situation evolves. The Ituri outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, with a case fatality rate estimated between 30% and 50%, and no approved vaccine or specific treatment, according to the World Health Organization. Monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア・サルデーニャでエボラ疑いの患者が陰性と判定
triage.triage_reason: イタリアでの疑い患者は全て陰性確認済みであり、実際の患者発生ではない。コンゴ民主共和国のIturi地域でのアウトブレイクは既知の状況であり、新たな事態展開は記事に示されていない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した発生地域にはイタリア（対象国外）が複数含まれているが、記事の実質的内容はコンゴ民主共和国のIturi地域での既知アウトブレイク状況の言及に過ぎず、新規シグナルではない。イタリアでの疑い患者は全て検査陰性であり、確定患者なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il test sul paziente ricoverato in Sardegna. Il Ministero della Salute: "In Italia rischio molto basso"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the test on the patient hospitalized in Sardinia is negative. The Ministry of Health: "In Italy, the risk is very low."
article.articleSummary: Ebola test on a patient who returned to Sardinia from the Democratic Republic of the Congo is negative, according to the Italian Ministry of Health. The individual, who arrived May 30, reported symptoms and was moved to the Santissima Trinità hospital in Cagliari under isolation; diagnostic analyses were conducted at the Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases in Rome. The Regional government of Sardinia stated that all procedures followed per protocol, with ongoing monitoring and constant contact with the Ministry, local and national health authorities, Civil Protection, and Spallanzani. Earlier in the afternoon a suspected Ebola case in Cagliari—an man originally from the Congo, who had traveled Kinshasa via Cairo to Italy and to Cagliari—had been reported; in the morning it was confirmed the test was negative. The Ministry reaffirmed that the risk of Ebola in Italy remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、サルデーニャ州に入院した患者のテストは陰性。イタリア保健省：「イタリアではリスクは非常に低い」
triage.triage_reason: 疑い患者からのエボラ熱陽性確認がなく、検査結果は陰性。イタリア国内での実際の発症事例がなく、当局も「リスク非常に低い」と評価しているため、シグナル基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: DRCから帰国した患者の疑い事例だが、検査結果は陰性であり、実際の感染症流行ではない。イタリアは対象国外のため検証位置情報に含めない。DRCは感染症流行の一次発生国として記録される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola recoveries offer much-needed hope in DRC as possible cases emerge in Brazil and Italy | LBC
article.articleSummary: Four nurses treated for Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo strain were discharged from Bunia hospital in the Democratic Republic of Congo, bringing total recoveries to five (including a laboratory worker). The DRC outbreak now lists 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with 19 new positives, as over 1,100 suspected cases remain under investigation. WHO notes there is no licensed vaccine or treatment, but survival is possible with timely medical care; the outbreak is the 17th in Congo and the third-largest since Ebola’s discovery, with ongoing regional spread risks from eastern Congo’s Ituri region. Suspected Ebola-linked cases emerged abroad: in Brazil’s Sao Paulo (a Congo visitor with fever; meningitis diagnosed) and Rio de Janeiro (recent Uganda travel; malaria). In Italy, a Congo-origin patient in Cagliari tested negative; officials say the overall risk remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ回復例が希望をもたらす一方、ブラジルとイタリアで疑わしい症例が出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病は高リスク病原体であり、DRCでの確認例282件および死亡42件、複数国への疑い例出現により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: サマリーに基づき、DRCでの確認されたエボラ発生地点（282確認例、42死亡）、ブラジル（サンパウロとリオデジャネイロで疑い例）が主題。イタリアの症例は陰性確認されたため、実際の発生地としてはカウントしない。ウガンダは記事内で渡航歴の文脈のみで、本発生地として記述されていないため除外。対象国リストに含まれるDRCとBrazilのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع الإصابات المؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا إلى 282 حالة بالكونغو الديمقراطية - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola virus cases rise to 282 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 282 after 19 new infections were reported in the past hours. Ituri Province remains the epicenter with 264 confirmed cases, followed by North Kivu with 15 and South Kivu with 3. Authorities, with support from international partners, are intensifying the response by expanding treatment centers, expanding contact tracing, and widening community awareness campaigns. This outbreak represents one of the largest EVD waves in recent years, raising concerns about potential spread to new areas if containment is not achieved promptly. Ongoing efforts aim to rapidly isolate cases, track contacts, and inform communities to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス確定患者数が282例に増加 - ザ・セブンス・デイ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）かつWPRO基準5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は高致死率であり、最近数年間における最大規模の流行の一つであり、国際支援も必要。フルRRAに進める必要性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は致死率が高く、最近数年間における最大規模の流行の一つとして記述されている。イトゥリ州が264例の確定患者数で震央となっており、北キヴ州15例、南キヴ州3例。国際パートナーの支援を受けた当局による対応強化（治療センター拡大、接触者追跡拡大、地域啓発キャンペーン拡大）が進められている。封じ込めが迅速に達成されない場合、新たな地域への拡大の可能性が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Masuk Musim Kemarau, Dinkes Sumsel Imbau Warga Waspadai Lonjakan DBD hingga ISPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the dry season begins, the South Sumatra Provincial Health Office urges residents to beware of a surge in dengue fever and acute respiratory infections.
article.articleSummary: South Sumatra Province’s Health Office warns of a potential surge in dengue fever (DF) and acute respiratory infections as the dry season lasts May–October. Other conditions to anticipate include diarrhea, typhoid, conjunctivitis, heatstroke, skin diseases, measles, and rubella. Hot, low-humidity conditions and limited access to clean water drive health risks. Dengue cases may rise as Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breed in water-storage containers such as bathtubs, drums, and dispensers when households stock water during shortages. Dengue symptoms include high fever for 2–7 days, red rash, muscle and joint pain, and nausea. ISPA risk rises from forest/land fire smoke (karhutla); symptoms include cough, runny nose, sore throat, and shortness of breath, potentially progressing to pneumonia. Poor water quality also raises diarrhea and typhus risk; common signs are loose stools >3/day, fever, nausea, and weakness. Emphasizes food hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 乾季の到来に伴い、スマトラ南部州保健局住民にデング熱と急性呼吸器感染症の急増に注意するよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（デング熱、麻疹、風疹、チフス、ISPA）が同時に言及されており、スクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」「重症度」に該当する可能性がある。ただし、現在のところ具体的な患者数増加、入院数、死亡例が報告されていないため、情報不足のため経過観察段階と判定。
triage.notes: 記事は地域保健当局による季節的な予警告であり、既存の患者数増加ではなく潜在的リスクを述べている。乾季（5月～10月）の環境条件とベクター繁殖条件が持続的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure=Yes）と流行適性（epidemic_prone=Yes）をもたらす。具体的な患者数、重症度、死亡例がないため、社会的・政治的関心はあるが、シグナルピックアップの閾値に達していない。今後の患者数報告に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Caso sospetto di Ebola a Cagliari, ecco l'esito degli esami sul 48enne ricoverato La Nuova Sardegna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected case of Ebola in Cagliari, here are the test results for the 48-year-old hospitalized patient La Nuova Sardegna
article.articleSummary: A 48-year-old man of Congolese origin, resident in Cagliari, who had recently returned from the Congo via Cairo (Kinshasa → Rome with a layover in Cairo) and arrived at Elmas airport, was hospitalized in Santissima Trinità for a suspected Ebola case after fever and cough. Health authorities activated strict biocontainment under the Health Ministry ordinance, isolating him at his Via Manno home in central Cagliari and blocking the street, before transferring him to the Infectious Diseases ward of Santissima Trinità. Overnight, the Istituto Spallanzani in Rome conducted blood tests, which were negative for Ebola. The patient remains under observation in hospital. Ebola has caused about fifty deaths in Congo and Uganda, providing essential epidemiological context for the alert.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでのエボラ疑い患者について、入院中の48歳男性の検査結果が判明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疑い患者が対象国（DRC）から欧州に渡航入国し、複数国での暴露リスク（Kinshasa→Cairo→Rome→Cagliari）と国際的な検査対応（スパッランツァーニ研究所）が確認されたため。国境を越えた感染症警戒は国際通知基準に該当。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリア（ローマ、カリアリ）とエジプト（カイロ）も言及していますが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていません。DRCからの帰還者で、検査結果は陰性でしたが、初期段階での感染症警戒アラートとしての価値があります。複数国間の渡航経路（DRC→Egypt→Italy）が記録されており、国際的な監視対象として適切です。

article.articleHeadline: 아프리카 넘어 이탈리아·브라질서도 에볼라 '의심'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beyond Africa, Ebola suspected in Italy and Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province (Ruampora area), with about 1,100 suspected cases. By May 31, 282 laboratory-confirmed infections and 42 deaths have been recorded. Transmission occurs via contact with blood or body fluids of infected people or animals. Symptoms include fever, muscle pains, vomiting, and diarrhea; there is no licensed vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo strain. Five patients have recovered, including four health workers, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Abroad, Brazil and Italy have reported suspected cases in travelers who recently returned from Africa: Brazil—two people under isolation after visiting the DRC and Uganda; Italy—one hospitalized after returning from Africa. The situation underscores ongoing transmission in DRC and potential international spread, necessitating vigilant surveillance and infection control.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカを超えてイタリア・ブラジルでもエボラが「疑い」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確定症例（282例）と死亡（42例）、国際的な疑い患者の発生、複数国への拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクがあり、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される実際の発生国は、DRC（震源地で確定症例282例、死亡42例）とBrazil（疑い患者2例を隔離中）。Italyは記事で言及されているが、サマリーには具体的な確定症例記載がなく「疑い」段階のため、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は既知の治療法がなく、国際的拡大のリスク評価が高い。WHO Director-Generalの言及により国際的な関心・対応が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: La respuesta de África al brote de ébola debe ser definida de forma interna, dice experto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa's response to the Ebola outbreak should be defined internally, says expert.
article.articleSummary: Africa's response to the Ebola outbreak should be defined internally, says expert. The analysis describes a region under intense pressure—porous borders, continual population movement, and saturated health systems—facing a strain for which there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment, leaving frontline workers stretched to the limit. Drawing on his experience running a rural hospital in Congo at age 28, Kaseya argues that the continent's health security must be built on African soil. Africa CDC's director-general contends that responses to health crises should be anchored in long-term local capacity, financed collectively by regional governments, the private sector, and international partners. The COVID-19 pandemic already demonstrated the catastrophic human and political costs of relying on financing and production networks controlled abroad.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行対応は内部で定義されるべき、専門家が述べる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が確認され、国際的な関心が高く、複数のIHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）および複数のWPRO基準（重症度、流行性、管理可能性）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはアフリカ全体のエボラ流行に対する地域的対応戦略について論じており、特にコンゴでの経験を例示している。DRCが対象国リストに含まれており、サマリー内で明示的に言及されているため verified_locations に含める。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ新興感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、医療システム飽和、ワクチン・治療薬の不足が述べられており、すべての重要基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Ιταλία: Σε απομόνωση ύποπτο κρούσμα Έμπολα, σε δοκιμασία τα πρωτόκολλα - SBC TV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy: Suspected Ebola case in isolation, protocols put to the test - SBC TV
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Italy triggers national protocols: an Italian citizen who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo is isolated in Cagliari, Sardinia, with Ebola-like symptoms. A diagnostic sample is sent to Rome’s Lazzaro Spallanzani Hospital, the national reference center for high-risk pathogens. The Italian Health Ministry states the risk of wider spread remains very low, but immediate isolation, contact tracing, and centralized laboratory confirmation are enforced. The incident tests Europe’s preparedness post-West Africa outbreaks. In Brazil, two men—one from Congo and one from Uganda—are also isolated with Ebola-compatible symptoms; the high-fever case is complemented by the other’s cough, chills, and diarrhea. Malaria is suspected in the latter, but precautions continue until tests are completed. Authorities describe very low risk to the general population. The episode underscores how rising international mobility pressures biosafety and public health readiness, with no active outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア：エボラの疑い症例が隔離、プロトコルがテストされている - SBC TV
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響の可能性、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での疑い症例、高リスク病原体、確定診断待ち中。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: イタリアはWPRO対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダも対象国外。DRC と Brazil のみが対象国リストに該当し、両国で疑い症例が報告されている。高リスク病原体（エボラ）、複数国での同時検出、国際的移動に関連、ヨーロッパの準備態勢への影響が確認される。診断確定待ちの段階だが、シグナル値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Global Health Agencies Intensify Action As Ebola Outbreak Surges Beyond Response Capacity
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo's Ituri province has caused about 220 suspected deaths and 900 cases, with cross-border spread into Uganda (7 Ugandan cases). There is no vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo; labs struggle to distinguish it from other Ebola viruses, delaying detection. As of last week only 7% of 1,261 identified contacts had been found and followed up; WHO later reported more than 2,000 contacts. The outbreak is outpacing the response amid attacks on health facilities, community mistrust, and security challenges in Ituri, where hospitals have been burned and isolation tents destroyed. Funding constraints from the U.S. withdrawal from WHO and broader aid cuts hinder emergency response. The 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976 shows the need to go back to basics: identify and monitor contacts over the 21-day incubation period, confirm cross-border spread, and bolster on-the-ground personnel. No vaccine exists; no therapy exists.

triage.headline_ja: グローバルヘルス機関がエボラ感染症の急増に対応 対応能力を超える拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。Bundibugyo株エボラの大規模流行で220人死亡、900例の疑例、ウガンダへの国境越え拡大、対応能力不足、資金制約による深刻な懸念。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているBundibugyo-strain Ebola感染症の発生は、コンゴ民主共和国東部のIturi州およびBundibugyo地区が主要な発生地。ウガンダへの国境越え拡大（7例）も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。医療施設への攻撃、コミュニティ不信、セキュリティ課題、資金制約などにより対応能力が深刻に不足している状況。ワクチンと治療法の欠如が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ratusan Babi di Bali Mati akibat Wabah ASF, Distan Siapkan 50 Ribu Dosis Vaksin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of pigs in Bali die due to ASF outbreak, Distan prepares 50,000 doses of vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, Bali, Indonesia faces an African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreak with hundreds of pigs dying across Buleleng, Badung, and Gianyar regencies; 25 pigs reportedly died in Tejakula, Buleleng, in the past week. Local authorities (DKPP Buleleng) attribute the deaths to ASF. The Bali Provincial Department of Agriculture and Food Security (Distan Pangan Bali) reports central government allocation of 50,000 ASF vaccine doses for Bali in 2026, plus 20,360 Classical Swine Fever (CSF) vaccine doses. Vaccine procurement is ongoing and expected to be completed by June 2026, with distribution to districts beginning in July 2026. Vaccination will prioritize breeding stock—boars and sows—due to their role in production and breeding, while fattening pigs are typically kept shorter for consumption.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州でアフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）流行により数百頭の豚が死亡、農業局が5万用量のワクチン配備を準備
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州）でのアフリカ豚コレラ流行は、動物衛生上の重大な影響を示し、複数地域への拡大、国際的な動物疾病発生報告の可能性、および家畜経済への脅威を有する。スクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度・流行性を満たし、社会的関心も確認される。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病ながらOIE報告義務疾患であり、国際貿易（豚肉・豚製品）への影響は重大。バリ州での複数地域での同時発生および古典豚コレラとの併発リスク指摘は、地域的な家畜衛生管理体制の脆弱性を示唆。ワクチン接種計画（7月配布開始予定）は対応準備の状況を示すが、現在流行抑制中。インドネシアは東南アジアの主要豚肉生産地であり、周辺国への拡大リスクも懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Има риск от разпространение на ебола по време на Световното първенство
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: There is a risk of Ebola spreading during the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the USA, Canada and Mexico could amplify Ebola spread due to the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Authorities warn thousands may be infected and unaware of their status, raising transmission risk during the tournament. DR Congo's national team will participate; the squad canceled its Kinshasa camp and shifted to Belgium in isolation as FIFA and the federation confirm compliance with US health requirements. Initially, US authorities demanded a 21-day isolation for arrivals from affected areas. The tournament runs 11 June–19 July across three hosts. On 28 May, USA, Canada and Mexico announced coordinated travel measures for travelers from high-risk African regions, with entry limited to designated airports and enhanced screening. Last week, WHO flagged a 'very high' national-spread risk for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain in the DRC, with about 1,000 cases and over 240 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：ワールドカップ中にエボラが拡大するリスクがある
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大リスク、複数国への潜在的な波及（USA、Canada、Mexico）、著しい重症度（1,000症例、240死亡以上）、およびWHOの「非常に高い」全国レベル拡大リスク評価により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。国際的なイベント（ワールドカップ）を通じた人的流動による感染拡大が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC内のキンシャサを発生地とし、USA、Canada、Mexicoでのワールドカップ開催に伴う国際的な拡大リスクを警告している。但し、USA、Canada、Mexicoは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定した。DRC内での進行中のアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo ebolavirus株、約1,000症例、240死亡以上）が主題であり、WHO の「非常に高い」全国レベル拡大リスク評価およびFIFA・当局による隔離措置等の対応が記録されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola recoveries bring signs of hope in DRC as suspected cases emerge outside Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda persists. Four nurses in Bunia, Ituri, have been discharged after recovery, bringing total recoveries to five (including a laboratory worker). No licensed vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola; outcomes hinge on good medical care. WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern earlier this month. The Congo‑Uganda cluster is the 17th Ebola outbreak in Congo and the third-largest; confirmed cases in the DRC rose to 282 with 42 deaths after 19 new positives. Over 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation globally, signaling regional spread risk. Outside Africa, suspected cases include Brazil: São Paulo (fever; meningitis positive; Ebola cannot be ruled out) and Rio de Janeiro (malaria positive; Ebola cannot be ruled out), and Italy (Cagliari: Congo‑returnee; negative). Overall, risk remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の回復事例がDRCで希望をもたらす一方、アフリカ外で疑い患者が出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上に該当（異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済みのエボラ熱アウトブレイク、アフリカ外での疑い患者検出、対象国内での確認患者数増加。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラ熱の確認患者数は282件（42名死亡）で増加継続。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。ワクチン・治療法なし。アフリカ外ではブラジル（サンパウロ、リオ・デ・ジャネイロ）とイタリア（カリアリ）で疑い患者確認。イタリアは対象国外のため除外。ウガンダも発生国だが対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Двама мъже в Бразилия са подложени на изследвания заради съмнения за заразяване с Ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two men in Brazil are undergoing tests for suspected Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: Two men in Brazil are under medical testing for suspected Ebola infection as of 1 June 2026. Initial tests indicated one patient had meningitis and the other malaria, but Ebola cannot be ruled out. The São Paulo case involves a man from the Democratic Republic of Congo who sought care with a high fever after visiting the country; he is intubated and in serious condition. The Rio de Janeiro case involves a man who recently traveled to Uganda. Brazilian health authorities stress that a diagnosis of another condition does not exclude Ebola, so both cases remain under strict observation. The Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are currently grappling with Ebola outbreaks, and authorities emphasize continued surveillance. No confirmed Ebola diagnosis has been reported in Brazil at this time.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの2人の男性がエボラ感染の疑いで検査を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの国際拡大可能性が高く、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）での流行地からの訪問者が疑い症例として検出されたため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行地からの訪問者がブラジルで疑い症例として検出された。現時点ではエボラ確定診断はないが、国際拡大の早期警報として重要。高熱・神経症状など重症度も高い。複数国にまたがる輸入リスク事例。

article.articleHeadline: تعافي مرضى إيبولا يمنح الأمل في الكونجو ومخاوف من انتشار خارج أفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recovery of Ebola patients gives hope in the Congo and fears of spread beyond Africa.
article.articleSummary: Four nurses treated for Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease have been discharged from Bunia hospital in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, bringing total recoveries to five with a lab worker earlier. The DR Congo outbreak now has 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with 19 new positives reported. WHO had designated the Congo–Uganda outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, noting no approved vaccine or treatment yet, but that good clinical care can save lives. Internationally, Brazil reports suspected Ebola in Sao Paulo—a man from the DRC who recently visited Africa with fever and meningitis; another suspected in Rio de Janeiro has malaria, but Ebola cannot be ruled out. In Italy, a suspected case in Cagliari, a Congo returnee, tested negative; officials say Italy’s risk remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者の回復がコンゴに希望をもたらし、アフリカ外への拡大の懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO既認定のPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）であり、複数国での疑い症例報告あり。
triage.notes: DRCはエボラアウトブレイク（282確定症例、42死亡）の主要感染地。ブラジルでは複数の疑い症例報告あり。イタリアの疑い症例は陰性だが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。ウガンダも地域的に言及されているが、記事サマリー上ではDRCと関連言及のため検証位置に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ιταλία: Σε απομόνωση ασθενής με ύποπτα συμπτώματα Έμπολα μετά από ταξίδι - SBC TV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy: A patient in isolation with suspected Ebola symptoms after travel - SBC TV.
article.articleSummary: An Italian man who recently returned from Congo is isolated in Cagliari, Sardinia, on suspicion of Ebola virus infection after developing compatible symptoms. A diagnostic sample has been sent to Rome’s Lazzaro Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases, a central high-risk reference center, which collaborates with the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC). Italian health authorities activated national and European biosafety protocols, while stressing that the risk of wide transmission is currently very low. The case underscores Europe’s ongoing vigilance against imported high-mortality infections amid dense cross-border mobility and extensive travel with sub-Saharan Africa. The ministry of health notes increased protective measures, but there is no confirmation yet of Ebola; this incident serves as a test of surveillance and interagency coordination within Italy and the EU’s health security framework.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア：コンゴからの旅行後、エボラの疑い症状を持つ患者が隔離措置下に
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染の疑い症例（アフリカからの輸入事例）で、IHR基準3つ以上該当。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、公衆衛生への潜在的重大影響があり、欧州機関（ECDC）との連携も進行中。
triage.notes: 患者はイタリアで隔離中だが、感染源はコンゴ民主共和国。対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。診断確定待ちの段階だが、疑い症例として欧州のバイオセキュリティプロトコルが発動されており、シグナル識別の基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le Gouvernement et l'OMS renforcent leur coordination pour accélérer la riposte contre Ebola en Ituri - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Government and the WHO strengthen their coordination to accelerate the Ebola response in Ituri - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains a concern across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. A joint declaration issued May 31 by the government and the World Health Organization reaffirms a strong partnership to intensify the response in eastern provinces where new cases are being reported. With technical and logistical support from WHO and partners, the government has intensified epidemiological surveillance to rapidly detect cases and limit transmission. Ongoing actions include strengthened laboratory diagnostics, active case finding and contact tracing, medical management of patients, and infection prevention and control in health facilities and communities. Authorities say coordinated interventions are essential to interrupt transmission chains and prevent escalation, highlighting Ebola as one of Africa’s deadliest diseases and the need to protect at-risk populations in these provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：政府とWHOがイトゥリにおけるエボラ対応を加速させるための協調を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はIHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性が確認される。DRCは過去に複数のエボラ流行を経験しており、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行可能性、管理能力の不確実性が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月1日付けで、DRCのイトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州でのエボラ流行を報告。政府とWHOが5月31日に共同宣言を発表し、対応の強化を確認。新規症例の報告があり、サーベイランス、検査診断、接触者追跡など対策が継続中。DRCはエボラに関する国際報告義務の対象国である。

article.articleHeadline: طبيب: عدد الوفيات الحقيقي بسبب إيبولا في أوغندا أعلى من إحصاءات الصحة العالمية - سواليف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor: The true number of Ebola deaths in Uganda is higher than World Health Organization statistics.
article.articleSummary: Dr. Eliya Kiza in Kampala says the Ebola death toll in Uganda exceeds WHO counts, which report a single Ugandan death. He told a Novosti correspondent that newer fatalities are being reported and that the toll will rise. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The current epicenter lies in Ituri Province, eastern DRC, near the Uganda border. Congolese health authorities first raised alerts on May 5, but experts do not rule out transmission among local populations for several weeks prior. The remarks highlight discrepancies between national tallies and WHO figures and underscore ongoing concerns about cross-border spread between the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 医師：ウガンダのエボラ死者数は世界保健機関の統計より多い
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済みで、IHR基準2項目以上（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。DRCとウガンダの国境地域での活発な感染拡大と越境感染リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ（Kampala、Central Region）が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国に含まれ、イトゥリ州での爆発的な感染拡大が主要な焦点。WHOはすでに2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。医師の証言による公式統計との不一致が社会的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" و"الكونغو الديمقراطية" توحدان الجهود لاحتواء تفشي الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization and the Democratic Republic of the Congo join forces to contain an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and the World Health Organization are intensifying efforts to contain an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with cases and deaths reported in Ituri province and across North and South Kivu, following a high-level visit to Bunia. The joint statement says the Congolese government, with WHO and partners, is expanding surveillance, laboratory testing, and patient care to curb transmission and accelerate control. A national response is led by the government with local authorities, while WHO and UN partners provide technical and logistical support, mobilizing resources for rapid, equitable interventions. Emphasis on community engagement—local leaders, women, youth, religious figures, and the private sector—alongside safe burials, early detection, contact tracing, IPC in health facilities, and risk communication. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists yet for Bundibugyo virus; vaccine/therapy studies are being fast-tracked. Cross-border coordination and essential health services are stressed.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）とコンゴ民主共和国がエボラ出血熱の流行を封じ込めるため力を合わせる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、予想外の事象性、渡航制限リスクをすべて満たし、IHR基準4つ該当。複数州での多数の患者・死亡報告があり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による流行。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州で患者・死亡が報告されている。WHOと多国籍パートナーが支援を実施中。ワクチンおよび治療法がまだ認可されていない点も深刻。クロスボーダー調整が強調されており、地域的拡大リスクが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Batanu bamaze gukira Ebola muri DRC
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, five people in the Democratic Republic of Congo have been infected with an unusual Bundibugyo strain of Ebola that currently lacks a licensed vaccine or approved treatment; all five have recovered and been discharged from hospital. One patient was discharged on Friday, and four more are to be discharged as a new Ebola treatment center opens in Bunia, Ituri province, eastern DRC. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, but unlike many outbreaks caused by the Ebola Zaire lineage, this strain has no approved medical countermeasures. The Bundibugyo virus is reported to have up to about a 50% case-fatality risk. Health workers report scarce supplies, and some communities are upset by strict burial practices. Armed groups operate in eastern Congo; WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged a ceasefire to support the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の感染者が確認される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）の確認で異常性・予想外性が高く、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、武装勢力による対応阻害など複数の懸念要因が存在。IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はザイール株と異なり承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、医学的対抗手段の欠如が懸念事項。症例の全員回復は肯定的だが、武装勢力による対応阻害の報告があり、制御可能性に重大なリスク。WHO事務局長が停戦を要請するなど国際的な関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: New Ebola warning issued as 'rapidly evolving virus' spreads across the globe
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, the Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak—an Ebola variant—continues to evolve rapidly, with 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths in DRC, and 55 suspected deaths across Uganda and DRC since May 21. WHO on May 29 outlined response measures: deployment of rapid response teams, delivery of medical supplies, strengthened surveillance, laboratory confirmation, infection prevention and control, safe and optimized treatment centers, and community engagement, amid ongoing cross-border transmission. MSF notes that two weeks after Ituri Province declared the outbreak, cases surged; doctors report many cases early and dozens of samples untested. Transmission is by direct contact with bodily fluids (blood, vomit, diarrhoea, saliva, urine, semen, sweat) and contaminated objects; patients require hospital quarantine and symptom-focused care (breathing support, IV fluids).

triage.headline_ja: 「急速に進化するウイルス」が世界中に広がるため、新しいエボラ警告が発令された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な死亡例、予想外の急速な進化、越境拡大、国際的な対応が必要）。WPRO基準でも全5項目に該当。エボラ関連疾患であり、複数国での活動的な流行が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダでのBundibugyo virus disease (BVD)（エボラ亜種）の急速な流行を報告。ウガンダ（Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。906疑い例と223死亡（DRC）、55疑い死亡（ウガンダ・DRC合計）。WHOが5月29日に対応を策定。越境伝播の進行中。急速な進化とメッセージが含まれており、深刻な感染症危機シグナルとして判定。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）5名埃博拉患者痊愈　本轮疫情首现康复病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Ebola patients in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have recovered; the first recoveries reported in this outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola patients in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, have recovered—the first confirmed recoveries of this outbreak. On May 31, four local healthcare workers were discharged after two consecutive negative tests following positive results, while a laboratory worker had recovered earlier and returned home. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved vaccine or specific antiviral therapy. Standard care and supportive treatment were provided. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia on May 30, underscoring that recovery is possible even without a vaccine, but warning that the outbreak is not over. As of May 29, Congo reported 263 confirmed cases and 42 deaths; more than 1,100 suspected cases remained under investigation as of May 30. Healthcare worker infections and community fear continue to hinder containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者5名が回復　今回の流行で初めての回復例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の回復事例、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による継続的な流行、263確定患者・42死亡、1,100件以上の疑い例が存在。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による流行は継続中。医療従事者の感染と地域社会の恐怖により封じ込めが妨げられている。WHO事務局長の訪問により国際的な関心が確認されている。ワクチンや特異的抗ウイルス療法がないため管理可能性に課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: Homem com suspeita de ebola viajou de Guarulhos (SP) ao Rio de ônibus, diz Ministério da Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man with suspected Ebola traveled by bus from Guarulhos (SP) to Rio de Janeiro, says the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: June 1, 2026 — Brazil is investigating a suspected Ebola case in Rio de Janeiro. A 37-year-old man from Uganda, isolated at INI/Fiocruz Evandro Chagas, developed feverish symptoms (chills, cough, diarrhea) after arriving on May 22 from Johannesburg, South Africa, and traveling by bus from Guarulhos to Rio de Janeiro. He stayed in Vila Isabel; five local residents are under monitoring and asymptomatic. Initial Ebola testing was negative; saliva and urine analyses on May 31 were negative; a blood sample remains under analysis, and the chance of confirming Ebola after negatives is very low. A separate suspected case in São Paulo: another 37-year-old man with suspected Ebola meningitis at Instituto Emílio Ribas (Pacaembu) is in grave condition; investigation ongoing. Authorities say Ebola viruses are not transmitted during incubation or by respiratory routes; Brazil/South America risk considered low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い患者がグアルーリョス（SP）からリオデジャネイロまでバスで移動、ブラジル保健省が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において「異常・予想外性」「国際的拡大リスク」が該当（2つ以上）し、かつWPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当。ブラジル国内での複数疑い例と公式な公衆衛生対応が確認されているため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（リオデジャネイロおよびサンパウロ）でのエボラ疑い例を主題としている。Johannesburg（南アフリカ）はウガンダの患者の経由地であり、発生地としては記載されていない。南アフリカはGeoNames対象国外。複数の疑い例、国際的な経由地での接触、バス移動による接触者拡大リスク、公式な監視体制が確認される。初期検査では陰性であるが、メニンジス症状を呈する重症例もあり、確認までの間の管理可能性が判定基準となる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, test negativo per il paziente isolato a Cagliari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Negative test for the patient isolated in Cagliari.
article.articleSummary: Ebola test in Sardinia for a Congolese resident who had returned from Congo via Kinshasa to Rome’s Fiumicino Airport with a layover in Cairo is negative. The patient, who developed malaise, was placed under biocontainment at Santissima Trinità hospital in Cagliari; samples were transported by military helicopter to Rome’s Spallanzani Institute for analysis on Sunday, 31 May. Italy confirms no Ebola cases; risk remains very low. A separate Congolese surgeon who recently returned from Congo also tested negative, and two suspected cases at Milan’s Sacco hospital are negative and still in isolation. The incident triggered a street closure on Via Manno for about an hour. Globally, Africa reports about 1,100 suspected Ebola cases with 263 confirmed by Africa CDC, centered in Bunia; MSF warns of rapid case growth and diagnostic delays as Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：カリアリで隔離されていた患者の検査が陰性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス感染の活発な流行（約1,100の疑い患者、263の確定患者）に対応して、イタリアに入国した患者が複数検査されており、国際的な拡大リスク、公衆衛生への懸念が存在する。IHR基準の複数該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）とスクリーニング基準（流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラウイルス流行（Bunia中心）が主要なシグナル。イタリアの複数の疑い患者は検査陰性だが、国際的な流行の活動性と輸入リスクが存在する。MSFが急速な症例増加と診断遅延を警告、WHO事務局長が現地訪問中。WPRO基準の対象国（DRC）は該当するが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Dois homens com possíveis sintomas de ébola colocados em isolamento no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two men with possible Ebola symptoms placed in isolation in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Two men from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda were placed in isolation in Brazil amid suspected Ebola exposure; Ebola has not been confirmed in either case. A Ugandan-arrival in Rio de Janeiro reported viral symptoms, tested malaria-positive and Ebola-negative, but remains isolated during investigation. In São Paulo, a man who recently traveled to the DRC is being assessed after fever; he was placed in isolation at Instituto Emílio Ribas and tested positive for a severe meningitis form, with Ebola tests pending. Brazil regards the risk of introduction as very low due to no local transmission and no direct flights from Africa; health services are advised to monitor febrile travelers with Congo/Uganda travel history. The DRC outbreak is Bundibugyo, with 30-50% fatality and no vaccine; Africa CDC cites 246 deaths and over 1,000 suspected cases. Uganda reports nine cases, with two new on Friday.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでエボラウイルス病の可能性のある症状を呈する2人が隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・予想外性が複数該当。DRC/ウガンダのエボラ流行国から入国者が疑似症で隔離されており、確定診断が保留中のため国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月1日のポルトガルメディア報道。DRC/ウガンダからのエボラ流行地域への入国者2名がブラジル国内で隔離されており、Bundibugyo型エボラで死亡率30-50%、DRCで246死亡・1000以上の疑い例、ウガンダで9例報告されている背景がある。ただし現時点ではエボラ陽性確定者はなく、1名はマラリア陽性・エボラ陰性、もう1名は髄膜炎で検査結果待機中。ブラジル政府は地域伝播のリスクは極めて低いと評価しているが、国際的な関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un premier cas en Europe, en Italie ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a first case in Europe, in Italy?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the DRC since May 15, 2026 has caused about 250 deaths among 1,028 suspected cases (Africa CDC). The eastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu are hardest hit amid health-system strain and insecurity. WHO Director-General Tedros warned on May 29 that the virus is advancing faster than detection. The epidemic has crossed borders: in Italy, a 46-year-old Congolese-origin Italian national is hospitalized in Cagliari after Kinshasa; blood tests at Rome's Spallanzani lab were negative, and he was not intercepted at Fiumicino, having transited via Cairo and listed as Egyptian-origin, highlighting surveillance gaps. Italy’s Health Ministry says national risk remains very low; PM Meloni calls for stronger EU border-control coordination ahead of the June European Council. In Brazil, two suspected cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro involve a Belgian national returning from Uganda and a 37-year-old man from DRC, prompting contact-tracing and investigations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ヨーロッパ、イタリアで初の症例か？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行（250死亡/1,028疑い例）が国境を越えてイタリアとブラジルに伝播し、重症度が高く、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが明確である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはイタリア・ブラジル・エジプト・ウガンダが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC での流行とその国外伝播（イタリア・ブラジルでの輸入症例）である。対象国リストに基づき、実際に感染症イベントが発生している DRC（203312）と Brazil（3469034）のみを verified_locations に含めた。イタリアでの症例は DRC からの輸入例であり、現地流行ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC hails recovery of four Ebola-affected health workers
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola-affected frontline health workers in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, have fully recovered and were discharged, Africa CDC reports, marking a milestone in the ongoing response. Africa CDC reaffirmed support for the DRC and partners in the Ebola effort. Separately, the World Health Organization announced a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) for the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus said the declaration, issued on May 18 under Article 12 of the International Health Regulations due to concerns over scale and speed, was made before an Emergency Committee was convened. The Committee will meet to consider temporary recommendations. This is the first PHEIC declaration by a DG prior to convening the committee, underscoring intensified global coordination as response teams work to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがエボラ感染の4人の医療従事者の回復を称賛
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOが2026年5月18日にPHEIC宣言を発出した確認済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでUgandaが言及されているが、実際のイベント発生地点はIturi州（DRC）であり、医療従事者の回復事例はDRCに限定。ウガンダはPHEIC宣言の対象として言及されているが、具体的な発生地点の報告はなく、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。PHEIC宣言は国際的な懸念の最高レベルを示している。

article.articleHeadline: 史上第三大伊波拉疫情！當地習俗與文化成防疫阻礙　還有醫療設施遭攻擊 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The third-largest Ebola outbreak in history! Local customs and culture hinder epidemic prevention, and medical facilities have also been attacked.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province, is the third-largest on record by total cases. From early May through 2026-06-01, there are 1,028 suspected cases and 225 laboratory-confirmed, with at least 246 deaths, including three Red Cross volunteers who died before PPE was available. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the outbreak area to press for more international support as logistics falter and local resistance rises. MSF warns the outbreak’s scale remains unclear, with hundreds of samples still pending. Resistance stems from unfamiliarity with Ebola prevention and traditional funeral customs; three treatment facilities were attacked over the weekend by residents upset about burial rites and skeptical that the outbreak is real (about 25% of locals). African Union estimates require roughly $264 million for DRC and Uganda plus $54 million for high-risk neighbors, with potential increases as needs grow. Clinicians focus on symptomatic care amid security and acceptance challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 史上第三大エボラ疫情！現地の習俗と文化が防疫の障害となり、医療施設も攻撃を受ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な死亡・発症者、異常なエボラ流行、ウガンダへの国際的拡大リスク、国境地域での流行）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全て該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理困難性）。国家規模の支援が必要。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: サマリーではウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）への言及がありますが、実際の発症者・死亡例はDRC（イトゥリ州）に限定されており、ウガンダは「高リスク隣国」として資金援助対象に挙げられているのみです。従ってverified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。DRCは対象国リスト（GeoNames ID 203312）に該当します。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、医療施設への攻撃、地域的な受け入れ困難性、深刻な死傷数（確認死亡246例、検査確認225例）により、国際的対応が急務です。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 감염 의심자 1100명...아프리카 밖 첫 확진 가능성도 - 신아일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,100 people suspected of Ebola infection... possibility of the first confirmed case outside Africa.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: about 1,100 people are under investigation for Ebola infection as of May 30, with 282 laboratory-confirmed cases and 42 deaths in the outbreak’s epicenter as of May 31 (AFP/Reuters). The circulating Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no approved vaccine or treatment, though recoveries have been documented; WHO reports five recoveries, including four nurses. Transmission occurs via contact with infected animals or humans, with symptoms such as fever, muscle pain, vomiting, and diarrhea. International spread concerns: Brazil flags two suspected cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro; a 37-year-old man from the DRC is in critical condition and could become the first infection outside Africa if confirmed. Italy also reports a suspected case with Africa travel history, hospitalized. Containment and monitoring remain critical for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染疑い者1,100人...アフリカ外での初の確認症例の可能性も
triage.triage_reason: DRC内での確認症例282名、死亡42名、及びブラジルとイタリアでの疑似症例報告により、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」「異常/予想外性」が明確に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行可能性が高く、国際支援必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にイタリアが含まれているが、サマリーではイタリアは疑似症例の報告国であり、実際のエボラウイルス伝播地ではない。対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC由来ウイルスのアフリカ外への国際流出が差迫った脅威として認識される。ワクチン・治療薬不在の高リスク株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）である点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola recoveries bring signs of hope in DRC as suspected cases emerge outside Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues as four nurses treated for Bundibugyo Ebola in Bunia are discharged, with a laboratory worker also recovered; total recoveries reach five. Confirmed DRC cases rise to 282 with 42 deaths; 19 new positives were reported. WHO declared Bundibugyo Ebola a public health emergency of international concern earlier this month; there is no licensed vaccine or treatment, but survival is possible with timely medical care. Suspected cases outside Africa include Brazil (São Paulo: fever in a traveler from the DRC later linked to meningitis) and Rio de Janeiro (traveler from Uganda; malaria positive). In Italy, Sardinia’s Cagliari triggered protocols for a DRC returnee who tested negative. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation; Africa CDC cautions the risk of regional spread. This is the 17th DRC Ebola outbreak and the third-largest since discovery.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱の回復事例が希望の兆候をもたらす一方、アフリカ外での疑い事例が出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO宣言済みのPublic Health Emergency of International Concern(PHEIC)であり、複数国での疑い事例確認により国際的な懸念が実在している。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。17番目のDRCエボラアウトブレイク。死亡率が確認（42人死亡、282人確定症例）。アフリカ外での疑い事例（ブラジル、イタリア）が報告されているが、イタリアは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めず。ブラジルは対象国として含める。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев заболевания лихорадкой Эбола в ДР Конго возросло до 282
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed cases of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 282.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 282 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with 264 in Ituri, 15 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu; 42 confirmed cases have died. The country also lists over 1,000 suspected cases and about 240 deaths. Neighboring Uganda reports 7 suspected cases and 1 death, with 2 recoveries. Uganda closed its border with DRC on 27 May to reduce cross-border spread; Rwanda had closed its border, and Zambia has strict medical checks. On 17 May, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda. The outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, first detected in Uganda in 2007.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス病確認症例数が282例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、複数国での検出と死亡例あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC（South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu州）での282確認症例と42死亡、ウガンダでの7疑似症例と1死亡を報告。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。ザンビアは医学的検査を実施している。WHO PHEIC宣言(2026年5月17日)済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus(2007年ウガンダで初検出)が病原体と特定。

article.articleHeadline: Réponse américaine à l'épidémie d'Ebola en Afrique : 162 millions de dollars mobilisés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. response to the Ebola outbreak in Africa: $162 million mobilized
article.articleSummary: United States mobilizes over $162 million to bolster Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with the State Department and CDC coordinating rapid actions. The U.S. remains the leading funder in a broader package including $350 million from OCHA humanitarian funds and a $1.8 billion package announced May 14. On May 28, the United States, Mexico, and Canada announced coordinated traveler health measures for FIFA World Cup 2026, requiring travelers who stayed in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days of arrival to enter via designated airports for enhanced screening. U.S. support includes funding commitments for Kenya and field operations in DRC and Uganda. PPE deliveries by UNICEF and IOM, surveillance and screening at regional airports, and testing cartridge provisioning by FHI 360 accompany contact tracing and risk-communication efforts by UNICEF and FHI 360; health workers are mobilized and supervisors trained.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行への米国の対応：1億6,200万ドルを動員
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という高リスク病原体による国際的な流行対応が示されている。複数国での確認、国際的な渡航制限措置の実施、重大な公衆衛生影響が認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ出血熱流行が報告されている。しかし対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国、メキシコ、カナダの言及は対応国であり発生国ではないため除外。FIFA World Cup 2026関連の渡航制限措置が複数国で導入されている点、複数の国連機関（UNICEF、IOM、FHI 360）が関与している点から、国際的な関心度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases in Congo rise to 282, health authorities say
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo rise to 282 on 2026-06-01, up 19 cases. Of these, 264 are in Ituri province, 15 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu, with 42 deaths. This outbreak is the DRC's 17th since 1976 and the third-largest on record. Health authorities and international agencies continue to monitor spread and resource needs to contain transmission. The World Health Organization reports the Bundibugyo strain remains active, with 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths under verification. No infection source, laboratory confirmation method, or details on imported/exported cases are provided in the report. The information reflects ongoing activity as concerns about outbreak scale persist.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定患者が282例に増加、保健当局が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（282確定例、42死亡）、異常性（DRC内で複数州での地理的拡大）、国際的拡大リスク（WHO報告、国際機関の関与）の少なくとも2つ以上に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で該当。フルRRAが必要な重大シグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行。確定患者282例、疑い患者906例、死亡42例（確認済み）～223例（検証中）。DRC内3州（Ituri主体、North Kivu、South Kivu）での地理的拡大を確認。DRC史上17番目の発生で3番目の規模。WHO・国際機関が関与、資源確保と封じ込め対策が継続中。感染源、検査確認方法、輸入/輸出例の詳細は報告に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS Alerta: Surto de Ébola na RDC Ultrapassa Resposta Internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Alerts: Ebola outbreak in the DRC outpaces international response.
article.articleSummary: An active Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC)—the 17th in the country and the third-largest since the virus’s discovery—advances faster than the international response. Initial cases were confirmed in Ituri province in early May, with Bunia as a focal point and spread toward Kinshasa and the Ugandan border. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia and Kinshasa, urging treatment access and safe burials, and noting that the Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccines or antivirals, making early palliation, isolation, rehydration, and pain control essential. Brazil is investigating a suspected Ebola case in São Paulo linked to travel from the DRC; the patient is isolated. MSF warned the response remains under-resourced, with shortages of basic materials, and WHO said only about one‑third of needed funds have been received. As of Friday, 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths under investigation; later, 1,028 suspected cases and 225 confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が国際的対応を上回る速度で進展
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。DRC内での大規模流行に加え、ブラジルでの患者検出により国際的な拡大が既に確認されている。
triage.notes: DRC内での17番目のエボラ流行であり、3番目の大規模流行。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・抗ウイルス薬未認可。ブラジルではサンパウロで疑い患者が検出され、DRC渡航歴が確認されている。WHOは資金不足を警告しており、国際的対応が追いついていない状況が記事の主要な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Пятеро больных Эболой выздоровели в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Ebola patients have recovered in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Five patients with Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus recovered in Bunia, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Four were healthcare workers discharged after two negative Ebola tests, and one laboratory technician returned home. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus attended the opening of a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia and welcomed the recoveries. Health authorities reported ongoing laboratory testing, epidemiological monitoring, contact tracing, and case verification, with no samples awaiting analysis as of the time of reporting. As of May 29, the DRC had 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths. Officials emphasized continued vaccine and treatment development and noted improving outcomes in the outbreak area.

triage.headline_ja: 5人のエボラ患者がDRCで回復した
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認感染事例が存在し、DRCでの継続的な流行が記事から明らかであるが、本記事は患者回復というポジティブなニュースであり、新規発生や急速な拡大を示す直接的な証拠に欠ける。情報が回復事例と公衆衛生対応体制の確立に限定されており、IHR基準の明確な該当判定には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo ebolavirus による263確認症例、42死亡（5月29日現在）を報告しており、進行中の流行を示唆。しかし本記事は回復事例とWHO長官による新治療センター開設式典への言及が主軸であり、急速な国際拡大やパニック的な保健上の危機を示すシグナルではない。継続的な疫学的監視と接触者追跡が機能していることが報告されており、公衆衛生対応体制は確立されている。フルRRA実施前に、流行の拡大傾向、死亡率の推移、地域外への拡散リスクに関する情報収集を優先するべき。

article.articleHeadline: تحذير عـاجل من الأمم المتحدة بسبب الإيبولا.. تفاصيل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent warning from the United Nations about Ebola.. details
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, UN OCHA warns that the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand across eastern provinces, notably Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, now affecting 13 health zones. Official data through 26 May record over 1,000 suspected cases, with 121 laboratory-confirmed, and 17 deaths, including six frontline health workers. The World Health Organization designates this outbreak as the third-largest Ebola event in history. Amid grim clinical conditions, a patient has achieved first full recovery at a treatment center in Ituri. The UN and partners are intensifying logistics, isolation facilities, patient care, and community risk communication, and bolstering border surveillance to curb spread. UNICEF reports an airlift of more than 100 tons of essential supplies, including PPE, medicines, and sanitation items, to protect about 100,000 people, especially children and internally displaced families.

triage.headline_ja: 国連がエボラ熱について緊急警告..詳細
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定症例と死亡があり、複数の州に拡大している深刻な公衆衛生事象。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する明白なシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行。確定症例121例、死亡17例（医療従事者6名含む）。東部地域13ヘルスゾーンに拡大。WHOが過去3番目の規模に指定。国連とパートナーが国境監視強化、支援物資輸送などの対応を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: KLM cancels Uganda flights due to Ebola restrictions
article.articleSummary: KLM cancelled two Amsterdam–Entebbe flights with a Kigali layover scheduled for Saturday and Monday due to travel and entry restrictions tied to the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Entebbe is not currently considered an active risk zone, but many countries have measures for travelers who recently passed through Entebbe, including crew. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC), though not a pandemic emergency. In May, the U.S. introduced enhanced travel screening and entry restrictions to prevent spread. Brussels Airlines said it would significantly adjust crew scheduling to continue operating flights to Entebbe, Kinshasa, New York, and Washington when possible. On May 20, an Air France Paris–Detroit flight was diverted after a passenger from DRC boarded in error.

triage.headline_ja: KLM、エボラ制限によるウガンダ便をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、複数国での航空制限実施、国際的な感染リスク管理が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではBundibugyo Ebola outbreakはDRCおよびウガンダで発生と記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。エンテベ、キガリ等の記載地点は航空便の経由地・目的地であり、現在の活発な発生地ではない。WHO PHEIC宣言、米国の入国制限強化、複数航空会社の運航調整等から高い社会政治的関心が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Former World Leaders Conduct Global Crisis Simulation with AI and Pandemic Scenarios - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: Eastern Chad reports several fatalities among patients with respiratory failure; preliminary samples hint at a novel bird flu variant, but confirmation requires sending specimens to an international laboratory. Chad has hesitated to inform WHO within 24 hours, citing economic impact and stigma. The situation is set against a hantavirus outbreak and an Ebola outbreak declared in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which has killed at least 139 people; reports of cross-border cases toward northern Cameroon emerge as severe flooding disrupts transport. The event unfolds during a simulated pandemic exercise at WHO’s emergency hub near Nairobi, featuring former leaders (the Elders) and an AI-enabled decision-support system. Debates focus on incentives for compliance, verification strength, and the need for integrated health-climate surveillance amid delays in finalizing a global pandemic treaty.

triage.headline_ja: 旧指導者がAIとパンデミックシナリオで世界危機シミュレーションを実施 - Internewscast Journal
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主要テーマが『シミュレーション演習（机上訓練）』であり、実際の感染症イベントではなく、仮想シナリオの議論を取り扱っている。記事内容は WHO 緊急対応ハブでの訓練イベントであることが明記されている。
triage.notes: 記事は『WHO 緊急対応ハブ近くのナイロビで実施されたシミュレーション演習』について報道しており、記事内で言及されるチャド・ウガンダ・DRC などでの疾患（鳥インフルエンザ、ハンタウイルス、エボラ）はすべてシミュレーションシナリオの一部である。実際の感染症イベントではなく、机上訓練（Table Top Exercise）の記録であるため、リアルシグナルではない。対象国内での実際の発生イベントではないため verified_locations は空とする。

article.articleHeadline: البرازيل تواصل التحقيق فى حالتين مشتبه بإصابتهما بفيروس إيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil continues to investigate two suspected Ebola virus infection cases.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected imported Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases under investigation in Brazil as of 2026-06-01. In Sao Paulo, a man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo developed fever; preliminary tests detected meningitis, but Ebola virus disease cannot be ruled out and investigations continue. The Rio de Janeiro case involves a traveler who recently went to Uganda; initial tests showed malaria, but Ebola virus disease testing remains ongoing. The Sao Paulo patient is described as serious and has required mechanical ventilation and intensive care. Brazil is intensifying surveillance of travelers from Ebola-affected countries to prevent domestic transmission; final diagnoses await confirmatory Ebola virus disease testing.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラウイルス感染の疑いのある2症例の調査を継続中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の疑い症例が報告され、複数国からの輸入ケースであり、サーベイランス強化が進められている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は致死率が高く、複数国への輸入リスクを有する。サマリーに基づきDRCとウガンダからの輸入症例が記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルでの確定診断待機中だが、疑い症例の存在とサーベイランス強化は重大な公衆衛生対応を示している。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : plus de 1 000 cas suspects d'Ebola, l'OMS alerte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: More than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, Ebola virus disease continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with cases also reported in Uganda, linked to the Bundibugyo strain, raising concern due to the absence of a vaccine or specific treatment. In eastern DRC, authorities report 1,077 suspected cases, 238 suspected deaths, and more than 100 laboratory-confirmed cases, concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu. Access challenges, insecurity, and displacement hinder surveillance and patient care. In Uganda, seven confirmed cases and one death are linked to transmissions from the DRC. Border controls and contact tracing have been intensified. The WHO declared on May 17, 2026 an international public health emergency (PHEIC) over cross-border spread risk and lack of targeted measures, with strengthened field teams, testing, isolation, and tracing. Authorities urge vigilance and regional cooperation; situation remains under close surveillance amid security and humanitarian challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルス疑い患者が1000例を超える、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、複数国での確定症例と死亡、国際的拡大リスク、ワクチン・治療薬欠如により、フルRRA実施の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。DRCでの確定症例(100例以上)、疑い患者1,077例、疑い死亡238例、ウガンダとの国境での感染確認により、PHEIC宣言(2026年5月17日)および緊急対応の実装がなされている。

article.articleHeadline: Perú declara estado de emergencia ante la epidemia de sarampión que expone la crisis del sistema de salud pública capitalista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peru declares a state of emergency in response to the measles epidemic that exposes the crisis of the capitalist public health system.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Peru prompts a 90-day health emergency. As of early May 2026, 301 cases confirmed and 1,403 suspected nationwide, with the epicenter in Puno reporting 295 confirmed cases. Six hospitalizations (two children, four adults) include a pregnant woman, and transmission has reached Arequipa, Cusco, Huancavelica, Moquegua, Tacna, Ucayali, Madre de Dios, Apurímac, plus Amazonas, Loreto, Tumbes, and Callao/Lima. Of 215 analyzed cases, 37 are aged 5–9, 75 aged 10–19, and 60 aged 20–29 (others up to 59). The WHO warns of potential further spread. Vaccination coverage in Peru in 2025 was 82% (below the 95% herd-immunity target); in Puno it fell from 70% (2025) to 16% in Q1 2026, with schools suspending classes in under-vaccinated centers. The outbreak highlights chronic underfunding of public health and social infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: ペルーが麻疹流行に対して非常事態を宣言—資本主義的公衆衛生制度の危機を露呈
triage.triage_reason: ペルーは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsが空配列となります。シグナルトリアージの対象外です。
triage.notes: ペルー（Peru）は対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれていません。記事ではペルー全域での麻疹流行が報告されており、IHR基準2つ以上、WPRO基準5つ全て該当する重大なシグナルですが、地域検証により対象国外となるため、本トリアージプロセスの対象外です。

article.articleHeadline: India Sends Emergency Medical Aid to Africa Amid Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: First tranche of India’s emergency medical supplies and protective kits, including diagnostic kits, therapeutic medicines, infection prevention and control materials, PPE, and case-management resources, was delivered to the Africa CDC in Uganda to bolster the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the Bundibugyo outbreak. The consignment was handed over by Upender Singh Rawat, India’s High Commissioner to Uganda, with the Africa CDC’s Eastern Africa Regional Coordinating Centre deploying it to affected communities in eastern DRC. External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar reaffirmed India’s commitment to global health security and South-South cooperation, while the MEA indicated ongoing support as the situation evolves. Africa CDC welcomed the assistance, calling it a valuable step toward containing the outbreak and protecting vulnerable populations. The article frames India as a growing global health partner contributing to outbreak response through medical-diplomacy and humanitarian aid.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の流行に対しインドがアフリカに緊急医療支援を送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱はIHR基準で重大な公衆衛生影響を持つ疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国東部での確認的な流行報告、国際支援体制の発動、複数国への波及リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国東部（Bundibugyo outbreak）での確認的なエボラ流行を主題としており、インドはこれに対する国際支援提供国として登場する。Uganda（226074）はエボラの発生地ではなく、支援物資の配送経由地（Africa CDC Eastern Africa Regional Coordinating Centre）であるため verified_locations から除外。Bluedot APIのメタデータに含まれるIndiaは本記事では支援提供国であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tajani: "Ebola? In Italia rischio irrisorio, ma serve prevenzione"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tajani: "Ebola? The risk in Italy is negligible, but prevention is needed."
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk in Italy is negligible, says Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani, after a Congolese resident of Cagliari tested negative for Ebola. Italy will not panic but will maintain strong prevention measures; the Health Ministry, in collaboration with the government and Italian embassies and consulates in the region, is implementing countermeasures to prevent Ebola from arriving in Italy, with readiness to deploy experts to Congo. There is an already prepared hospital plan and intensified prevention activities. Tajani emphasizes monitoring and vigilance, and seeks stronger European Union engagement, recalling Italy’s proactive stance during the Coronavirus outbreak. No active outbreak in Italy; the measured risk remains very low, but surveillance continues. The article highlights ongoing international cooperation and preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: タジャーニ: 「エボラ？イタリアでのリスクは無視できるほど低いが、予防が必要」
triage.triage_reason: イタリア在住のコンゴ国籍者がエボラ陰性と判定された単一事例に基づくため、現時点では確定的なシグナルではないが、エボラという高危険度病原体とDRCの流行状況が絡んでいるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリアにおける単一の接触者スクリーニング事例（陰性）であり、イタリア国内での実際のエボラ発生はない。DRCはエボラの流行地域として言及されているため verified_locations に含める。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。イタリアの政治家による予防態勢強化の声明は社会的・政治的関心を示すが、確定例がないため PICKUP には至らず。

article.articleHeadline: В Роспотребнадзоре оценили риски заноса лихорадки Эбола в Россию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor assessed the risks of introducing Ebola fever into Russia.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever importation risk to Russia is assessed as minimal by Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, with no current risk of introduction and border controls monitoring inbound travelers. Russia’s epidemiological situation is described as absolutely stable across all infections. The report notes ongoing concerns about the outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where Doctors Without Borders reports an unprecedented speed of spread. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns about the danger posed by the rapid transmission. As of 2026-06-01, authorities emphasize vigilant border screening and no detected importation routes for Ebola into Russia, while global health bodies monitor the evolving outbreak in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健当局がエボラ熱の流入リスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱はIHR基準で重大だが、本記事の主題はロシアへの流入リスク評価（最小限）であり、実際の発生地域はDRCの限定的な地域。DRCは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列となるが、スクリーニング基準複数該当により継続注視が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にDRCおよびロシアが含まれているが、記事サマリーの内容を精読すると、実際のエボラ熱発生地はDRC東部であり、ロシアは発生国ではなく流入リスク評価対象国。DRCは対象国リスト（895949=Zambia, 1694008=Philippines, 1605651=Thailand, 2300660=Ghana, 203312=DRC, 3469034=Brazil, 1643084=Indonesia, 1814991=China, 1327865=Myanmar, 1562822=Vietnam, 1269750=India）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列。ただしエボラ熱の重大性とIHR基準複数該当により、グローバルレベルでの継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativo il paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo: tanto rumore per nulla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo tests negative: much ado about nothing.
article.articleSummary: One patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo tested negative for Ebola. Analyses were conducted by the Spallanzani Institute in Rome. The individual arrived in Italy on 30 May, developed some symptoms, called 118, and was taken to the biocontainment unit at Santissima Trinità Hospital in Cagliari for diagnostic work-up per protocol. The Italian Ministry of Health remains in contact with Sardinia’s health authorities. The incident attracted attention but yielded no positive Ebola result; authorities urge rapid, transparent updates only if infection is confirmed to avoid public fear. No confirmed Ebola cases are reported in connection with this event.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、コンゴから帰国した患者は陰性：大騒ぎに終わる
triage.triage_reason: 患者のエボラ検査は陰性であり、確認されたケースはない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当せず。社会的関心は限定的。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴから帰国した患者の検査結果である。DRCが発生地域に含まれているが、本イベントはDRCでのエボラ確認ではなく、イタリアでの陰性検査結果である。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみだが、患者は帰国して検査を受けているため、verified_locationsに含める。ただし確認されたケースがないため、シグナルとしての価値は低い。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
