article.articleHeadline: Sri Lanka ready to respond to Ebola threat: Health Ministry
article.articleSummary: Sri Lanka has completed preparations to respond to potential Ebola risks, according to Public Health Specialist Dr. Thushani Dabarera. With the WHO and global authorities closely monitoring a disease that carries about a 50% mortality rate, Ebola remains a priority for Sri Lanka. Ebola can affect humans and animals, including gorillas, chimpanzees, and monkeys, and spreads via contact with infected blood or other bodily fluids. Preparedness plans and simulation exercises have been conducted in line with WHO guidelines. Enhanced traveller monitoring targets arrivals from outbreak countries such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Sri Lanka’s Quarantine Unit at airports and seaports screens passengers, with anyone displaying suspicious symptoms reported to the Epidemiology Unit. The National Institute of Infectious Diseases (IDH) is ready to admit and manage suspected cases, with necessary treatment and infection-control measures in place.

triage.headline_ja: スリランカ、エボラ脅威への対応準備完了：保健省
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（高致死率疾患）の記事であり、複数国での言及と国際的警戒がある。しかし記事サマリーはスリランカの「準備態勢」を報じており、実際の発症例や確定症例の報告はなく、現在のアウトブレイクはDRC/ウガンダに限定される。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はスリランカの準備態勢について述べているが、実際のアウトブレイク発生地はDRC（及びウガンダ）のみ。スリランカは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。アウトブレイク国としてはDRCのみが対象国リストに該当。現時点では進行中の局所的アウトブレイク情報であるため、フルRRA実施までは至らないが、エボラの高い病原性と国際警戒の状況から継続監視を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Lagos, FAAN intensify Ebola surveillance at MMIA
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) surveillance has been intensified at Lagos's Murtala Mohammed International Airport (MMIA) as Lagos State and FAAN bolster border controls to prevent importation into Nigeria. Nigeria currently has no confirmed cases; the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) says the country remains capable of response with ongoing nationwide surveillance. Globally, the World Health Organization has declared the DRC- and Uganda-associated Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with more than 390 suspected cases and at least 100 deaths reported by Africa CDC. On May 24, 2026, the Nigeria Immigration Service stated that land borders are monitored to prevent entry of Ebola. A Lagos delegation led by Health Commissioner Prof. Akin Abayomi reviewed MMIA’s infection prevention/control, passenger-flow, and digital traveler-monitoring systems to improve early detection, rapid isolation, and safe evacuation of suspected cases from high-risk countries, recalling Lagos’s 2014 importation from Liberia and its containment through frontline workers, underscoring ongoing preparedness as essential.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴス、FAAN、MMIAでのエボラ出血熱監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WHO の PHEIC 宣言およびアフリカ CDC の報告により、シグナルレベルでピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア（ラゴス）でのエボラ監視強化を扱うが、実際のアウトブレイクはDRCとウガンダで発生しており、ナイジェリアは現在症例ゼロで監視・防止段階。WHO PEICおよび390超の疑い患者・100以上の死亡が報告されており、国際的な懸念の大きさを反映。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil Places Two Patients in Isolation Over Possible Ebola Cases
article.articleSummary: Two people in Brazil are in isolation over suspected Ebola infections as of 2026-06-01. A Belgian man who arrived from Uganda tested negative for Ebola, and will remain isolated until all examinations are completed. In São Paulo, doctors are treating a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo who has a fever. Test results for both patients are expected next week. If either case is confirmed, they would mark the first Ebola detections outside Africa since the current outbreak began in Congo. The report notes laboratory testing is underway to confirm infection status; no further details on exposure or transmission are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルが可能性のあるエボラ患者2人を隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）。エボラの確定例はアフリカ域外での報告となる可能性があり、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、ブラジル（2患者の隔離地）とコンゴ民主共和国（患者の出身国で関連ケース）を verified_locations に含める。ウガンダはベルギー人患者の渡航元だが、感染発生地ではないため除外。確定検査結果が次週予定のため、今後の続報が重要。

article.articleHeadline: البرازيل تواصل التحقيق في حالتين مشتبه بإصابتهما بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil continues to investigate two suspected Ebola virus cases.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola virus disease cases are under investigation in Brazil as of 1 June 2026. In São Paulo state, a man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo developed fever; preliminary tests showed meningitis, and he remains in critical condition on respiratory support and intensive care. In Rio de Janeiro state, a person who had recently traveled to Uganda was found malaria-positive, but health authorities say this does not rule out Ebola, and the case is under ongoing follow-up with additional diagnostic testing. Final diagnoses are pending for both cases. Brazil has heightened health surveillance at entry points for travelers from Ebola-affected countries to curb potential spread. No confirmed Ebola cases have been announced; investigations continue with laboratory confirmation as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルはエボラウイルスの感染が疑われる2件の事例の調査を継続している
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例報告、対象国での多国籍曝露（DRC・ウガンダ）、国際的な懸念高い病原体（エボラ）、入国検査強化実施により、IHR基準2項目以上とWPRO基準複数項目該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 2件の疑い例はいずれも最近の対象国（DRC・ウガンダ）への渡航歴あり。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、DRCは含まれるため検証対象。ウガンダは対象国リストに非含だが、DRCからの関連性が強く、エボラウイルス（高優先度病原体）の国際的リスク評価の背景にある。記事は調査継続中で最終診断未確定。国家レベルの監視強化実施が確認され、国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Los casos confirmados de ébola en el Congo ascienden a 282
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The confirmed Ebola cases in the Congo rise to 282.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 282, after 19 new infections reported on Monday. Official data show 264 cases in Ituri Province, 15 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu, with 42 confirmed deaths. This marks the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the third-largest since the virus was first identified nearly 19 years ago. The current spread occurs amid concerns that the outbreak is challenging the international response capacity. The World Health Organization reported last Friday that the Bundibugyo strain continues to spread, with 906 suspected cases, including 223 deaths, under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの確認されたエボラ病例が282件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。確認患者282名、死亡42名、複数州での地理的拡散、DRCにおける17番目のアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、アウトブレイクの主体はDRCのIturi Province（264例）、North Kivu（15例）、South Kivu（3例）。Bundibugyo株の継続的な拡散が報告されており、疑い例906例を含む調査中。国際的対応能力に対する懸念が表明されている。

article.articleHeadline: La risposta all'epidemia di ebola è totalmente inadeguata - Pierre Haski
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The response to the Ebola epidemic is totally inadequate - Pierre Haski
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC has about 1,000 confirmed cases and 256 deaths, with spread to Uganda. The outbreak came to light on May 15, and within two weeks the response had worsened, with delays in confirmation, shortages of medical supplies, and chaotic logistics and security in a region plagued by underdevelopment and armed groups. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, the epicenter, to reassure residents that they are not alone, but overall the context remains challenging. The article contends that the global response to the Ebola epidemic is totally inadequate. The piece highlights ongoing outbreaks in the region and calls for improved international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行への対応は完全に不適切である - ピエール・ハスキ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の多国にわたる流行は最高リスク案件。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれており、記事の主題である。1,000確認症例、256死亡という重大度、医療用品不足、ロジスティクス混乱、そしてWHO事務局長の現地訪問等から、国際的にも高い関心と対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: China is sending medical team to assist with DRC Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On June 1, 2026, China announced it will send a team of medical specialists to the Democratic Republic of Congo to assist with the Ebola outbreak there, according to foreign ministry spokesperson Lin Jian. The Chinese government has decided to provide humanitarian assistance to Congo and will continue to do so to the best of its ability, Lin said. The move highlights Beijing's involvement in the DRC's Ebola response and its support for international public health efforts in the region. The briefing offered no details on the team size, deployment timeline, or funding arrangements accompanying the assistance.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がDRCエボラ感染症アウトブレイク支援のため医療チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準で重篤性と国際的拡大リスクが該当。DRCでの発生地域検証により対象国リストの対象地域での確認、かつスクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度・管理可能性が該当し、国際的な関心と支援体制の発動が認められる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはChinaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではエボラアウトブレイクはDRCで実際に発生しており、Chinaは支援国として言及されているのみ。よってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な感染症であり、公式な国際支援の発表は高度なシグナル値を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO hands over Ebola treatment centre in Bunia as DRC intensifies outbreak response
article.articleSummary: WHO hands over a refurbished Ebola Treatment Centre in Bunia, Ituri Province, DRC, with an initial capacity of 24 beds, expandable to 60; an annex adding up to 42 beds will be ready in two weeks. As of 31 May, the DRC reports 210 confirmed Ebola cases and 17 confirmed deaths, with 349 suspected cases under investigation. Sixteen health workers have fallen ill with Ebola during this outbreak. Once fully operational, the centre can care for about 65–80 patients (confirmed or suspected). Despite the Bundibugyo Ebola virus having no licensed vaccine or treatment, Dr. Tedros said that survivors exist and early care improves outcomes. The DRC government leads a comprehensive national response, with WHO and UN partners strengthening coordination, mobilizing resources, and delivering life-saving interventions to affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがブニアのエボラ治療センターを引き継ぎ、DRCは感染拡大対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の確認症例210件・死亡17件が報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が認められ、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。また国際的な支援（WHO・UN関与）が必要とされている。
triage.notes: ブニア（イツリ州、DRC）でのエボラ治療センター整備は、DRCでの公式なアウトブレーク対応を示唆。確認症例210件、死亡17件、医療従事者16名の感染報告あり。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus種であり、ワクチン・治療薬なし。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola, l'appello del direttore OMS: "Venite nei centri medici se avete sintomi"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, WHO Director-General's appeal: "Go to medical centers if you have symptoms."
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, an Ebola Treatment Center has been established, co-managed by the Ministry of Health and the World Health Organization. A team of Ebola specialists from Kinshasa has arrived to support the existing staff. The outbreak is straining the local health system, with many healthcare workers infected. The newly inaugurated center hosts the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who urged people with symptoms to seek care at health facilities: 'Come to the health facilities if you have symptoms. You can receive care and recover. Step forward as soon as possible, so we can stop Ebola and anyone affected will recover.' The report highlights the importance of rapid access to treatment to curb transmission; no patient counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱、WHO事務局長が訴え：「症状がある場合は医療センターに来てください」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確定的な流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的に極めて重大な公衆衛生上の脅威として認識される。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは国際保健規則(IHR2005)の最高優先度疾患。Bunia（Ituri州）とKinshasa両地域での同時流行を示唆する記事内容。複数の医療従事者が感染しており、地域保健システムが逼迫している状態が確認される。WHO事務局長による直接的な呼びかけと治療センターの設置は、事態の深刻性を反映している。患者数の詳細情報が記事に含まれていないが、DRCでのエボラ確定流行であることにより、即座にフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）に進むべき案件。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak 'reaches Brazil' as deadly virus kills 250 in central Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri, with more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths. The 17th DR Congo outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, a strain with no vaccine. First death occurred April 24 in Bunia; confirmation weeks later, with the body repatriated to Mongbwalu. Neighbouring countries closed borders; WHO cautions against restricting movement. Brazil reports two suspected imported cases: a 37-year-old man from DR Congo in Sao Paulo and a Ugandan man in Rio de Janeiro, triggering emergency measures. Doctors Without Borders calls rapid spread deeply alarming, with hundreds of samples untested. Oxford University researchers are developing a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo; trials could start in 2–3 months. WHO Director-General Tedros visited Ituri and warned that funeral practices can fuel transmission as of 1 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が「ブラジルに到達」、致命的ウイルスが中央アフリカで250人を殺害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、国際的移動制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱のワクチンなしBundibugyo株による大規模流行で、ブラジルへの輸入症例報告があり、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ流行の中心はDRC（Ituri州Bunia）であり、ブラジルは輸入症例（São Paulo、Rio de Janeiro）の報告地点。ウガンダはサマリー内で触れられているが、流行発生地として主要な位置づけではないため除外。Oxford大学のBundibugyo標的ワクチン開発情報あり。WHO事務局長がIturi訪問済み。

article.articleHeadline: Controles sanitarios por ébola impactan viajes a Estados Unidos, México y Canadá antes del Mundial 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola health screenings affect travel to the United States, Mexico, and Canada ahead of the 2026 World Cup.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, Ebola health screenings are tightening at airports in the United States, Mexico, and Canada ahead of the World Cup 2026. Outbreaks are reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Mexico imposes entry restrictions on travelers from African countries affected by the outbreak; the United States and Canada have intensified entry surveillance. The measures are not travel bans but target passengers with recent exposure to transmission zones or with symptoms. Cuban travelers or those connecting via Cuban routes may face longer processing times. Airlines may request health information; authorities may conduct questionnaires or medical evaluations if symptoms are detected. Ebola is not airborne; transmission mainly via direct contact with bodily fluids. Travelers should prepare travel documents and check official airline, airport, and immigration information, as changes can occur. Brazil is also investigating suspected cases awaiting confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ前のエボラ出血熱健康診断検査により米国、メキシコ、カナダへの渡航に影響
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。複数国での流行、主要国の渡航制限措置、国際的なイベント（ワールドカップ）に関連した対応が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでの発生が報告されている。米国、メキシコ、カナダは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。ブラジルは疑い例調査中と記載されているため対象国として含める。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。国際的な渡航制限措置と複数国での流行確認によりフルRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 迎戰夏日登革熱 新竹縣舉辦跨局處防疫教育訓練
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hsinchu County Holds Inter-Agency Epidemic-Prevention Education Training to Tackle Summer Dengue Fever
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-01, Hsinchu County Health Bureau held a dengue prevention education training with 80 participants from county agencies, towns, health centers, schools, and clinics to strengthen cross-agency epidemic response. County Magistrate Yang Wen-ke said the program covered dengue outbreak status, vector-control methods, international travel precautions, breeding-source surveillance, and chemical-control notes, using practical cases to boost frontline capability. Dengue is primarily transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; summer weather increases breeding in standing-water containers such as pot bases, water barrels, tires, and roof gutters. Residents should implement Inspect, Empty, Clean, Brush, seek prompt medical care for fever, headache, myalgia/arthralgia, or rash, and report travel history. With frequent international travel, imported cases persist. National dengue cases as of May 25 total 64 (1 local, 63 imported; 19 from Indonesia). Hsinchu reports 21 cases, 2 confirmed, both imported from Indonesia. Advice: wear light-colored long-sleeve clothing and use government-approved repellents outdoors.

triage.headline_ja: 新竹県、夏のデング熱対策に向け部局横断型防疫教育訓練を開催
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的流行対策として行われた防疫訓練報道。インドネシアからの輸入症例が多数（国内64例中63例が輸入、うち19例がインドネシア発症）確認されており、国際的な連動が示唆されるが、現在のところ地域内での局所的な予防活動報道であり、実質的な新規クラスターや重大なアウトブレイクの記述なし。続報で症例数増加や異常な流行パターンが確認されれば見直し。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した台湾は記事の主題地域だが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。インドネシアは輸入症例の発生源として記事に明記されているため含める。デング熱は季節性疾患であり、夏期流行は予想内。イベント自体は防疫強化の取り組みであり、シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準には達していない。

article.articleHeadline: Sardegna, negativi i test per l'Ebola su un uomo rientrato dal Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sardinia, Ebola tests negative for a man who returned from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola scare in Sardinia was averted after diagnostic tests on a man returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo proved negative. The patient, who arrived in Italy on May 30 and developed symptoms compatible with Ebola, alerted emergency services and was transferred to the Santissima Trinità hospital in Cagliari under biosafety containment for diagnostic workup. After hours of exams, the Spallanzani Institute in Rome confirmed no infection. The episode prompted precautionary actions at national and regional levels, but Italy’s contagion risk is described as very low. Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said the Congolese resident living in Cagliari should test negative and urged continued measures to prevent Ebola entry, including collaboration with the Health Ministry, embassies, and consulates and potential deployment of experts to Congo. Authorities will keep monitoring the situation.

triage.headline_ja: サルデーニャ、コンゴから帰国した男性のエボラ検査が陰性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴから帰国した疑似患者のエボラ検査が陰性確認され、感染は否定された。国内のイタリアでの発症例なしのため、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当せず、シグナル要件を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、コンゴから帰国した疑似患者の検査が陰性確認されたことが主題であり、実際のエボラ発症例はイタリアには存在しない。政府機関が対応措置を講じたことは記述されているが、確認された感染症イベントではなく、検査陰性により懸念は解消されている。DRCはリスク国として記載されているが、当該記事の主題はイタリアでの陰性確認であり、DRC内での新規発症報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola are nevoie de un răspuns rapid pentru a evita o catastrofă
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola needs a rapid response to avoid a catastrophe
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, prompts urgent response as authorities report over 900 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths since May 15. Cases have spread to North and South Kivu and to Uganda, which has seven confirmed cases. WHO has declared a PHEIC as the epidemic advances faster than response capacity. Ituri, under military administration since 2021 amid armed conflict, faces food insecurity, overcrowding, and other health burdens; two treatment centers have been attacked by grieving relatives seeking bodies. Urgent funding and capacity building are needed: qualified medical staff, secure treatment centers, and additional resources. Africa CDC proposes a regional response with a $319 million budget; about 10% funded so far, with South Africa pledging $5 million. The Bundibugyo strain is unusual; no approved vaccines or treatments exist yet, though several vaccines are under development and could be ready in up to nine months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが破局的状況を回避するため迅速な対応が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響（900件以上の疑い例、223例以上の死亡）、異常な状況（治療センターへの攻撃）、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、国際支援が必要な状況を示している。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）も記事で言及されており、7例の確認症例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。南アフリカ（953987）は資金拠出について言及されているが、実発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株は異常で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、このため社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Union Afrikano ta alertá pa mas di 1.100 kaso sospechoso di ébola - èxtra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The African Union warns of more than 1,100 suspected Ebola cases - extra
article.articleSummary: More than 1,100 suspected Ebola cases are under investigation in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, per the African Union’s health agency. Of these, 263 cases are laboratory-confirmed across both countries, with 43 deaths confirmed. A joint plan worth $319 million by the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan aims to curb the outbreak. The northeastern DRC province of Ituri, near Bunia, is the epicenter, where a new Ebola treatment center with 20 beds has been established. The Bundibugyo virus variant has no vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs only from symptomatic individuals, with an incubation period up to 21 days. In Goma, U-Report is conducting awareness campaigns to boost community vigilance amid cross-border concerns.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合が1,100件以上の疑い例があるエボラを警告 - extra
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常なアウトブレイク、国際的拡大（ウガンダ、南スーダン）、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。シグナル要件を完全に満たしており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとSudanが含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。記事サマリー上でDRCが主要な発生地として記載されており、同国は対象国リスト内。Bundibugyo variant（ワクチン・特定治療なし）による感染拡大中。$319百万ドルの合同計画が進行中。国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола от Африка стряска Европа - вирусът тръгва от животни, няма одобрени лекарства и ваксини
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola from Africa alarms Europe - the virus originates from animals, there are no approved drugs or vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Boogie Woogie, a rare Ebola variant, fuels an outbreak in Africa with more than 1,100 suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda; five patients have recovered. There are no approved drugs or vaccines for this strain, though vaccine candidates are under consideration for clinical trials. The first case, a nurse in Bunia (DR Congo), died 2-3 days after diagnosis in late April. Burial practices are highly risky and, at present, limited to about 50 mourners. Transmission occurs through contact with infected animals or humans; no asymptomatic spread—symptoms appear before contagiousness, including high fever, sore throat, muscle and joint pains, and headaches, followed by diarrhea, abdominal pain, vomiting, a rash, and bleeding. The pathogen is an RNA virus with zoonotic origins; new mutations may arise as it enters humans. There is concern that isolated cases could reach Europe, but containment is essential to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラがヨーロッパを揺るがす - ウイルスは動物由来で、承認された医薬品やワクチンがない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新種株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目すべてに該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダでの発生が言及されているが、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれていないため、DRC のみ verified_locations に含める。新種エボラ「Boogie Woogie」による1,100件以上の疑い患者、死亡者、承認医薬品/ワクチンの不在、ヨーロッパへの拡大懸念など、複数の重大リスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil e Italia investigan tres posibles casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil and Italy are investigating three possible Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Three possible Ebola cases are under investigation in Brazil and Italy as authorities monitor travelers from Africa amid concerns about the Congo outbreak. In Brazil, two men are under surveillance: a 37-year-old from the Democratic Republic of Congo is in isolation in São Paulo after fever, meeting the suspected case definition; a second case in Rio de Janeiro is a Ugandan man with cough, chills and diarrhea, with malaria later reported but investigations continue to rule out Ebola. In Italy, a man in Cagliari, Sardinia, who arrived from the DRC via Rome with fever and mild cough is isolated while testing proceeds; epidemiological workups to identify contacts are ongoing. The Congo outbreak has exceeded 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths; Uganda has reported linked cases. WHO has activated alerts; risk outside Africa remains low.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルとイタリアがエボラウイルス感染症の疑い例3件を調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。アフリカでのコンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイク（1,000件超の疑い例、246人死亡）に伴い、複数国での輸入症例の調査が進行中であり、WHO警報が発動されている。
triage.notes: イタリアはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダも同様に対象国外だが、サマリーではDRCとブラジルが主要な発生地として述べられている。DRCでの継続的なアウトブレイク（1,000超の疑い例、246死亡）と海外への輸入症例が確認されており、WHO警報が発動済み。

article.articleHeadline: Nỗi lo Ebola lan đến châu Âu và châu Mỹ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fear of Ebola spreading to Europe and the Americas.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri. By May 31, 2026, WHO reports 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths in DRC, with 282 confirmed infections and 42 deaths. Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death along the border. Brazil is monitoring two suspected cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro; a Ugandan returnee tested negative but remains isolated. Four Bundibugyo patients who were nurses in Bunia have been discharged; a lab worker has recovered, totaling five recoveries. MSF warns transmission is accelerating; PPE shortages hinder response. Ituri has protests over burial restrictions and at least three attacks on health facilities amid fighting by armed groups. Tedros calls for community action and ceasefire; no vaccine or approved treatment exists yet for Bundibugyo, though a vaccine may arrive by year-end. EU and US aid support Ituri; commitments reach $112 million.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパとアメリカ大陸へのエボラ感染拡大の懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（Bundibugyo株）のアフリカ域内での継続的流行に加え、ブラジルにおける疑似症例の報告があり、IHR基準の「国際的な拡大リスク」と「異常性」が認められる。WHO報告による高い死亡率、医療対応の課題（PPE不足）、ワクチン未整備、国際的な支援動員が確認されるため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRCのイトゥリ州が主流行地であり、ウガンダは国境地域での限定的な感染を報告、ブラジルは疑似症例を監視中であることが確認された。発生地域リストにはウガンダも含まれているが、記事の主題はDRCとブラジルであり、ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo株によるエボラは治療法・ワクチン未整備であることが重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : à Bunia, la RDC et l'OMS activent tous les leviers face à la flambée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In Bunia, the DRC and the WHO activate all levers in the face of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, the DRC government and the World Health Organization activated an all-hands response to an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with transmission from Bunia (Ituri) to North Kivu and South Kivu. The plan emphasizes early case finding, strict contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and reinforced hygiene in health facilities, alongside frequent hand washing and prompt care for fever or bleeding. Information verification is stressed to prevent misinformation. The response relies on the DRC's Ebola experience, political backing, and international support to interrupt transmission and strengthen health security; Ituri and neighboring provinces are fully engaged. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo, so two pillars guide the effort: community engagement and research with planned clinical trials. Border openness is urged to sustain response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ブニア（イトゥリ州）で、コンゴ民主共和国とWHOは流行に対するすべての手段を発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の複数州への拡大、死亡リスク、国際的拡大の懸念、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州ブニアから北キブ州および南キブ州に拡大。ワクチンおよび特異的治療薬がないため、コミュニティ・エンゲージメントおよび臨床試験を含む研究が重要な対応柱。WHOおよびDRC政府による統合的対応が報告されており、国際支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Arunachal district bans pork transport, purchase after ASF outbreak in Assam's Tinsukia
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, Arunachal Pradesh's Longding district imposed a one-month ban on transport and purchase of live pigs and pork products after confirmed African Swine Fever (ASF) in neighbouring Assam's Tinsukia region. The advisory, under the Prevention and Control of Infectious and Contagious Diseases in Animals Act, 2009, prohibits buying live pigs, piglets, pork, and pork products from Assam or other affected zones and warns of punitive action for non-compliance. It also cautions against swill feeding, a primary ASF driver, and mandates farm-level biosecurity: disinfectant foot dips at pigsty entrances, dedicated farm footwear and clothing, restricted visitors and vehicles, and daily cleaning/disinfection of housing and utensils. Farmers should monitor for fever, weakness, inappetence, hemorrhages or purple patches, and sudden deaths; suspected cases must be isolated and promptly reported. Carcasses must be disposed of by deep burial with lime or incineration per veterinary guidance.

triage.headline_ja: アルナーチャル・プラデーシュ州がアッサム州ティンスキアのASF発生後、豚肉の輸送・購入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）の確認事例がインドで報告され、隣接州による輸送禁止など行政措置が取られている。家畜疾病であり国際的な動物疫学的関心があり、シグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: ASFはOIE報告対象疾病であり、家畜疾病としての重要性は高い。記事はアッサム州ティンスキアでの確認事例と、アルナーチャル・プラデーシュ州ロングディング地区による予防的措置を報じており、インド国内での動物疫学的シグナルとして適切にピックアップされるべき。

article.articleHeadline: 中國派遣醫療專家組赴剛果民主共和國　協助應對伊波拉疫情 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China dispatches a team of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist in the Ebola outbreak response - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-01, China announced it will send a medical expert team to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist with the Ebola outbreak response, via a statement by Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian. The mission will work with Congo's health authorities and provide humanitarian aid, materials, and technical support to help curb the Ebola public health crisis in Central Africa, where Ebola outbreaks have a high fatality rate and strain local health systems. China described the aid as part of its Africa humanitarian commitments and said it will continue to offer resources within its capabilities. The move highlights international cooperation to strengthen regional surveillance and reduce virus spread, amid global attention to Ebola threats.

triage.headline_ja: 中国が医療専門家チームをコンゴ民主共和国に派遣し、エボラ出血熱の流行対応を支援
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は対象国DRCで確認され、致死率が高く地域の保健システムに負荷をかけている。中国からの国際支援派遣は対応の必要性を示唆。
triage.notes: 発生地域にChina(1814991)が含まれているが、サマリーではエボラ出血熱の発生はDRC（中央アフリカ）であり、Chinaは支援派遣国である。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と地域的影響を持つため、国際的な保健危機として評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : quatre nouveaux patients déclarés guéris
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: four new patients declared cured.
article.articleSummary: Four new Ebola patients at Bunia's Evangelical Medical Center (CME) in the Ituri region have been declared cured, announced May 31, 2026. With these recoveries, five people have recovered since the outbreak was officially declared 17 days earlier. All survivors are healthcare workers, including a female nurse, infected while performing duties at CME. Dr. Calvin Ambitapio, CME medical director, said patients received symptomatic treatment—addressing malaria, antibiotics, and close medical follow-up—and after several days of observation with daily samples, analyses confirmed recovery. The outbreak, presently lacking a specific treatment or vaccine, continues to be monitored and managed with surveillance and care. Jeanne Alasha, provincial health advisor to the Governor, attended the ceremony and urged the population to trust health facilities. Officials remain hopeful for more cures among current patients and ongoing containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がイトゥリ地域で発生：4人の新規患者が治癒宣告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な出来事、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでのエボラ出血熱は常に高リスク疾患であり、新規患者の報告と治癒報告が確認された。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はWHO指定の重要な公衆衛生脅威であり、DRCでの発生は国際的な懸念事項。医療従事者の感染確認、治療対策の限定的状況、継続的監視が必要。記事言語がフランス語で、アフリカの信頼できるヘルスニュースソースからの報告。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Muyembe estime que l'épidémie ne dépassera pas les 1 000 cas confirmés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Muyembe estimates that the outbreak will not exceed 1,000 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola outbreak updates were provided by Prof. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, director-general of the INRB, during a live Space discussion. He framed the current outbreak as a normal Ebola epidemic with comparatively low mortality and a trajectory similar to prior episodes. Of about 900 suspected cases since onset, roughly 290 have been laboratory-confirmed; cases not sampled but epidemiologically linked to confirmed cases are classified as probable. Muyembe stressed that in Ebola reporting the focus should be on confirmed cases, not suspects. Based on this assessment, he estimated the outbreak will not exceed 1,000 confirmed cases—perhaps 300–400, but not 1,000. A retrospective analysis could show the outbreak began earlier than the official date, moderating its apparent progression. With reinforced surveillance, contact tracing, and isolation of confirmed and probable cases, the outbreak could be contained within two to three months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱のRDC流行：ムエンベ氏は流行が1,000確認症例を超えないと推定
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行であり、IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限リスクの4項目すべてに該当する可能性がある。WPROスクリーニング基準においても重症度の高さと流行リスクが明らかであり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行であり、公式報告では約900疑似症例、290確認症例が報告されている。INRB局長ムエンベ氏は2〜3ヶ月以内に流行を制御可能と評価しているが、エボラ出血熱の重篤性とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性により国際的懸念が高い。WHO通知基準を満たし、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: В Роспотребнадзоре назвали низким риск завоза лихорадки Эбола в Россию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor said the risk of importing Ebola virus disease into Russia is low.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, Russia reports an absolutely stable epidemiological situation regarding Ebola virus disease (EVD), with no transmission detected domestically and an extremely low risk of importation, according to Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, cited by TASS. She states that Russia faces no risk from Ebola and that potential importations are minimal, with border controls monitoring travelers entering the country. The comment emphasizes ongoing vigilance while confirming no active outbreak or spread within Russia. In parallel, the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus plans to visit the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an Ebola outbreak has begun, to collaborate with WHO staff and local clinicians under the authorities' guidance. The report highlights border surveillance and international coordination as authorities monitor the situation in the DRC while maintaining a calm domestic stance.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健当局、ロシアへのエボラ出血熱の輸入リスクは低いと述べた
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生は重要だが、ロシアの記事は国内リスク評価であり、同国でのアウトブレイクは報告されていない。対象国はDRCのみだが、発生地域はDRCであり詳細情報の継続確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの輸入リスク評価に焦点を当てているが、サマリーではDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク発生が言及されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ロシアはWPRO対象国外のため除外。DRCでの具体的な症例数、死亡者数、感染拡大状況の詳細情報が不足しており、より詳細な報告の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ռուսաստանում գնահատել են Էբոլայի ներթափանցման վտանգը
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of Ebola entering Russia has been assessed.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, Russia's risk of Ebola entering the country is assessed as minimal, with the epidemiological situation deemed controllable and stable. Russian experts have been in Uganda for over a week to study the drivers and spread of the outbreak there. They are on-site with patients and examining biosamples to assess risks in real time. Ebola virus disease is a severe viral illness transmitted through direct contact with infected people or animals. In May 2026, a major outbreak was recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, after which the World Health Organization labeled the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The assessment reflects ongoing international surveillance and expert collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアへのエボラ出血熱の侵入リスクが評価された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模発生がDRCで記録され、WHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の事象（PHEIC）として宣言されている。国際的な拡大リスク、国境間の感染リスク、渡航制限の可能性があり、複数国の専門家による国際的な対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ出血熱の大規模発生（2026年5月）とそれに対するロシアの対応評価を扱っている。ロシアとウガンダは地理的・疫学的な言及がされているが、記事の主題は『DRCでの発生とそのロシアへの影響評価』であり、実際の患者発生はDRCに限定される。WHOによるPHEIC宣言が記載されており、国際的な懸念の段階にある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Explainer: Are Caregivers At A Higher Risk Of Catching The Bundibugyo Virus?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda heightens caregiver risk. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; not airborne. As of June 1, 2026, ongoing outbreak involves healthcare workers, family caregivers, and burial volunteers who are disproportionately affected due to delayed detection and inadequate infection-control. Transmission sources include blood, vomit, diarrhoea, urine, saliva, semen, breast milk, and contaminated bedding or medical equipment; caregivers often handle feeding, cleaning, transport, and burial-related tasks when patients present severe symptoms such as vomiting, diarrhoea, bleeding, and high fever. Burial practices contribute to exposure; emphasis on safe and dignified burials. Protective measures include immediate isolation of suspected cases, rigorous hand hygiene, PPE (gloves, masks, gowns, eye protection), avoiding direct contact with fluids, and safe handling of contaminated clothing and bodies.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ説明資料：介護者はブンディブギョウイルスに感染するリスクが高いか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）のアウトブレイク。DRCとウガンダで複数国にわたる流行、医療従事者と介護者への高いリスク、感染制御の不備が認識されている。IHR基準2つ以上、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Ugandaはサマリーに言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ確認。2026年6月時点での ongoing outbreak。医療従事者と埋葬関係者による曝露、感染制御の不備が重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 11 M USD du CDC au Burundi pour prévenir et riposter contre le virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC funds Burundi with $11 million to prevent and respond to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Burundi has received $11 million in funding from CDC Africa to prevent introduction of Ebola and to mount a rapid response, announced during a visit by CDC Africa Director-General Jean Kaseya and signed with Burundi Health Minister Fidèle Nkezabahizi. The funds support a preparedness and response plan; Burundi had previously developed a plan estimating needs at $15 million, with actions to begin soon. Separately, CDC Africa reported that more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases linked to a new outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda had been recorded as of late May. The African Union health agency lists 11 African countries at high risk, including Burundi, South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, and Somalia.

triage.headline_ja: ブルンジがエボラウイルスの予防と対応のためにCDCから1,100万ドルの資金を受け取る
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの新規感染が確認され、1,000症例以上が報告。複数国への国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、対象国DRCでの現在の流行により、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な内容はブルンジへの資金配分の発表であるが、サマリーで明示されている現在の流行はDRC及びウガンダで発生。対象国リストではDRCとザンビアのみ該当。ブルンジは高リスク国リストに含まれているが、実際の流行発生地ではなく予防対象国として言及されている。エボラウイルスは高い致死率と国際拡大リスクを持つため、シグナルとしてのピックアップが正当化される。

article.articleHeadline: В Роспотребнадзоре оценили риски заноса лихорадки Эбола в Россию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor assessed the risks of introducing Ebola fever into Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, Russia's consumer health watchdog head Anna Popova deems the risk of introducing Ebola fever into Russia as minimal. She notes Russia's epidemiological situation is stable across infections. Rospotrebnadzor staff have been in Uganda for more than a week to investigate the Ebola outbreak's causes, observing patients and handling materials to determine where transmission occurred and to prevent any complications in the Russian Federation. Ebola is a severe disease caused by ebolaviruses, including Ebola virus and Bundibugyo virus. In May 2026, a large Bundibugyo virus outbreak occurred in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール（ロシア消費者保護機関）、エボラ熱のロシアへの流入リスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）。WHO公式にPHEIC宣言されたDRC発生のBundibugyoウイルス流行を背景とした発生イベント。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月1日時点でのDRCにおけるBundibugyoウイルス流行（2026年5月に大規模発生）を主題としている。WHOがPHEIC（国際懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言した正式な流行。Ugandaは隣国として言及されているが、記事の主流行発生地はDRC。Russiaへの流入リスク評価は二次的な内容。verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: la Russie crée un dépistage ultra-rapide de la souche Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Russia develops ultra-fast screening for the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Russia has announced the rapid development of an ultra-fast screening test for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, produced in four days by Rospotrebnadzor Director Anna Popova. The new assay is already used in Uganda, alongside Russia's antibody-detection tests for Ebola. As of May 30, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda reported 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation, according to Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya. The development enhances diagnostic capacity to rapidly identify Bundibugyo infections and support outbreak response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: ロシアがブンディブギョ株の超高速スクリーニング検査を開発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、異常性）。ウガンダとDRCでのエボラ流行（263確認例、43死亡、1,100以上の疑い例）は重大事象であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Russian Federation は記事の発生地として含まれているが、スクリーニング検査開発国であり、実際のエボラ流行地ではないため verified_locations から除外。DRC及びウガンダにおけるBundibugyo株のエボラ流行が主要な公衆衛生上の懸念。

article.articleHeadline: EAC ministers meet over Ebola outbreak as regional cases rise
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo strain (no approved vaccine or specific treatment), was officially declared May 15, 2026; as of May 25–26, DRC reported 121 confirmed cases with 17 deaths and 1,077 suspected cases with 246 suspected deaths, while Uganda had 7 confirmed cases and 1 death (first two confirmed cases traveled from DRC to Uganda). The outbreak centers on Ituri, with Ituri as the epicentre, and involves North Kivu and South Kivu provinces, elevating cross-border transmission risk amid population movements and trade. EAC health ministers held a virtual session on June 1–2 to coordinate a regional response, aiming to strengthen surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, infection prevention and control, risk communication, and rapid response. Nine mobile laboratories are deployed at key border points (Beni, Busia, Nimule-Elegu, Kobero, Kagera, Kigoma, Rwanda districts, Bwera Hospital) funded by Germany’s KfW and supported by the Bernhard Nocht Institute, with plans to accelerate vaccine/treatment/diagnostic approvals."} } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } }

triage.headline_ja: EAC保健大臣がエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応で会合、地域での患者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスの国境を越えた多国家アウトブレイク、既存の複数死亡事例、ワクチン・治療法の未承認、EAC域内での調整対応が進行中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクは、DRC（Ituri地域が震源地）とウガンダの両国で確認された。DRC側で121確定例・17死亡、ウガンダで7確定例・1死亡。国境を越えた患者移動が既に記録されており、Kagera Region、Kigoma、Busia等の境界地域での監視体制が強化されている。ドイツ（KfW）からの資金支援で9台の移動検査室が国境拠点に配置されている。EAC（東アフリカ共同体）諸国間での調整対応が開始されており、国際的な関心と支援体制が高い。

article.articleHeadline: تعافي 5 مصابين بإيبولا في الكونجو وسط متابعة حالات مشتبه بها دوليًا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Ebola patients have recovered in Congo as internationally suspected cases are monitored.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues with 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths after 19 new infections. Five have recovered—four nurses in Bunia and a lab worker—raising total recoveries to five. WHO says early diagnosis and proper care improve survival, and response efforts continue. The Bundibugyo outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), though not a global health emergency. In Bunia, the WHO Director‑General stressed there is no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain, but patients can recover with good care. Investigations continue for suspected Ebola cases in Brazil and Italy. In Brazil, one suspected case had meningitis and another malaria; results do not rule out Ebola. In Italy, emergency measures followed a Congo-returned man to Sardinia; tests were negative and the risk remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで5人のエボラ患者が回復、国際的に疑い例が監視されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは重篤で異常な疾患、282確認例と42死亡により深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事では複数国の疑い例（ブラジル、イタリア）が言及されているが、確認された発生地はDRC（ブンディブギョとブニア）のみ。WHOがPHEICを宣言し、国際的な対応が進行中。ワクチンと承認済み治療法がない状況での282確認例は重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola Vakaları 282'ye Yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo have risen to 282
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports Ebola confirmed cases rising to 282, with 42 deaths. Of these, 264 are in Ituri province, 15 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu; 19 new cases were recorded Monday. This outbreak marks about 50 years since Ebola was first detected and is the 17th outbreak in the country’s history, the third-largest on record. Officials warn that transmission could outpace international response capacity. The World Health Organization, citing last Friday, said the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is ongoing, with 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths awaiting confirmation. The report cautions that the spread risks overwhelming international intervention capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス症例数が282例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生上の深刻な影響（282例、42死亡）を示し、国際的拡大リスク（WHOが状況監視中）が存在し、渡航・貿易制限の対象となる可能性が高い。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理能力不足が明確。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス症（Bundibugyo株）の確認例282例、死亡42例が報告されており、未確認例を含めると計906疑い例・223死亡。DRC内でIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu各州での感染が確認されている。WHOによる継続的監視が実施されており、国際対応能力を超過するリスクが指摘されている。17番目のアウトブレイクであり、過去3番目の規模。

article.articleHeadline: China Is Sending Medical Team to Assist With DRC Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: China will send a team of medical specialists to the Democratic Republic of Congo to assist with the Ebola outbreak there. Foreign ministry spokesperson Lin Jian said on Monday that the Chinese government has decided to provide humanitarian assistance to Congo and will continue to do so 'to the best of its ability.' The announcement underscores China's support amid the DRC Ebola outbreak, with Reuters noting the aid as part of ongoing humanitarian efforts. The report is dated 2026-06-01. No details on case counts, symptoms, or laboratory confirmations are provided in the article; the focus is on China's commitment to international aid and assistance in response to the Ebola outbreak in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへの支援のため医療チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクをすべて満たし、IHR基準4個該当。また国際的な医療支援が開始されていることから、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが主題であり、中国の支援は二次的な内容。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。中国（1814991）は支援国として言及されているが、エボラ出血熱の実際の発生地ではないため除外。個別の症例数や検査確認情報は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDS welcomes medical aid by Indian govt amid Ebola outbreak - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, Africa CDC welcomed emergency diagnostics, therapeutics and medical supplies donated by India to support the Bundibugyo Ebola Outbreak response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Supplies were delivered via Africa CDC’s Eastern Regional Coordinating Centre in Uganda and will be deployed to affected communities in eastern DRC, strengthening containment and patient care, including diagnostics, therapeutics, infection prevention and control materials, and case-management support. India confirmed on 29 May the first tranche had been dispatched to Africa, handed over in Uganda by the High Commissioner, with further assistance anticipated. Africa CDC expressed gratitude and said it remains in close contact with African health authorities as New Delhi stands ready to deploy additional shipments as the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDS、エボラ出血熱の流行中にインド政府の医療支援を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が確認され、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。国際的な医療支援体制が構築されており、DRCで進行中の公衆衛生危機として確実にシグナル化される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからBundibugyo Ebola Outbreakは東部DRCで発生しており、主要な発生地はDRCである。ウガンダは医療支援の配送中継地点として言及されているが、アウトブレイク発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。インドは医療支援国として言及されているが、感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外。本イベントは対象国内での発生確認であり、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進捗が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDS welcomes medical aid by Indian govt amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: India provides emergency diagnostics, therapeutics, and medical supplies to support the Bundibugyo Ebola Outbreak response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Africa CDC welcomed the assistance and said supplies were delivered through its Eastern Regional Coordinating Centre in Uganda and will be deployed to affected communities in eastern DRC. The package includes essential diagnostics, therapeutics, infection prevention and control materials, and case management support, aimed at strengthening ongoing containment efforts. India confirmed on May 29, 2026 the dispatch of the first tranche; the humanitarian aid has been received in Uganda by Africa CDC’s Eastern Africa RCC, with further tranches expected as the situation evolves. India maintains close contact with African health authorities and stands ready to provide additional support as needed.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがエボラ流行中のインドによる医療支援を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラ出血熱のDRCでの流行は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを持つ。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にはインド（1269750）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではインドは医療支援の提供国であり、エボラの流行地ではない。実際のイベント発生地はDRC東部のみ。ウガンダは物流経由地として記述されているが、アウトブレイク発生地としての記載なし。Bundibugyo型エボラはDRC東部での確認であることが明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Oro för ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the outbreak concentrated in Kongo-Kinshasa, particularly the Ituri region. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) reports over 1,000 people infected and more than 240 deaths. The situation is described as worst in Ituri, where broader humanitarian crises—food and water shortages and ongoing armed conflict—complicate response efforts. Uganda has closed its border with the DRC in an attempt to stop cross-border spread, but MSF warns that border closures risk preventing essential medicines and aid from reaching those in need. The article emphasizes the urgent public health threat posed by Ebola alongside other regional challenges, underscoring the need for rapid, well-coordinated medical and humanitarian assistance to affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに対する懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPRO基準でも5つ全て該当。対象国DRCで大規模流行中。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ地域で1,000人以上の感染と240人以上の死亡を報告。ウガンダが国境閉鎖を実施しているが、サマリー上ウガンダはイベント発生地として記述されておらず境界対策段階のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Doctors Without Borders（国境なき医師団）による公式報告あり。食糧・水不足と武装紛争による人道的危機が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում էբոլայով վարակման հաստատված դեպքերի թիվը հասել է 282-ի
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola infection cases in Congo has reached 282.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 282 confirmed cases, per a May 15 health ministry report. Ituri province accounts for 264 cases, North Kivu 15, and South Kivu 3. The death toll is 42, with 238 patients in treatment and 2 recoveries. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, first identified in Uganda in 2007, and was officially declared on May 15. Earlier updates noted more than 1,000 suspected cases and about 240 suspected deaths. The outbreak has also spread to neighboring Uganda, where nine infections and one death have been reported. Data reflect the evolving situation as surveillance continues across the affected regions and cross-border areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ感染の確認症例数が282件に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病の確認症例282件、死亡42件という深刻な公衆衛生影響、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダへの波及9感染1死亡）、国際的な懸念と対応の必要性が明らかである。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo種）の確認症例282件、死亡42件。複数州での発生（Ituri 264件、North Kivu 15件、South Kivu 3件）。隣接するウガンダでも二次感染報告（9感染1死亡）。5月15日に公式宣言。患者治療中238名、回復2名。サーベイランス継続中で進化する状況。

article.articleHeadline: 鬆口氣！巴西2起疑似伊波拉病例 其中1人確認陰性
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Relief! Brazil reports two suspected Ebola cases, one of which has been confirmed negative.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola virus disease cases were reported in Brazil amid an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. A Ugandan man in Rio de Janeiro state presented with cough and feverish symptoms and was confirmed Ebola negative on May 31, though he remains in isolation for epidemiological investigation. A 37-year-old man from the Congo in São Paulo state exhibited fever and related symptoms; initial testing did not detect Ebola, with final results pending and the patient still in isolation. Both cases involve travelers from Ebola-affected regions, underscoring ongoing surveillance and isolation protocols in Brazil. As of 2026-06-01, no laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 安心！ブラジルで報告された2件の疑いのあるエボラ病例、そのうち1件は陰性確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い例が報告されており、DRCでの流行背景があるため監視対象。ただし、両件とも現時点で陰性またはテスト待機中であり、ブラジルでの確定例はなく、緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事のメインテーマはブラジルにおけるエボラ疑い例の報告。DRCおよびウガンダからの旅行者による輸入症例の可能性。現在のところ確定例なく、両患者とも隔離中。IHR基準で2つ該当（異常性と国際的広がりの可能性）、WPRO基準で2つ該当（異常性と流行しやすさ）するが、確定例の欠如と社会的混乱の程度から、シグナルとしてはWATCHレベルが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: IRC: вспышка лихорадки Эбола гораздо масштабнее, чем по официальным данным
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IRC: the Ebola fever outbreak is much larger than official figures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be far larger than official figures indicate, according to the International Rescue Committee (IRC). The IRC warns only about 20% of contacts are being traced, hindering the identification of new transmission chains and isolation of cases. The true scale could have circulated undetected before March, with shortages of diagnostic materials and delays in testing complicating detection. Seven patients with laboratory-confirmed Ebola have left treatment centers in the DRC, and more than six healthcare workers have died, including two doctors. Fear and distrust of prevention and treatment measures are driving people away from hospitals. Earlier reports cited over 900 suspected cases with 101 laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, and authorities suspended flights to the city of Bania.

triage.headline_ja: IRC: エボラ熱の流行は公式発表よりも規模が遥かに大きい
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、死亡・医療従事者感染を含む重症度の高い事象である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）での深刻なエボラ出血熱の流行。公式発表の20倍規模である可能性、医療従事者死亡2名を含む6名以上の死亡、治療センター離脱患者7名、接触追跡率低下（20%のみ）、検査材料不足などの深刻な管理課題が報告されている。国際救援委員会（IRC）による警告で国際的な関心が高い。Ituri州（フォーカス地域）の座標確認済み。

article.articleHeadline: Kiina lähettää lääkintäryhmän avustamaan Kongon ebolaepidemiassa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sends a medical team to assist in the Congo Ebola epidemic
article.articleSummary: On June 1, 2026, China announced it will dispatch a medical expert group to the Democratic Republic of Congo to assist with the Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, according to Lin Jian, spokesperson for the Chinese Foreign Ministry. Beijing will provide humanitarian aid to the DRC and continue offering assistance to the best of its abilities, Lin said. The outbreak was detected in Ituri in mid-May. Africa CDC reports the ongoing epidemic has led to about 250 suspected Ebola deaths; the report does not provide details on confirmed cases or laboratory confirmation. This development signals international support for the Congo’s response to the Ebola epidemic, with China joining other partners in the regional effort.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、コンゴのエボラ流行支援に医療チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な支援動向を示す報道。DRCでの進行中のアウトブレイク（約250人の疑い死亡報告）は重大な公衆衛生影響を示しており、IHR基準の「深刻な影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性（国際支援の必要性）」も複数該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にChinaを含めているが、記事サマリーでは実際のエボラアウトブレイクはDRCのイトゥリ州で発生しており、中国は支援国としてのみ登場。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。5月中旬に検出された進行中のアウトブレイクで約250人の疑い死亡が報告されており、確認症例数や検査確認情報が限定的だが、重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威として評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, negativi i test sul paziente ricoverato a Cagliari. In Italia il rischio "resta basso"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, tests on the patient hospitalized in Cagliari are negative. In Italy the risk remains low.
article.articleSummary: Ebola test on a patient hospitalized in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy, was negative. Analyses were performed by Rome's Istituto Spallanzani and confirmed by the Sardinia Region. The patient, Italian-Congolese, had returned to Italy on May 30, developed symptoms, called 118, and was taken to the Santissima Trinità di Cagliari hospital under biocontainment for diagnostic workup per current protocols. The Ministry of Health and regional authorities said the Ebola risk in Italy remains very low. Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani stated that Italy should not panic but act, with ongoing collaboration with authorities and embassies, and readiness to send experts to Congo to help combat Ebola. The episode underscores surveillance and containment measures for imported cases, with coordination among national and local health authorities and the Spallanzani Institute.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、カリャーリ入院患者の検査は陰性。イタリアではリスク「低いままである」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の疑い例は検査で陰性と判明し、イタリアでのリスクは低いと評価されている。ただし、DRCでの継続的なエボラ熱流行の背景と、国際的な輸入症例監視体制の稼働状況を考慮すると、今後の動向を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はイタリアの疑い例が検査で陰性となったことを報じており、輸入症例の監視体制が正常に機能していることを示している。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めたが、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラ熱の疑い例であることと政府・外務大臣の言及により社会的・政治的関心があると評価されるが、検査陰性、イタリアでのリスク低評価、輸入症例として隔離・管理下にあったため、WATCH段階が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Centrafrique: l'inquiétude grandit à Bangui face à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central African Republic: Concern grows in Bangui amid Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Central African Republic's capital Bangui is gripped by Ebola fears amid proximity to Zongo, a Congolese town across the Oubangui River. The daily cross-border movement fuels anxiety even as the outbreak remains reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo. This week, a Congolese national's death in Kokoro, IIIe arrondissement, fueled rumors; medical tests indicate the person died of tuberculosis, not Ebola. Nevertheless, fear persists in several districts as boats shuttle between Bangui and Zongo. Authorities say prevention and surveillance are being strengthened; from today, any neighborhood death is treated as a suspected Ebola case until proven otherwise, with the Health Ministry coordinating prevention programs and hospital-level preparedness despite ongoing capacity challenges. As of 1 June 2026, no Ebola cases have been detected in the Central African Republic. Public vigilance and border precautions are urged.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ共和国：エボラ流行に直面するバングイで懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルスの国境を越えた流行リスク、隣国DRCでの確認、強い社会的・政治的関心から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ流行がDRCで報告されており、中央アフリカ共和国はまだ確認症例なし（1 June 2026現在）だが、Zongo（DRC側）とバングイ間の頻繁な人の往来によるリスクが主題。中央アフリカ共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCのみ該当。エボラウイルスの高い致死率、国境地域での感染リスク、弱い保健インフラを考慮すると、地域的に最も懸念される状況。
