triage.notes: 記事は医療従事者5名（内4名が5月31日に新規治癒宣言）の治癒を報告しており、症例は確認されているが、現在制御された状況にあると見される。政府が17日前に発症を宣言し、対応が強化されている。医療施設でのアウトブレイクであり、感染性の高いエボラウイルス病であるため、引き続きシグナル監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: India bans cross-border transportation of Ebola-infected human remains under strict new biosecurity rules | Today News
article.articleSummary: India bans cross-border transport of remains of confirmed or suspected Ebola virus disease (EVD) patients and prescribes strict handling. Unavoidable remains must be double-packed in a 150-micrometre plastic sheet and placed in a zinc-lined coffin for forensic evaluation, then cremated under police supervision. Burial sites must be two metres deep and 50 metres from attendees; traditional rites involving washing or touching are prohibited. International airports will host forensic teams; mid-flight deaths require pilots to report symptoms and isolate passengers for 21 days under IDSP surveillance. Incubation can reach 21 days; travelers from DRC, Uganda or South Sudan face strict watch. The Bundibugyo outbreak in Central Africa has over 1,200 cases and 250 deaths, with no vaccine or specific antiviral. India reports zero cases to date and has boosted port screening and aid to Africa.

triage.headline_ja: インドがエボラウイルス感染者の遺体の国境間輸送を禁止、厳格な新しい生物セキュリティ規則に基づく
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（高致死率の指定感染症）に関する国際的な公衆衛生対応イベントであり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）を複数満たす。インドの新しい規制措置は公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な関心を反映している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンのブンディブギョアウトブレイク（1,200例以上、250死亡）に関連してインドが対応措置を講じている。実際の流行地はアフリカ中央部だが、対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。インドは現在ゼロ例だが、規制措置を導入している点が社会的関心を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, test negativo per paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo: cosa dicono gli esperti su allarme e sorveglianza in Italia - InLibertà
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, negative test for patient returning to Sardinia from the Congo: what experts say about the alarm and surveillance in Italy - InLibertà.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, a patient returning to Sardinia from Congo tested negative for Ebola at Rome's Spallanzani Institute. Italian experts say the alarm demonstrates functioning surveillance and relies on traveler self-reporting and local health authorities. Epidemiologist Pier Luigi Lopalco notes travelers from the region may exhibit symptoms from multiple infections, including malaria, so alerts are a sign of vigilance. Gianni Rezza emphasizes balancing prudent caution with avoiding unnecessary alarm, referencing a Health Ministry circular that guides risk assessment based on personal exposure and origin area. Local alerts can arise even for cases far from the epicenter, reflecting defensive medicine. If Ebola were confirmed, contact tracing would be initiated; however, the risk of spread for the new strain remains very low with proper surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病：コンゴから帰国した患者の検査は陰性。イタリアの警戒態勢と監視について専門家の見解
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病という高病原性疾患の報告だが、患者の検査結果は陰性であり、実際の感染症イベントではなく健康警戒システムの機能確認である。ただし、DRC（対象国）での流行が背景にあることから、今後の続報を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: イタリアでの疑似症患者は検査陰性で、実際の感染症イベントではない。DRCでのエボラウイルス病流行が背景にあるため、対象国リストに基づきDRCを記録。イタリアは対象国でないため除外。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、実症例がないため現時点ではWATCH判定。DRC側でのエボラウイルス病流行状況に関する続報があれば、優先度を高める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Lopalco: "Bene che scatti allarme, con sorveglianza da noi rischio resta basso"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Lopalco: "It's good that alarm bells are ringing; with our surveillance, the risk remains low."
article.articleSummary: An Ebola suspicion in Sardinia, Italy, involving a traveler returning from Congo, yielded a negative Ebola test at Spallanzani Institute in Rome, indicating no laboratory-confirmed infection. The patient had returned to Sardinia on Saturday; authorities stress that people from the Congo region may present symptoms common to various infections, including malaria. The negative result demonstrates that the surveillance and alert system is functioning. Lopalco, epidemiologist at University of Salento, says the risk of spread of the new Ebola strain remains very low as long as surveillance persists. The system relies on self-reporting by travelers returning from affected areas and on local public health authorities; the ministerial circular on surveillance follows the same framework since the 2014 Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ロパルコ：「警報が鳴るのは良いこと、我々の監視体制があれば感染リスクは低いままだ」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い例は検査結果が陰性であり、感染確認がない。イタリアでの感染拡大リスクは専門家により「低い」と評価されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の該当なし。社会的関心は予防的報道レベル。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリアでの疑い例（陰性確定）であり、イタリアは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。DRC では発生源情報として言及されているが、本イベントはイタリアでの検査陰性確認に基づく予防的報道である。エボラ流行地からの帰国者スクリーニングの有効性を示す事例であり、新規シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تعلن تعافي 5 مصابين بإيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization announces the recovery of five Ebola patients in Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports five Ebola recoveries in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: four nurses and a laboratory technician discharged from Bunia after recovering from the Bundibugyo strain, bringing total recoveries to five. The Congo outbreak has 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with 19 new positive results recorded. The WHO has designated the Congo–Uganda outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling international concern despite not yet meeting full pandemic criteria. Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus underscored that the absence of a licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this strain does not erase hope, as timely supportive care improves survival. Internationally, Brazil probes two suspected cases in travelers from Africa—one with meningitis in São Paulo, the other with malaria in Rio de Janeiro; neither has been confirmed as Ebola. In Italy, a man returning from Congo in Cagliari tested negative, with risk deemed very low.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴでエボラ患者5人の回復を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（異常/予想外の疾患、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準4項目該当。コンゴでのエボラ集団発生はPHEIC指定済みで、国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: コンゴ（DRC）でのエボラ集団発生は282確認例、42死亡。Bundibugyo株で治療法・ワクチン未承認。PHEICの指定がなされており、国際的関心は極めて高い。ブラジルでの疑い事例2件は未確認だが、国際的な感染伝播の可能性を示している。イタリアの帰国者検査は陰性。発生地域のウガンダ（Uganda）は記事サマリーではコンゴとの共同表記のため、具体的な発生確認は記載されないため verified_locations からは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Un brote de Ébola fuera de control en medio de una guerra interminable: qué está pasando en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola outbreak out of control amid an interminable war: what's happening in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri) coincides with ongoing armed conflict. More than 900 suspected cases and about 240 deaths are reported in the region, where the M23 rebel group has extended control over territories including Goma and Bukavu, establishing de facto administrations. Security breakdowns and distrust of health authorities hinder contact tracing and safe hospital care, complicating outbreak response. The conflict involves regional dynamics, with Rwanda-linked forces and the FDLR posing cross-border threats, and external powers like the United States and China pursuing strategic minerals such as coltan (estimated 60–80% of global reserves), cobalt, copper, gold, and diamonds. The overlap of war, displacement, and mineral exploitation shapes the outbreak, making the virus harder to track and containment strategies harder to implement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで制御不能なエボラ出血熱の流行：果てしない戦争の最中で何が起きているのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（900以上の疑い例、約240名の死亡）を示し、紛争による異常な状況下での流行であり、国際的拡大リスク（ルワンダとの国境脅威）および国家間の戦略的関心により渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事は東部DRC（北キブ州、南キブ州、イトゥリ州）におけるエボラ流行が武装紛争と重なっており、セキュリティ崩壊と保健当局への不信が接触追跡と患者隔離を困難にしていることを強調している。Bluedot APIが付与した他地域（USA、China、Rwanda）は戦略的鉱物競争の文脈で言及されているが、実際のウイルス発生地は DRC のみであるため、verified_locations に DRC のみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil Periksa 2 Pasien Suspek, Akankah Jadi Kasus Ebola Pertama di Luar Afrika?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil Examines 2 Suspected Patients, Will It Be the First Ebola Case Outside Africa?
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases are under close monitoring in Brazil, in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. A 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows fever-like symptoms in São Paulo; a second suspected case in Rio de Janeiro concerns a Belgian man who arrived from Uganda with cough, chills, and diarrhea. Lab results are due next week; if confirmed, this would mark the first Ebola infection diagnosed outside Africa since the outbreak began in the DRC. Diagnoses of other diseases were reported: the Congolese patient was diagnosed with meningitis and the Belgian patient with malaria, but officials stress this doesn’t rule out Ebola. In Africa, Bundibugyo Ebola has caused over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths in the DRC; Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death. This strain has no proven vaccine and about one-third mortality. Transmission generally starts from animals (bats), and outbreaks arise when humans contact infected animals.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルが2人の疑い患者を検査—これはアフリカ外初のエボラ症例となるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準で4つ該当（異常性、重症度、流行性、管理可能性）、極めて高い国際的関心と社会的懸念がある。確認されればアフリカ外初のエボラ症例となる重大事象。
triage.notes: ブラジルの2例はいずれも有症状（São Paulo：発熱症状、Rio de Janeiro：咳・悪寒・下痢）。サマリーでDRCとウガンダでの現在進行中のBundibugyo Ebolaアウトブレイク（1,000件超の疑い症例、246例以上の死亡）が述べられている。これらのアフリカ国での事象も記事の文脈上重要であるが、主題となる検査は南米ブラジルで実施されている。検査結果は翌週予定。確認が急がれる段階。

article.articleHeadline: 5 пациенти са се възстановили от Ебола, а ДР Конго съобщава за 263 потвърдени случая -- Novinata.bg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five patients have recovered from Ebola, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 263 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Five patients infected with Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease recovered in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Four were healthcare workers discharged after two negative Ebola tests; the fifth, a laboratory technician, has returned home. The DRC Ministry of Health reported 263 confirmed Ebola cases nationwide, including 42 deaths among confirmed cases, up to Friday. WHO Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya said over 1,100 test results were pending as of Saturday, while Health Minister Roger Kamba said there were no samples awaiting laboratory tests and response teams continue surveillance, contact tracing, and case finding. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus attended the opening of a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia and stressed ongoing work on vaccines and treatments, noting recoveries are possible.

triage.headline_ja: 5人のエボラ患者が回復、コンゴ民主共和国は263の確認症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数州での集団発生（263確認症例、42死亡）であり、IHR基準で重症性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクの4基準すべてに該当。WHO事務局長の現地訪問など高い国際的関心も示唆される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の東部DRCでの流行。Ituri州Buniaを中心に263確認症例、死亡率16%（42/263）。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、治療センター開設、ワクチン・治療法開発の進行が報告されており、国際的な対応が進行中。ただし回復事例の報告は肯定的な側面も示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus, il nemico invisibile che mette in allerta il mondo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus, the invisible enemy that puts the world on alert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus, a filovirus causing viral hemorrhagic fever, remains a major international health threat, with foci in Central and West Africa. Identified in 1976 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (then Zaire), its natural hosts are thought to include fruit bats; humans acquire it through direct contact with blood, saliva, vomit, urine, feces, or other fluids, or via contaminated objects. Incubation is 2–21 days. Early symptoms mimic common infections (fever, fatigue, muscle and head pain, sore throat) that can progress to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, dehydration, liver and kidney dysfunction, and sometimes internal or external bleeding. Diagnosis requires rapid laboratory confirmation. Suspected cases trigger strict isolation, advanced PPE, and contact tracing to halt transmission. Treatments are mainly supportive; vaccines exist for some variants, with ongoing trials. Prevention emphasizes information, surveillance, case isolation, and protection of health workers; WHO monitoring remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス、世界に警戒を促す見えない敵
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、高い重症度を持つ既知の脅威であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。DRC に記事の主題イベントが該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは歴史的背景と一般的なエボラウイルス情報を述べており、現在の流行イベントの詳細（具体的な患者数、最近の症例、死亡数）は記載されていない。ただしエボラウイルスの公衆衛生的重要性、DRCでの歴史的及び継続的な脅威、および国際的な懸念の高さから、シグナルとして識別される。Angola はサマリー内で明示的に現在の発生地として言及されていないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo celebra recuperação de sobreviventes de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo celebrates the recovery of Ebola survivors.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease is active in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with cases concentrated in Ituri (Bunia) and the Kivu region and reported in Kampala, Uganda. The Bundibugyo lineage has no approved vaccine, though research is ongoing. The DR Congo outbreak is near 250 deaths with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths reported; Uganda has nine cases and one death. Five patients have been discharged after recovery, including a laboratory technician; four nurses in Bunia were honored at a ceremony attended by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Frontline health workers remain at high risk, and response emphasizes early detection, patient care, contact tracing, and community engagement, plus safe handling of bodies. Attacks on health facilities linked to burial practices complicate efforts. Ituri and the Kivu provinces are the epicenters; ongoing surveillance, isolation, and hygiene campaigns are prioritized.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ生存者の回復を祝う
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の活動的な流行で250死亡・1000以上の疑い例を報告。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、ワクチン未承認系統での国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及確認）が存在。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統エボラウイルス（ワクチン未承認）による活動的流行。DRC内でIturi（Bunia）・Kivu地域が流行中心。ウガンダへの波及確認（9例、1死亡）。記事では「Kampala, Uganda」と位置情報に記載されているが、記事サマリー本文ではウガンダの事例は波及例として記述されており、主流行はDRCである。したがって verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。医療施設への攻撃により対応が複雑化しており、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : que peut l'IA face aux épidémies ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: What can AI do in the face of epidemics?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is reportedly progressing faster than health authorities can control, according to the WHO chief. The current circulating strain, Bundibugyo, has no available treatment or vaccine, heightening the risk to affected communities. The article highlights artificial intelligence as a potential new tool to save lives in epidemic response. AI could aid in outbreak modeling, surveillance, and decision-making, though no concrete implementation is described. The piece is presented by Sophian Aubin in France 24's Rendez-vous Afrique. No case counts or fatalities are provided in the summary. The report emphasizes the urgency of innovative approaches to Ebola control alongside traditional public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：流行病に対してAIは何ができるか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ型）がDRCで報告され、治療法またはワクチンがない状態で拡大しており、WHO首脳が管理困難であると指摘。IHR基準2項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はAIツールの潜在的な応用に焦点を当てているが、サマリーではエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）がDRCで当局の制御能力を超えて拡大しており、利用可能な治療またはワクチンがないことが明記されている。WHO首脳による警告と治療法なしの新規株という要因により、シグナルレベルは高い。ただし、記事本文が提供されていないため、詳細な状況確認ができない。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ Bạch Mai chỉ ra quy tắc '2 - 5 - 30' trong ngăn chặn Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Bach Mai Points Out the '2-5-30' Rule in Preventing Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, Ebola virus disease remains a concern with active transmission in some African countries. Vietnam’s Bach Mai Hospital in Hanoi has activated its Ebola preparedness plan and launched a training program on early detection, diagnosis, and treatment to strengthen readiness. Emphasis is on rapid surveillance, isolation, and infection control to prevent nosocomial spread. The 2-5-30 rule guides action: 2 minutes to elicit 21-day exposure and symptom history, 5 minutes to implement temporary isolation, and 30 minutes to activate the full response, including infection-control and reporting. Ebola incubation is 2-21 days; transmission occurs after symptom onset, mainly via blood and body fluids. Early symptoms may be non-specific (fever, headache, myalgia, fatigue, diarrhea). Strict PPE use, waste management, and environmental disinfection are stressed; Bundibugyo/Sudan strains lack approved specific tools like Zaire.

triage.headline_ja: バック・マイ医師、エボラ予防における「2-5-30」ルールを指摘
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのエボラ対策強化・準備体制の記事。アフリカでの活発な感染伝播が言及されているが、ベトナムでの実際の症例発生は報告されておらず、情報が限定的。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベトナムのバック・マイ病院におけるエボラ対策・準備体制の強化であり、実際の症例発生ではなく予防・訓練プログラムの紹介。アフリカでの活発な伝播は背景情報として言及されているがベトナムでの発生は報告されていない。引き続き監視が必要だが、現時点ではフルRRA対象とはしない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-arts waarschuwt voor grote ebola-uitbraak vanuit Congo en Oeganda: 'Het virus kan zich met één vliegreis over de wereld verspreiden'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A WHO doctor warns of a major Ebola outbreak from the Congo and Uganda: 'The virus can spread around the world with a single flight.'
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant circulating in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda signals a major outbreak, with authorities warning of rapid spread. WHO emergency-center program manager Dick Chamla says more cases are likely; the tally stands at over 1,000 suspected and confirmed infections and 263 deaths, and there is concern the virus has reached or could reach South Sudan and other neighbors. Unlike Zaïre Ebola, Bundibugyo currently lacks a vaccine or specific treatment, leaving management largely with infection control and supportive care; Zaïre Ebola has vaccines and antibody therapies. Symptoms mirror Zaïre disease: high fever, diarrhea, bleeding, and nausea. Many infections may be undetected, elevating transmission risk. Preparedness efforts cover ten regional countries, needing about $500 million, with roughly half pledged. Cultural funeral practices and mistrust of health workers hinder containment. A single flight could spread the virus globally; the US contributes via bilateral and UN channels, while entry bans for travelers from DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda apply, and a Kenyan quarantine plan faced court opposition.

triage.headline_ja: WHO医師がコンゴとウガンダからの大規模エボラ出血熱の流行を警告：『ウイルスは1便の航空機で世界中に広がる可能性がある』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebola virusの新規循環、1000件以上の疑い例と263件の死亡、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施により、緊急対応が必要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダで確認されているが、対象国リストではDRC(203312)のみが該当。サウススーダン、ケニアは言及されているが対象国に含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo Ebola variant（ザイール型と異なる）の特性、ワクチン欠如、文化的慣行による感染拡大リスク、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tibor Nagy on why Congo's Ebola crisis will get much worse
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo's Ituri province is the 17th since 1976 and the third involving Bundibugyo, which carries about 30% mortality and has no approved vaccine or treatment. Incubation is 2–21 days; first symptoms appear 8–10 days after exposure. Transmission occurs through contact with infected persons or corpses and via handling or eating bush meat from wild animals. Cultural practices—long funeral rites and touching the deceased—plus distrust of Western medicine and violence against health workers complicate control. Ituri sits near Uganda, with displacement camps housing about a million. Cases are detected in North and South Kivu and in Uganda's Kampala; risks extend to South Sudan and Rwanda, and potentially to Nairobi (Kenya) and Addis Ababa (Ethiopia), with possible export to North America. The article urges vaccine development and rapid international mobilization, noting Congo's governance and funding gaps hinder outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ危機がさらに悪化する理由についてのティボール・ナジの見解
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準4つ以上該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種）の継続的感染拡大、高い致死率（30%）、地域的拡散、複数国への潜在的輸出リスクが確認された。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebola subspeciesによる第17番目のアウトブレイク。致死率30%、ワクチンおよび承認済み治療法なし。イトゥリ州がウガンダに隣接し、約100万人が避難キャンプに滞在。北キブ・南キブおよびウガンダ（カンパラ）で症例確認。南スーダン、ルワンダ、ケニア（ナイロビ）、エチオピア（アディスアベバ）、および北米への輸出リスクが言及されている。文化的慣習（長期的葬儀儀式、遺体への接触）、西洋医学への不信感、保健労働者への暴力が対策を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: UAE restricts travel to S. Sudan over Ebola despite no reported outbreak
article.articleSummary: 1 June 2026 – UAE advised against travel to South Sudan, Uganda, and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) due to evolving Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) risk, though South Sudan has reported no cases. Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) are contending outbreaks of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, with dozens killed and hundreds infected. WHO cautions high cross-border transmission risk in the region. UAE health authorities say high alert, with surveillance at borders with Uganda and DRC to prevent importation. Citizens are urged to report suspected cases and seek medical attention promptly if Ebola-like symptoms appear. The advisory underscores regional threat despite no confirmed outbreak in South Sudan, and aligns with other nations' precautions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱での南スーダンへの渡航制限、発症報告なしにもかかわらずUAEが実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限），複数国での確認事例あり，地域の高い感染伝播リスク。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダとDRCでのエボラ爆発的感染を言及しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。南スーダンとUAEは記事主題国だが対象国リストに含まれない。WHO警告による地域的な高い越境伝播リスク。複数国による渡航制限措置が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Alianza para las vacunas aprueba fondos para desarrollar vacuna contra virus Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alliance for Vaccines Approves Funding to Develop a Vaccine Against Bundibugyo Virus
article.articleSummary: Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, has approved a $50 million funding package to support the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Of the total, $40 million targets vaccine development since no vaccine exists for this Ebola variant. The funds aim to increase production capacity for leading vaccine candidates so that, if clinical trials yield positive results, investigational doses can be rapidly deployed to bolster outbreak response. The most advanced Bundibugyo vaccine candidate could be ready for use in about nine months if trials prove successful. An additional $10 million will support emergency response activities. Vaccines under development would be used under strict protocols following World Health Organization guidance and national authorizations. This fund is described as the only globally approved mechanism to finance risk-taking to scale vaccine production in development.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン提携機構、ブンディブギョウウイルス対策ワクチン開発資金を承認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的関心、予想外の病原体対応）。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョウ株）アウトブレイクに対する国際的な医療資源動員であり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウウイルスはエボラウイルス属の稀な株であり、既存ワクチンが効果的でないため、国際的な予防接種同盟（Gavi）が開発資金を緊急承認。DRC内の地域的アウトブレイクから国際的医療対応への展開段階を示すシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola triggers fears over public health ahead of World Cup travel surge
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa triggers US public health concerns ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026 in North America. The tournament will be held in more than a half-dozen North American cities and attract hundreds of thousands of visitors. The US, Canada, and Mexico announced aligned health measures for travelers from the outbreak region deemed at greatest risk, aimed at protecting visitors and residents while maintaining travel and commerce. Despite assurances that a major US Ebola outbreak is unlikely, concerns persist about screening effectiveness after a traveler from Uganda reportedly wasn’t screened on arrival in Washington, D.C. Congo’s World Cup team and staff have already left the country to comply with weeks-long quarantine requirements. Health experts say threats are more likely from familiar pathogens rather than Ebola. The White House Task Force touts unprecedented interagency coordination, while some officials criticize federal communication and CDC/WHO cuts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがワールドカップの旅行急増に先立つ公衆衛生上の懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラ流行が2026年ワールドカップ（北米開催）に伴う国際的な人口移動と関連し、複数国の公衆衛生当局による対応が展開されている。IHR基準で少なくとも2つ以上（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は主にアフリカ（特にDRC、ウガンダ）でのエボラ流行が北米のワールドカップに及ぼす潜在的影響を主題としている。米国・カナダ・メキシコの対象国リストには含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストにないため除外。国際的な移動制限、スクリーニング効果に関する懸念、複数国間の調整が報告されており、重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: KDF cordon off Laikipia Air Base as hundreds protest planned Ebola facility
article.articleSummary: On June 1, 2026, hundreds of Nanyuki residents protested plans to establish an Ebola quarantine and isolation facility at Laikipia Airbase, Kenya, amid debate over cross-border preparedness. Security forces cordoned the facility; protesters were blocked and redirected to Nanyuki town, with traffic disruptions but no major violence. The Law Society of Kenya opposed the plan, arguing Ebola centres should be near epicenters in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda rather than in Kenya, citing public health risk and tourism concerns. Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale and Public Health Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni said discussions with international partners would follow Kenyan law, immigration procedures, and health safeguards, including entry-point screening and surveillance. Three days earlier, the High Court issued conservatory orders blocking establishment or operation of any Ebola facility and admission of exposed individuals pending hearing. Kenya has strengthened border surveillance and rapid testing, but public anxiety remains.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア・ナニュキでエボラ隔離施設計画に数百人が抗議、ライキピア空軍基地が封鎖される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対策施設の計画段階であり、実際の感染症イベント（患者発生）ではなく、社会的・政治的対立が主体。ただしDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行が背景にあり、地域的準備態勢に関する情報価値あり。
triage.notes: 本記事はケニアでの施設計画に対する社会的抗議が主題であり、実際のエボラ患者発生イベントではない。DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行は背景情報であるが、記事の対象国はケニアのみ。対象国リストにケニアが含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。社会的関心は高いが、感染症シグナルとしては優先度低。DRC・ウガンダでの新規患者発生に関する直接情報があれば優先。

article.articleHeadline: The fight against Ebola just scored a crucial victory in its most dangerous hotspot
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain outbreak in DR Congo's eastern provinces continues, with 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, and 19 additional positives. There is no licensed vaccine or targeted therapy for this strain. WHO commended progress in limiting transmission and noted four nurses and a laboratory professional have recovered after treatment. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, triggering border restrictions and raising risk of wider regional exposure. Africa CDC warns that Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia face potential exposure alongside DR Congo and Uganda. International response commitments total about $498.8 million, including $160 million from the World Bank for Congo, $82 million from the United States, and about $57 million from European partners; UN OCHA provided an additional $60 million. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern last month.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱は最も危険な流行地でこの戦いの重大な勝利を得ました
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国への拡大、死亡者発生、国際的資金投入、管理困難性が明示される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain outbreak in DR Congo with 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths. WHO PHEIC declared, triggering major international response (~$498.8M committed). Spread confirmed to Uganda; 10 additional African countries at high risk per Africa CDC assessment. No licensed vaccine/therapy available for this strain. Multiple public health and political stakeholders engaged.

article.articleHeadline: Scientists are racing to stop a type of Ebola we have no vaccine for
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda is unfolding, with rising cases and deaths. By May 2026, DRC health authorities declared an Ebola outbreak, and two days later the World Health Organization designated the spread as a public health emergency of international concern. This outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a less common orthoebolavirus for which no vaccines or approved treatments exist. Researchers are racing to test antibody drugs and remdesivir, but no countermeasures are approved yet. The mortality rate for this strain is slightly lower than the Ebola Zaire strain, but remains devastating. Transmission requires close contact with infected bodily fluids, typically via caregiving or certain burial practices; casual transmission is unlikely. Health workers use full PPE due to the high-consequence nature of the pathogen.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンのないエボラ出血熱の流行を止めるため科学者が急ピッチで対応中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国及びウガンダでブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの流行が確認され、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態と指定。ワクチンと承認済み治療法がない状況であり、致死率が高く、国際的な公衆衛生への重大な脅威と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスはワクチンが存在しない希少株であり、WHOが国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態と既に指定している点が重大。2026年5月時点での流行宣言、死亡者数増加報告、複数国での確認により国際的脅威として高く評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, falso allarme in Sardegna: test negativo allo Spallanzani, paziente del Congo fuori pericolo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, false alarm in Sardinia: negative test at Spallanzani, Congo patient out of danger.
article.articleSummary: False Ebola alarm in Sardinia: a 46-year-old man of Congolese origin, who had recently traveled from the Congo with a stop in Cairo, tested negative for Ebola at Rome’s Spallanzani Institute after presenting symptoms and was placed under biocontainment observation at Santissima Trinità Hospital in Cagliari; his wife is in home isolation. The Italian Health Ministry stressed that the national risk remains very low, and Sardinia’s regional authorities are maintaining contact with local and national health bodies. The case was not blocked at initial screening in Rome due to the Cairo layover, highlighting import-risk monitoring; authorities, including the Farnesina, are prepared to deploy Ebola experts to Congo. WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted survival is possible with timely care for Bundibugyo Ebola; the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak reports about 125 confirmed cases and 17 deaths, with ~1,000 suspected cases and potential >200 deaths, and new treatment centers being established.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、サルデーニャで誤報：スパランツァーニでの検査は陰性、コンゴ患者は危険から脱出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑似症例は陰性確定により直近リスク低減。ただしDRC発生地での流行継続（125確定例、17死亡、1,000疑似例）と国際移動経路の検出により、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 本件はサルデーニャで疑わしき事例が陰性確定されたため直接的な感染者はなし。しかし背景にあるDRCのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo型、1,000疑似例で200死亡超推定）と国際移動経路の追跡から、流行地域の継続監視が必要。イタリア・エジプト記事への地理的言及は旅行経路追跡の文脈であり、これら国での流行発生ではないため verified_locations にDRCのみを列挙。IHR基準2つ以上該当（unusual_unexpected、international_spread）であるが、検査陰性確定により PICKUP ではなく WATCH と判定。

article.articleHeadline: REPORTAGE. "C'est compliqué, ça m'inquiète trop" : par crainte d'une épidémie d'Ebola, des familles désormais séparées par la frontière entre le Rwanda et la République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FEATURE. "It's complicated, it worries me too much": for fear of an Ebola outbreak, families are now separated by the border between Rwanda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Rwanda tightened border controls with the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid the Ebola outbreak, banning entry of foreigners from DRC and imposing a health quarantine for Rwandans or residents returning from the DRC. In Gisenyi, opposite Goma, border restrictions are enforced: only about 50 workers are authorized to cross, rotating in three‑day blocks to limit movement. Cross‑border transporters now bring goods to a neutral zone near the frontier, with strict measures: handwashing, disinfectant, temperature checks, and registration of address, ID, and phone numbers at the border. Families are separated by the line: Congolese caregiver Mbavu Safi in Rwanda cannot currently visit her children in DRC, while urging precautions from afar. Rwanda reports no Ebola cases yet, and domestic activities continue as usual, despite the ongoing outbreak in DRC. Keywords: Ebola, Rwanda, DRC, Gisenyi, Goma, border control, quarantine, cross-border movement, public health measures."}{

triage.headline_ja: 「複雑だし心配が大きい」：エボラ出血熱流行への懸念から、ルワンダとコンゴ民主共和国の国境で家族が引き離されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的展開、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。DRCでの継続的なエボラ流行による国際的リスク管理が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（特にGoma）でのエボラ流行を主題としており、ルワンダはこれに対する対応（国境管理強化）の実施国として記載されている。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを記載。ルワンダ（対象国外）での措置は含めない。国際的な感染拡大リスク評価としてはピックアップの価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: A Bunia, le patron de l'OMS réaffirme sa solidarité avec les populations affectées par Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: In Bunia, the WHO Director-General reaffirms his solidarity with populations affected by Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On May 30, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Bunia, Ituri province, in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, to oversee the Ebola response. He reaffirmed WHO solidarity with populations in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu and urged placing communities at the heart of the response, citing local knowledge for durable solutions. During his stay, he planned meetings with community leaders, women, youth, traders, and religious leaders to strengthen trust—critical for outbreak control. He also praised the Congolese government's investments to bolster the health system in the response. The DRC is at its 17th Ebola outbreak; there is no vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain yet, as research continues alongside surveillance, contact tracing, laboratory testing, and patient care. WHO reaffirmed long-term support beyond this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ブニアでWHO事務局長がエボラウイルスに影響を受けた住民への連帯を改めて確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行であり、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク、およびWPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性に該当。WHO事務局長の現地訪問という高い国際的関心あり。
triage.notes: DRCの17番目のエボラ流行で、Bundibugyo株に対するワクチンがまだない。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な関心の高さを示唆。長期的な国際支援を要する案件。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola In Congo: Confirmed Cases Rise To 282, Survivors Share Recovery Stories
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo's Ituri province has 282 confirmed cases, 264 in Ituri, with over 1,000 suspected cases linked to Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved treatment or vaccine. Containment challenges include early detection, rapid isolation, rigorous contact tracing (45% coverage) and safe burials; 220 suspected cases remain under investigation. Five survivors, all health workers (four nurses and a laboratory worker), have recovered, with AP interviews recounting their relief and onset of symptoms: Baraka Bulambulu's tests turned negative after initial positivity; Ezo Etienne described dizziness, hypotension and vomiting. WHO Director-General Tedros opened a Bunia treatment center and presented recovery certificates. Uganda reports nine cases and has closed its border with Congo to limit spread. The Bundibugyo virus is rare, and response is hampered by remote locations and violence, but officials call the recoveries a victory and stress early care in dedicated facilities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：確認症例が282例に増加、生存者が回復の経験を共有
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生に深刻な影響を持ち、確認症例282例・疑い例1,000例超と異常な規模、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、国境閉鎖による渡航制限が既に実施されており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主題はコンゴ国内のイトゥーリ州での発生であり、ウガンダは9例の二次的な報告に留まるため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo virus（ウイルス名は誤記の可能性あり、エボラウイルス亜種）の記述あり。複数の対象国リスト外地域も含まれているが、感染症危機管理上の重要性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cuma Pakai Google Form, Kasus Stunting dan TB di Perante Didata Lebih Cepat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stunting and TB Cases in Perante Documented More Quickly Using Only Google Form
article.articleSummary: In Desa Perante, Situbondo, Indonesia, stunting and tuberculosis (TB) are being tackled with a digital-and-community approach. Siti Zubaidah and Farhana, local PKK leaders, introduced Google Form surveys via WhatsApp to screen nearly 200 children for stunting and 500–600 villagers for TB among a ~1,000-person population, linking data collection with Kardas Centing Tosis (Kartu Cerdas Cegah Stunting dan Tuberculosis). The team notes TB and stunting form a vicious cycle: stunted children are more TB-susceptible, and TB impairs growth. Google Form-based data is complemented by in-person outreach to ensure full coverage, with home visits for families not online. As part of the program, stunted children receive free PMT (supplementary feeding) for one month; several cases showed improvement, enabling some children to stop PMT by 2025. Workshops educate on TB and stunting, alongside routine Posyandu activities with midwives.

triage.headline_ja: スタンティングと結核をGoogleフォームだけで迅速に把握—ペランテ村での事例
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの一村落における結核とスタンティング対策の取り組みを紹介する記事であり、新規の感染症危機や異常な発生報告ではない。村落レベルの公衆衛生プログラムの効率化に関する好事例報告に過ぎず、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核とスタンティングという既知の公衆衛生課題に対する村落レベルのプログラム実装に関する報告である。データ収集方法の工夫（Google Form活用）が主題であり、新規のアウトブレイク、異常な増加、または危機的状況を示す情報は含まれていない。定期的な公衆衛生活動の進捗報告として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: Helfer warnen vor rasanter Verbreitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: Aid Workers Warn of Rapid Spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in the Ituri region with cross-border concerns into Uganda. Two weeks after the outbreak was publicly announced and the World Health Organization (WHO) declared an international health emergency, approximately 1,000 Ebola cases and 250 deaths have been reported; Uganda has around a dozen deaths. Aid groups warn there may be a large, uncounted toll in the thousands. The ongoing civil war in Ituri hampers humanitarian response and aid delivery. The first Ebola patient in the DRC has recovered and left hospital, offering cautious optimism. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus has visited the crisis area to bolster assistance, but resources remain limited, partly due to the United States no longer being the largest donor.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：支援団体が急速な感染拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響（約1,000例、250死亡）、異常な事象、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの国境越え）、渡航・貿易制限リスクを示す。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にDRCのイトゥリ地域での流行が中心。ウガンダは国境越え懸念として言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの発生。米国はBluedotが付与した発生地域に含まれているが、本記事では支援資源の減少文脈での言及であり、実際の感染症発生地ではないため除外。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態(PHEIC)宣言済みであることが記載されており、シグナルの信度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Le Gouvernement veut offrir une prise en charge holistique aux patients en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - The government wants to offer holistic care to patients in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo's Minister of Public Health, Roger Kamba, announced holistic medical and psychosocial care for all Ebola patients currently isolated at Nyakunde Hospital Center and at the General Reference Hospitals of Rwampata and Bunia in Ituri. Speaking on May 30 after a 72‑hour mission to Ituri's epicenter, he said the government has taken steps to stop the outbreak by strengthening patient care and engaging local communities to cut transmission chains. Nyakunde currently houses more than a dozen suspected and confirmed Ebola cases. As in other treatment and isolation facilities, patients lack adequate medical care and share latrines; some patients also lack food and must obtain supplies from the community, creating a major risk for further spread. The statement underscores ongoing efforts to curb the Ituri Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・キンシャサ：エボラ熱 - 政府はイトゥリ州の患者に総合的なケアを提供したい
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱という高リスク病原体で、DRCイトゥリ州での継続的な流行、施設内での感染管理上の問題（患者間での共有施設、食糧不足による地域との接触）が報告されており、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行を報告。複数の治療・隔離施設で衛生管理の問題（患者間での共有便所、食糧不足による地域との接触が感染拡大のリスク）が指摘されており、感染管理体制の強化が急務。政府による対応が進められているが、地域レベルでの資源不足が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola/RDC: Velocidade da progressão do vírus surpreende organizações e OMS apela à cooperação internacional para atacar epidemia no leste congolês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola/DRC: The speed of the virus's progression surprises organizations, and WHO appeals for international cooperation to combat the epidemic in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, Bunia, Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reports Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, spreading rapidly. Since the first officially detected case on 15 May, there have been more than 40 deaths and about 230 laboratory-confirmed infections, with around 1,300 suspected cases. Cross-border spread concerns reach Uganda (at least eight cases, two deaths) and Rwanda with suspected cases. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or reactive treatment; vaccines for the Zaire strain (Merck’s rVSV-ZEBOV and Johnson & Johnson candidates) are ineffective here. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with MSF, CDC Africa, the African Union, and Congolese authorities battling both the virus and sociocultural barriers, including local beliefs and resistance to corpse-management restrictions. International cooperation and funding remain critical as authorities urge symptomatic individuals to seek official care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ/コンゴ民主共和国：ウイルス進行の速度が組織を驚かせ、WHOが東部コンゴの流行に対処するための国際協力を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の多国間拡大、高い致命率、既知の治療法の欠如、公式な国際保健上の緊急事態宣言がなされている。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダとルワンダは地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリーで言及される二次的な拡大地域であり、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの急速な蔓延（5月15日以降230例確認、1300例疑い例、40例以上の死亡）、ワクチン対策の制限（Bundibugyo株に対する既認可ワクチンなし）、医療体制と社会的障壁が重大なリスク。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Rientra malato dal Congo. Ipotesi Ebola: in isolamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ill patient returns from Congo. Ebola suspected: in isolation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy: an Italian man from Congo, who recently visited Congo with a layover in Egypt, developed symptoms and was isolated at Santissima Trinità Hospital after being transported from his home. A blood sample was sent to Spallanzani National Institute in Rome for testing; results expected on 2026-06-01. Authorities cordoned off Via Manno and followed Ministry of Health protocols mandating data sharing within 24 hours for travelers from Congo/Uganda; suspected cases may be diverted to Spallanzani via the Rome hub at Fiumicino. The circulating strain Bundibugyo is less contagious; there is no targeted vaccine or rapid diagnostic test. WHO reports in the affected African region at least 1,100 suspected cases, 263 confirmed cases, and 43 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴから帰国した患者。エボラが疑われている: 隔離中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い例が報告され、IHR基準3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク）。対象国DRCでの流行が背景にあり、イタリアでの輸入例の可能性がある。
triage.notes: イタリアでの発症事例は対象国外だが、患者がコンゴから帰国した者であり、DRCにおけるエボラ流行の背景（疑い例1,100件以上、確認例263件、死亡43件）が記事の主要な文脈。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC を含める。イタリアはスクリーニング対象外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Infekcemi v zahraničí se za osm let nakazilo 197 lidí z Vysočiny, předloni 50
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 197 people from the Vysočina Region contracted infections abroad over eight years, 50 of them in the year before last.
article.articleSummary: From 2018 through 2025, Vysočina Region health authorities recorded 197 imported infections, including 11 dengue fever cases. Digestive illnesses were the most common, with Salmonella accounting for 50 infections. The peak year was 2024 with 50 imported infections; 2025 saw 28. Earlier years were much lower (five in 2020, one in 2021), with the Covid-19 era suppressing travel-related cases. Dengue fever last year (2025) had one confirmed case; 2024 had six treated. Dengue typically appears 4–10 days after a mosquito bite, with high fever, severe headache, muscle and joint pains, retro-orbital pain, rash, fatigue, nausea, and possible nose or gum bleeding. Most infections in Vysočina residents were contracted in India, Thailand, and the Maldives. Travel-medicine ambulances operate in Havlíčkův Brod, Nové Město na Moravě, and Jihlava, offering pre-travel advice, vaccination certificates, travel kits, and prescriptions for antibiotics, antimalarials, and yellow fever vaccination when needed.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィソチナ地域住民の8年間の海外感染者は197名、前年は50名
triage.triage_reason: 報告される感染症は複数だが、本件は過去8年間の輸入感染症の統計報告であり、現在進行中の流行やアウトブレイクではない。チェコは対象国に含まれず、対象国での活発な感染伝播を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: チェコの地域保健当局による過去8年間の輸入感染症の統計報告。これは疫学的監視データの定期報告であり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。感染がタイ、インド、モルディブで獲得されたが、これらは過去の旅行による散発的な輸入感染症であり、現地での活発な流行兆候ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, test negativo per paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo: cosa dicono gli esperti su allarme e sorveglianza in Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, negative test for patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo: what experts say about the alert and surveillance in Italy
article.articleSummary: Ebola test negative for a patient returning to Sardinia from Congo, prompting Italy's surveillance officials to assess alert and case-management systems. Results from Spallanzani in Rome confirmed the absence of infection and downgraded the case in Cagliari. Epidemiologist Pier Luigi Lopalco says travelers from the region can have febrile symptoms linked to malaria and other infections; timely alert signals functioning surveillance and keeps the risk of spread of the new Ebola strain very low. Gianni Rezza notes that Italian authorities use a risk grid considering personal and area exposure; as a result, multiple alerts may arise even from cases far from the outbreak epicenter, reflecting precaution and defensive medicine with emotional and cost consequences. Matteo Bassetti cautions against sensational treatment of reporting, arguing for calmer communication. The Cagliari case remained negative, underscoring coordinated, proportionate response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴから帰国した患者の検査が陰性：イタリアの警戒態勢と監視について専門家の見解
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ流行に関連した症例報告だが、当該患者の検査は陰性で感染なし。ただし国際渡航関連の感染症アラート機能と情報不足の観点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 当該患者はコンゴから帰国し、サルデーニャで検査実施された症例。検査結果は陰性で感染確認されず。イタリアは対象国外のため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ含める。コンゴにおけるエボラ流行状況が記事サマリーに明記されていないため、発生地の詳細な疫学状況は不明。国際渡航関連の検査・監視機能の動作確認としては注視価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Глава Роспотребнадзора оценила риски заноса вируса Эбола в РФ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Head of Rospotrebnadzor assessed the risks of the introduction of the Ebola virus into Russia.
article.articleSummary: Head of Russia's Rospotrebnadzor assessed the risks of introducing Ebola into Russia as the Democratic Republic of Congo experiences record spread of Ebola virus; the situation is extremely concerning. In response, Russia has tightened sanitary-quarantine controls at the state border, with heightened scrutiny of arrivals from risk zones. For assessment and minimization of threats, authorities rely on the AIS Perimeter information system. The report notes serious concern among local communities and frontline medical workers in DRC. No Russian case counts are provided; the focus is on preventive border measures and risk assessment amid the ongoing outbreak in the DRC. The article highlights ongoing vigilance for potential imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健監視庁長官、エボラウイルスのロシアへの流入リスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で4項目該当（異常性、長期曝露、流行性、管理可能性）。DRCでの記録的エボラ流行とロシアの国境警戒強化という社会政治的関心が高い状況。
triage.notes: 発生地域にロシア連邦が含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCでの流行が主題であり、ロシアではEbola症例が報告されていない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの『記録的流行（record spread）』と『極めて深刻な状況（extremely concerning）』という記述が強調されており、複数国への国際的拡大リスクの認識が表現されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Moderna va participer au développement d'un vaccin contre la souche Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Moderna to participate in the development of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Moderna inks a deal with CEPI to develop a vaccine against the Bundibugyo (BDBV) strain of Ebola, in response to the outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. CEPI will fund up to $50 million for Moderna’s preclinical work and early clinical trials. Additional CEPI funding includes up to $8.6 million for a vaccine developed by the University of Oxford and manufactured by the Serum Institute of India, and $3.2 million for a vaccine developed by the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative. The WHO recently urged prioritizing experimental therapeutics—antibodies, antivirals, and vaccines—for BDBV. Published June 1, 2026, the Bundibugyo strain is the cause of the current outbreak in the DRC, with ongoing vaccine development efforts targeting containment and prevention.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：Modernaがブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン開発に参加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での進行中のエボラ・ブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクに対応したワクチン開発の重要な進展。WHOが実験的治療法の優先化を推奨し、複数の国際的ワクチン開発プロジェクトが進行中であり、国際的な感染症対応の重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ・ブンディブギョ株の現在のアウトブレイクに対応したワクチン開発を主題としている。インドはセーラム・インスティテュート・オブ・インディアがオックスフォード大学開発ワクチンの製造に参加しており、ワクチン開発の実施地として含まれる。UKはBluedotが特定しているが、記事サマリーでは主要な発生地域として言及されていないため除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Moderna va participer au développement d'un vaccin contre la souche Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-Moderna will participate in the development of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Moderna will partner with Cepi to develop a vaccine candidate against Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV), the strain fueling an outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Cepi will provide up to $50 million to support Moderna's preclinical work and early clinical trials. In addition, Cepi would invest up to $8.6 million for a vaccine developed by the University of Oxford and manufactured by the Serum Institute of India, and $3.2 million for a vaccine developed by the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative (IAVI). The World Health Organization recently recommended prioritizing experimental therapies, including antibodies, antivirals and vaccines, for BDBV. Cepi is an international foundation funding independent research to accelerate vaccine development against epidemic and pandemic threats."}

triage.headline_ja: エボラ - Modernaがブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン開発に参加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ・ブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクは IHR 基準2つ以上に該当する可能性があるが、本記事はワクチン開発の資金調達・パートナーシップに関する報道であり、流行の詳細情報（確定患者数、死亡率、拡大傾向）が不足しているため、続報と流行動向の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中のエボラ・ブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクに関連する国際的なワクチン開発への資金提供と製造パートナーシップについての報道。Bluedot APIが英国（Oxford、University of Oxford関連）とインド（Serum Institute）を発生地域として抽出しているのは、記事のコンテキスト上ワクチン製造施設の場所であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生国はDRCのみ。フルRRA実施時は、DRCでの具体的な患者数、死亡数、拡大の時間的推移、国際的拡大リスク、WHOの対応方針などの詳細情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Autoridades de saúde investigam caso suspeito de ebola em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities investigate a suspected Ebola case in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Health authorities in São Paulo, Brazil, are investigating a suspected Ebola case. The patient, born in the Democratic Republic of Congo with recent travel to the country, is hospitalized in isolation and has tested positive for meningococcal meningitis; Ebola test results are still pending. In Rio de Janeiro, a Belgian national who arrived in Brazil from Uganda had Ebola suspected but this was ruled out, with malaria diagnosed. As of 2026-06-01, there are no confirmed Ebola cases reported; one suspected case remains under investigation in São Paulo, while the Rio de Janeiro case is resolved as malaria. No fatalities are described in the report related to these events. The article emphasizes ongoing differential diagnosis and laboratory confirmation for imported exposure risk.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでエボラ疑い症例を調査中 保健当局が検査実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い症例が報告され、国際的な移動歴（DRC→ブラジル）を伴う。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニングでも異常性・流行性・管理可能性が認められるためピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い症例はサンパウロで確認、患者はDRC出身で最近の渡航歴あり。メニンゴコッカス性髄膜炎陽性だがエボラ検査結果は保留中。リオデジャネイロの症例はウガンダからの渡航者だが、マラリアと確定診断済み。現在のところ確定症例なし。国際的な移動経路（DRC→ブラジル、ウガンダ→ブラジル）があるため国際的脅威としてのシグナル価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: China va trimite o echipă de specialiști medicali în R.D. Congo pentru a ajuta la gestionarea epidemiei de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China will send a team of medical specialists to DR Congo to help manage the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: China will send a team of medical specialists to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to help manage the Ebola outbreak in the region, according to Lin Jian, spokesperson for the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The government has decided to offer humanitarian assistance to DR Congo and will continue to do so 'within its means,' Lin said. The announcement underscores Beijing's support for the Ebola response in DR Congo, with no further operational details on team composition, timeline, or funding provided in the report. Details on the team's size, composition, duration, or financing were not disclosed. Dated June 1, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がエボラ出血熱の流行管理を支援するため、医療専門家チームをコンゴ民主共和国に派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスという高致死性病原体の流行がDRCで発生中であり、IHR基準で「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では「重症度（エボラは高致死率）」「流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染性）」「管理可能性（国際支援の実施）」に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事主題はDRCにおけるエボラ流行であり、中国は医療支援を提供する国として言及されている。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。Chinaは支援国であり、エボラ発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo : le CEPI finance en urgence trois candidats vaccins, dont un de Moderna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola: CEPI urgently funds three vaccine candidates, including one from Moderna.
article.articleSummary: CEPI urgently funds three Ebola Bundibugyo vaccine candidates to address the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The candidates come from IAVI (rVSV platform), Moderna (mRNA), and Oxford University in partnership with the Serum Institute of India (ChAdOx1). CEPI commits up to $3.2 million for IAVI, up to $50 million for Moderna (with manufacturing funding to enable phase 2/3 as soon as phase 1 data permit), and up to $8.6 million for Oxford-SII. None are yet in clinical trials; the aim is to accelerate entry into phase 1. CEPI CEO Dr. Richard Hatchett says every day counts as Bundibugyo spreads rapidly with no approved vaccine. Candidate selection followed a global review with WHO, Africa CDC, ANRS, Gavi, and affected countries to ensure equitable, affordable access. The outbreak has >900 suspected cases and >220 suspected deaths, the third-largest filovirus outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョエボラ：CEPIが緊急にModernaを含む3つのワクチン候補に資金提供
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo種）の大規模な発生（900以上の疑い患者、220以上の死亡）で、複数国に拡大。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、国際的な緊急対応が進行中。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはUgandaを発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではDRCとUgandaの両国での発生を言及。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCとIndiaのみを検証済み場所として列挙。インドはセラム・インスティチュート・オブ・インディアがOxford大学と共同でワクチン開発に参加している。エボラBundibugyo種は過去3番目の大規模フィロウイルス流行であり、複数の国際機関（WHO、Africa CDC、ANRS、Gavi）が関与する国際的対応が既に開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: La Jornada: Casos de ébola en el Congo ya superan mil 100
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Jornada: Ebola cases in the Congo already exceed 1,100.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda exceed 1,100 suspected, with 43 deaths and 263 laboratory-confirmed infections. The African Union warned of the expanding outbreak; the WHO reported five recoveries and urged stronger community cooperation to curb transmission. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warned that the risk of spread beyond affected zones is real and urged rapid action, saying we must act at the speed of the epidemic. Health ministers of the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan approved a 319 million-dollar response plan to address the outbreak, which officials say will not be the last. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia in Ituri, emphasized that public engagement is critical, noting recent protests and attacks on medical centers over how victims' bodies are handled, per The Guardian.

triage.headline_ja: ラ・ホルナーダ: コンゴのエボラ症例が既に1,100を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ以上該当、高い社会的・政治的関心。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い危険度の疾患。1,100症例超・43死亡・263確定例は重大な公衆衛生事象。Uganda・South Sudanへの拡大リスク言及されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、アフリカ連合・Africa CDCの警告、319百万ドルの対応計画承認など国際的対応の高度化を示唆。医療センターへの攻撃・遺体処置をめぐる抗議により対策実施の困難性が増大。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases in Democratic Republic of the Congo reach 282 | BreakingNews
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo total 282, with 264 in Ituri province. The Bundibugyo virus, the current species, has no approved treatment or vaccine. More than 1,000 suspected cases have been reported. Health authorities cite challenges including early detection, rapid isolation, rigorous contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and strengthened infection prevention and control in facilities. Contact tracing coverage stands at 45%, with 220 suspected cases under investigation. Five people have recovered, all health workers—four nurses and a laboratory worker—joyfully described in interviews; the World Health Organization has coordinated care as a new Ebola treatment centre opened in Bunia. Uganda has reported nine Ebola cases and closed its border with the DRC to limit spread. No approved vaccines or antivirals exist for Bundibugyo Ebola; outbreak response emphasizes care and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認症例が282件に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。WPRO域内での進行中の多国間エボラ流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの9症例確認も言及しているが、発生地域リストに含まれるウガンダ（1269750）は対象国リスト外であるため verified_locations から除外。本記事の主体はDRCでの進行中のバンディブジオエボラ流行。治療法・ワクチンなし、接触者追跡率45%、疑い症例1000超、国境閉鎖など国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: China sends emergency medical teams to Ebola-hit DRC amid outbreak
article.articleSummary: China will dispatch emergency humanitarian assistance to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to combat an Ebola outbreak, with medical expert teams on the ground in the DRC to provide services and assistance. The Foreign Ministry said the move includes support to the African Union Commission and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention. The World Health Organization’s update released Friday reports 134 confirmed Ebola cases across the DRC and Uganda, with 18 deaths among confirmed cases in the two countries. Spokesman Lin Jian stated the government’s commitment to assisting affected African partners as the outbreak continues, highlighting China’s role in international public health support during this crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ出血熱の発生に対応しDRCに緊急医療チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常な事象、複数国への国際拡大、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、国際的な対応と支援の動員が既に進行中。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健上の最高レベルリスク病原体。DRC134確認例、18死亡例（DRCとウガンダ計）が報告されており、既にWHOが公式更新を発表。中国による国際支援動員が明示されている。Chinaは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事の主題は「DRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生」であり、Chinaは対応国家として言及されているため verified_locations には含めない。Uganda（226074）は提供された対象国リストに含まれていないため、該当対象国はDRC（203312）のみだが、サマリー上ウガンダでの確認例が明記されているため併記。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, test negativo per paziente rientrato in Sardegna dal Congo: cosa dicono gli esperti su allarme e sorveglianza in Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, negative test for a patient who returned to Sardinia from the Congo: what experts say about the alarm and surveillance in Italy
article.articleSummary: On June 1, 2026, Italy confirmed a negative Ebola virus test for a patient who had returned to Sardinia from the Congo. Experts say the alert and surveillance systems functioned, and the risk of spread of the new strain remains very low if surveillance is maintained. The Spallanzani Institute in Rome reported the result for the suspected case. Epidemiologist Pier Luigi Lopalco notes the alert framework mirrors the 2014 Ebola outbreak response, relying on self-reporting by travelers and local health authorities, per ministerial guidance. Gianni Rezza adds that many travelers come from African countries and that symptoms may arise from malaria or other infections; prudence is essential, but avoid wasteful alarmism and maintain cross-institutional cooperation. He also warns that local alarms can trigger even when exposure risk is distant, fueling defensive medicine and contact tracing if Ebola were confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴから帰国した患者の検査結果は陰性：イタリアの警戒と監視についての専門家の見解
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで発生したエボラの確認事例ではなく、イタリアで検出された疑似患者が陰性確認されたもの。IHR基準・スクリーニング基準のいずれも該当せず、むしろ監視体制が有効に機能していることを示す事例である。
triage.notes: イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、実際のイベント発生国としてはDRCのみを列挙。本記事は負のシグナル（陰性確認）であり、トリアージ対象外。ただしDRCでのエボラ流行が背景にあるため、今後の流行情報は監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases in Democratic Republic of the Congo reach 282
article.articleSummary: Reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 282 confirmed Ebola cases, with 264 in Ituri province, in the ongoing outbreak. More than 1,000 suspected cases linked to Bundibugyo virus, a strain with no approved treatment or vaccine. Response challenges include early detection, rapid isolation, contact tracing (45% coverage) and safe burials, with 220 suspected cases under investigation. Five survivors have recovered, all health workers (four nurses and one laboratory technician), who experienced dizziness, hypotension and vomiting before recovery. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus opened a new Ebola treatment centre in Bunia as part of the response. Uganda reports nine cases and has closed its border to limit spread. Treatments remain largely supportive, addressing symptoms. Authorities stress that early care in dedicated facilities is key to stopping transmission and achieving recovery.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認症例が282例に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中4項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行拡大、国際的リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全項目該当。エボラアウトブレイク（1,000件超の疑い例、死亡率高い、国境閉鎖、WHO本部長による現地対応）であり、国際的関心も高い。フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus（Bundibugyo strain）は治療法・ワクチンがない。ウガンダは国境閉鎖を実施し、9例確認。WHO事務局長が治療センター開設など対応を強化。記事ではウガンダも言及されているが、主流行地はコンゴ民主共和国であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Ebola patients recover in Congo as rare virus sparks health alerts across 3 continents
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda persists with more than 200 confirmed cases and hundreds of suspected infections under investigation as of end-May. Five survivors have been discharged in Bunia—four nurses and one laboratory worker—demonstrating that early, specialised care can improve survival despite no approved vaccine or licensed treatment for this strain. WHO is accelerating experimental vaccines and treatments into prioritised trials. A refurbished Ebola Treatment Centre in Bunia now has 24 beds (expandable to 60) with an annex for 42 more beds opening soon, as health authorities strengthen response. At least 16 health workers have been infected since the outbreak began on May 15. Imported/exported case signals: a Congolese traveller with meningitis in Brazil (São Paulo); a Uganda traveller with malaria in Rio de Janeiro; a Congo traveller in Italy with Ebola-like symptoms ruled out.

triage.headline_ja: 5人のエボラ患者がコンゴで回復、稀なウイルスが3大陸で健康警報を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブンディブギョ型エボラの確認症例200以上、疑い例多数、複数国への輸出ケース（ブラジル、イタリア）が報告され、国際的な懸念が高まっている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはイタリア・ウガンダも含まれるが、サマリーの主要な感染症イベント（ブンディブギョ型エボラ流行）はDRC・ウガンダで発生。対象国リストに基づき、verified_locationsはDRCとブラジル（輸出ケース）のみ含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに非含有のため除外。治療センター拡張、WHOによるワクチン・治療薬の優先試験加速など、対応の進展が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Au moins 282 cas confirmés d'Ebola signalés en République démocratique du Congo | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 282 confirmed Ebola cases reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | L'actualité
article.articleSummary: By 1 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 282 confirmed Ebola cases in the current Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, with 264 in Ituri province in the east. More than 1,000 suspected Bundibugyo infections have been reported, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Main control challenges include early detection and rapid isolation, rigorous contact tracing (45% coverage; 220 suspects under investigation), safe and dignified burials, and stronger infection prevention and control in health facilities. Five survivors have been publicly celebrated; all are health professionals. Baraka Bulambulu and Ezo Étienne, both nurses, described negative tests after initial positives. The WHO notes recovery is possible with prompt treatment in specialized centers, and Uganda has closed its border after nine cases. Bunia, capital of Ituri, hosted the inauguration of a new Ebola treatment center.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で少なくとも282例のエボラ確定症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い死亡率の新興感染症であり、複数国での確認と国境閉鎖まで招いている重大事象。フルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Bundibugyo型エボラウイルス）による大規模アウトブレイク。ウガンダも9例確認し国境閉鎖している重大事象。ワクチン・承認治療法なしという極めて高リスク状況。記事ではウガンダも言及されているが、実際の発生はコンゴ民主共和国が主体であり、ウガンダは流入警戒段階と判断。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないためDRCのみ verified_locations に掲載。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie d'Ebola : le taux de létalité de la souche Bundibugyo constaté à 15% en République démocratique du Congo, de premiers cas suspects détectés hors d'Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: the case fatality rate of the Bundibugyo strain recorded at 15% in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with first suspected cases detected outside Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 282 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 42 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate around 15% among confirmed cases. Five survivors are reported: four nurses at Bunia hospital and a laboratory technician. Early diagnosis and rapid supportive care are improving survival. The outbreak also involves neighboring Uganda, with cross-border transmission under heightened regional surveillance. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting it does not meet pandemic criteria due to non-respiratory transmission. Outside Africa, suspected imported cases have emerged: in Brazil, two travelers from affected areas were hospitalized (one with meningitis, one with malaria) with investigations ongoing; in Italy, a Congo-returned individual tested negative in Cagliari, with very low risk of spread and strict border/hospital precautions in place.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：民主共和国コンゴで確認されたブンディブギョ株の致死率は15%で、アフリカ外で初めての疑い例が検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスの流行は、複数国への国際的な拡大（ウガンダ、ブラジル、イタリアへの輸入症例）、深刻な死亡率（15%）、WHO PHEIC宣言により、フルRRA対象のシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、エボラ流行の主要発生地はDRCのブニア地域。ウガンダとの国境を越えた感染が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ブラジルとイタリアへの輸入症例が報告されているが、記事の主題は DRC での流行であり、輸入症例は二次的な言及のため対象国確認のための地理的検証を厳密に適用。実際の流行・発生地は DRC のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Salud emite aviso epidemiológico en México por virus ébola en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health issues an epidemiological alert in Mexico due to Ebola virus in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Mexico issues an epidemiological alert for Ebola virus disease (EVD) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus as outbreaks persist in Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. As of 1 June 2026, no cases have been detected in Mexico, but the WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. CONAVE requires immediate isolation of suspected cases, minimal clinical assessment, and mandatory impermeable PPE and high-efficiency masks. Suspected patients are transferred under strict biosecurity to Centro Nacional de Investigación y Atención de Quemados (CENIAQ) at the National Institute of Rehabilitation in Mexico City for evaluation and sampling. The suspected case definition: fever >38.6°C plus malaise, severe headache, abdominal or muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, anorexia or dysphagia, or hemorrhagic signs. Incubation is 2–21 days; risk from travel to active zones or contact with a case. No vaccines or antivirals exist; transmission via bodily fluids. UIES: (55) 5337-1845.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコが、アフリカのエボラウイルスを理由に疫学的警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念（PHEIC宣言）は高いが、メキシコでの実患者はなく、記事の主たる対象国はDRC・ウガンダ・スーダンである。確認された対象国内の発生状況が十分でないため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus株）の国際的な大規模流行が進行中。DRC以外にウガンダとスーダンでの流行が記述されているが、これら2国は対象国リストに含まれない。メキシコは地理的に対象国外であり、記事の主題は「アフリカの流行に対するメキシコの警戒」である。WHOがPHEIC宣言しており、IHR4基準全て該当するが、対象国内での検証可能な発生情報が限定的（DRCのみ）であるため、追加情報を待つWATCH判定が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: OMS e República Democrática do Congo estão a desenvolver vacina contra a atual estirpe de Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and the Democratic Republic of the Congo are developing a vaccine against the current Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) and the Government of the Democratic Republic of Congo are collaborating to secure a vaccine against the current Ebola strain declared in eastern DRC. Agencies indicate health authorities, WHO, and partners are working to rapidly conduct randomized controlled trials of vaccines and candidate treatments. The approach aims to speed up clinical testing and potential deployment of preventive and therapeutic options amid the eastern outbreak. The report provides no specific case or death counts. This initiative underscores intensified international cooperation to combat the outbreak through vaccine development and experimental therapies, with trials designed to evaluate safety and efficacy of candidate vaccines and treatments as soon as possible.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとコンゴ民主共和国は現在のエボラ株に対するワクチンを開発している
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準で複数該当が予想されるが、本記事はワクチン開発協力の報道であり、急性的なアウトブレイク情報ではない。現在の感染状況に関する具体的な症例数・死亡数が示されていない。続報でアウトブレイク規模の拡大や重症化傾向の情報が出現した場合は再評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容はワクチン開発・臨床試験の実施に関する協力体制の報道であり、アウトブレイク自体の現況報告ではない。東部DRCでのエボラ発生が背景にあるが、具体的な患者数・死亡数・感染状況の詳細が記載されていない。この情報だけではWPRO基準の『重症度』が確認できないため、判定は『要経過観察』とした。

article.articleHeadline: Moderna receives $50 million to develop Ebola vaccine as number of cases surge
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo; over 900 suspected cases and more than 220 suspected deaths. Moderna, in partnership with CEPI, is developing an investigational BDBV vaccine, with CEPI committing up to $50 million for preclinical development and early clinical testing. CEPI also initialed funding for an Oxford–Serum Institute vaccine and an IAVI candidate. Gavi pledged up to $50 million, including $40 million to accelerate vaccine access and $10 million for outbreak response. The World Health Organization has recommended prioritizing experimental drugs for BDBV, including antibodies, antivirals and vaccines. The Pandemic Fund announced up to $220.6 million in grants to address Ebola response gaps. This reflects intensified international efforts to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: Modernaがエボラワクチン開発で5000万ドルを獲得、症例数の急増に対応
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）のアウトブレイク（900件以上の疑い症例、220件以上の死亡）が報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。複数の国際機関（WHO、CEPI、Gavi、Pandemic Fund）による大規模対応が展開されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）は通常エボラウイルスの中でも死亡率は比較的低いが、900件以上の疑い症例と220件以上の死亡報告は重大。国際的なワクチン開発・資金供与が急速に進行しており、パンデミック対応の一環として扱われている。記事は開発支援の側面を強調しているが、アウトブレイク事象そのものは明確にDRC東部での発生として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mistrusting the process: containing Congo's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province. No vaccine for this strain. Official counts exceed 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 deaths, with testing capacity limited and figures likely underestimates. Signs of spread to South Kivu and North Kivu; Uganda has reported several cases, and experts expect cases in South Sudan; reports of cases imported by Congolese travelers to Brazil remain unconfirmed. On the ground, distrust and conflict—including attacks on burial sites, arson, and tear gas—complicate response efforts and fuel underreporting. Community beliefs are shaped by past outbreaks, with Action Aid finding about a third of residents doubt Ebola’s reality, undermining safe burial practices linked to transmission. The crisis remains focused in the east, with cross-border risk to neighboring countries and ongoing operational challenges in field, government, and laboratory responses.

triage.headline_ja: プロセスへの不信：コンゴのエボラ流行の封じ込め
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラウイルスの確認された流行で、1,000件以上の疑い例と約250人の死亡が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで確認、南スーダンでの例が予想され、ブラジルへの輸入例も報告）があり、国際的な関心と対応が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUganda、Sudan、Brazilが含まれているが、記事サマリーの内容から実際の主要イベント発生地はDRC（Ituri州、South Kivu州）であり、ウガンダは複数例が確認された隣接国（二次的影響）、スーダンは予想される拡大地域、ブラジルへの輸入例は未確認である。したがって、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラウイルス病は世界的に極めて高い関心を集める感染症であり、国際的支援と封じ込め対応が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: reforçada vacinação em João Pessoa antes das férias e festas juninas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: intensified vaccination in João Pessoa ahead of holidays and the June festivities.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination intensified in João Pessoa, Brazil, ahead of mid-year holidays, Junina festivities, and Copa do Mundo travel surges. With rising measles activity in the United States, Mexico, and Canada, residents and travelers are urged to update vaccination records and obtain measles protection before travel or at transit hubs and events. Brazil remains free of endemic measles, but higher tourist flows call for vigilance. Recommendations: people aged 1–29 should have two MMR doses; 30–59 should have at least one dose; 6–11 months-olds traveling may receive a 'dose zero'. Pregnancy is a contraindication for MMR; health workers must have two doses. Other vaccines for travelers include influenza, COVID-19, yellow fever, hepatitis B, and tetanus as indicated. Vaccination sites include municipal polyclinics, Centro de Imunização in Torre, USFs, and mobile points at shopping centers and beaches; home vaccination is available for bedridden via the 'João Pessoa na Palma da Mão' app.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：ジョアン・ペッソアでの休暇とジュニナ祭前の予防接種強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹予防接種キャンペーンが強化されており、米国・メキシコ・カナダでの麻疹活動増加を背景とした国際的な感染リスク拡大シナリオ。WPROスクリーニング基準（流行リスク、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米国・メキシコ・カナダでの麻疹活動増加を言及していますが、主な発生地点はブラジル（ジョアン・ペッソア）であり、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれています。大規模なイベント（Junina祭、Copa do Mundo）や国際的な人流に伴う感染拡大リスクが懸念される点がWPRO基準（流行りやすさ、長期曝露）に該当。予防接種キャンペーンは管理可能性を示唆していますが、国際的なリスク認識が明確なため、フルRRAに進める価値があります。

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever Alert: Arunachal's Longding Bans Pig Transport, Pork Trade After Outbreak In Assam
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever outbreak in Assam's Tinsukia region prompts Longding district, Arunachal Pradesh, to impose a one-month ban on transport and purchase of live pigs and pork products from Assam or other affected zones to curb virus entry. ASF has been confirmed in Tinsukia; non-compliance may invite action under the Prevention and Control of Infectious and Contagious Diseases in Animals Act, 2009. The advisory bans live pigs, piglets, pork, and pork products from affected zones and warns against swill feeding as a transmission driver. It mandates strict farm biosecurity: disinfectant foot dips, dedicated footwear and clothing, restricted visitors, cleaning and disinfection of housing and utensils, and strict disposal of carcasses. Watch for high fever, weakness, loss of appetite, hemorrhages or purple patches on the skin, and sudden deaths; suspected cases must be reported to the nearest veterinary office for isolation and deep burial with lime or incineration.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱警報：アルナーチャルプラデーシュ州ロンディン地区、アッサム州の流行後、豚の輸送と豚肉取引を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」に該当（2つ以上）。アフリカ豚熱は家畜動物衛生上の重大な脅威であり、地域的措置が講じられている。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）はOIE報告対象疾病であり、畜産経済に甚大な影響を及ぼす。アッサム州ティンスキア地域での確認事例に基づき、隣接するアルナーチャルプラデーシュ州ロンディン地区で予防的措置が実施されている。州間の豚・豚肉製品取引禁止は家畜動物衛生当局による公式対応を示す。インド国内の他地域への拡大リスクがあり、動物健康管理能力の観点からフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Factbox-Countries tighten travel rules as Ebola risk rises
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO on May 17, with high risk of spread to Uganda and South Sudan. To curb cross-border transmission, the United States banned entry of non-citizens who recently traveled to DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan, and extended the ban to green-card holders; travelers are screened at Atlanta and Dulles with temperature checks, travel histories, and symptom tracking. Canada imposed a 90-day entry ban for residents from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, followed by a 21-day quarantine for those who have been there without symptoms. The Bahamas and Bahrain imposed 30-day travel suspensions for entrants from the same countries, with enhanced health screenings. Thailand restricts entry to Suvarnabhumi with a 21-day quarantine; Mexico, Jordan, Kenya, and Zambia expanded screenings or restrictions. The EU indicated no entry screening for these origins; KLM canceled flights to Entebbe, and Brussels Airlines adjusted crew rosters.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱リスク上昇に伴い、各国が渡航規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。DRCでのエボラ熱アウトブレイクがWHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言され、複数国への国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限措置が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月の将来シナリオであるため、実際のアウトブレイク検証不可。ただし、サマリーに基づくと対象国のうちDRC、Thailand、Zambiaがエボラ熱の発生国または対応国として言及されている。Bluedot APIは米国、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ベルギー、バハマ、バーレーン、ヨルダン、ケニア、メキシコなども検出しているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bejelentette a Covid-vakcinagyártó: oltóanyagot fejlesztenek az elszabadult halálos kór megfékezésére
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The COVID vaccine manufacturer announced: they are developing a vaccine to curb the out-of-control deadly disease.
article.articleSummary: Moderna and CEPI have agreed to develop a vaccine candidate against Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV), the Ebola pathogen driving the outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo that has spread to Uganda. The deal could mobilize up to $50 million from a foundation funded by private and public actors and civil society for preclinical and early clinical development. CEPI also funds other vaccines, including an Oxford University/Serum Institute vaccine with $8.6 million and an IAVI-developed vaccine with $3.2 million. The WHO last week urged exploration of experimental therapies—antibodies, antivirals, and vaccines—for BDBV treatment and prevention. The outbreak was first reported May 15, with over 1,100 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths as of June 1, 2026, in the DRC and Uganda."

triage.headline_ja: COVID ワクチン製造企業が発表：制御不能な致死的疾病を抑制するためのワクチンを開発中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスによる大規模感染症クラスター（1,100症例以上、246死亡）が複数国に拡大し、国際的な医療介入（ワクチン開発、WHOの呼び出し）が開始されている。
triage.notes: Uganda は発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRC は対象国（203312）に含まれ、記事サマリーで実際の発生地として明記されている。ブンディブギョエボラウイルス（BDBV）による新規感染症クラスターで、高い致死率（22.4%）、2国への拡大、国際的なワクチン開発の進行により、複数基準で強いシグナルを示す。

article.articleHeadline: The U.S. needs a tough Ebola policy -- before the virus gets here
