article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, Ebola (Bundibugyo strain) outbreaks are expanding in remote, war-torn Africa, with about 500 suspected cases and no vaccine or cure. The piece notes the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak—more than 28,000 infected—as context for the risk of repeated U.S. exposure, citing Dallas and New York cases linked to travelers and a large contact-tracing effort (177 contacts in the Dallas episode). The author argues for a tougher, data-driven quarantine policy, free of xenophobia, noting the U.S. health system has weakened by CDC staff losses (about 3,000 positions). Current policy screens Americans or legal residents who visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days and requires routing through Washington, Atlanta, or Houston for screening. The piece mentions plans to open a treatment center in Kenya for exposed Americans and stresses overseas initial screening and skeptical views on home quarantine based on COVID-19 lessons.

triage.headline_ja: 米国はウイルスが到着する前にエボラへの厳しい政策が必要である
triage.triage_reason: 複数の対象国（DRC）でエボラアウトブレイク（約500疑い例）が拡大しており、IHR基準3つ以上該当。米国への国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施、政府の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は将来の潜在的リスクを論じているが、DRCでの現在のアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo strain、約500疑い例）と米国での過去の事例（2014-2016年西アフリカアウトブレイク、ダラス・ニューヨークでの旅行関連症例）に基づいている。発生地域にはアフリカ諸国（Sudan、Angola、Kenya、Uganda）も含まれるが、記事本文ではDRCが政策対象地域として明示されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: KLM schrapt vluchten naar Oeganda door Ebola-gerelateerde reisbeperkingen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KLM cancels flights to Uganda due to Ebola-related travel restrictions.
article.articleSummary: KLM canceled Amsterdam–Entebbe flights (via Kigali) due to international travel restrictions tied to an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, affecting Entebbe near Kampala, Uganda. Although the area itself is not labeled high risk, new entry rules have made crew eligibility difficult, leading to two rotations planned for Saturday and Monday being scrapped; Schiphol confirmed the cancellations. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola in Congo and Uganda an international health emergency, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this variant. The United States began stricter screenings and entry restrictions in May. Brussels Airlines reported further disruption, as crews who had been in Congo or Uganda in the past 21 days are barred from entering the US, prompting roster changes to keep services to Entebbe, Kinshasa, New York and Washington. Emirates urged travelers to check destination entry requirements amid broader measures.

triage.headline_ja: KLM、Eボラ関連の渡航制限により、ウガンダへのフライトをキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の国際保健上の緊急事態宣言と、複数国での国際的な渡航・入国制限が実施されている。IHR基準において公衆衛生影響の深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の全4項目に該当し、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスのPHEIC（国際保健上の懸念される公衆衛生上の事象）宣言が確認され、複数国（米国、ベルギー、オランダ）での渡航制限が実施されている。記事ではコンゴとウガンダでの発生を言及しているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当する。ウガンダはリスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Agrees to Correct Uganda Ebola Data After Call With Adonia Ayebare
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC agreed to correct Ebola data on Uganda after Uganda’s Foreign Affairs Minister Adonia Ayebare challenged the reporting that merged Uganda and Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) figures, which showed 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths across both countries. The bulk of those cases and deaths were from eastern DRC (263 cases, 42 deaths); Uganda’s outbreak appeared much smaller, with eight confirmed cases at the time and all patients under treatment, with contacts traced. Following Ayebare’s objections, Africa CDC issued a Uganda-specific update. As of May 30, Uganda had nine confirmed Ebola cases, one death among confirmed cases, 580 contacts under follow-up, and three infections among health workers. Separately, Ayebare said discussions covered establishing a regional pandemics response center in Uganda to bolster surveillance, laboratory testing, and emergency response.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ外務大臣アドニア・アイェバレとの通話後、アフリカCDCがウガンダのエボラデータ修正に合意
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数国での発生（DRC及びウガンダ）であり、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」に該当する。WHO通知相当のシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にDRC東部での263確定例、42死亡を報告しており、ウガンダは9確定例、1死亡と限定的。対象国リストに従い、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。ウガンダ（1850144）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。アフリカCDCのデータ修正と地域的なパンデミック対応体制構築に関する外交的関心の高さが示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC confirms recovery of Ebola frontline workers in DRC
article.articleSummary: Four frontline health workers infected with Ebola in Ituri, DRC, have recovered and been discharged, marking a key milestone in outbreak response. Africa CDC described the development as a positive sign for teams and communities striving to stop transmission and reduce fatalities, reaffirming ongoing support to DRC and partners. The Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) under the IHR, with WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus noting the declaration occurred on May 18 under Article 12 after consultations due to concerns over scale and speed. The Emergency Committee is expected to meet to review the situation and issue temporary recommendations. Africa CDC will continue coordination with DRC authorities and regional partners as surveillance and containment efforts intensify. The bottom line remains: the outbreak is active, and coordinated international action is critical to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがDRCのエボラ最前線労働者の回復を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的公衆衛生上の重大事象。IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当、PHEIC宣言済みの継続中の事象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認事例。DRCとウガンダにまたがるが、記事の主題はDRCの状況。2026年5月18日にIHR下でPHEIC宣言済み。複数の保健労働者の回復は肯定的な進展を示すが、アウトブレイクは継続中で国際的な協調行動が不可欠との指摘。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola disease in Democratic Republic of Congo: MSF scales up response to a rapidly evolving outbreak
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo caused by Bundibugyo virus, with 125 confirmed, 906 suspected cases, and 223 deaths as of 28 May in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Ituri is the epicenter, accounting for over 90% of suspected cases, with rising numbers in Mongbwalu. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or specific treatments. MSF is scaling up response, training staff in Brussels and deploying to support the Ministry of Health. A 65-bed Ebola treatment centre is being built in Ituri (Mongbwalu); isolation and care are supported at Mongbwalu and Fataki referral hospitals. In Bunia, Salama hospital hosts isolation; in Goma, an 80-bed ETC has opened; in South Kivu, ETCs are planned for Bukavu and Lwiro. Challenges include limited testing, samples awaiting processing, access restrictions due to security and travel controls, and community fear impacting care seeking. MSF supports surveillance and infection prevention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ病：MSFが急速に進化する流行への対応を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例125例、死亡223例という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、Bundibugyo株という予想外の病原体、国際的な医療支援対応（MSF）の展開、隔離対策や移動制限による貿易・渡航影響の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC（イトゥーリ州、北キヴ州、南キヴ州）が主な発生地であり、MSF のブリュッセル本部での訓練言及があるが、実際の流行発生地は DRC。Bundibugyo エボラウイルス株は珍しい病原体で、ワクチンなしという点で公衆衛生上極めて重大。

article.articleHeadline: Liberia: NCCRM Intensifies National Response Readiness Over Ebola Threat
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak expands with 121 confirmed cases and 17 confirmed deaths, plus 246 suspected fatalities and 1,077 suspected cases; 17th outbreak in DR Congo, with neighboring Uganda and Sudan reporting cases. Africa CDC expects a vaccine and medicine by end-2026; WHO notes experimental treatments and vaccines for Bundibugyo Ebola should only be used in clinical trials. In Liberia, NCCRM intensifies response readiness following Monrovia meeting with Liberia Peace Building Office, Women NGO Secretariat, and NCCRM analysts, focusing on Ebola preparedness, early warning, public awareness campaigns, and coordinated response to public health emergencies. NCCRM head Arthur Bestman reiterates commitment to strengthened coordination, information sharing, and timely analysis, urging Liberians to be vigilant and cooperate with Health Ministry and community-based prevention. NCCRM is part of ECOWAS Early Warning Mechanism.

triage.headline_ja: リベリア：エボラ脅威に対する国家対応態勢強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）。コンゴで確認されたブンディブギオ株エボラの拡大と複数国への波及により、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴのブンディブギオ株エボラ流行とその地域拡大。リベリアはコンゴの状況への対応準備を述べているのみで、実際のエボラ発生の報告はないため verified_locations にはコンゴのみを含める。ウガンダ・スーダンの症例報告も記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。リベリアも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ブンディブギオ株エボラは致死率が高く、複数国への波及リスクが高い点で重要。

article.articleHeadline: Exames descartam suspeita de ebola em paciente internado no RJ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tests rule out suspected Ebola in patient hospitalized in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil as of 2026-06-01: in Rio de Janeiro, a traveler from Uganda presenting with fever, chills, cough and diarrhea is hospitalized at the Instituto Nacional de Infectologia Evandro Chagas. Saliva and urine tests are negative for Ebola; malaria positive; blood test results are pending. The patient arrived in Brazil on May 22 at Guarulhos Airport and traveled by bus to Rio; five cohabiting contacts are under monitoring and asymptomatic. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, who recently traveled to the DRC (an outbreak area deemed of international concern by the WHO), was hospitalized at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas with Ebola-like symptoms and later diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis; Ebola investigations continue. The Ministry of Health reiterates that Brazil/South America risk is low, with established protocols; Ebola viruses are not transmitted during incubation or via respiratory routes.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロで入院中の患者のエボラ疑い検査で陰性
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤な感染症（エボラ、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎）の疑いケースが報告されており、うち1例はウガンダからの旅行者で国際的な接触がある。ただし記事時点でエボラは除外されており、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年未来日付。ウガンダからの旅行者がリオデジャネイロで発熱症状で入院したが、エボラテスト陰性、マラリア陽性と判明。サンパウロの別症例はDRC渡航歴がありメニンゴ球菌性髄膜炎と診断。いずれもエボラはほぼ除外されている。ブラジル当局は感染リスク低いと評価しており、症例検査の経過を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Le nombre de cas confirmés d'Ebola au Congo monte à 282
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Congo rises to 282.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo rise to 282, with 42 confirmed deaths, after 19 new infections were recorded on Monday. Data from the Ministry of Telecoms and Media, relayed by Reuters, show 264 cases in Ituri province, 15 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu. This marks the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the third largest since the virus was first identified nearly five decades ago, amid indicators suggesting the outbreak may surpass international response capacities. The World Health Organization reported ongoing spread of the Bundibugyo strain, with 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths awaiting verification. The report underscores a sustained, high-magnitude outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確認患者数が282人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラは深刻な公衆衛生影響を持つ異常・予想外のイベントであり、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが高い。DRCでの大規模流行は国際支援が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を持つ危険な感染症。DRCでの17番目の流行で、過去3番目の規模。WHOが報告するBundibugyo株の継続的拡大と、国際対応能力を超える可能性を示唆する指標があり、フルRRAが必須。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz descarta ebola em paciente internado no Rio - Ser Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz rules out Ebola in a patient hospitalized in Rio de Janeiro - Ser Saúde
article.articleSummary: A suspected Ebola case in a Belgian traveler hospitalized in Rio de Janeiro was ruled out by Fiocruz. The man, who arrived from Uganda, presented with cough, chills and diarrhea and was admitted to the Evandro Chagas Institute of Infectious Diseases on May 30, 2026, triggering isolation and observation. Initial saliva and urine tests indicated malaria and were negative for Ebola; a blood test result on May 31 confirmed Ebola as ruled out. Contacts are being monitored by municipal and state health secretariats. Fiocruz reiterates that Ebola virus is not transmitted by respiratory routes but through direct contact with blood, tissues or bodily fluids of infected humans or animals. The current Ebola outbreak is in Central Africa, with the epicenter in Congo and cases recorded in Uganda. Fiocruz remains the reference for suspected Ebola assessment and diagnostic testing in Brazil; transmission risk there is low.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルーズがリオデジャネイロの入院患者のエボラを除外 - セル・サウデ
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例の検査結果によりエボラが除外され、実際のエボラ感染症例ではない。ブラジルのエボラ伝播リスクは低く、4つのIHR基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: ベルギー人旅行者の疑い例はウガンダから到着後、発熱・咳・下痢で入院。検査によりエボラは除外されマラリアが確認された。中央アフリカ（コンゴ・ウガンダ）での流行は記事で言及されているが、ブラジル国内ではエボラ症例ではなく、伝播リスクは低い旨が明示されている。これは「疑い例除外」報告であり、シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: عودة الأمل في الكونغو.. تعافي 5 مصابين بفيروس إيبولا | التلفزيون العربي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hope Returns to the Congo as Five Ebola Patients Recover.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, the WHO reports Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, including 19 new cases. Four nurses treated in Bunia have recovered and been discharged; a laboratory worker also recovered earlier, bringing total recoveries to five, with more expected through early diagnosis and continued care amid intensified response. Brazil records suspected Ebola-linked cases: in São Paulo a man suspected of Ebola was diagnosed with meningitis; in Rio de Janeiro a suspected case was later confirmed as malaria; authorities do not rule out Ebola linkage. Italy activated Ebola protocols in Cagliari after a Congo-arrival patient showed symptoms, but tests were negative and national risk remains very low. WHO had designated the Bundibugyo outbreak in DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting lack of vaccine or licensed treatment does not eliminate hope.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで希望が戻る、エボラウイルス患者5人が回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。DRCのエボラ集団発生（282確認例、42死亡）は公衆衛生上深刻で、WHO PHEIC指定済み。国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ、ブラジル、イタリアでの関連事例）と渡航制限リスクを示唆。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ集団発生は既にWHO PHEIC指定（Bundibugyo株、282確認例、42死亡）。ブラジルとイタリアでの関連疑似症例は検査結果が陰性（髄膜炎、マラリア）だが、当局が除外完全排除していない。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。ウガンダも同outbreak指定対象だが、サマリーでの具体的な新規発生言及なし、現状DRCが主軸。

article.articleHeadline: China joins global Ebola response as Congo outbreak surpasses 1,000 suspected cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) is intensifying, with suspected infections surpassing 1,000 since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The World Health Organization reports 134 confirmed cases and 18 confirmed deaths across the DRC and Uganda; true totals may be higher. The Bundibugyo strain involved has no licensed vaccine, complicating containment. China announced dispatch of medical teams and humanitarian aid to bolster Congo's response, joining a widening international effort that includes the United States, European Union, Canada, WHO, Africa CDC and the Gates Foundation. Africa CDC has launched a continent-wide response; funding gaps and insecurity threaten control measures. The outbreak has already crossed borders into Uganda, prompting tighter entry controls in several countries. WHO urges enhanced surveillance, testing, contact tracing and treatment rather than travel bans; weeks to come could determine if it remains contained or becomes a wider regional emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がコンゴのエボラ対応に参加、感染者1,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ワクチン未承認株、越境拡大、国際的対応など多要素で高リスク。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の重要なシグナル。DRC（Ituri、South Kivu）が主要発生地。ウガンダへの越境確認、ワクチン未承認株（Bundibugyo）、1,000人超の疑い例、複数国による国際対応。資金不足と治安不安定化が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: OMS e RDCongo estão a desenvolver vacina contra a atual estirpe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO and DR Congo Are Developing a Vaccine Against the Current Strain
article.articleSummary: June 1, 2026: The World Health Organization and the Democratic Republic of Congo government are fast-tracking a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola driving the outbreak in eastern DRC’s Ituri province, with Bunia as the epicenter. They plan rapid controlled trials of vaccines and candidate treatments, following a weekend mission led by Health Minister Samuel Kamba, Communications Minister Patrick Muyaya, and WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The Bundibugyo strain has a case fatality rate of about 30–50%; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment yet, but proven public health measures can curb transmission and support recovery with timely care. Africa CDC projects a Bundibugyo vaccine and drug by late 2026. Uganda has nine confirmed Ebola cases, including one death, with one imported from a Congolese patient. The outbreak affects conflict-affected border areas; emphasis remains on hand hygiene, early care, and health-system resilience.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOとコンゴ民主共和国が現在の株に対するワクチンを開発中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による多国家での発生。DRCおよびウガンダで確認症例あり、死亡例も報告。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、WPRO基準も複数該当。国際的な対応と支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: サマリーではウガンダでの9確認症例および1死亡が記載されているが、ウガンダはGeoNames ID1269750がリストに含まれておらず、対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。DRCのIturi州Buniaを震源とした多国家にまたがるエボラ発生の可能性がある一方、対象国リストの制約により DRC のみを記載。ワクチン開発・臨床試験の進行中という点で、疾患的には重大だが、これは対応フェーズ情報であり、発生の確認・拡大トレンドの最新把握が必要。

article.articleHeadline: बे-मौसम बारिश बनी खतरा! अप्रैल-मई में 6 बार हुई बारिश, शहर में बढ़े चिकनगुनिया के मामले - Sanjeevni Today
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unseasonal rain has become a danger! Six rain events occurred in April–May, chikungunya cases on the rise in the city.
article.articleSummary: Unseasonal rains in April–May, totaling six events, caused waterlogging and created ideal Aedes mosquito breeding sites in the city. Chikungunya cases are increasing, with several patients testing positive in government and private hospitals. Patients report fever, joint pain, headache, and weakness; some experience prolonged joint pain after recovery. Health department data indicate accelerated transmission, with dengue risk also noted. Authorities have begun targeted neighborhood surveys, fogging, and anti-larval spraying, while municipal teams clear flooded areas to curb breeding. Officials urge residents to eliminate standing water around homes, regularly clean coolers and water storage containers, wear full-sleeve clothing, and use nets and repellents. If not controlled, cases could rise before the monsoon strains the health system. Hospitals are stockpiling medicines and resources, and early diagnosis and treatment are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 異常な雨が危機に！4月～5月に6回の降雨が発生、市内でチクングニア感染者が増加
triage.triage_reason: インドでチクングニアとデング熱の同時流行リスクが報告され、患者の増加傾向が確認されている。異常な気象条件（時期外れの降雨）による蚊媒介感染症の急速な伝播が懸念され、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は特定都市でのチクングニア急増を報告。時期外れの降雨による蚊のブリーディングサイト増加が原因と明記。デング熱同時流行リスク、関節痛の長期後遺症報告あり。保健当局による積極的な対応（消毒、調査、医薬品備蓄）が記録されている。今後の季節的悪化リスク（モンスーン）への懸念も表現されている。

article.articleHeadline: Opinion | The U.S. needs a tough Ebola policy -- before the virus gets here
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could persist for months; about 500 suspected cases so far, with no vaccine or cure, and the strain is in a remote, war-torn area. The United States faces a high likelihood of repeated introductions over the coming year, echoing the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that infected more than 28,000 people. Past U.S. experiences included Dallas and New York cases, with hundreds of contacts traced; seven American clinicians treated in Africa did not seed further transmission. Current policy screens travelers who have visited DRC, Uganda or South Sudan in the prior 21 days, routing them through designated hubs. A proposed plan includes a treatment center in Kenya for exposed Americans to avoid long medevac flights. The piece urges overseas screening, strict quarantine, and a policy free of xenophobia and politics, grounded in data.

triage.headline_ja: 米国はエボラ熱がここに到着する前に厳しい政策が必要である
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された発生（DRC、ウガンダ）で、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露リスク）。米国への導入リスク言及により国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはUganda、Sudan、Kenyaなども含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はBundibugyo（DRC）のエボラ発生であり、他国への言及は接触者追跡や過去事例、提案される対策地点の位置付けである。対象国リストに該当する国はDRCのみであるため verified_locations に含める。米国への導入リスクと過去の経験（2014-2016西アフリカ流行）が強調されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Moderna entwickelt Impfstoff gegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moderna develops a vaccine against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Moderna, with CEPI, is developing a vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus in response to the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. As of June 1, 2026, authorities report more than 900 suspected cases and over 220 suspected deaths linked to Bundibugyo virus. CEPI commits up to $50 million for preclinical development and initial clinical trials of Moderna's candidate, plus up to $8.6 million for a vaccine by Oxford University and Serum Institute of India, and $3.2 million for an IAVI project. Gavi pledges up to $50 million, with up to $40 million to accelerate vaccine access and $10 million for containment measures. WHO has urged prioritizing experimental therapeutics, including antibodies, antivirals, and vaccines for Bundibugyo virus. The World Bank Pandemic Fund announced up to $220.6 million to close gaps in outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: Moderna がエボラに対するワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：900+疑い例、220+死亡、異常/予想外：Bundibugyo型、国際的拡大リスク：ワクチン開発と国際支援体制、渡航/貿易制限のリスク：DRCにおける発生）。WPROスクリーニングでも全5項目該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い（CEPI、Gavi、World Bank Pandemic Fundの大規模コミットメント）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際の感染症イベント（Bundibugyo ebolavirus による発生）は DRC 東部で発生している。India はワクチン開発パートナー（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているが、発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。900+ 疑い例、220+ 死亡という重大な数値に基づき、IHR基準すべてが該当。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Pharmakonzern: Moderna entwickelt Impfstoff gegen Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pharmaceutical company: Moderna develops vaccine against Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Moderna, with support from the international vaccine alliance CEPI, is developing a vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus in response to the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Health authorities report more than 900 suspected cases and over 220 presumed deaths linked to the wave. CEPI will provide up to $50 million for preclinical development and initial clinical testing of Moderna’s candidate, as well as up to $8.6 million for a vaccine being developed by the University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India, and $3.2 million for an IAVI project. Separately, Gavi pledged up to $50 million, with up to $40 million to accelerate vaccine access and $10 million for direct containment measures. As of 1 June 2026, efforts aim to curb transmission while vaccine candidates advance through development.

triage.headline_ja: 製薬企業：モデルナ、コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行に対抗するワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による900件以上の疑似症例と220人以上の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な懸念、および国際的な支援の必要性が明らかである。IHR基準とWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行を主題としており、インドはセラム・インスティテュート・オブ・インディアがオックスフォード大学とのワクチン共同開発に関与しているため記事サマリーに明示されている。イギリスはBluedot APIが付与した発生地域であるが、記事サマリーでは流行の実際の発生地として記載されていないため、verified_locationsから除外した。DRCとインドのみを検証済み地域として識別した。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Moderna Joins Global Initiative to Advance Vaccine Candidate for Bundibugyo Ebola Virus (MRNA)
article.articleSummary: Moderna (MRNA) joins CEPI's initiative to accelerate vaccine development against Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV), the strain driving the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak has surpassed 900 suspected infections and more than 220 suspected deaths. CEPI will provide up to $50 million to support Moderna's investigational BDBV vaccine program, funding preclinical work and early-stage clinical studies to assess safety and efficacy. In parallel, CEPI announced additional funding: up to $8.6 million for a vaccine developed by the University of Oxford and manufactured by the Serum Institute of India, and $3.2 million for a separate project from the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative. The World Health Organization urged prioritizing experimental therapies—investigational antibodies, antivirals, and vaccine candidates—to contain the outbreak. CEPI continues its mission to strengthen epidemic preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: モデルナが、ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスワクチン候補を推進する世界的イニシアティブに参加（MRNA）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（BDBV株）の流行がコンゴ民主共和国東部で900以上の感染者と220以上の死亡者を報告しており、IHR基準（異常性、重症度、国際的関心）を満たし、複数のワクチン開発イニシアティブとWHOの対応が展開されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラウイルス流行の実態と複数国による対応を記述。DRCが流行中心地、インドはセラム・インスティチュート・オブ・インディアがワクチン製造に参加する国として記載されている。英国はBluedetで抽出されているが、サマリーでの主題イベント発生地ではないため除外。BDBV株は確認された流行株であり、CEPI資金投入、WHO公式対応、複数のワクチン開発プロジェクトが進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Maï-Ndombe : à Yumbi, MSF clôture son appui à la riposte contre le choléra après la prise en charge de plus de 500 patients
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maï-Ndombe: in Yumbi, MSF ends its support for the cholera response after treating more than 500 patients.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Mai-Ndombe, DRC, led MSF to end six weeks of support in Yumbi after treating 536 patients (336 severe/complicated) in MSF-supported facilities from 30 March to 10 May. The outbreak began in early July 2025 and escalated to 116 suspected cases and 16 deaths (case fatality rate 13.8%), with samples sent to the Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) for testing. Affected health zones included Mushie, Nioki, Bolobo (epicenter with 51 suspected cases and 3 deaths), Kwamouth, and Yumbi. At least 542 patients had recovered and been discharged, yielding an estimated province-wide cure rate of 71%. Population movements between Bolobo, Yumbi and the Republic of Congo likely facilitated spread. MSF conducted over 6,450 community-sensitization sessions to promote prevention and prompt care. As of 2026-06-01, MSF remains engaged with communities and health facilities against cholera and other epidemic-prone diseases.

triage.headline_ja: マイ・ンドンベ州：ユムビでMSFがコレラ対策への支援を終了、500人以上の患者を治療後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。DRC内の複数地域での継続的な流行と隣国への二次拡大懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月1日付で、コレラ流行は2025年7月初旬に開始。記事時点で患者536人以上、死亡16人（CFR 13.8%）を報告。複数の健康区域（ムシエ、ニオキ、ボロボ、クワマウス、ユムビ）で検出され、隣国コンゴ共和国への人的移動による拡大可能性言及。MSF撤退後も流行継続の可能性があり、長期曝露リスク高。

article.articleHeadline: Seberapa Mengerikan Penyebaran Ebola, Virus yang Merebak di Kongo dan Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Terrifying Is the Spread of Ebola, the Virus Spreading in Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Eight laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths have been recorded in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of May 16, 2026. Cases are reported in health districts including Bunia, Rwampara, and Mongbwalu. Uganda reported two laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in Kampala within 24 hours on May 15 and 16, 2026; both patients had traveled from the DRC before confirmation. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or body fluids of infected people or animals. The World Health Organization designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), noting cross-border spread and the need for international coordination, though it is not yet a pandemic. The situation is complicated by community deaths with symptoms consistent with Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) and four health workers who died with suspected exposure to viral hemorrhagic fever. There is concern about transmission in health facilities due to weak infection control, and uncertainty remains about the true number of infections, suggesting a larger outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダで広がるエボラウイルスの拡散はどの程度危険か
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な発生、国際的な越境拡大、WHOによるPHEIC指定）。また WPRO スクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月中旬時点で DRC イトゥリ州で8例の確認患者、246例の疑い患者、80例の疑い死亡が報告されている。ウガンダはカンパラで2例の確認患者を報告し、越境感染が確認されている。WHO が PHEIC を宣言しており、感染管理の弱さと実感染者数の不確実性により、発表値より大規模な流行の可能性がある。Bundibugyo ウイルス病（BVD）との合併感染の懸念も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 恙蟲病｜39歲女網紅遭恙蟲叮咬身亡　生前喉嚨潰爛至無法進食　叮咬後留意1病徵【附5大防蟲貼士】
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease | A 39-year-old female influencer dies after being bitten by a kissing bug; in life, her throat ulcerated to the point she could not eat; watch for one symptom after the bite [Includes five tips to prevent insect bites].
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, a 39-year-old Chinese influencer from Yunnan, known as '哈尼小微', died after a suspected Chagas disease infection following a kissing-bug bite. Her death occurred May 27, with family confirming by May 29 after delayed medical care; she had previously returned from Southeast Asia's Golden Triangle to seek treatment. Chagas disease can reach a mortality of up to 60% if untreated, while timely therapy reduces death risk to below 5%. The illness typically presents after a 9–12 day incubation with fever, headache, back pain, chills, night sweats, lymphadenopathy, and a rash; the bite site may develop a black scab, a key sign. Transmission is via triatomine bugs in outdoor, vegetated areas. The report also notes five prevention tips for bites and highlights DEET-containing repellents as highly effective, with cautions on proper use and age recommendations.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病｜39歳の女性インフルエンサーがサシガメに咬まれて死亡　生前は喉が潰瘍化して食事ができず　咬まれた後に注意すべき1つの症状【5つの防虫対策付き】
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では「重症度（死亡事例）」「異常性（対象国での報告）」が明確であり、社会的関心も高い。中国での初の確認事例と見なされる可能性がある。
triage.notes: 注記：見出しおよびサマリーの説明に齟齬がある。見出しは『恙蟲病』（つつがむしびょう：ダニによる感染症）と表記しているが、記事サマリーはシャーガス病（トリアトマ虫による感染症）について述べている。本トリアージはサマリーの内容（シャーガス病、サシガメ咬傷）に基づき評価した。中国での確認報告は極めて異常であり、詳細な検証とRRA実施が必要。患者の東南アジア滞在歴があるため国際的リンケージの評価も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Countries Tighten Travel Restrictions and Health Screening as Ebola Threat Raises Global Concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO, prompting tighter travel restrictions, enhanced airport screening, and quarantine measures. The alert seeks to limit spread to regions across North America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean. The United States expands entry rules to bar non-citizens and certain residents who recently traveled to affected areas, with airport temperature checks, travel history reviews, and symptom monitoring. Canada imposes a temporary ban on arrivals from affected countries and requires returning citizens and permanent residents from high-risk regions to complete a 21-day quarantine. Africa: Kenya activates enhanced screening and isolation facilities; Zambia broadens surveillance. Bahrain and Jordan suspend entry from affected areas. Asia: India steps up screening; Thailand designates an airport for health checks and quarantine depending on status. Caribbean: Bahamas and Cayman Islands add screening and quarantine. Europe remains cautious; airlines adjust routes.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ脅威が世界的懸念を引き起こす中、各国が渡航制限と健康スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHO による PHEIC 宣言、複数国での渡航制限と検疫措置実施、多地域での感染防止対策による国際的関心の高さから、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに多くの国が含まれているが、記事サマリーで実際にエボラ対応施策が記載されている対象国は DRC（主発生地）、Zambia、Thailand、India のみ。その他の国（米国、カナダ等）は対象国リストに含まれていないため excluded。WHO による PHEIC 宣言は最高レベルのシグナルであり、即座のピックアップが正当化される。

article.articleHeadline: KLM temporarily suspends Uganda flights as Ebola travel restrictions
article.articleSummary: KLM has temporarily suspended flights to and from Entebbe International Airport due to new Ebola-related travel and entry restrictions tied to the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. As of 2026-06-01, the move follows WHO’s declaration of the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, though not a pandemic. Flights Amsterdam–Entebbe with a Kigali layover were cancelled for May 30 and June 1, 2026; passengers will be rebooked or refunded. Entebbe itself is not deemed an active Ebola risk zone, but several countries require entry measures for travelers who recently passed through Uganda, now extended to airline crews. Uganda has also suspended flights to parts of DRC. The restrictions contribute to operational headaches for regional carriers; KLM will monitor developments and resume service once crew travel rules are clarified. US enhanced screening and other carriers such as Brussels Airlines and Emirates face related restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の渡航制限に伴い、KLMがウガンダへの便を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PAHEOICs宣言済みで、複数国への波及が既に生じている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理情報分析：発生地域にはウガンダ、ルワンダ、オランダ（アムステルダム）が含まれているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダとルワンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。本イベントの実質的な感染症発生地はDRCおよび非対象国のウガンダであり、オランダは航空規制の影響を受ける国。PAHEOICs宣言済み、複数国の渡航制限、航空便の運航停止など社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola scare in Italy: Congo returnee isolated as suspected case triggers emergency response, Europe on high alert
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, Italy is managing a suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, after a patient who returned from Congo became symptomatic and was isolated at Santissima Trinita hospital. The Ebola test has been performed and samples were sent by air ambulance to Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases in Rome for analysis, with results expected Sunday evening. Protective procedures are in place at Is Mirrionis hospital. The Italian government is coordinating with Sardinia’s authorities and Spallanzani to monitor the case as investigations continue. Prime Minister Meloni’s office said Italy will send a team of Spallanzani experts to Congo to bolster outbreak response and monitoring. The government urged Europe to strengthen border surveillance to curb cross-border spread amid concerns over Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BVD strain) in Congo and neighboring Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアでエボラ恐怖：コンゴからの帰国者が疑い患者として隔離、緊急対応が発動、ヨーロッパが警戒態勢へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの疑い患者であり、コンゴからの帰国者で既知の流行地域との関連性がある。政府レベルの対応と国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: イタリア（対象国外）での症例報告であるが、患者の起源はコンゴであり、コンゴのBundibugyo Ebola virus（BVD株）の流行との直接的な関連性がある。対象国はコンゴのみ。ウガンダも言及されているが、記事の主題はコンゴからの帰国者による疑い症例であるため、DRCのみ列挙。

article.articleHeadline: WHO priniesla povzbudivú správu. Piati zdravotníci porazili ebolu, epidémia v Kongu však naberá na sile
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO brings encouraging news. Five healthcare workers have beaten Ebola, but the Congo outbreak is gaining strength.
article.articleSummary: Five healthcare workers in Ituri’s Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, have recovered from Ebola, receiving discharge certificates from WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus; Baraka Bulambulu and Ezo Étienne are among the healed. The Congolese outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, continues to strengthen, with authorities citing slow detection, delayed isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials as major obstacles. In neighboring Uganda, authorities reported nine Ebola cases and closed the border with Congo to curb cross-border transmission. The virus variant Bundibugyo ebolavirus is relatively rare. The article notes lack of approved vaccines or therapies, and the remoteness of affected areas and ongoing conflict hinder response. Dieudonné Mwamba Kazadi, director of the National Institute of Public Health, called recoveries a significant sign that survival is possible with timely care in specialized facilities.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが励ましのニュースをもたらす。5人の医療従事者がエボラを克服したが、コンゴの流行は勢いを増している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、コンゴから隣国ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認され、国境閉鎖など渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダも報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀な変異体で、ワクチンや治療法の不足、紛争地域での対応困難が問題。5人の医療従事者の回復は肯定的だが、流行全体の拡大傾向が続いている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus: What treatments and vaccines are under development
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, the Ebola Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. About 906 cases and 223 suspected deaths have been reported, with the toll expected to rise. There are no approved BDBV treatments or vaccines yet. The leading candidate is the rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine, an experimental vector vaccine related to Ervebo; it is a single-dose shot with adverse effects within 72 hours and is slated for trials by early next year, with release years away. A second candidate, ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo from Oxford University and the Serum Institute of India, could enter efficacy testing within 2–3 months; dosing may be single-dose for contacts and two-dose for high-risk unexposed groups. Other candidates include Moderna's mRNA BDBV vaccine, MBP134 antibody therapy, maftivimab, survivor-derived antibodies, obeldesivir; WHO also recommends evaluating a monoclonal antibody-remdesivir combination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：開発中の治療法とワクチン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラBDBV流行であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Ebola Bundibugyo virus (BDBV)のWHO PHEIC宣言済み流行。DRCで906症例・223疑い死亡報告。記事はワクチン・治療開発の進展状況を扱うが、インドはワクチン候補開発の実施機関（Serum Institute）の拠点であり、発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: o que se sabe sobre os casos suspeitos no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: What Is Known About Suspected Cases in Brazil
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola virus disease cases are under investigation in Brazil, in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, involving travelers from Africa; no confirmed cases yet. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo was admitted with diarrhea and rapid clinical decline; he required intubation. While Adolfo Lutz confirmed meningococcal meningitis, Ebola-specific tests are ongoing. In Rio de Janeiro, a man who had recently been in Uganda presented with diarrhea, chills, and cough and is isolated at Evandro Chagas Institute; malaria was diagnosed, but Ebola remains under observation until laboratory results definitively exclude it. Contact tracing and broader surveillance are in place. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever identified in 1976 (Sudan and DRC); incubation 2-21 days; transmission via bodily fluids; no widely available vaccine; global pandemic risk is considered low. No confirmed cases in Brazil to date.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病：ブラジルで疑い例について既知の情報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の疑い例が複数国（DRC、ウガンダからの帰国者）に関連し、ブラジルで検査中。確定例はないが、高致死性病原体の越境リスクを示唆。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジルの疑い例。DRCとウガンダからの帰国者が関連するため、DRCは対象国に含める。スーダンはサマリーに言及されるが当該イベントの発生地ではないため除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに未含。現在疑い例段階だが、エボラウイルス病の越境リスク（高致死性、ヒト-ヒト感染可能、アフリカ発生源）により即時注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz descarta suspeita de ebola em paciente isolado no RJ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz Rules Out Suspected Ebola in a Patient in Isolation in Rio de Janeiro
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected in a patient in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, was ruled out by Fiocruz; the man, from Uganda, arrived at the Instituto Nacional de Infectologia Evandro Chagas after presenting cough, chills, and diarrhea. He reached the facility late Saturday; due to recent Ebola activity in Uganda, isolation and testing began. Early lab results indicated malaria; further tests at the Oswaldo Cruz Institute using blood, saliva, and urine samples confirmed no Ebola infection. The patient left isolation and continues malaria treatment. Fiocruz notes Brazil's Ebola risk remains low. Separately, São Paulo authorities continue investigating another case: a migrant from the Democratic Republic of Congo admitted to the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas; Neisseria meningitidis detected, meningococcal meningitis identified, but Ebola testing remains pending, with definitive results expected on 1 June 2026. No Ebola transmission reported in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruz、リオデジャネイロで隔離された患者のエボラ疑い例を除外
triage.triage_reason: 複数疾患（エボラ、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎、マラリア、シャーガス病）が報告され、うち髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が確認された事例を含む。エボラは除外されたが、DRC由来患者からの髄膜炎菌検出と未検査のエボラテストが存在する。情報が部分的であり、継続モニタリングが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、ウガンダからの患者がリオデジャネイロ到着時にエボラが除外され、マラリアと診断された。別途、DRC からの移民患者がサンパウロで髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎として確認されたが、エボラテスト結果は2026年6月1日に予定されている。IHR基準3項目に該当し、WPRO基準も3項目該当するが、エボラ確認例がないこと、DRC患者のエボラテスト結果が未報告であること、社会政治的関心の程度が不明確であることから、WATCH判定とした。DRC患者のエボラテスト結果確認待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Comunidad de África Oriental convoca reunión urgente por brote de ébola - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East African Community calls for urgent meeting over Ebola outbreak - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: East African Community (EAC) convenes an urgent virtual meeting (Monday–Tuesday) with Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Somalia to coordinate immediate measures against Ebola virus disease. The alert began May 15 after reports from the DRC of the Bundibugyo strain, with a case fatality rate of about 30–50%. The DRC reports 246 suspected deaths linked to the 17th Ebola outbreak in its territory, while Uganda confirms one death in an imported case, per Africa CDC. The EAC groups will address rapid containment actions and convene Technical Working Groups on communicable and non-communicable diseases, plus teams evaluating vaccines, therapies, diagnostics, and complementary countermeasures. The bloc reiterates its commitment to strengthened regional health cooperation and a unified emergency response to great-impact health threats.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行に関する緊急会議を開催する東アフリカ共同体 - teleSUR
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の複数国での確認、DRCで246人の死亡報告、ウガンダで輸入症例による死亡が報告され、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。東アフリカ共同体が緊急会議を招集するほどの国際的対応が進行中であり、重大なシグナルと判定される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから提供された発生地域にはスーダン、ルワンダ、ソマリア、タンザニア、ケニア、ブルンジ、ウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは確認された事例はDRC（246人の死亡・17次流行）とウガンダ（輸入症例による1人の死亡）のみ。他国は緊急会議の参加国として言及されているが、実際の流行事例の発生は明記されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定した。ウガンダは輸入症例の発生地として含めるべきだが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情：無國界醫生擴大救援行動應對疫情迅速發展 | 全球企業動態 | 商情 | 經濟日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak: Doctors Without Borders expands relief efforts in response to rapid developments of the outbreak | Global Business Dynamics | Business News | Economic Daily
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is facing an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. As of May 28, 125 confirmed cases, 906 suspected cases, and 223 deaths have been reported, though figures are provisional due to limited testing and access. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. MSF and the Ministry of Health warn the outbreak is outpacing response capacity amid border closures and transport restrictions. In Ituri, MSF is building a 65-bed Ebola treatment center and supporting Mongbwalu and Rwampara health zones, plus Fataki hospital, with isolation for suspected cases and strengthened infection prevention at Bunia’s Salama hospital. In North Kivu, an 80-bed center operates in Goma; isolation wards exist in Walikale, Mweso, Rutshuru, and Kyeshero, with a field team in Butembo. In South Kivu, Bukavu and Lwiro host two treatment centers. Hundreds of tons of supplies have arrived; rapid case finding, testing, and maintaining essential health services are crucial in the coming weeks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国エボラ出血熱疫情：国境なき医師団が疫情の急速な発展に対応して救援活動を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）による確認症例125例、死亡223例が報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明らかであり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ・ルワンダとの国境地域）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、緊急のフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルスによる出血熱であり、ザイール型ではなく治療法・ワクチンが限定される。Ituri、Nord-Kivu、South Kivu州での多地点の同時発生。MSFが治療センター拡張中だが、疫学的データが暫定的であり実数はより高い可能性がある。ウガンダ・ルワンダとの国境地域での発生のため国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola cases rise to 282 as survivors share hope amid ongoing outbreak
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached 282 confirmed cases, with 264 in Ituri province. Over 1,000 suspected infections are linked to the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists. As of 1 June 2026, contact tracing coverage stands at 45%, with 220 suspected cases under active investigation. Operational gaps include delays in early detection, slower isolation of confirmed patients, incomplete contact tracing, unsafe burial practices, and weakened infection prevention in healthcare facilities. Five survivors—four nurses and one laboratory technician—have recovered, and certificates were presented by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus at a new Ebola treatment center in Bunia. Uganda reports nine cases and has closed its border with the DRC to slow cross-border transmission. Reported symptoms include hypotension and vomiting; current management remains supportive rather than antiviral.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス患者数が282人に増加、サバイバーが流行中の希望を共有
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認患者282人（疑い例1,000人以上）、国際的拡大（ウガンダで9症例）、ワクチン・治療なしのBundibugyo株など、IHR基準3項目該当およびWPRO基準全項目該当。公衆衛生への重大な脅威。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも9症例報告されているが、記事の主題はDRC（Ituri州Bunia市）での流行。ウガンダはWPRO対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。ワクチン・特異的治療なしのBundibugyo株による流行は高リスク。接触者追跡率45%、医療施設での感染予防の弱化など運用上の課題が複数指摘されており、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情延燒! 巴西出現疑似病例 剛果累積逾千例通報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak continues to spread! Brazil reports suspected cases; Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 1,000 cumulative cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread. In DRC, 282 cumulative cases and 42 deaths have been reported; the WHO designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17. In Brazil, health authorities on May 30-31 intercepted two feverish travelers: a 37-year-old man from Congo in São Paulo state, hospitalized with fever; initial Ebola test negative but final results pending. A second man from Uganda arriving in Rio de Janeiro state presented with cough, chills, and diarrhea; malaria diagnosed May 30 night and Ebola testing on May 31 was negative; he remains isolated pending epidemiologic investigation. São Paulo officials say the risk of introduction or spread is very low. The outbreak source remains Congo; reports of Congo-travel history in Sardinia and warnings from MSF raise concerns of international spread. No approved Ebola vaccine exists; timely proper care can improve survival, per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が拡大継続！ブラジルで疑似病例報告；コンゴ民主共和国では累計千例を超す通報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC指定した活動的なエボラアウトブレイク。対象国DRC及びBrazilで確認例あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラアウトブレイクはDRCで発生し(282例，42死)、WHOがPHEIC指定(5月17日)。ブラジルではコンゴ渡航歴のある男性がサンパウロ州で確認、ウガンダ渡航歴のある男性がリオデジャネイロ州で確認。両者とも初期検査は陰性だが最終結果は確定待ち。Sardegnaに関する言及はBrazilイベントの国際拡大懸念の文脈であり、実際の確認例ではないため対象国リストに含まれるイタリアは除外。DRCとBrazilのみ verified_locations に列挙。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор оценил вероятность появления лихорадки Эбола в России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor assessed the likelihood of Ebola fever appearing in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease risk to Russia remains extremely low as of June 1, 2026. Rospotrebnadzor reports the overall epidemiological situation in Russia is stable. Anna Popova, head of the agency, said teams have been in Uganda for more than a week to study the current outbreak, monitor patients under observation, and perform analyses to prevent any spillover into Russia. Ebola is caused by ebolaviruses, including Ebola virus and Bundibugyo ebolavirus. In May 2026, a significant Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak occurred in the Democratic Republic of Congo and was declared a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Symptoms typically include fever, headache, myalgia, and vomiting 2–21 days after exposure, with transmission requiring direct contact with infected bodily fluids. Russia continues surveillance and urges avoidance of outbreak zones and use of personal protective equipment when near suspected cases or contaminated sites.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナドゾール、ロシアへのエボラ熱出現の可能性を評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCで宣言されたWHO PHEIC (Bundibugyo ebolavirus)に関連し、複数国での監視体制が構築されている。
triage.notes: DRCで発生したBundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak が2026年5月にWHO PHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダでの現地調査チーム展開および同国での患者監視が報告されているが、記事本体ではウガンダでの実際の患者発生は明示されていない。DRCのみ確認可能。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: सिरसा : रेबीज संक्रमण से महिला की मौत, दो महीने पहले कुत्ते ने हाथ पर काटा था, टीका न लगवाने पर फैला संक्रमण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sirsa: Woman dies of rabies infection; two months ago a dog bit her on the hand, and the infection spread because she did not get vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Rabies case in Haryana: A 35-year-old woman, Manpreet Kaur, died from rabies contracted after a dog bite two months earlier in Dabwali's Mahagram Desujodha village, Sirsa district, Haryana. The bite on her hand produced only a minor wound, leading her family to forgo vaccination and post-exposure prophylaxis. As the rabies virus progressed to the brain, she developed neurological symptoms, including slurred speech. She was initially treated at a private Dabwali hospital and later transferred to AIIMS Bathinda in Punjab, where she died in the ICU on Monday. Her body was brought back to Desujodha. The case underscores the delay in seeking vaccination after animal bites and has spurred renewed local awareness, with residents reportedly seeking vaccines promptly after bites.

triage.headline_ja: シルサ：狂犬病感染で女性死亡。2ヶ月前に犬に手を咬まれたが、ワクチン接種を受けなかったため感染が広がった
triage.triage_reason: 散発的な狂犬病死亡例であり、IHR基準は2つ以上該当しない。ただしワクチン接種遅延の課題が明らかになり、地域的な関心が高まっているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一の散発的死亡例。狂犬病は既知の疾患であり異常ではない。ただし、ワクチン接種アクセスの遅延という公衆衛生的課題と地域での認識向上の努力が報告されている。フルRRAは不要だが、インドにおける狂犬病ワクチン接種体制の脆弱性を示す事例として記録価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: 考生健康莫忽视！永州疾控发布六月健康提示：气温升高蚊虫活跃，虫媒、肠道、流感进入高发期_健康_永州站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't neglect examinee health! Yongzhou CDC issues June health tips: As temperatures rise, mosquitoes become more active; vector-borne diseases, gastrointestinal illnesses, and influenza enter peak season — Health — Yongzhou Station
article.articleSummary: June health tips from Yongzhou CDC warn of a peak season as heat and humidity rise. Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) remains a concern for children under five; EV71 vaccine is recommended; emphasize handwashing, disinfection of bottles and toys, and avoiding crowded venues during outbreaks. Summer elevates risks for vector-borne diseases: dengue and chikungunya by mosquitoes; tick-borne thrombocytopenia syndrome by ticks. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water, screens and nets, protective clothing, repellents, and proper tick removal. Gastrointestinal infections and food poisoning rise in heat; prevent via hand hygiene, separating raw and cooked foods, thorough cooking, refrigerating leftovers, and avoiding wild mushrooms or toxic seafood. Rabies risk increases with more outdoor animals; keep pets vaccinated, avoid stray animals, and rinse wounds promptly before seeking care. Influenza activity in Yongzhou is higher than 2025; vaccination and masking advised. Also advise examinees on sleep and stress management.

triage.headline_ja: 受験生の健康を軽視するな！永州疾病対策センターが6月の健康警告を発表：気温上昇に伴い蚊が活発化、媒介昆虫病・腸道疾患・インフルエンザが高発期に突入
triage.triage_reason: 複数の疾患が列挙されているが、記事は予防啓発・公衆衛生情報であり、現在の具体的な集団発生事例の報告ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はYongzhouの疾病対策センター（CDC）による季節的な予防啓発情報。HFMD、EV71、デング熱、チクングニア、SFTS、狂犬病、インフルエンザなど複数の疾患が言及されているが、現在の急性集団発生の報告ではなく、夏季における通常の公衆衛生リスク警告である。ただし「Yongzhouのインフルエンザ活動が2025年より高い」との記載があり、継続的な監視を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola lây lan với tốc độ "chưa từng có": Ghi nhận 250 người tử vong, hơn 1.000 ca bệnh tại khu vực Trung Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading at an unprecedented rate: 250 deaths recorded, more than 1,000 cases in the Central Africa region.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Central Africa has caused 250 deaths and over 1,000 cases, spreading faster than response capabilities. The outbreak involves a rare Bundibugyo strain in DRC, with over 1,000 cases and 250 deaths. Doctors Without Borders warns this outbreak is unprecedented in speed and scale since its declaration; MSF's Dr. Alan Gonzalez says the scope remains unknown and responders lag behind transmission. Brazil is investigating two suspected cases: a 37-year-old man from DRC in São Paulo isolated after meeting Ebola criteria, and a man from Uganda in Rio de Janeiro with symptoms. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or wildlife; symptoms include nausea, rash, and bleeding from ears, eyes, nose, or mouth. No Bundibugyo vaccine. WHO advises against border closures; US bans entry for noncitizens from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, while Rwanda and Uganda have closed borders; Tedros warns such measures undermine transparency.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が「前例のないペースで」拡大：中央アフリカ地域で250人が死亡、1,000件以上の感染例が報告されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常・予想外な状況」「国際的な拡大リスク」が該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当し、さらに国際的な関心が高い。DRCでの主要な流行に加えブラジルでの疑い例検出は、国際的な拡散リスクを示唆する。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にはセントラルアフリカ、スーダン、ウガンダ、ルワンダなど複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーでの主要流行はDRCと明記されている。ブラジルでの疑い例2件（サンパウロの男性、リオデジャネイロの男性）が記載されており、DRCおよびブラジルのみが対象国リストに該当するため verified_locations に含めた。Bundibugyo株は稀な株であり、ワクチン未開発という点が管理可能性の低さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: News: Police urge compliance with Ebola measures for Martyrs
article.articleSummary: Surveillance and enforcement efforts accompany Uganda’s Ebola response amid a cross-border outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo strain. Uganda and the DRC report ongoing transmission, with 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths in DRC and seven confirmed Ugandan cases with one death; first Ugandan cases involved people crossing from DRC seeking treatment. The outbreak, declared May 15, centers in eastern DRC’s Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, raising cross-border concerns. To limit spread, Martyrs Day commemorations on June 3 will be held at parish level instead of the usual large gatherings; worship and prayers will occur with Ministry of Health guidelines on sanitisation, distancing and avoiding contact. Police briefings note active enforcement of movement restrictions and Ebola response participation at national, district, and sector levels. An extraordinary EAC health ministers’ meeting (June 1–2, 2026) will strengthen surveillance, diagnosis, IPC and risk communication with Africa CDC and WHO support.

triage.headline_ja: 警察、烈士の日のエボラ対策への遵守を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：246死亡、異常：国境を越えた新規流行、国際的拡大リスク：ウガンダへの越境感染、渡航制限：移動制限実施中）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。多国間（DRC・ウガンダ）での死亡者を伴う確認事例あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題は DRC でのエボラ流行および越境感染であり、ウガンダは影響を受ける隣国として言及されている。GeoNames ID 226074（Uganda）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリーの焦点は DRC の流行（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu）にあり、ウガンダの症例は越境感染として扱われているため、verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。DRC は対象国リストに含まれ、エボラ流行の現在進行中の事例が明確に記述されている。EAC 保健相会議（6月1-2日）開催予定、WHO・Africa CDC支援による地域レベルの対応強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, collaborazione tra OMS e Repubblica Democratica del Congo per lo sviluppo di un nuovo vaccino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, collaboration between WHO and the Democratic Republic of the Congo for the development of a new vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) advances amid international collaboration as the World Health Organization partners with Congolese authorities to develop an Ebola vaccine. The announcement follows a mission to Bunia, epicenter of the current transmission, led by Congo's Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba and Communications Minister Patrick Muyaya, with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. No licensed vaccine or specific therapy exists yet, but epidemiological data indicate survival is possible: case fatality rates range from 30% to 50%. Health authorities emphasize that proven public health measures remain effective to curb transmission and support recovery. The outbreak marks the seventeenth wave since the virus's initial identification in 1976. Ongoing collaboration aims to accelerate prevention and emergency management in conflict-affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：新規ワクチン開発のためのWHOとコンゴ民主共和国の協力
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数項目該当。エボラ出血熱の流行拡大と国際的な対応が進行中であり、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: DRC東部（イトゥリ州ブニア）でのエボラ出血熱の第17波。致死率30～50%。WHO事務局長を含む国際的な対応が進行中。ワクチン開発に向けた緊急的な国際協力が進められている。

article.articleHeadline: Három Ebola-oltás fejlesztését gyorsítják a vírus terjedése miatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The development of three Ebola vaccines is being accelerated due to the spread of the virus.
article.articleSummary: CEPI is accelerating three experimental vaccines against Bundibugyo Ebola virus amid outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Bundibugyo Ebola has no licensed vaccine, and the outbreak has at least 282 confirmed cases and about 1,000 suspected cases. WHO named these three candidates the most promising among Ebola vaccines under development. CEPI plans up to $50 million for Moderna’s candidate (preclinical work and Phase 1 trials) using the proven mRNA platform; up to $8.6 million for an Oxford University/SII candidate to fund preclinical work and Phase 1 prep; and up to $3.2 million for an IAVI candidate that uses the rVSV platform. Manufacturing will take place at Serum Institute of India. While vaccines progress, WHO emphasizes stopping transmission through surveillance, testing, contact tracing, isolation and care, infection prevention, community engagement, and safe burials. WHO DG Tedros and Africa CDC chief Kaseya welcomed the move.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの拡大によるアフリカでの3つのエボラワクチン開発の加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、Bundibugyo Ebolavirus による DRC・ウガンダでの実際のアウトブレイク（確認症例282例以上、疑い症例約1,000例）が進行中。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、Bundibugyo Ebolavirus のアウトブレイクは DRC とウガンダで発生中だが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。インド（1269750）は製造地（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているが、アウトブレイク発生地ではないため除外。CEPI による国際的なワクチン開発加速と WHO の支援表明により、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil investigates possible Ebola cases amid scramble to contain oubreak
article.articleSummary: June 1, 2026 — Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation as of May 30. DRC and Uganda report 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths; WHO tracker shows 291 confirmed cases in the region, up from 128/17 a week earlier. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, Ituri Province, noting survivors can recover with timely healthcare even without vaccines or therapeutics. Four nurses and a laboratory worker have recovered, bringing total DR Congo recoveries to five. MSF warns the response cannot keep pace with rapid spread. Africa CDC cites regional spread risk and urges rapid detection, isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials. Brazil probes two suspected cases (Sao Paulo: meningitis; Rio de Janeiro: malaria). Italy’s Cagliari case, a Congo returnee, tested negative. The outbreak was declared a public health emergency of international concern last month.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、発生の抑制に奔走する中、エボラの可能性のある症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスの継続的な流行により1,100以上の疑い症例、263確認症例、43死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生的影響は極めて重大。複数国への国際拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクも高く、既にPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bluedot API発行の地域情報にはイタリア、ウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーでのイタリア（カリアリ）は濃厚接触者追跡事例であり、ウガンダは確認症例報告地であるが、対象国リストに未含含。主要な発生国はDRC（Bunia, Ituri州）。ブラジルの2疑い症例は調査中だが、最終確認待ち。既にWHO Director-General訪問、PHEIC宣言済みの重大事象。MSFが対応能力不足を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Teadlased püüavad ennetada ebolat esmakordselt viirusevastase tabletiga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists aim to prevent Ebola for the first time with an antiviral tablet.
article.articleSummary: Ebola antiviral trial launches in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kongo region) and Uganda, testing the oral drug obeldesiviir as post-exposure prophylaxis for individuals exposed to the bundibugyo Ebola strain, which currently lacks an effective vaccine. Outbreaks have resulted in over 200 deaths and around a thousand suspected cases. The aim is to interrupt transmission by giving exposed high-risk contacts two doses daily for ten days, potentially reducing the burden on public health surveillance and encouraging earlier care. Obeldesiviir, developed during the COVID era, is an oral prodrug that mimics ATP to inhibit viral replication and is easier to use in Africa due to intestinal absorption. Animal studies showed 80–100% survival in monkeys treated within 24 hours against Zaire/Sudan strains and Marburg; however, Bundibugyo has not yet been tested. The trial faces ethical questions, including placebo use and vaccine confounding, with WHO not endorsing a Zaire-vaccine arm given data gaps. If effective, this could mark a breakthrough in outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らがエボラウイルス対策として初めてウイルス対策錠剤で予防を目指している
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染の現在の流行（200以上の死亡、約1000の疑い例）が確認されており、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常/予想外性」「国際的拡大のリスク」に該当。新規治療薬の臨床試験開始という異例の展開も伴っている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダで流行が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみを検証済み地域として列挙した。エボラとマールブルグウイルス病が同時に言及されているが、現在の流行はBundibugyo Ebola株（ウガンダに関連）が主体。新規経口抗ウイルス薬obeldesivirの初期臨床試験開始という点で予防医学上の重要な進展を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Sağlık kurumu, virüs yayılırken üç Ebola aşısını hızlandırıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The health authority is accelerating three Ebola vaccines as the virus spreads.
article.articleSummary: CEPI accelerates three experimental Ebola vaccines targeting Bundibugyo virus amid an outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. With no licensed vaccine, CEPI pledges to advance three candidates—Moderna's mRNA vaccine (preclinical and Phase 1) up to $50 million; University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India (SII) collaboration using preclinical and Phase 1 support up to $8.6 million; International AIDS Vaccine Initiative (IAIVI) with up to $3.2 million for a rVSV-based candidate sharing the platform of the approved rVSV-ZEBOV vaccine. WHO calls these three candidates among the most promising Ebola vaccines. Funding aims to deliver safe and effective vaccines to help contain the outbreak. The rVSV platform has been used for other pathogens. As of Sunday, the DRC reported at least 282 confirmed Bundibugyo cases and about 1,000 probable cases. CEPI’s investments accompany emphasis on surveillance, rapid testing, isolation, infection prevention, community engagement, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: 保健機関がウイルス拡大に伴い3つのエボラワクチンを加速している
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）のアウトブレイクがDRCとウガンダで発生しており、確定症例282例、疑い症例約1,000例と相当規模である。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な状況、国際的拡大リスクが認められ、IHR基準3つ以上を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダでのアウトブレイク、およびインドの血清研究所（SII）がワクチン開発に参画していることが明記されている。ウガンダはスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの出現は異常であり、ワクチン開発の国際的加速と相まって、高い優先度でRRA対象とすべき事象。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil Investigates Possible Ebola Cases Amid Scramble To Contain Oubreak
article.articleSummary: Brazil investigates possible Ebola cases amid scramble to contain outbreak. In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda, more than 1,100 suspected Ebola cases were under investigation as of May 30, with 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths; the WHO tracker later cited 291 confirmed cases. WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern and described it as one of the largest, third only to earlier outbreaks. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to inspect treatment facilities and urged timely care even without vaccines for Bundibugyo-strain Ebola. Four nurses and a laboratory worker previously recovered, bringing total recoveries in the DRC to five. MSF warned that the outbreak is outpacing response. Brazil reported two suspected Ebola cases: Sao Paulo (tested positive for meningitis) and Rio de Janeiro (malaria); neither was Ebola. Italy reported a suspected case in Sardinia (Cagliari) that tested negative.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、アウトブレイク封じ込めの混乱の中でエボラの可能性のあるケースを調査
triage.triage_reason: WHO により公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）が宣言されたエボラアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。DRC及びウガンダで291確認例、43死亡と重症度が高く、ブラジル・イタリアへの国際的拡大懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、実際のエボラ発生は DRC（Bunia）及びウガンダであり、ブラジル（2例疑い例、陰性判定）とイタリア（1例疑い例、陰性判定）は疑い例の報告に過ぎない。対象国リストに該当するのは DRC と Brazil のみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、MSF による懸念表明あり、Bundibugyo株という比較的稀な株系統。フルRRAへの進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola crisis: Five people discharged from hospital in DR Congo after recovering from virus
article.articleSummary: Five people discharged from hospital in DRC after recovering from Bundibugyo Ebola, a strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the recoveries in Bunia: four discharged today and one yesterday. The DRC–Uganda outbreak has been designated a public health emergency of concern. Brazil is examining two suspected Ebola cases: in São Paulo, a Congolese man who recently returned from DRC tested positive for meningitis; in Rio de Janeiro, a person who travelled to Uganda tested positive for malaria. Italian protocols were activated in Cagliari after a DRC arrival; the man tested negative and risk remains low. As of Saturday, 263 confirmed cases and more than 1,100 suspected across DRC and Uganda, with 43 confirmed deaths. MSF warns the outbreak continues to outpace containment, calling for expanded testing, faster deployment and guaranteed supplies. Tedros stresses community involvement: Ebola can be stopped and patients can recover.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機：コンゴ民主共和国の病院からウイルスから回復した5人が退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による進行中の公衆衛生上の懸念事案であり、DRC・ウガンダでの確認症例と死亡例の報告がある。
triage.notes: DRC・ウガンダでの進行中のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）は公式にPHEIC指定されている。ブラジルでの疑い例は陰性確認されているが、イタリアでも防疫措置が実施された。MSFは封じ込めが追いつかないと警告。対象国リスト外のウガンダ・イタリアに関連情報があるが、verified_locationsは実際に症例が報告されている対象国のみで構成。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola sílí: Kongo hlásí stovky případů, sousední stát už nekompromisně zavřel hranice
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola on the rise: Congo reports hundreds of cases, the neighboring country has already closed its borders decisively.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 282 confirmed Ebola cases, with more than 1,000 suspected. The outbreak centers in the eastern Ituri province, with 264 confirmed cases, and Bunia, the provincial capital, where health workers are among the affected. Five infected health workers recovered and were discharged, with two additional workers testing negative on follow-up. Healthcare workers are among the most affected; timely care in specialized facilities is cited as enabling recovery. Slow case-finding hampers isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials. Uganda reports nine Ebola cases and has closed its border with Congo amid cross-border concerns. The Bundibugyo virus strain is relatively rare. Challenges include lack of approved vaccines and therapies, remoteness of affected areas, and ongoing violence.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが急増：コンゴが数百例を報告、隣国はすでに断固として国境を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの多国間での確認拡大、重大な公衆衛生への影響、及び緊急の国際対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの事例報告があるが、記事サマリーはDRCが主題であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。282確定例、1,000以上の疑い例、Ituri州に集中、Bundibugyo株は稀な株。ワクチンと治療薬の欠如、紛争地域での対応困難、保健医療従事者への影響が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola pare să dea înapoi. Cinci cazuri de vindecare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak appears to be retreating. Five recoveries.
article.articleSummary: Five recovered Ebola patients discharged from Bunia hospital in Ituri, DR Congo, as ongoing outbreak driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus continues. The current outbreak has surpassed 1,000 suspected Ebola cases with at least 246 deaths in the DRC, with the epicenter in Ituri and spillovers into North and South Kivu; Uganda reports nine confirmed cases and one death, with some testing conducted outside Africa. A Sunday ceremony honored four nurses among the recoveries; the first survivor, a laboratory worker, had left hospital the previous week. Health workers remain on the front line, facing high exposure. Officials credit early detection, medical care, contact tracing, and community engagement for progress. The outbreak marks the 17th Ebola crisis in DR Congo’s history, and some cases have been detected outside Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が収束に向かっているようだ。5例の回復事例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。1,000例超の疑い例、246例以上の死亡、複数国での確認、ウガンダへの流行波及により。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行。DRCが主たる発生地であり、イツリ地域が震源。ウガンダへの流行波及（9確定例、1死亡）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。既に報告されている検査例がアフリカ外でも検出されている点で国際的拡大の懸念がある。回復例の増加は前向きな兆候だが、引き続き危機的状況である。

article.articleHeadline: Entidade de saúde acelera três vacinas contra o Ébola em expansão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health agency accelerates three Ebola vaccines as outbreak expands.
article.articleSummary: CEPI accelerates urgent development of three experimental vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola as the Central Africa outbreak expands in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The three vaccine candidates, identified by the World Health Organization as the most promising, are from Moderna (mRNA platform), the University of Oxford, and the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative (IAVI), to be produced at Serum Institute of India (SII). CEPI has earmarked up to $50 million for Moderna’s preclinical and Phase 1 work; up to $8.6 million for Oxford/SII preclinical and Phase 1 activities; and up to $3.2 million for IAVI using the rVSV platform linked to the Ebola Zaire vaccine. The outbreak has at least 282 confirmed cases and about 1,000 suspected. In parallel, WHO emphasizes traditional measures—surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention, community engagement, and safe burials—to curb transmission while vaccines are developed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の拡大に伴い保健機関が3つのエボラワクチンを加速
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR指定疾患であり、中央アフリカの複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）での確認例282件以上、疑い例1,000件、国際的ワクチン開発対応という重大な公衆衛生上の影響が認識されている。IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは中央アフリカ地域（Central Africa）の発生として述べられており、具体的な発生国はDRCとウガンダと記載されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。インドについては、記事ではSerum Institute of India (SII)が製造を担当する旨が述べられているが、感染症イベント発生地ではなく、ワクチン製造国として言及されているため含めない。エボラ出血熱はIHR 2005 Annex 2の指定疾患であり、確認例282件、疑い例1,000件の規模と複数国での発生、国際的ワクチン開発対応により4つのIHR基準全てが該当する。

article.articleHeadline: نهاد بهداشتی توسعه سه واکسن ابولا را با تداوم شیوع شتاب می‌دهد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Agency Accelerates Development of Three Ebola Vaccines Amid Ongoing Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: CEPI accelerates three experimental vaccines targeting Bundibugyo virus Ebola amid an ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of June 1, 2026, at least 282 confirmed cases and about 1,000 suspected cases have been reported. The three candidates come from Moderna (mRNA platform), a U.K.-Oxford University and Serum Institute of India collaboration, and an rVSV-based approach from the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative (IAVI). CEPI will fund up to $50 million for the Moderna candidate, up to $8.6 million for the Oxford/SII effort, and up to $3.2 million for IAVI. WHO identifies these vaccines as the most promising options to curb the outbreak and bolster future preparedness. In the meantime, the response relies on established measures: surveillance, testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention, community engagement, and safe and dignified burials.

triage.headline_ja: 保健機関がエボラアウトブレイク継続の中、3つのエボラワクチンの開発を加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。アクティブなエボラ流行で確認症例282例、疑い症例1000例以上、複数国での発生。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行。インドはワクチン開発に参加（セラム・インスティチュート・オブ・インディア）するが、アウトブレイク発生地ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみを含める（ウガンダは対象国リストに未含）。イギリスとインドはワクチン開発国として言及されるが、記事サマリーの地理的な流行地はDRCとウガンダに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/Inter/ La RDC et l'OMS accentuent la mobilisation contre l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/Inter/ The DRC and the WHO intensify mobilization against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain prompts intensified mobilization as of May 31, 2026. The response covers the north‑east and east DRC, with ongoing cases reported in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Authorities are strengthening surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, prevention, infection prevention and control, patient management, and active case and contact finding, while renewing operational coordination and accelerating resource mobilization to reach affected communities. Emphasis is placed on community trust, engagement, and leadership, with dialogue ongoing with community leaders, youth, women, religious figures, and civil society to foster adherence to preventive measures. Communities are advised to practice regular handwashing, seek care early, and share verified information. The Bundibugyo strain poses challenges due to no licensed vaccine or approved specific treatment, though public health measures remain effective; rapid clinical trials for vaccines and candidate therapies are being pursued with Africa CDC, the UN system, and partners.

triage.headline_ja: コートジボワール-AIP/国際：DRCとWHOがエボラ流行に対する動員を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当する。Bundibugyo株による新規エボラアウトブレイク、複数州での継続的な症例報告、ワクチン・治療法がない株による重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的な拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイクは2018-2020年西アフリカ流行以来の重要な新規シグナル。ライセンス化されたワクチンや承認治療がないことが懸念を増幅。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivuの複数州での継続的な症例報告。WHO及びAfrica CDCとの国際的な対応枠組みが構築されている。本イベントは緊急RRA対象として最優先対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود تعبر عن قلقها من تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders expresses concern about the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns of an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province. Two weeks after the outbreak was declared, the situation is highly worrying for communities and health workers, with a large number of cases appearing in a short period. Dr. Alan Gonzalez, MSF Deputy Director of Operations, notes this outbreak involves a rare Ebola virus with no licensed vaccines or specific treatments, making diagnosis difficult due to limited capacity to conduct tests. The inability to ascertain the outbreak's true size and severity poses a major challenge, underscoring the need for a rapid and effective international response to curb transmission and meet the needs of affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行について懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的脅威として明確なシグナル。治療法・ワクチンなし、検査能力不足、急速な患者増加など重大な公衆衛生上の懸念。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健上の脅威。記事で「稀なエボラウイルス」「ワクチンなし」「治療法なし」「検査能力の限界」と明記され、2週間で多数の患者が発生している緊急事態。MSFが正式な懸念表明をしている。コンゴ民主共和国はWHO東南アジア地域外だが、IHR基準を完全満たすため優先度最高。

article.articleHeadline: Un organisme de santé accélère trois vaccins contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A health organization accelerates three vaccines against Ebola
article.articleSummary: CEPI accelerates three experimental vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola as the outbreak expands in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The three candidates—Moderna's mRNA vaccine, an Oxford University–SII platform vaccine, and IAVI's rVSV vaccine—will be manufactured by Serum Institute of India. CEPI is providing up to $50 million for Moderna's preclinical and Phase 1 work, up to $8.6 million for Oxford/SII, and up to $3.2 million for IAVI. The WHO identified these candidates as the most promising in development. The outbreak has at least 282 confirmed cases and about 1,000 suspected cases. In parallel, WHO emphasizes stopping transmission through surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, patient care, infection prevention, community engagement, and safe, dignified burials. Leaders from WHO and Africa CDC welcomed the funding as timely for Africa's health and vaccine capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 保健機関がエボラ対策の3つのワクチンを加速
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の流行がDRCとウガンダで拡大中。282確認例・約1,000疑い例を伴う重篤な公衆衛生危機であり、国際的なワクチン開発支援が展開されている点から、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただしサマリーではDRCとウガンダで流行が拡大中との記述あり。インドは製造拠点（Serum Institute of India）として言及されており、ワクチン開発の国際協力の一部として識別。エボラBundibugyo株の流行は極めて高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Aceleran nuevas vacunas contra el ébola ante el avance del virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola vaccines accelerate as the Ebola virus advances.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, CEPI announced urgent acceleration of three experimental vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola as the Central African outbreak expands in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and into Uganda. The three candidates—Moderna (mRNA platform), Oxford University/SII, and IAVI (rVSV-based)—will be manufactured by the Serum Institute of India. CEPI has allocated up to $50 million for Moderna preclinical and Phase I trials, up to $8.6 million for Oxford/SII preclinical and Phase I work, and up to $3.2 million for IAVI. The WHO identified these vaccines as the most promising. With at least 282 laboratory-confirmed cases and about 1,000 suspected cases, priority remains stopping transmission using established tools: surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection control, community engagement, and safe burials. The platforms carry prior safety data and have shown efficacy signals against Zaire, Sudan Ebola and Marburg in preclinical/clinical studies.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの進行に伴い、新しいエボラワクチンを加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4該当。エボラ・マールブルグの確認症例と疑い症例が多数、中央アフリカからの国際的拡大進行中、ワクチン開発の緊急加速を要する重大事態。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ・マールブルグ株の発生は DRC とウガンダ（対象国外）で確認されており、ワクチン製造は血清研究所（インド）が担当するため、DRC と India を verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。CEPI による緊急資金配分（$50M+）と WHO の認可候補ワクチンの動向から、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事案として位置付けられる。

article.articleHeadline: Autorità sanitaria accelera tre vaccini anti Ebola in piena diffusione
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities fast-track three Ebola vaccines in full deployment.
article.articleSummary: Central Africa Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak drives vaccine push. CEPI funds three experimental vaccines targeting Bundibugyo Ebola virus circulating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Partnerships include IAVI, Moderna, and University of Oxford, with Serum Institute of India manufacturing. CEPI commits up to $50 million for Moderna's mRNA vaccine (preclinical and Phase 1); up to $8.6 million for Oxford/SII efforts; up to $3.2 million for IAVI's rVSV-based candidate, leveraging the platform used for approved Zaire Ebola vaccine.
