WHO Director-General Tedros calls this a critical step in outbreak control and pandemic preparedness; African CDC Director Jean Kaseya welcomes the move. The Congo outbreak has at least 282 laboratory-confirmed cases and about 1,000 suspected. In the interim, WHO emphasizes traditional measures: surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention, community engagement, and safe burials to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局が流行拡大中のエボラワクチン3種を加速承認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の流行と複数国への拡大が報告されており、ワクチン開発と国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、Bundibugyo Eボラ流行がDRC・ウガンダで発生。DRCで確認症例282例、疑い症例約1,000例。India(Serum Institute)はワクチン製造パートナーとして関与。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente em São Paulo com suspeita de ebola testa positivo para meningite - Diário de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient in São Paulo with suspected Ebola tests positive for meningitis - Diário de Notícias
article.articleSummary: 37-year-old man in São Paulo, Brazil, who recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo, was hospitalized with a suspected Ebola case but tested positive for meningococcal meningitis by blood PCR. The Ebola diagnosis remains under investigation, with further laboratory and genomic analyses planned. The patient, admitted to Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, is in isolation. Democratic Republic of Congo, a country experiencing an Ebola outbreak, was the travel source. In São Paulo, suspected cases must be reported immediately to municipal epidemiological surveillance and the CVE-SP. The Emílio Ribas Institute is the state's reference center for suspected or confirmed cases, while Instituto Adolfo Lutz handles laboratory investigation and differential diagnosis. This case underscores the need for rapid differential testing in travelers returning from outbreak zones and adherence to surveillance protocols.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの患者がエボラ疑いで検査され、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎で陽性 - ディアーリオ・デ・ノティシアス
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ疑い例の報告、複数国にまたがる事例、差別検査体制の必要性から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病が疑われた事例で、DRC内での流行地域への渡航歴がある。髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が確認されたが、エボラ診断は調査中。ゲノム解析と追加検査が予定されている。DRCはエボラ流行地域であり、ブラジルでの確認例は国際的な懸念をもたらす可能性がある。州レベルの感染症監視体制が機能している。

article.articleHeadline: جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل 282 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس "إيبولا" | الصحافة اليوم - يومية اخبارية جامعة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records 282 confirmed Ebola cases | Today's Press - a general daily newspaper.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo totals 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths as of 2026-06-01. Data from the Congolese Ministry of Communications and Media show 264 confirmed cases in Ituri province, 15 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu. The figures indicate ongoing transmission with the majority of cases concentrated in Ituri. The report does not provide additional details on recovered cases, vaccination status, or transmission sources. This update underscores sustained outbreak activity in these provinces and the continued public health response required by authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスで282件の確定症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定症例282件・死亡42件という重大なアウトブレイク。IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPRO基準も全て該当。対象国DRCで継続的な感染伝播が確認されており、迅速なRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高致死率・高感染性の危機的感染症。記事では複数県（イトゥリ州264件、北キブ州15件、南キブ州3件）での継続的な伝播が報告されており、医療システムの負荷と国際的懸念は確実。記事サマリーに回復例数やワクチン接種状況の詳細がないため、追加情報が必要だが、提供データでも判定基準に十分適合。

article.articleHeadline: Recuperação de casos de Ebola traz sinais de esperança no Congo, surgem casos suspeitos fora da África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recovery of Ebola cases brings signs of hope in the Congo; suspected cases emerge outside Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) total 282 confirmed infections with 42 deaths; 19 new positives were reported, and five people have recovered, including a laboratory worker. Suspected cases are under investigation in Brazil and Italy linked to travel to affected countries. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant outbreak in the DRC and Uganda was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO in May; there is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, though survivors can recover with quality medical care, per WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus during a visit to Bunia, Ituri province, eastern DRC. In Brazil, a São Paulo man with a suspected Ebola case tested positive for meningitis, and a Rio de Janeiro case tested positive for malaria; neither diagnosis excludes Ebola. In Italy, a suspected case in Cagliari returned negative after flying from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の患者回復が希望の兆し、コンゴでの患者数増加、アフリカ外で疑い症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) 宣言済みで、DRC・ウガンダ・ブラジル・イタリアに及ぶ国際的な懸念事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認された主要な感染症イベント発生地はDRC（確認282例、死亡42例）とBrazil（疑い症例）。イタリアの疑い症例は陽性判定されず、ウガンダはWHO宣言で言及されているが記事サマリーでは直接的な症例報告なし。DRC・Brazilのみverified_locations に含める。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国での国際的な懸念が存在し、医療対応リソースの需要が高い事象。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática do Congo e Uganda têm 263 casos de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda have 263 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, 2026, 263 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 43 deaths linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain. More than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation. The outbreak, described as the 17th in the DRC and the third-largest since Ebola’s discovery, is outpacing the global response. Health authorities warn that basic supplies, including masks, are in short supply as the outbreak was not detected for weeks. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) director-general Jean Kaseya urged rapid activation of national incident management systems and permanent investments in pandemic preparedness. While international partners are essential, he emphasizes that support should align with strategies devised by African institutions and governments. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで263件のエボラウイルス病症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、263確定患者、43死亡、1,100以上の疑似患者、複数国での発生。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダが言及されているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain、複数国での発生、医療資源の深刻な不足が記載されている。フルRRAの優先度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Gesundheitsbehörde beschleunigt drei Ebola-Impfstoffe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Authority Accelerates Three Ebola Vaccines.
article.articleSummary: CEPI accelerates three experimental vaccines against the Bundibugyo Ebola strain to curb the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The candidates—Moderna (mRNA), Oxford University/SII, and IAVI—are deemed the WHO’s most promising. CEPI funds: up to $50 million for Moderna to support preclinical work and Phase 1; up to $8.6 million for Oxford/SII for preclinical and Phase 1 prep; up to $3.2 million for IAVI using the same rVSV platform linked to a WHO-prequalified Zaire strain vaccine. No vaccines are available yet; WHO prioritizes interruption of transmission via surveillance, rapid tests, contact tracing, isolation, IPC, community engagement, and safe burials. As of 2026-06-01, the DRC outbreak has at least 282 lab-confirmed cases and about 1,000 suspected.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局がエボラワクチン3種を加速
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の確定症例282例、疑い症例約1,000例を伴うDRC/ウガンダのアウトブレイク。IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WHO・CEPIによる国際的対応が既に開始されている重大事態である。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはアウトブレイク国として明示されており、282確定例と約1,000疑い例という実質的な流行状況が報告されている。CEPI・WHOによる迅速な国際対応（最大$50M投資）が既に進行中であり、ワクチン開発の加速という国際保健政策レベルの反応が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള; ജാഗ്രത പാലിക്കാം, പരിഭ്രാന്തി വേണ്ട
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola; Stay vigilant, no panic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak reemerges in African nations, with WHO declaring PHEIC. In India, experts say no immediate panic, but vigilance is required. Not airborne; transmission requires close contact with bodily fluids. The current outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain; there are no licensed vaccines or effective antivirals for this variant. Monoclonal antibody therapies such as Inmazeb and Ebanga, used against Zaire ebolavirus, have not proven effective against Bundibugyo. Survival depends on prompt recognition and supportive care, including IV fluids, electrolyte balance, blood pressure and oxygen management, and organ support; earlier treatment improves outcomes. Incubation is 2-21 days. Initial symptoms: high fever, fatigue, headache, muscle and throat pain; later vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and bleeding may occur. Severe cases involve shock, kidney and liver failure, and multi-organ failure. No Ebola cases reported in India; the government advises avoiding travel to DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan and airport screening.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ；警戒を保つこと、パニック不要
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の再発生がアフリカ諸国で確認され、WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的に重大なリスク。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した発生地域にはUgandaとSudanも含まれるが、対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCはリスト内（203312）であり、サマリーで明示されている。Indiaはリスト内（1269750）であるが、サマリー記述「No Ebola cases reported in India」に基づき、インド国内での発生ではなく、インドへの影響・警戒情報として含める。Bundibugyo strain、既存治療薬無効、高い致死率が指摘されており、緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: O sarampo pode voltar a circular no Brasil?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can measles circulate again in Brazil?
article.articleSummary: Measles risk re-emerges in Brazil ahead of the World Cup as travel-linked exposure increases. By 2026-06-01 Brazil recorded three confirmed measles cases this year and is investigating 468 suspected infections; a 2019 outbreak of over 21,700 prompted the first measles-free declaration in 2024, later suspended. In the Americas, measles outbreaks surged in 2025, with the United States, Canada and Mexico accounting for about 67% of regional infections, heightening risk to tourists. The Ministry of Health notes an 'imminent risk' of reintroduction, despite Brazil's 2025 vaccination coverage of 92.66% for the first MMR dose and 78.02% for the booster. Travelers are advised to receive the MMR vaccine at least 15 days before departure; children as young as 6 months may get an early dose. The standard schedule remains two MMR doses; antivaccine sentiment challenges uptake, particularly among adolescents and young adults.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルではしかが再び循環する可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。対象国ブラジルにおけるはしか再興の懸念であり、2026年ワールドカップ開催地での旅行関連リスク増加が社会・政治的関心を高めている。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジルでのはしか再興リスクに焦点を当てており、2019年の大規模流行（21,700例超）の後に2024年に「はしか排除国」と宣言されたが後に保留となった経緯がある。2026年ワールドカップ開催を控え、米国・カナダ・メキシコからの旅行者を通じた感染再入症のリスク増加が強調されている。ブラジルでの2026年上半期の検査例は3確認例と468疑い例。Bluedot APIが列挙した他国（米国、カナダ、メキシコ、スペイン）はコンテキストとして言及されているが、本イベントの主体はブラジルであるため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Aíslan en Brasil a congoleño por posible caso de ébola: dio positivo a meningitis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese national isolated in Brazil over possible Ebola case: tested positive for meningitis.
article.articleSummary: A 37-year-old Congolese man hospitalized in São Paulo, Brazil, after arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, was initially suspected of Ebola due to fever but PCR testing confirmed meningococcal meningitis. The patient remains isolated as authorities pursue additional laboratory and genomic analyses to fully exclude Ebola and other infectious diseases. Brazil’s São Paulo Health Secretariat notes that Ebola must still be ruled out, so isolation continues during the diagnostic workup. The case underscores ongoing concern given recent travel from the DRC, where an Ebola outbreak has caused 43 deaths and more than 263 confirmed cases. No infection source is confirmed, and authorities are monitoring potential imported or exported case considerations as investigations proceed.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで隔離されたコンゴ国籍男性：エボラ可能性で検査後、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎で陽性判明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では国際的拡大リスク（DRCでのエボラ流行と国境を越えた患者移動）と渡航制限の可能性が該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・流行可能性が該当し、DRCでの進行中のエボラアウトブレイクと関連した輸入症例の可能性があるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（43死亡、263確認症例）とのリンク、国際的な患者移動、エボラ除外に至らぬ診断プロセスが重要。髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎確定後も、当初のエボラ疑いと現地での流行状況を勘案すると、輸入症例リスクの評価が必要。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Φορέας υγείας επισπεύδει τρία εμβόλια Έμπολα καθώς ο ιός εξαπλώνεται
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authority speeds up three Ebola vaccines as the virus spreads.
article.articleSummary: Three Ebola vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo strain are being accelerated as the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak spreads across the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. CEPI will expedite development of three candidates—Moderna’s mRNA vaccine, an Oxford University/SII collaboration, and IAVI’s rVSV-based vaccine—produced by the Serum Institute of India. CEPI’s funding totals up to $50 million for Moderna’s candidate (preclinical and Phase 1), up to $8.6 million for Oxford/SII (preclinical and Phase 1), and up to $3.2 million for IAVI. The WHO has named these three as the most promising vaccines in development for Ebola. The outbreak has at least 282 confirmed cases and about 1,000 suspected cases in DRC and Uganda. While vaccines advance, priority remains interrupting transmission via surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, patient care, infection prevention, community engagement, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: 健康当局がエボラワクチン3種類を加速、ウイルスが拡大中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）かつWPRO基準複数該当。Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクが282確定例・1000疑い例を計上し、DRC・ウガンダで進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではBundibugyo Ebolaアウトブレイクが「DRC and Uganda」で報告されているが、対象国リストではDRC(203312)とIndia(1269750)のみが該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Indiaはワクチン開発のSerum Institute of Indiaが言及されているため検証地として含める。CEPIによる50百万ドル相当の迅速なワクチン開発資金配分と、複数のワクチンプラットフォーム（mRNA、組換えVSV）の並行開発は国際的な対応強化を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Cinco pessoas curaram-se do Ébola na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five people have recovered from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows 42 deaths among 282 confirmed cases, with 321 suspected infections, up from the prior day; five people have recovered. The outbreak is centered in Ituri province, with Bunia reporting 264 confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo strain circulating has no vaccine, but survival is possible with quality medical care. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to urge timely treatment and address distrust and misinformation, including funeral practices that may spread the virus. Cross-border concerns are noted, with nine confirmed cases in Uganda. In Brazil, two travelers from the affected region with compatible symptoms are under Ebola investigation after initial diagnoses of meningitis and malaria; a suspected case in Sardinia, Italy, tested negative. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, the third largest on record, underscoring the need for rapid international funding and action.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱から5人が回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRCで継続中の大規模エボラ出血熱の流行（282確定例、42死亡）で、ウガンダへの越境感染（9例）、ブラジルとイタリアでの関連疑い例が報告されており、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、および公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはSardegna（イタリア）とBrazilが含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらは「疑い例が検査中」または「検査陰性」で実際の流行の主舞台ではない。主たるイベントはDRC（Ituri州、Bunia）でのエボラ流行であり、越境事例としてウガンダのみが確認済み。ブラジルとイタリアの事例は疫学的リンクが不確定であるため、verified_locationsからは除外した。DRCの第17次アウトブレイク、過去3番目の規模。Bundibugyo株はワクチン非対応だが医療介入で生存可能。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de ebola testa negativo e deixa isolamento no Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola tests negative and leaves isolation in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: Fiocruz ruled out Ebola in a patient admitted from Uganda. Saliva, urine, and blood samples tested negative for Ebola on Sunday, with the man—who presented with cough, chills, and diarrhea—placed in isolation at the Evandro Chagas Institute. He was later diagnosed with malaria and released from isolation, with ongoing medical follow-up. A second patient with suspected Ebola remains in isolation at Emílio Ribas Institute in São Paulo; the 37-year-old Congo-born man tested positive for meningococcal meningitis, while Ebola testing continues. Across the current outbreak, 263 cases have been confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with at least 43 deaths; about 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain with no vaccines or approved treatments. The WHO has declared it an international emergency, prompting surveillance, contact tracing, and isolation to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでエボラ疑いの患者が陰性と判定され隔離から解放
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、WHO緊急事態宣言）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行可能性）。対象国ブラジルでの疑い例報告と国際的監視態勢あり。
triage.notes: ブラジルで複数の疑い例が報告されており、DRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo virus（エボラウイルスの希少株）アウトブレイク（263確診例、43死亡、1,100疑い例）に関連。WHOが国際緊急事態を宣言済み。サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が記述されるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみ。ただし本イベントはグローバルなシグナルとして極めて重要。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. cements position as top Ebola donor with over $212 million for Africa's outbreak response
article.articleSummary: U.S. remains the top Ebola donor with over $212 million for Africa's outbreak response, alongside $350 million through UN OCHA for broader humanitarian relief in the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan; $13.5 million pledged to Kenya's Ebola preparedness. Funding, coordinated with the CDC, targets rapid containment at the virus source and prevents international spread, including $162 million in direct Ebola assistance and $50 million to establish up to 50 Ebola response clinics. Cross-border concerns ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026 and regional mobility spur travel measures: the U.S., Canada and Mexico announce public health travel steps for travelers from high-risk Ebola regions; travel cautions require entry through designated airports for enhanced screening, with Uganda advisory urging reduced non-essential travel. Total Ebola-related and humanitarian commitments exceed half a billion dollars.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、アフリカのエボラ出血熱対応に2億1,200万ドル以上を拠出し、最大ドナー国としての地位を確固たるものに
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国家発生（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ケニア）による公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク（国境を越えた懸念、渡航制限措置の実施）、及び米国・カナダ・メキシコによる公式な渡航措置の発表により、IHR基準3つ以上該当およびWPRO基準複数該当。国際的支援の必要性も明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されている発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ケニアだが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。発生地域フィールドに米国、カナダ、メキシコが含まれているのは渡航制限措置の実施国であり、エボラ発生地ではない。FIFA World Cup 2026前の国境を越えた感染リスク懸念と複数国による公式な渡航措置（スクリーニング強化、渡航勧告）が社会的・政治的関心を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Tightens Ebola Screening At Lagos Airport As Authorities Move To Block Imported Cases
article.articleSummary: Nigeria tightened Ebola screening at Lagos' Murtala Muhammed International Airport (MMIA) to block imported cases amid renewed concerns over Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo. A joint review by FAAN, Lagos State health authorities, and Port Health Services assessed MMIA's ability to detect, isolate, and respond to suspected Ebola cases, updating emergency preparedness and response frameworks. Risk assessments identified airlines operating routes from high-risk regions, with health declarations and passenger screening procedures now being administered for relevant flights. Officials from FAAN, Lagos State Ministry of Health, and Port Health Services emphasized rapid identification, reporting, and coordination with the Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority (NCAA) to align with international health regulations and safety standards. Training for airport workers and health officials has been expanded to strengthen border health controls at Nigeria's busiest international gateway.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ラゴス空港でのエボラ出血熱スクリーニングを強化 輸入症例遮断に向け当局が対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の予防的対策イベントであり、DRCでの流行への対応として国境検疫を強化している。IHR基準は2つ以上該当する可能性があるが、記事はナイジェリアでの確診症例報告ではなく準備・予防段階の情報であり、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア（非対象国）で実施されているエボラ対策について報じている。DRC（203312）での流行が背景にあるが、記事の主題はナイジェリアのスクリーニング強化であり、対象国リストにナイジェリアは含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。IHR基準では『国際的拡大リスク』『渡航制限リスク』『予想外性』が認められるが、確診症例がナイジェリアで報告されていない予防段階のため、追加情報を待つべき。

article.articleHeadline: View: Ebola outbreak requires multifaceted response
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo’s volatile, underserved regions spreads amid armed conflict, displacement, and irregular artisanal mining-driven migration. By May 15, authorities publicly confirmed cases after hundreds of suspected infections; no approved vaccine or treatment exists for this Bundibugyo strain. The piece argues that a public-health response alone cannot contain such outbreaks and that messaging and surveillance depend on a durable multisectoral infrastructure. USAID-style experience shows rapid mobilization through trusted community health workers, local leaders, and networks to counter disinformation and enable simultaneous prevention and treatment. The author urges expanding responses beyond health, engaging community leaders, local government, education, agriculture, security, and humanitarian actors. Calls for permanent inter-governmental coordination units with budgetary power to redeploy resources, arguing that epidemic preparedness requires enduring institutions and cross-sector coordination, not temporary crisis structures. Act now.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行は多面的対応を必要とする
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の治療法・ワクチン未承認、武装紛争下での拡散、複数国での確認例があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は治療法・承認ワクチンが存在しない高病原性株。武装紛争、人口移動、不規則な採掘活動により拡散リスク高い。DRCが発生国として確認。ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは国境を越えた拡大の明示的な確認記述なし。ウガンダでのBundibugyo株確認の明確な言及がないため、検証対象国リストにはウガンダは含めない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل ارتفاعاً جديداً في إصابات إيبولا وسط جهود مكثفة للسيطرة على التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records a new rise in Ebola cases amid intensified efforts to contain the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 282, with 19 new infections reported in the past hours. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri Province, which has 264 confirmed cases, while North Kivu reports 15 cases and South Kivu 3. Health authorities, alongside international partners and humanitarian agencies, are sustaining emergency response measures, including treatment centers, contact tracing, and expanded community awareness to promote prevention and early detection. This outbreak ranks among the largest Ebola events in recent years in the DRC, raising concerns about the risk of spread to new areas if containment is not rapid and effective. Ongoing efforts focus on curbing transmission and protecting affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国コンゴ、封じ込め努力の最中、エボラ出血熱の患者数が新たに増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（282例、死亡率懸念）、異常事象（大規模流行）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目中5項目に該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高レベルの危険病原体であり、DRCにおける282例の確認患者は直近時点での大規模流行を示唆。記事では「最近数年のDRCで最大級」と明記され、Ituri州を中心にした継続的な感染拡大と、新興地域への広がりリスク、国際的な懸念が指摘されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: O sarampo pode voltar a circular no Brasil?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Could measles circulate again in Brazil?
article.articleSummary: Measles could circulate again in Brazil as the World Cup raises travel-linked infection risk; United States, Mexico and Canada are experiencing outbreaks. Brazil reports three confirmed cases in 2026 with 468 suspected; diagnoses have been rare for decades. The WHO declared Brazil measles-free in 2024; status achieved in 2016, revoked in 2019 after a surge of over 21,700 cases in 12 months. A 4-year-old girl, Thereza Lopes, developed red spots across the body, high fever, sweating, body pains and eye pain. The Ministry of Health's Programa Nacional de Imunizações director Eder Gatti stated Brazil is at an 'imminent risk' of reintroducing measles, linked to rising measles activity in the Americas. Travel-related infection risk is a key concern ahead of international events.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでしばしば麻疹が再び流行する可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ワクチン接種率低下と大規模国際イベント（ワールドカップ）を背景とした米州全域での麻疹再興は、ブラジルの麻疹撲滅達成状況の喪失リスクを示唆し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響を持つ。
triage.notes: 記事は米国、メキシコ、カナダの麻疹流行に言及しているが、これらは対象国に含まれていないため検証対象外。ブラジルは2016年に麻疹撲滅を達成したが2019年に状況が喪失されており、再導入リスクが「imminent」と明記されている点が重要。ワールドカップ開催（記事配信日2026年6月）を背景とした渡航関連感染リスクの懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: البرازيل تعزل رجلين للاشتباه بإصابتهما بإيبولا وتحذير من انتشاره خارج الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil isolates two men suspected of having Ebola and warns of its spread outside the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Two men in Brazil are in isolation after arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, suspected of having Ebola virus disease. Brazilian authorities intensified border and public health precautions as the Ebola outbreak persists in several African countries. The isolation of these potential cases underscores Brazil’s alert against possible international spread. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of confirmed Ebola cases has risen to 282. The incidents highlight potential imported cases from Africa to South America and the ongoing risk of cross-border transmission as health agencies monitor travelers, reinforce screening, and coordinate with international partners.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルがエボラ疑い患者2名を隔離、民主共和国コンゴ以外での感染拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の疑い患者がアフリカからブラジルへ輸入された可能性があり、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: DRCでは確認患者282名と報告されており、地域的流行が継続中。ブラジルへの輸入症例の疑いは国際公衆衛生上の重大な関心事。ウガンダはBluedotで検出されているが、記事サマリー上ではDRCとブラジルが主な発生地域であるため、ウガンダは除外した。対象国リスト外の国（ウガンダ等）も関連しているが、verified_locationsは対象国のみに限定。

article.articleHeadline: 五伊波拉患者康复出院 为更多患者能被治愈带来希望
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Ebola patients discharged after recovery, bringing hope that more patients can be cured.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 300 confirmed Ebola cases and 43 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda as of May 31, 2026. In Ituri Province’s Bunia hospital, four healthcare workers infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus were discharged, bringing total recoveries in this outbreak to five; a laboratory staff member previously discharged on May 27 after two negative tests. The World Health Organization notes that stronger response measures enable earlier diagnosis and treatment, likely boosting recoveries. Africa CDC chief cautions that containment must keep pace with transmission, underscoring a major test for regional health authorities. Moderna and CEPI agreed to develop a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Brazil reports two suspected Ebola cases, later diagnosed as meningitis and malaria; a Congo-born man with severe meningitis is undergoing Ebola screening, and another man from Uganda to Rio de Janeiro remains isolated after Ebola testing is negative. Italy reports a May 30 returnee to Cagliari with negative Ebola results and low risk.

triage.headline_ja: 5名のエボラ患者が回復して退院、より多くの患者が治癒できることへの希望をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例が約300件、死亡43件と報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められる。複数国での発生と国際的な懸念（ブラジル・イタリアでの疑い症例）が見られ、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行の最新状況を報告し、ブラジルでの疑い症例や国際的な懸念を記載している。対象国リストではDRCとブラジルが該当。ウガンダはリスト外のため除外。イタリアは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株によるアウトブレイクであり、ワクチン開発の動きがある。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS y RD Congo trabajan para lograr una vacuna contra la cepa del actual brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO and DR Congo are working to develop a vaccine against the strain of the current Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: The WHO and the Democratic Republic of Congo government are pursuing a vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain driving the current Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo, with rapid randomized controlled trials planned for vaccines and candidate therapies. In Bunia, Ituri Province—the outbreak epicenter—Health Minister Samuel Kamba and Communications Minister Patrick Muyaya, with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, briefed on the effort. The Bundibugyo strain presents no approved vaccine or specific treatment, but public health measures remain effective at limiting transmission; with timely care, patients can survive. The fatality rate for Bundibugyo Ebola is estimated at 30–50%. The joint statement urged continued Ebola treatment centers and strengthened health systems, amid ongoing conflict in the region. The AU cites 246 suspected deaths and 1,077 suspected cases in DR Congo; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and one death, linked to a Congolese import.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとコンゴ民主共和国が現在のエボラ出血熱流行株に対するワクチン開発に協力
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常な大規模流行、国際的拡大実績、国際支援の必要性）。Bundibugyo株による確認死亡例、複数国への拡大、30-50%の高い致命率が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolaは承認ワクチンが存在しない新規株。DRC（Ituri Province Bunia）での流行に加え、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が既に確認されている（9確認例、1死亡）。WHOおよびコンゴ民主共和国政府による公式な対応が進行中。東コンゴの紛争継続により管理難度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Says Ebola Readiness At 59% As Authorities Tighten Border Surveillance
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's health authorities say Ebola preparedness is 59% as of 2026-06-01, with intensified border surveillance at airports and crossings following WHO warnings about the Congo Basin outbreak. NCDC Director-General Jide Idris notes system improvements since 2014 but vulnerabilities remain, especially at borders and points of entry. A dynamic risk assessment identified cross-border movement as critical, prompting enhanced screening at international airports and coordination of surveillance for passengers from higher-risk destinations. Idris cautions that land borders, road and informal routes complicate containment. Lessons from Lagos 2014 guide current measures: rapid detection, immediate isolation, contact tracing, and laboratory confirmation. Nationwide assessments of isolation facilities, emergency operations centers, and lab networks are underway, with expanded labs, trained staff, PPE, reagents, and stocks closer to transport corridors. Nigeria also faces Lassa fever and cholera, with emphasis on public education and state-level leadership.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ出血熱の対応準備率は59%と発表、国境警備を強化
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高危険性疾患（エボラ、ラッサ熱、コレラ）の同時報告であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当。また国際的な越境移動リスク、WHO警告への対応が記載されており、アフリカ地域の関心事となっている。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアのエボラ対応準備状況を主題としており、コンゴ盆地でのアウトブレイク警告に対する国境強化について記載。DRCも言及されているため両国を verified_locations に含める。複数疾患の同時流行懸念（エボラ、ラッサ熱、コレラ）は公衆衛生上の重大リスク。越境移動の複雑性（非公式ルート含む）が記載されており、国際的拡大リスクが示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Петоро здравствених радника отпуштено из болнице након опоравка од еболе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five healthcare workers discharged from the hospital after recovering from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Five healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo have been discharged from Bunia hospital after recovering from Ebola. The group includes four nurses and one laboratory technician; the first recovered patient left last week. A certificate recognizing their recovery was presented during a ceremony in Bunia, Ituri province, as the country fights an outbreak that has claimed hundreds of lives. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called these recoveries hopeful signs and urged continued vigilance. DR Congo reports more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 246 deaths, with transmission centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, and spillover into neighboring Uganda (Kampala). Brazil meanwhile investigates two suspected cases in Sao Paulo. Health authorities emphasize early detection, contact tracing, safe burials, hygiene, and community trust to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 5人の医療従事者がエボラ熱から回復して病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（1000以上の疑い患者、246人以上の死亡）が複数国で進行中。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ、ブラジルへの波及）も確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRC（複数州での主要なアウトブレイク）とブラジル（サンパウロでの2件の疑い患者調査）が確認される対象国。ウガンダはカンパラへの波及が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルのリスク病原体であり、1000以上の疑い患者と246人の死亡を伴うアウトブレイク、複数国への国際的拡大が全IHR基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patienten heilen aus: Was Ärzte in der DR Kongo entdeckt haben
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patients are recovering: What doctors in DR Congo have discovered.
article.articleSummary: Five people infected with the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, have been declared virus-free after two consecutive negative tests; four survivors are nurses, with a lab technician released earlier. By May 29, the Congo’s health ministry reported 263 infections and 42 deaths, while another lab-based estimate cited 282 cases and as many deaths after 19 new positives. The WHO has deemed the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, though not a pandemic. Lab capacity has expanded, yet more than 1,100 test results remained pending as of May 30. The region (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) contends with restricted access due to armed groups like the ADF and M23. Uganda reports nine cases and one death linked to the same strain. Outside Africa, suspected Ebola-related findings appear in Brazil and Italy; Congo-to-Rio de Janeiro and Sardinia cases are under scrutiny. MSF warns of rapid spread, urging more testing and protection. No approved vaccine or antiviral exists for Bundibugyo; early diagnosis, IV fluids, anticoagulants, and close monitoring improve survival. The outbreak is the third-largest Ebola event in the DRC in 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が治癒：コンゴ民主共和国の医師が発見したもの
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイクは公衆衛生上深刻（263感染、42死亡）、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ9例、ブラジル・イタリアで疑い例）、渡航・貿易制限リスク有。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した発生地域にはブラジルとイタリアも含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらの国での「疑い例」について言及されているのみで、確定例の発生地は記述されていない。したがって、確実な発生地はDRCのみとして verified_locations に含めた。WPRO対象国ではブラジル（3469034）が該当するが、サマリーではブラジルでの確定事例の発生は明記されておらず、「ブラジルでの疑い例」のみの記述であるため、リスク評価は高いが地域検証では対象外とした。PHEICの宣言、CFR16%（42/263）、武装勢力による制限、検査遅延（1,100件以上待機中）により、リスクは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Az ebola egyre több embert fertőz meg, de a WHO szerint van remény + videó
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is infecting more and more people, but according to the WHO there is hope + video
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus is rapidly spreading in Central Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province (Bunia) as a focal area. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; with appropriate medical care, infection can be survivable. As of early June 2026, the World Health Organization declared an international public health emergency. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia and cautioned that the virus is spreading faster than authorities can respond, with the situation potentially becoming critical soon. Jean Kaseya, head of Africa CDC, wrote in the Financial Times that more than 1,100 suspected cases are under investigation. The report highlights ongoing transmission risk in the region and the urgent need for public health measures and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがますます多くの人々に感染しているが、WHOによれば希望がある + ビデオ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルスが中央アフリカで急速に拡大し、DRCのイトゥリ州で焦点地域となっており、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。1,100件以上の疑い事例が調査中であり、感染速度が対応能力を上回っている状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC のイトゥリ州（Bunia）が焦点地域として明示されており、中央アフリカでの急速な拡大が報告されている。WHO事務局長による現地訪問、Africa CDC 責任者の Financial Times への寄稿など高レベルの対応が記述されている。Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルスには承認されたワクチンや治療法がないため、重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de SP divulga resultado de novo exame de paciente com suspeita de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo state government releases result of new test for patient with suspected Ebola.
article.articleSummary: New testing did not detect Ebola genetic material in a 37-year-old man hospitalized in São Paulo. The sample, collected by Instituto Adolfo Lutz, was released on Monday, June 1, 2026, after the patient—an immigrant from the Democratic Republic of the Congo—had been diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis; Ebola infection had not been ruled out. The case is under investigation as suspected at Hospital Emílio Ribas, with a potential confirmatory retest discussed as in a Rio de Janeiro patient. He remains isolated and receives antibiotics and fluids; contacts on the plane and at the local urgent care are monitored. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood and bodily fluids during the acute phase. The CCD recently updated guidance on the Bundibugyo strain, emphasizing isolation in suspected cases. South America has reported no autochthonous cases. WHO notes 134 confirmed and 18 deaths in the Congo-Uganda outbreak (13% mortality); 906 cases and 223 deaths remain under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: São Paulo州政府がエボラウイルス疑い患者の新検査結果を発表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでエボラウイルス疑い患者が報告されたが、新検査では遺伝物質が検出されず、診断は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に確定。DRC・ウガンダでの流行との関連があり情報継続監視が必要だが、ブラジル国内での確診例ではなく、現段階では国際的拡大リスクは限定的。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからは、ブラジル（サンパウロ）で報告された患者の新検査がエボラ陰性で、診断が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に確定したことが主題。DRC出身の患者がDRCでのエボラ流行と関連している可能性があるが、ブラジルでの実際の確診例ではない。DRCとウガンダについても地理的言及はあるが、記事の主題はブラジルでの疑い患者の検査結果であり、両国での確定的な新規流行拡大を報告しているわけではない。ただし、DRC・ウガンダでの流行が継続中（134確診、18死亡）との記述があるため、当該地域での流行状況の継続監視は重要。

article.articleHeadline: 1 जून से शुरू हुआ 'मलेरिया रोधी माह,2030 तक मलेरिया खत्म करने का संकल्प,हर बुखार पीड़ित की होगी जांच।
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Starting June 1, Malaria Eradication Month: Pledge to eliminate malaria by 2030; every fever patient will be tested.
article.articleSummary: Malaria Eradication Month begins in Lakhimpur-Kheri district on June 1–30, 2026, with a target to test 10% of the population. The campaign, themed 'Resolve to eliminate malaria—now we can, now we must,' directs health centers to screen every fever patient; malaria-positive cases receive complete treatment with ASHA-led follow-up. If a local case appears, a rapid survey of 50 nearby houses and destruction of breeding sites will be undertaken, with Malaria Treatment Cards tracking every patient. Weekly sanitation drives will carry slogans such as 'Sunday—attack mosquitoes, strike larvae' and 'We have resolved to eradicate malaria.' Training is provided to ASHA, ANM, and CHO. Malaria numbers have fallen: 2024—614; 2025—445; 2026 so far—22; dengue likewise declined. India aims to eradicate malaria by 2030, requiring zero local cases for three consecutive years and rapid action within 24–48 hours. Public participation and preventing standing water are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 6月1日からマラリア対策月間開始、2030年までのマラリア撲滅を誓約、すべての発熱患者が検査対象に
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州ラキムプール・ケーリー地区における公衆衛生キャンペーンの報告であり、新規のアウトブレイクや異常事象ではなく、既知の地域性疾患（マラリア・デング熱）の継続的管理プログラムの実施を報じている。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: マラリア・デング熱の症例数は減少傾向（2024年614件→2025年445件→2026年22件）であり、既知感染症の地域的管理活動の報告に過ぎない。新規シグナル、異常、国際的拡大リスクはなし。定期的な予防キャンペーンとして位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: South Africa ramps up foot-and-mouth disease vaccination drive - LNN - Network News
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in South Africa is being tackled with a nationwide vaccination drive. Government spent R494 million on vaccine procurement and deployment, acquiring 13.5 million doses; nearly 4.4 million animals had been vaccinated by May 28, with KwaZulu-Natal leading at over 1.1 million. The country received 3.5 million additional doses last week, and regulatory approval has been granted to import another 14 million doses for booster vaccinations. Provinces including Eastern Cape, Free State, Mpumalanga, Gauteng, Limpopo, North West, Western Cape and Northern Cape are rolling out large-scale vaccination programs. The response expands diagnostic capacity and strengthens surveillance as part of a shift to preventative, risk-based biosecurity. Some export markets remain open (Jordan, UAE, Hong Kong, Kuwait), with Qatar discussions ongoing; regional cross-border coordination with SADC is prioritised to protect trade and livestock. A public–private biosecurity model is planned to bolster ongoing containment.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカが口蹄疫ワクチン接種の推進を強化 - LNN - ネットワークニュース
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の広域発生（複数州）、政府による大規模対応（R494百万の支出、1350万用量の調達）、国際的な貿易への影響（一部市場開放、地域間調整）が確認されるため、IHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は南アフリカにおける口蹄疫発生への政府対応を主題としている。Bluedot APIが付与した他国（クウェート、中国、ヨルダン、香港、カタール、UAE）は貿易市場の開放状況の文脈で言及されているのみであり、実際の発生地ではないため excluded。動物疾病であるが、農業経済および国際貿易への著しい影響から公衆衛生上の重要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola e l'Italia: i buchi (piccoli ma reali) della sorveglianza sanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and Italy: the gaps (small but real) in public health surveillance.
article.articleSummary: An imported suspected Ebola virus disease case from the Congo to Sardinia, Italy, returned negative after testing. The Ministry of Health confirmed the result, with analyses conducted by the Spallanzani Institute in Rome. The patient arrived in Italy on 30 May, reported symptoms, called 118, and was transported in biosafety containment to Santissima Trinità Hospital in Cagliari. The incident underscores gaps in Italy’s public health surveillance for travelers from risk zones and prompts scrutiny of the ministerial ordinance of 29 May regulating surveillance on returns from high‑risk areas. Three specific questions remain unanswered. Although no Ebola case is confirmed in Italy, the episode raises questions about safeguards and procedures for managing imported-risk cases. Published on 1 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとイタリア：公衆衛生監視の（小さいが現実的な）欠陥
triage.triage_reason: コンゴからイタリアへの疑似エボラ症例輸入が報告されたが、検査は陰性で確定症例なし。ただし国境検疫体制の欠陥が指摘されており、今後の追跡情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事主題は高リスク地域（コンゴ）からの疑似輸入症例だが、検査陰性で確定症例なし。イタリアの国境検疫手続きの問題が論点だが、実際の感染症イベント発生はコンゴのみが確認される。社会的・政治的関心があり要経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 1 100 cas d'Ebola suspects en Afrique, deux hommes isolés au Brésil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,100 suspected Ebola cases in Africa, two men in isolation in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda remains large, with over 1,100 suspected Ebola cases reported as of May 31, 2026, alongside 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths. The flare-up, identified in Ituri, has spread to several Congolese provinces and into neighboring Uganda. With no vaccine or approved treatment for the Bundibugyo strain, control relies on non-pharmaceutical measures and rapid case detection. In Brazil, two men arriving from Central Africa were placed in isolation after developing Ebola-compatible symptoms; one was diagnosed with malaria, while testing continues for the second, with no Ebola confirmation at this stage.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ疑い例1,100件以上、ブラジルで2人が隔離中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の多地域拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。シグナルとして識別され、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでの多数の疑い例・確認例および死亡例、Bundibugyo株でのワクチン・承認治療なし、隣国への拡大、ブラジルへの国際拡大（2例）により、高優先度の対応が必要。ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Moderna Secures $50 Million Boost to Fast-Track Ebola Vaccine Development Amid Rising Outbreak Cases
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, the Ebola outbreak affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and nearby areas continues, with more than 900 suspected cases and over 220 deaths attributed to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus episode. The Bundibugyo strain is treated as high risk, with a fatality rate around 40% at worst. There is currently no licensed vaccine or dedicated specific treatment on the market. Moderna has secured up to $50 million from CEPI to accelerate development of a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo, covering preclinical research, early clinical testing (Phase 1), and manufacturing readiness. Moderna will employ its mRNA platform to build the candidate. The funding arrives as outbreaks persist, underscoring CEPI’s role in fast-tracking vaccines during ongoing transmission in Africa. No timeline for clinical milestones is provided.

triage.headline_ja: Modernaが5000万ドルの支援を確保し、エボラ発症例の増加を受けてエボラワクチン開発を加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCにおけるBundibugyo ebolavirus流行で900以上の疑似患者と220以上の死亡が報告されており、高い重症度と致死率（約40%）を示す。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症（Ebola）はIHR規則に基づく通知対象疾患。DRCにおけるBundibugyo株の流行は現在も進行中であり、致死率40%と高リスク。ワクチン開発への国際支援（CEPI資金）がすでに動員されており、国際的関心と支援需要が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola: Nurses Recover, Discharged
article.articleSummary: Four nurses discharged after recovering from Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Five people have recovered overall, including a laboratory worker cleared last Thursday. As of 1 June 2026, DRC reports 210 confirmed Ebola cases and 17 deaths, with about 350 suspected cases under investigation; 16 health workers have contracted Ebola in this outbreak. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus; there is no licensed vaccine or treatment. WHO notes that early diagnosis and intensified response improve outcomes. In Bunia, capital of Ituri province, a refurbished Ebola Treatment Centre with 24 beds (60 total capacity) has been handed to authorities; an annex with up to 42 beds is being set up. Transmission remains concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu amid a severe humanitarian crisis. Experimental therapeutics prioritized for trials include MBP-134 and maftivimab, plus remdesivir; obeldesivir is being studied post-exposure. Two candidate vaccines identified for evaluation once doses are available. Tedros emphasized care-seeking to end transmission; a US case treated in Germany.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国エボラ：看護師が回復し退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準5つ全て該当。活発な感染症危機として対応が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョウイルス）による確認症例210件、死亡17件、医療従事者16名感染。Ituri州、North Kivu州、South Kivu州で流行集中。ワクチン・治療薬未認可。USA症例はドイツで治療されており、国際的な懸念を反映。Bluedot APIが USA と Germany を含めているが、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള; ജാഗ്രത പാലിക്കാം, പരിഭ്രാന്തി വേണ്ട
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola; Stay vigilant, don't panic.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, the World Health Organization has declared Ebola outbreaks in Africa a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The current outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo virus strain; there is no specific vaccine or universally effective antiviral for this strain. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated materials, not via casual airborne transmission. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include sudden fever, fatigue, and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and potential internal/external bleeding. Severe disease can cause shock, kidney and liver failure, and multi-organ failure. Treatment relies on intensive supportive care and timely ICU management—intravenous fluids, electrolyte balance, BP and oxygen monitoring, and organ support—since pathogen-specific therapies are limited. India reports no cases; authorities screen international arrivals and advise restricting nonessential travel to affected countries (DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan) to prevent importation. Remain vigilant, rely on official guidance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：警戒を怠らず、パニックに陥らないこと
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスのアフリカでの発生がWHOにより国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言されており、IHR基準4つ全て該当。深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が全て存在。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはアフリカ大陸、ウガンダ、南スーダン、インドが含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際の発生地は DR Congo、Uganda、South Sudan（スーダン）。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。インドは症例がなく、スクリーニング対象外。Bundibugyo virus strainによる2026年の発生で、ワクチンと有効な抗ウイルス薬の不在により、管理可能性のリスクが高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Moderna anuncia parceria para desenvolver vacina contra cepa Bundibugyo do ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moderna announces a partnership to develop a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Moderna and Cepi sign a partnership to develop a vaccine against Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV) amid the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. Cepi will invest up to $50 million for Moderna’s preclinical work and early clinical trials; additional funding includes up to $8.6 million for an Oxford University vaccine manufactured by Serum Institute of India and $3.2 million for a vaccine from the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative. WHO has prioritized experimental therapies, including antibodies, antivirals, and vaccines, for BDBV prevention and treatment. Four nurses treated in Bunia plus a laboratory technician have recovered, bringing total recoveries to five. Confirmed BDBV cases in the DRC reach 282 with 42 deaths after 19 new positives. Suspect Ebola cases in Brazil (São Paulo meningitis-positive; Rio de Janeiro malaria-positive) and Italy (Cagliari, Congo traveler; tested negative) are under investigation; travel history to DRC/Uganda is noted, with very low transmission risk per Italian authorities.

triage.headline_ja: Modernaがエボラウイルスのブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン開発パートナーシップを発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイク（確認症例282例、死亡42例）が進行中であり、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。複数国での疑似症例報告があり、WHO による予防・治療の優先化も示唆されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提示した発生地域にはイタリア、ウガンダ、英国も含まれているが、記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国が主要な発生地である。ブラジルとインド（血清研究所）は疑似症例の報告地またはワクチン製造国として確認。イタリアの症例は陰性確認済みのため verified_locations から除外。エボラのブンディブギョ株は稀な株であり、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya protests: 'This will expose our people to Ebola': Kenya holds massive protests against quarantine centers for affected US citizens - THE LOCAL REPORT ARTICLES
article.articleSummary: Kenya protests eruped over plans to build an Ebola quarantine center at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki for U.S. citizens exposed to Ebola. The High Court suspended the facility and barred entry of foreign patients pending a hearing, following a petition by the Kenya Bar Association and a constitutional watchdog. The site, planned at Laikipia Air Base, would host about 50 isolation beds. Local leaders, including Governor Joshua Irungu, warned the project could expose residents near the base to Ebola; Health Minister Aden Duale said the center is for everyone, not just Americans. The U.S. pledged $13.5 million toward Kenya’s Ebola preparedness. Kenya has no confirmed Ebola cases, while Uganda reported nine cases and closed its border with the DRC, which has at least 282 confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola cases and over 1,000 suspected cases. No approved treatments or vaccines exist.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの抗議デモ：「これは私たちの人々をエボラにさらすことになる」：ケニアは米国市民の隔離施設計画に対する大規模デモを開催
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（致死率が高く重症度が高い）に関する国際的な懸念を伴うイベントであり、IHR基準で異常性・予想外性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが複数該当、かつWPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当する。DRC・ウガンダでの実際の患者発生がある中での地域的スケーリング懸念を反映している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地域検証：ケニア（対象国リストに含まれていない）での隔離施設計画を主題としているが、実際のエボラウイルス病患者の発生はDRC（確認患者282人、疑い例1,000人以上）とウガンダ（9例の患者、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない）に限定されている。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。米国への言及もあるが、これは隔離施設に向かう可能性のある米国市民の受け入れ準備のコンテキストであり、米国での発生ではない。ウガンダの患者報告およびDRCとの国境閉鎖は国際的な懸念を増幅している。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de ebola testa positivo para meningite em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola tests positive for meningitis in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: A 37-year-old man admitted in isolation at São Paulo's Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas tested PCR-positive for meningococcal meningitis after presenting with fever on arrival from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where an Ebola outbreak is ongoing. The confirmed meningitis diagnosis supersedes the initial Ebola suspicion, but officials say the Ebola assessment remains under rigorous investigation while final genomic results are pending. The case triggered a state health alert and activation of safety protocols in São Paulo, with municipal epidemiological surveillance and CVE-SP notified. Instituto Adolfo Lutz leads the laboratory and genomic analyses to determine the final diagnosis. The patient’s travel history and acute febrile illness necessitated immediate isolation to protect others; meningitis treatment is underway, while coinfection with Ebola is considered until genomic confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・サンパウロで、コンゴ民主共和国から入国した患者がエボラ疑似患者としながら髄膜炎で陽性判定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国を巻き込む国際的移動に伴う感染症イベントであり、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国からのエボラ流行地域からの入国者で、当初エボラ疑い患者として扱われたが、髄膜炎(Neisseria meningitidis)のPCR陽性確認。ただし最終ゲノム解析が未決定であり、エボラとの同時感染の可能性も完全には排除されていない。国境を越えた国際的な感染症リスク、複数の医療機関による対応の必要性、および社会的関心の高さから、シグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: Suspeita de ebola é descartada em paciente de São Paulo - 01/06/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola ruled out in patient from São Paulo - June 1, 2026
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola ruled out in a 37-year-old man from São Paulo, Brazil. On 2026-06-01, the Instituto Adolfo Lutz announced no Ebola virus genetic material was detected in the patient’s sample, and the case no longer qualifies as Ebola suspected. The man remains hospitalized in grave condition at Instituto Emílio Ribas, São Paulo. Earlier, the same institute noted on Saturday, May 30, 2026, the result for Neisseria meningitidis, the bacterium causing meningococcal meningitis, was confirmed. The patient is from the Democratic Republic of Congo, a country with areas of Ebola transmission, and had recently traveled there. The Ministry of Health said that before transfer to hospital he was treated at a UPA, presenting with high fever and malaria tests inconclusive.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの患者でエボラの疑い例が除外される - 2026年6月1日
triage.triage_reason: 確認済みの髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎症例であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。さらにDRCからの渡航歴があることで複数国関連の懸念事例。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い例は除外されたが、患者の髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が確認されており、これが主要な公衆衛生懸念。患者がDRCからの渡航者であり、DRC滞在中の感染リスク、および同院での院内感染リスクが存在。マラリア検査も結果不確定とされており、複合感染の可能性を考慮する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" تضطر "لارام" إلى فرض قيود صارمة على الرحلات إلى أمريكا - أحداث.أنفو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Ebola" forces RAM to impose strict travel restrictions on flights to the United States - Akhbar.info
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts Royal Air Maroc to impose strict travel restrictions on flights to the United States. Passengers who have resided in or visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days of US entry are barred from US-bound flights, with limited exemptions under direct US directives. Travelers allowed to fly must enter the US via designated airports and undergo rigorous medical screening upon arrival. Measures follow a new Ebola outbreak centered on the Bundibugyo strain that emerged in mid-May 2026, with 129 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 8 in Uganda officially reported. Approximately 1,077 suspected cases and 246 probable deaths have been recorded, raising concerns about spread to 11 African countries: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Democratic Republic of Congo, Burundi, and Somalia, according to Africa CDC. Published 2026-06-01.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」がロイヤル・エア・マロックに米国への便に対する厳格な旅行制限を強制 - Akhbar.info
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株、2026年5月中旬発生）により、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRC・ウガンダで129例・8例の確認症例、約1,077例の疑似症例、246例の死亡が報告され、11アフリカ国への拡大懸念あり。国際的な旅行制限措置が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供した発生地域には複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主たる対象は確認症例が報告されているDRC・ウガンダ、および対象国リストに含まれる懸念国（ザンビア）のみを verified_locations に含めた。米国も発生地域に含まれるが、記事では旅行制限措置の実施地であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生地ではないため除外。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Onu: "In RD Congo le donne sono più esposte al contagio di Ebola"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: "In DR Congo, women are more exposed to Ebola infection."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains active in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with women representing about two-thirds of those affected, as in the 2018–2019 outbreak. UN Women cited gendered exposure: women are typically the first caregivers in households and constitute the majority of healthcare workers, increasing their infection risk. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus opened a new 100-bed Ebola treatment and care center in Bunia, Ituri Province, the epidemic’s epicenter; 45 beds are currently in use, and a medical team from Kinshasa will soon join. He stressed the urgent need to stop transmission of the Bundibugyo virus, for which no approved drugs or vaccines exist, though early diagnosis can improve survival. The Director urged everyone to protect themselves and others, noting progress on vaccines and treatments while acknowledging that people can recover from Ebola. No case counts or fatalities are detailed in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 国連: 「コンゴ民主共和国ではエボラウイルスへの女性の曝露が増加している」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは高い致死率を持つ急性ウイルス性出血熱であり、IHR基準を複数満たす。DRCでの継続的な発生、国際的な関心の高さ、WHOの治療センター設置など、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo virus）の継続的な発生はDRCで確認されており、WHOの高官による治療センター設置と対応動員が報告されている。女性の感染割合が高いなど、特定の集団における脆弱性も指摘されている。ただし、具体的な感染者数と死亡者数が記事に記載されていないため、現在の疫学的規模の正確な把握は限定的である。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Τουλάχιστον 282 τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: At least 282 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: 282 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 264 in the eastern Ituri province; over 1,000 suspected cases involve Bundibugyo, for which no approved therapy or vaccine exists. Key challenges include early detection, rapid isolation, strict contact tracing (45% traced; 220 suspected cases under investigation), and safe burials. The most promising vaccine is rVSV Bundibugyo (single-dose) by IAVI, requiring 7–9 months before clinical trials. ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford University/Serum Institute of India) could be available in 2–3 months to assess efficacy, though additional animal data are needed to confirm safety for this strain. Ervebo, the vaccine for Zaire ebolavirus, appears ineffective against Bundibugyo. WHO, DRC and Uganda, CDC Africa and others are coordinating treatment protocols; vaccines/drugs will be used only within clinical trials to draw safe conclusions. Priority remains breaking transmission using established tools: monitoring, contact tracing, rapid diagnosis, isolation, patient care, community engagement, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：少なくとも282の確認事例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種）の大規模流行で、高い死亡リスク、急速な感染可能性、ワクチン/治療の欠如、国際的な対応調整が必要。
triage.notes: サマリーはDRCでの流行に焦点。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未承認、治療薬なし）の282確認例、1,000以上の疑い例。Uganda（Bluedot発生地域に含まれる）との国境接触リスクはあるが、サマリーでUgandaでの実際の発生は記載されておらず、WHO・CDC等の調整国として言及されているのみ。従ってUgandaは除外。India（Bluedot発生地域に含まれる）はワクチン開発のSerum Instituteが言及されているだけで、実際の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nữ blogger 39 tuổi qua đời sau một tháng bị côn trùng cắn: Cảnh báo căn bệnh nguy hiểm dễ nhầm với cảm cúm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 39-year-old female blogger dies after a month of insect bites: Warning about a dangerous disease that is easily mistaken for the flu.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, a 39-year-old Chinese blogger from Yunnan, Hani Xiaowei, died after a month of illness linked to scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi). Transmitted by larval chiggers, infection often incubates 1–2 weeks and occurs in warm, humid outdoor areas such as grass, brush, streams, and forest edges. The patient delayed seeking care; she developed septic shock and multi-organ failure despite treatment. Early symptoms mimic influenza and include sustained high fever, severe headache, fatigue, and sore throat. A key diagnostic clue is a necrotic eschar with a black crust at the bite site, typically on soft skin folds (armpits, groin, waist, near the anus). Prevention focuses on protective clothing, insect repellents, and prompt medical evaluation if fever or rash follows outdoor exposure, especially after hiking or camping.

triage.headline_ja: 39歳の女性ブロガーが虫刺されから1ヶ月後に死亡：インフルエンザと間違いやすい危険な病気への警告
triage.triage_reason: つつが虫病による死亡事例であり、IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響は深刻か（死亡）」「異常か（稀な致命的感染症）」の2基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡）と管理可能性（診断遅延）で該当。中国・雲南省での重要な感染症シグナル。
triage.notes: つつが虫病（Orientia tsutsugamushi）による致命的症例。診断遅延による重篤化の事例であり、公衆衛生教育・啓発のシグナルとして重要。雲南省は温暖湿潤な環境でベクター媒介感染症が風土病的に存在する地域。インフルエンザとの鑑別診断の困難性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Teste descarta caso de Ebola em paciente internado em São Paulo | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out Ebola case in patient hospitalized in São Paulo | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, a 37-year-old man returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo was hospitalized in São Paulo, Brazil. An Adolfo Lutz test ruled out Ebola virus infection, with no viral genetic material detected. He had first sought care at a UPA; malaria was suspected but inconclusive. At Instituto Emílio Ribas, he developed diarrhea, disorientation, and rapid deterioration requiring intubation. Investigations confirmed meningococcal meningitis. Despite this, authorities continued Ebola surveillance as a precaution given his recent travel to an Ebola-affected region. He remains in isolation at Emílio Ribas under high-biosafety protocols. The report also outlines Ebola transmission by bodily fluids (not airborne), possible incubation of 2–21 days, and symptoms including fever, malaise, diarrhea, vomiting, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス検査で陰性と判定、サンパウロの入院患者の症例は除外される | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国滞在歴のある患者がサンパウロで髄膜炎菌髄膜炎と診断されており、エボラウイルスは除外されているため。スクリーニング基準に該当する可能性があるが、エボラ疑い症例の否定と確定診断があるため、社会的関心は限定的。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国からサンパウロに帰国した男性。エボラウイルス検査は陰性（遺伝物質検出なし）であり、確定診断は髄膜炎菌髄膜炎。重症度は高く（挿管が必要だった）、IHR基準で2項目該当するが、エボラ疑い症例の除外と重症度の高さから、フルRRAの前に続報を注視する判定。

article.articleHeadline: Caso suspeito de Ébola em Cagliari: doente no hospital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari: patient in hospital.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy: A patient showing symptoms compatible with Ebola was transported to Hospital Santissima Trinità’s Infectious Diseases unit after being taken from home. The individual had recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, triggering Ebola protocols in Cagliari. The Health Ministry said the patient is currently isolated in a hospital unit, with blood and other samples to be analyzed tonight by the Spallanzani Institute in Rome to confirm infection. Police, firefighters, and municipal authorities assisted in the response. Italy has recently deployed Spallanzani experts to the DRC. While authorities stress the risk of Ebola in Italy remains very low, the government is pushing for enhanced border controls and coordination ahead of EU meetings, including a videoconference of health ministers and EPSCO Council discussions on June 16–19, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: カリアリでエボラの疑い例：患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラの疑い例は高い公衆衛生上の懸念を示し、DRCからの持ち込みケースとして国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: イタリアでの疑い例であるが、対象国リストではイタリアは含まれていない。患者の渡航元であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。エボラは高い病原性を有し、DRCでの流行状況を踏まえると国際的に重要なシグナルである。確定診断待機中。

article.articleHeadline: ASF hits Dibrugarh & Tinsukia, officials enforce ban at markets
article.articleSummary: ASF (African swine fever) outbreaks in upper Assam's Dibrugarh and Tinsukia districts prompt swift containment, with the Dibrugarh farm at Romai Kordoibum in Lahowal confirming the case and a May 30 containment order, and Tinsukia's Uttar Rangpuria village in Kakopathar (Doomdooma co-district) as the epicenter following a May 26 order for a three-day culling May 27–29. Authorities imposed a 30-day ban on pork sale and movement, and designated infected and surveillance zones covering dozens of villages; markets in Sadiya sub-district (Chapakhowa Municipality, Shantipur Gaon Panchayat, Burhaburhi Gaon Panchayat, Dhola Bazar, Dangari Bazar, Talap Bazar) were inspected to ensure compliance. Pigs within zones undergo intensive clinical, virological and serological surveillance; forest-adjacent areas are surveilled in coordination with the forest department. Farmers face income losses; officials urge reporting of suspicious deaths and promise compensation and support as orders remain in force until further notice.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）がディブルガル・ティンスキアを襲う、当局が市場での販売禁止を強制
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱の動物感染症アウトブレイクとして異常・予想外であり、複数地域での感染確認と厳格な封じ込め措置が実施されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・流行可能性・管理対応の必要性）を複数満たす。動物衛生の観点からのシグナルとして検出値がある。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は動物衛生上の重要な感染症であり、複数の地区での同時発生、公式な封じ込め命令（5月26日、5月30日）、30日間の豚肉売却禁止令、農民の所得損失など、統治体による積極的な対応が確認される。記事は2026年6月1日付で、インド（アッサム州）の上流地域での発生を報告している。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準5項目全て該当。

article.articleHeadline: തൃശൂരിൽ മൂന്നു പേരെ ആക്രമിച്ച തെരുവ് നായക്ക് പേവിഷബാധ; നായ ചത്തു ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies infection in the stray dog that attacked three people in Thrissur; the dog died.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, a stray dog that attacked three people in Thrissur's Chovannoor area tested positive for rabies and died soon after the incident. The victims are Soumya, Rajeev's wife; 56-year-old Suresh; and 48-year-old Vijesh, all residents of the locality, who sustained injuries from the dog. Rabies infection was confirmed in the dog, underscoring the ongoing risk from stray animals in the region. The report notes that two of the injured had not completed the second dose of the post-exposure rabies vaccine, indicating gaps in prophylaxis for exposed individuals. The dog’s demise followed the attack, and the incident highlights the persistent rabies risk posed by stray dogs in Thrissur.

triage.headline_ja: トリッシュルで3人を襲った野犬に狂犬病感染；犬は死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響＆国際拡大リスク）。確認された狂犬病ケース3件と動物由来の人獣共通感染症で、予防接種の不完全接種が確認されている。
triage.notes: インド・ケーララ州トリッシュル地域での確認された狂犬病ケース。3名の被害者のうち2名が不完全な予防接種状態であることが公衆衛生上の懸念となる。野犬による人獣共通感染症は対象地域における継続的なリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta ebola em paciente internado no Instituto Emílio Ribas, em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out Ebola in patient admitted to Instituto Emílio Ribas in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, Ebola is ruled out in a 37-year-old man admitted to Instituto Emílio Ribas in São Paulo. The hospital reported no Ebola virus genetic material detected in his sample. Laboratory results instead identified Neisseria meningitidis, the meningococcal meningitis bacterium. The man, from the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an Ebola outbreak there (Bundibugyo strain), developed fever after travel and remained in isolation while diagnostic workup continued. A preventive investigation continues as tests proceed. Last week, São Paulo Health Secretariat updated a technical note from CVE and Instituto Adolfo Lutz on the Congo outbreak, outlining surveillance, case definitions, immediate notification, isolation, and lab workflows. Authorities say the risk of importing Ebola into Brazil and South America remains very low, but services should monitor fever with travel history within 21 days and contact with bodily fluids of suspected or confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロのエミーリオ・リバス研究所に入院中の患者のエボラ検査が陰性
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの疑似症例がエボラ検査で陰性となり、実際にはメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎と診断された。DRCでのエボラ流行の背景から監視継続は必要だが、輸入リスクは低いと当局が評価している。情報不足のため WATCH に分類。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジルでの疑似症例（エボラ陰性）だが、DRCでのエボラ流行の文脈で報道されている。患者はDRC渡航歴があり、現地でのBundibugyo株の流行と関連。ブラジル当局による監視継続の方針が示されており、社会的・政治的関心は高い。ただし患者診断がメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎で、実際のエボラ輸入リスクは低いと評価されているため、PICKUP とは判定しない。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz descarta Ebola em viajante belga no Rio; caso em SP tem meningite confirmada, mas investigação médica continua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz rules out Ebola in Belgian traveler in Rio de Janeiro; a case in São Paulo has confirmed meningitis, but the medical investigation continues.
article.articleSummary: Belgian traveler in Rio de Janeiro tested negative for Ebola after saliva, urine, and blood analyses; remains under marble-level biosafety isolation until discharged, having been diagnosed with malaria. He had symptoms of cough, chills, and diarrhea and had recently been in Uganda, a country with confirmed Ebola cases. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old Congolese patient at Instituto Emílio Ribas is under investigation for suspected Ebola after an initial meningitis diagnosis; Instituto Adolfo Lutz will perform Ebola-specific tests on Monday. The patient arrived in grave condition with fever, diarrhea, and disorientation and was intubated; sedation prevents confirming whether he traversed Ituri, North Kivu, or South Kivu. Both cases trigger Brazil’s high-risk disease contingency: isolation, health ministry notification, lab testing, and contact tracing. The outbreak in the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo totals 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths under investigation; 125 confirmed cases and 17 deaths; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death; no vaccine exists for this variant.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruzがリオデジャネイロのベルギー人旅行者のエボラを除外。サンパウロのケースは髄膜炎が確認されたが医学調査は継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な可能性のある症例検出であり、DRC由来のBundibugyo株による大規模発生が確認されている。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・公衆衛生への影響が該当し、ブラジルへの輸入症例の可能性があるため。
triage.notes: DRCのBundibugyo株エボラ発生（確定125例、疑い死亡223例）からの輸入症例の可能性。ブラジルの2ケースは最初は否定的/疑い段階だが、サンパウロの症例はエボラの確定検査待機中。DRCではワクチンが存在しない株。ウガンダでの確定9例と1死亡も確認されており、地域的な拡散が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 역대급 속도로 확산..."트럼프 지원 줄인 탓"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Spreads at an Unprecedented Rate... Blamed on Waning Support for Trump
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo at an unprecedented rate. So far, 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths have been reported. The outbreak began with the first confirmed onset on May 15, and two weeks later the case count has surged. The virus is the Bundibugyo variant, unlike the more familiar Zaire strain; there is no approved vaccine or therapy, and case fatality can reach about 50%. Incubation can extend to 21 days, and early symptoms mimic malaria or typhoid, delaying detection. Critical shortages of protective gear and diagnostic kits leave patients, families, and frontline health workers vulnerable. Critics blame diminishing international support after the Trump administration withdrew from WHO and dismantled USAID; Washington has since pledged around $23 million, deemed insufficient. Nearby Uganda and others have closed borders or airports, complicating aid access, while local distrust of health workers remains a challenge.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ史上最速で拡散...「トランプ支援削減のせい」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な速度の拡大、国際的拡大リスク、国境閉鎖による渡航制限実施中）。Bundibugyo株、高い致死率、ワクチン/治療法なし、急速な症例増加により国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Uganda は記事で国境閉鎖の言及あるが、主要な発生地はDRC。対象国リストに DRC (203312) のみ該当。Bundibugyo 株は Zaire 株と異なり、致死率約50%、利用可能なワクチン/治療法なし、潜伏期間21日と対応が困難。PPE と診断キットの深刻な不足が報告されている。国際的支援の減少と地域の保健従事者への不信が管理を困難にしている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Moderna anuncia parceria para desenvolver vacina contra cepa Bundibugyo do ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moderna announces partnership to develop a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Moderna and Cepi have formed a partnership to develop a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, in response to the ongoing outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Cepi will invest up to US$50 million to support Moderna’s preclinical development and initial clinical trials of the candidate vaccine. Cepi will also invest up to US$8.6 million in a vaccine developed by the University of Oxford and manufactured by Serum Institute of India, and US$3.2 million in a vaccine from the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative. This funding signals a broad, coordinated effort to advance Ebola vaccines amid regional spread in the DRC. The article does not provide case counts, laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported/exported cases; it solely notes the outbreak location and the vaccine development investments.

triage.headline_ja: Modernaがエボラウイルス・ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン開発パートナーシップを発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な疾患だが、本記事はワクチン開発の資金提供に関する発表であり、進行中のアウトブレイクの具体的な疫学情報（患者数、死亡数、確定診断数など）が記載されていない。シグナルとしてはIHR基準では情報不足のため判定困難だが、DRCでの流行継続と地域的拡大の可能性を考慮し、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ・ブンディブギョ株の流行が進行中であることが確認される。インドはSerum Institute of Indiaによるワクチン製造拠点として言及されているため対象国として含める。ただし本記事は疫学的詳細（患者数、死亡数、発症件数など）を欠いており、ワクチン開発の資金提供発表が主題であるため、フル規模のRRAの前には当該地域からのより詳細な疫学報告の続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cientos de personas se manifiestan en Kenia contra un centro de aislamiento para estadounidenses con ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of people protest in Kenya against an isolation center for Americans with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Hundreds in Nanyuki, central Kenya, protested plans to install an Ebola isolation center at Laikipia Air Base, arguing Kenya’s health system cannot safely manage foreign patients. The facility would host American citizens exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, as regional alarm grows with the DRC reporting 246 suspected deaths and 1,077 suspected cases in its seventeenth epidemic; Uganda is also affected. The Kenyan High Court temporarily blocked the center after petitions by the Kenyan Law Society and Katiba Institute, while the government emphasizes collaboration with Washington. Health Minister Aden Duale said the quarantine facility would serve all and align with international assistance obligations. The US State Department confirmed $13.5 million in support for Kenya’s Ebola preparedness. Legal voices urge locating such centers near outbreak epicenters. Kenya has no confirmed Ebola cases to date; Bundibugyo variant cited, with no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの数百人がエボラ患者のアメリカ人隔離センターに反対する抗議活動を展開
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRC内での大規模エボラ流行（246死亡疑い例、1,077疑い例）と地域への波及、国際的対応を伴う。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアの隔離センター設置への反対抗議が主題だが、実際のエボラ流行はDRC（246死亡疑い例、1,077疑い例）とウガンダで発生している。ケニアは現在確認症例なし。対象国リストにはケニアが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。高い社会的・政治的関心と国際的対応（米国$13.5百万支援）が認められる。

article.articleHeadline: Caso suspeito de ebola em paciente internado em São Paulo é descartado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in a patient hospitalized in São Paulo is ruled out.
article.articleSummary: On June 1, 2026, a 37-year-old immigrant from the Democratic Republic of Congo hospitalized at Emílio Ribas in São Paulo was ruled out for Ebola after Instituto Adolfo Lutz confirmed no Ebola virus genetic material in the patient’s sample. The man, previously seen at a UPA with fever and inconclusive malaria tests, arrived in grave condition with diarrhea and disorientation, requiring intubation. He remains in isolation under biosafety protocols, receiving antibiotics and hydration; contacts from the UPA and hospital are being monitored. A confirmed meningococcal meningitis diagnosis was established, with Ebola suspicion arising from recent travel to an Ebola-endemic country. Health authorities discussed a contraprova (repeat test) but have not disclosed a decision. Officials emphasize the risk of Ebola introduction in Brazil/South America remains very low due to no autochthonous transmission and the absence of direct flights from the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロに入院した患者のエボラ疑い例は除外された
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは検査で除外され、確定診断は髄膜炎菌髄膜炎。疑い例の解決により、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準のいずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はエボラ疑い例の除外確定である。確定診断は髄膜炎菌髄膜炎だが、単一例の診断報告であり、アウトブレイク的要素はない。DRCからの渡航者由来だが、ブラジル国内の感染拡大リスクは公式に『非常に低い』と評価されている。シグナル化の基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Race for Ebola vaccine gets $50m boost as medics struggle to trace contacts | The National
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has reached 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with only 20% of contacts traced as of 2026-06-01. Four nurses and a laboratory worker have recovered, bringing total recoveries to five, while the outbreak continues to expand in the east of the country, raising concerns about cross-border spread toward Uganda. Health authorities stress the need for intensified surveillance and care, noting no licensed vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola. In response, CEPI has committed up to $50 million to support development and early testing of a Moderna vaccine candidate; other shots are being developed by the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative and the University of Oxford, with production by Serum Institute of India. The WHO has designated the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, underscoring urgency for vaccines and robust response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチン開発に5000万ドルの支援決定、医療従事者が接触者追跡に奮闘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される状況（PHEIC）として指定され、複数国境地域での流行拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）が主な発生地で282確認例・42死亡を報告。ウガンダへの国境拡大リスクも明記されているが、記事主題はDRCの現在の流行状況。インドはワクチン製造（セラム・インスティテュート）の関連国として言及されているため含める。WHOがPHEIC指定済みであり、複数国家的支援体制が動員されている。接触者追跡率20%と低い管理効率も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn chặn từ sớm nguy cơ dịch Ebola xâm nhập qua đường hàng không
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early Prevention of the Risk of Ebola Entering Through Air Travel.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Civil Aviation Authority (CAAV) orders aviation-related bodies to bolster Ebola prevention and prevent entry via air travel. Measures require strict enforcement of outbreak controls, early detection of suspected cases, and appropriate responses at airports. Agencies must closely monitor passengers from outbreak regions, promptly identify suspected infections, isolate and monitor them, and tighten screening and discipline across airports. The CAAV also calls for closer coordination with the Ministry of Health and other relevant ministries and localities to inspect and detect Ebola infections, with airport authorities disseminating these requirements to all agencies operating at airports and airfields. WHO has warned that Ebola is a highly dangerous, high-mortality disease transmitted by direct contact with blood, secretions, or contaminated surfaces. Ongoing Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda have been flagged as international public health concerns due to cross-border spread and rapid transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 航空路による早期のエボラ流行侵入リスク防止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。現在進行中のDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行の国際的な広がりに対し、ベトナムが予防措置を強化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCおよびウガンダでの進行中のエボラ流行が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ベトナムは記事の主体的な対象国（航空局による予防措置強化）として含める。2026年6月時点の配信日付は未来の日付であるため注意。

article.articleHeadline: International Rescue Committee (IRC) warns Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) Ebola outbreak likely far larger than official figures suggest
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is likely far larger than official figures, with only 20% of contacts traced and diagnostic backlogs delaying confirmation. The virus may have been circulating before March, potentially three months prior, enabling multiple transmission chains across provinces and increasing cross-border risk to Uganda, Burundi, and South Sudan.
