Seven confirmed Ebola patients have left treatment centers, and more than six healthcare workers have died, including two doctors, highlighting fear and mistrust that drive people away from care. No approved vaccine exists for this strain. The IRC urges urgent international support to scale up contact tracing, surveillance, laboratory testing, and treatment capacity, plus community engagement. Response actions include PPE distribution, rehabilitation of triage areas, showers, latrines and waste disposal facilities, and border screening with Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 国際救援委員会（IRC）がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が公式発表より大規模である可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、エボラ出血熱という公衆衛生上の重大脅威、複数国への越境感染リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダ、ブルンジ、南スーダンへの越境感染リスクが言及されているが、これらは確認済みの発生地ではなく潜在的リスク地域であるため除外。ザンビアは Bluedot API の「発生地域」に含まれていない。エボラ出血熱の新規流行、ワクチン未承認株、医療従事者の死亡、接触者追跡の不十分さ（20%のみ）などから極めて高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Five health workers recover from Ebola in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri, northeast DR Congo, with five recoveries including four nurses at a Bunia hospital (all discharged per WHO). As of 2026-06-01, Congo has 282 confirmed Ebola cases after 19 new positive tests; Africa CDC reports 246 suspected deaths and more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. The outbreak, declared May 15 in Ituri, has since been detected in three provinces and in Uganda, indicating cross-border transmission. Laboratory confirmation is based on positive test results; the article does not specify an infection source. Ongoing response centers on hospital treatment, case confirmation, and expanded surveillance across affected sites to monitor transmission and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴでエボラ熱から回復した保健医療従事者5名
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。282確認症例、246疑い死亡、複数州およびウガンダでの国境越え感染確認による。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの国境越え伝播が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内の複数州（Ituri含む）での拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تبدأ إنشاء مركز لعزل مرضى إيبولا بتمويل أميركي رغم حكم قضائي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya begins constructing an Ebola patient isolation center with American funding despite a court ruling
article.articleSummary: Kenya plans to build an Ebola isolation center inside a US military base about 200 km north of Nairobi, funded by the United States, despite a Kenyan court's temporary injunction blocking the agreement. The 50-bed facility at Laikipia Air Base will be operated by American personnel to treat Ebola patients, including U.S. citizens. The US has earmarked $13.5 million for Kenya's preparedness and deployed 30 health officials. The court pause followed rights groups' concerns about health risks. Congo's Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak has at least 282 cases and 42 deaths as of May 30, with spillover to Uganda (9 cases, 1 death). WHO warns the outbreak outstrips response capacity; Africa CDC and WHO are coordinating funding, with Burundi receiving $11 million. Total pledges reach about $290 million of $500 million needed.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが米国の司法判断に反して米国資金によるエボラ患者隔離センター建設を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な複数国での発生（DRC、ウガンダ、ブルンジ）、WHO警告、国際的な資金調達と支援、及びケニアでの予防的な施設構築という点で、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）とWPRO基準複数個に該当する重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: DRCでのBundibugyo ebolavirus暴発（282症例、42死亡）が核となるイベント。ウガンダ、ブルンジでの波及、ケニアでの予防的施設整備という国際的対応が記されている。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当。WHOが対応能力超過を警告し、アフリカCDC等が資金調達・調整中。高リスク評価でフルRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Pílula Farmacêutica 186#: Substância de árvore nativa brasileira mostra poder contra coronavírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pharmaceutical Pill 186#: Substance from a native Brazilian tree shows activity against coronavirus.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-01, the Pílula Farmacêutica episode details a discovery where a substance from Copaifera lucens, the red copaiba tree native to Brazil and found mainly in the Atlantic Forest, exhibits activity against coronavirus. The study identifies galloylquinic acids that can block viral entry into cells, reduce replication, and interfere with viral protein production in laboratory tests. The research, led by Felipe Rodrigues de Andrade under Regina Andrade at USP's Ribeirão Preto Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences, involves Jairo Kenupp Bastos, an expert in copaíba phytochemistry and pharmacology, collaborating with teams in Egypt and the Czech Republic. Although prior data showed antifungal, anticancer, and antiviral properties of copaíba extracts, in vivo studies and clinical trials are still needed before any COVID-19 drug development. The work highlights Brazil's biodiversity as a strategic source for new therapeutics.

triage.headline_ja: 医薬品ピル186#：ブラジル原産樹木の物質がコロナウイルスに対する活性を示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究段階の報告であり、実際の感染症発生イベントではなく、COVID-19に対する潜在的な治療物質の実験室試験結果の記述である。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント（症例の発生、流行）ではなく、研究機関（USPリベイラン・プレト薬学部）による基礎研究の公開報道である。Bluedotが発生地域として複数国（米国、エジプト、チェコ）を抽出しているが、これらは研究協力機関の所在地であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではない。したがって検証対象国はブラジルのみ。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: KLM cancela todos los vuelos a Uganda tras las restricciones por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KLM cancels all flights to Uganda after Ebola restrictions.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, KLM canceled all flights to and from Entebbe International Airport near Kampala, Uganda, due to travel and entry restrictions linked to an Ebola outbreak in Africa. Although Entebbe is not currently an active-risk zone, restrictions for people who recently passed through Entebbe, including crew, prevent operation. Two Amsterdam–Entebbe flights with a Kigali layover were canceled for Saturday and Monday, per Flightradar24. The World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo variant of the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though not a pandemic. In May, the EU imposed stricter travel controls to curb spread. Brussels Airlines reported crew-entry restrictions for those who had been in DRC or Uganda in the prior 21 days and planned to adjust scheduling to serve Entebbe and Kinshasa, plus New York and Washington. Air France diverted Paris–Detroit to Montreal on May 20 after a passenger from DRC boarded by error; Emirates urged travelers to check entry requirements amid Ebola measures in several countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ制限の後、KLMがウガンダへのすべての便をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外、国際的な拡大リスク）。WHOがエボラ爆発をPHEICに宣言し、複数国での渡航制限・航空便キャンセルが実施されている。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言、Bundibugyo variant、複数国での渡航制限・航空便運休が報告されている。記事サマリーではDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ爆発が明記されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。北米・ヨーロッパの都市名が多く記載されているが、これらは渡航制限の二次的影響地点であり、実際の発生地はDRC。

article.articleHeadline: La presidenza Ue convoca una riunione straordinaria dei ministri della Salute sull'Ebola - Notizie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The EU Presidency Convenes an Extraordinary Meeting of Health Ministers on Ebola - News
article.articleSummary: Cyprus, holding the EU presidency, will convene an extraordinary videoconference of health ministers on Friday, June 5 at 15:00 to address a recent Ebola epidemic in Central Africa and to discuss additional preparedness and coordination measures among EU member states. The topic is the ongoing Ebola outbreak in Central Africa. According to ANSA, an Ebola test for a patient who returned to Sardinia from Congo was negative; the Health Ministry says the risk in Italy remains very low. Tests were conducted by Rome's Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases. The meeting underscores EU-level coordination to monitor cross-border threats and strengthen surveillance, testing, and response capacity in member states amid the Central African outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: EU大統領国がエボラに関する健康大臣の臨時会合を召集 - ニュース
triage.triage_reason: 中央アフリカにおけるエボラアウトブレイク（対象国DRCを含む）が主題であり、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」に該当（2つ以上）。EU政府レベルの対応と国際調整が実施されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカ（DRC）におけるエボラアウトブレイクを主題としており、イタリア（Rome、Sardinia）での輸入患者（検査陰性）は報告背景の補足情報。EU大臣級会合の召集は国際的対応の強化を示唆。verified_locationsはDRCのみ（イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, rientra l'allarme in Sardegna: negativo il test del paziente ricoverato a Cagliari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, alarm subsides in Sardinia: the test on the patient hospitalized in Cagliari is negative.
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert subsides in Sardinia as a test on a patient hospitalized in Cagliari returns negative. A man who had just returned from the Congo called emergency services and was placed in biocontainment at Santissima Trinità Hospital in Cagliari for diagnostic work-up after developing symptoms. The analyses were conducted by Rome's Spallanzani Institute. The patient returned to Italy on May 30; yesterday he exhibited symptoms, prompting transport to the hospital under established protocols. The Health Ministry said the Ebola test is negative and that the overall risk to Italy remains very low. The ministry is maintaining contact with Sardinia's health authorities as investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、サルデーニャでの警戒解除：カリアリ入院患者の検査は陰性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴからの帰国者について懸念された症例であるが、エボラウイルス検査が陰性と確認され、イタリア保健省は国全体のリスクが極めて低いと評価。既に検査段階を完了し、確定患者ではない。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴからイタリアに帰国した人物であるが、エボラ検査は陰性確定。発生地域リストにはイタリアも含まれているが、イタリア国内でのエボラ確定患者はなく、単なる疑い患者の除外ケースである。DRCは対象国であるため verified_locations に含めたが、記事本文の主題はイタリアでの検査結果であり、DRC国内での新規発生情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: BLOG: Why Precision Matters in Uganda's Ebola Narrative
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports 9 Ebola Virus Disease cases, 1 death; all linked to travel from the DRC, with no uncontrolled community transmission. The index case traveled from Bunia to Kampala; rapid isolation and contact tracing kept the outbreak contained. DRC reports 282 confirmed cases, 42 deaths, and over 200 suspected cases. Borders are open for trade, with restrictions at the Uganda-DRC border. CDC places Uganda at Level 1; DRC at Level 3. Aggregating Uganda and DRC data has harmed Uganda’s tourism and business through misperceived regional risk. Uganda cites its outbreak-response pedigree (Gulu 2000, Bundibugyo 2007, 2022 Sudan ebolavirus), urging precision in reporting to reflect localized containment.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラウイルス病の叙述における精密性の重要性について
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な多国間イベント（ウガンダとDRC）であり、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクに該当。ウガンダでの確認患者と死亡、DRCでの大規模流行報告により、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性にも該当。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの限定的な患者発生（9例、1死亡）に焦点を当てているが、リンク先となっているDRC（282確認例、42死亡）での大規模流行を背景としている。ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため通常の評価では含まれないが、DRC（対象国ID 203312）での確認イベントとして重要。記事の主題はウガンダでの対応能力と地域限定的な封じ込めの実証であるが、国際的なエボラウイルス病流行シグナルとして評価。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta ebola em paciente hospitalizado em São Paulo - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out Ebola in a patient hospitalized in São Paulo - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola in a 37-year-old immigrant from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, hospitalized at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas in São Paulo, Brazil, was ruled out by Adolfo Lutz; no Ebola virus RNA detected. The patient, evaluated after a UPA visit for fever, was later diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis and remains in isolation, having required intubation. He is being treated with antibiotics and intravenous hydration. Contacts traced on the airplane and at the UPA are under monitoring. The health authorities assess Ebola's introduction risk in Brazil and South America as very low, citing no autochthonous transmission on the continent, no direct flights from the outbreak region, and the transmission requiring direct contact with blood, secretions, or fluids from symptomatic infected individuals. As of 1 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの入院患者のエボラ検査は陰性 - ジョルナル・オ・スル
triage.triage_reason: エボラは検査で除外されたが、患者は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎と診断され隔離中。ブラジルでのエボラ導入リスクは極めて低いとされており、重症度および国際拡大リスクは限定的と評価される。ただし、DRCからの渡航者による疑い事例が確認された点と、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が報告されている点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: エボラは検査で除外されたため、直接的なエボラ発生イベントではない。しかし、DRCからの渡航者による疑い患者が報告された点、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の確定診断、患者の重症度（挿管が必要）、および航空機搭乗者・医療施設接触者の追跡調査が実施されている点が注視対象。ブラジルでのエボラ導入リスクは当局により極めて低く評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta ebola em paciente internado em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out Ebola in patient hospitalized in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: 37-year-old man hospitalized at Instituto Emílio Ribas, São Paulo, Brazil, tested negative for Ebola after Adolfo Lutz analysis found no Ebola virus genetic material. He had been diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis; Ebola was investigated due to recent travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and compatible symptoms. He presented high fever, diarrhea, disorientation, and rapid clinical deterioration requiring intubation and remains in isolation under biosafety protocols. A repeat or confirmatory test decision was being considered by health authorities, with no announcement yet. Brazilian officials say the risk of Ebola introduction in Brazil and South America remains very low, given no autochthonous transmission in the continent and transmission only via direct contact with fluids from symptomatic individuals. The WHO reports 134 confirmed Ebola cases and 18 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; Brazil has no autochthonous transmission.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの入院患者のエボラをテストで除外
triage.triage_reason: 患者のエボラ感染は検査で除外されており、確認された感染症イベントではない。DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行は報告されているが、本記事の主題はブラジルでの陰性確認事例であり、実際の流行ではなく疑い事例の除外である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジルでのエボラ疑い事例の除外であり、確認されたエボラ感染イベントではない。患者は最終的にメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎と診断された。DRCとウガンダでの流行は言及されているが、本記事の焦点ではなく、これらの国での新規患者報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Главный эпидемиолог РБ оценил риски завоза Эболы в Башкирию " Новости Уфы и Республики Башкортостан - UfaTime.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Chief Epidemiologist of the Republic of Bashkortostan assessed the risks of Ebola being imported into Bashkortostan.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus-driven outbreak is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as of May 29, 2026, with more than 900 suspected cases, 134 laboratory-confirmed infections, and 18 deaths, including at least 16 healthcare workers. This rare Ebola variant differs from Zaire ebolavirus; there are no licensed vaccines or approved therapies for Bundibugyo, though candidate vaccines are in clinical trials. In Bashkortostan, Azat Mukhametzyanov, Chief Freelance Epidemiologist of the Ministry of Health and chief physician of the Republican Clinical Infectious Diseases Hospital, said there is no immediate threat to Bashkortostan or to Russia. The report emphasizes regional safety despite ongoing international concerns.

triage.headline_ja: バシコルトスタン共和国の主任疫学者、エボラウイルスのバシコルトスタンへの流入リスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてが該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀少な変異体）による発生で、致死率が高く、ワクチンが未承認であり、医療従事者への感染が確認されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとRussian Federationが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は、DRCおよびUgandaでのBundibugyo ebolavirus発生、およびロシア・バシコルトスタンでの輸入リスク評価である。Ugandaは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。ロシアも対象国外。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当するため、DRCを verified_locations に含める。稀少な変異体による発生、利用可能なワクチン・治療法の欠如、医療従事者への感染があり、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Homem com suspeita de ebola viajou de Guarulhos ao Rio de ônibus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regional Newspaper: Man with suspected Ebola traveled by bus from Guarulhos to Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro is investigating a suspected Ebola case. The patient is isolated at the Evandro Chagas Institute (INI/Fiocruz), the city’s reference unit for infectious diseases. He is from Uganda and arrived in Brazil on May 22 after a flight from Johannesburg, South Africa, then traveled by bus from Guarulhos (Greater São Paulo) to Rio de Janeiro. Upon arrival, he stayed in the Vila Isabel neighborhood. Five other residents sharing the same residence are being monitored and remain asymptomatic. The information comes from the Ministry of Health. The article notes the case as suspected Ebola, with no laboratory confirmation mentioned, and emphasizes monitoring of contacts as a precaution to prevent potential transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 地域新聞：ギャラルオスからリオデジャネイロへバスで移動したエボラ疑い患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱疑い患者が複数州にまたがる移動と接触者監視中。
triage.notes: ウガンダから到着した患者によるエボラ疑い事例。国際移動と複数州での接触者監視が確認された。南アフリカを経由していることに注意。ただし対象国リストではブラジルのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, in Puglia 'nessuna situazione di particolare allarme' - Notizie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, in Apulia 'no particular cause for alarm' - News
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Apulia, Italy: as of 1 June 2026, authorities report no evidence of a heightened alarm in Puglia. Preventive measures are activated to ensure surveillance, prevention, and operational readiness per Health Ministry directives and the national infectious disease emergency system. An ordinance governs Ebola prevention, surveillance, and potential management of suspected cases. Instructions have been issued to all ASLs, hospital trusts, IRCCS, Prevention and Emergency Departments, infectious disease units, Usmaf-Sasn, and Prefectures. Regional procedures include immediate activation of Prevention Departments, publication of dedicated email addresses for auto-reporting, 24‑hour risk-based evaluation of reported individuals, and use of the regional Iris platform for reporting suspected, probable, or confirmed cases, with transmission to the national Premal platform. Specialist clinical-epidemiological evaluation centers are Bari’s Policlinico and Giovanni XXIII. Citizens from Congo and Uganda are urged to self-report, self-monitor, and contact their local Prevention Department.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、プーリア州で「特別な懸念はない」状況 - ニュース
triage.triage_reason: イタリア（対象国外）での予防対応の報道であり、実際の患者発生やアウトブレイクは報告されていない。ただし、DRC及びウガンダからの個人への自己報告呼びかけがあり、シグナルの初期段階として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイタリア（プーリア州）での予防対応体制の説明であり、実際のエボラ患者発生は報告されていない。DRCとウガンダからの個人への自己報告呼びかけは、これらの国でのエボラ流行の存在を示唆するが、本記事の主題はイタリアでの対応である。DRCのみ対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。イタリアも対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola registra 263 casos confirmados na RDC e em Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola records 263 confirmed cases in the DRC and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 May 2026, Ebola cases across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda reach 263 confirmed, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation and 43 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain. This outbreak is the 17th in the DRC and the third largest since the virus’s discovery about 50 years ago. The World Health Organization has declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Health authorities report operational challenges, including shortages of essential supplies such as masks and initial detection delays by several weeks. Authorities urge rapid activation of national incident systems and sustained investments in pandemic preparedness, noting that international support is most effective when aligned with the strategies of African governments and institutions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで263例の確定患者を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。ブンディブギョ株による263確定患者、1,100以上の疑い患者、43死亡が報告されており、国際的なシグナルピックアップに該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダに言及しているが、対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国（203312）のみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、初期検出の遅延、医療用品不足など管理上の課題が指摘されている。アフリカ地域への国際支援の必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: A deadly Ebola outbreak in an era of global aid cuts: An imperative for Corporate Africa's boardrooms to capture the health security premium
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in Ituri Province, DRC, announced 15 May 2026; 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths reported. Uganda confirms its first cross-border case with a fatal outcome. Lab results identify Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment, complicating containment across Central and Eastern Africa’s mining and trade corridors. The World Health Organization declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 16 May 2026, and Africa CDC followed with a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security on 18 May 2026, elevating it to a boardroom priority. Africa’s health-security gains, including Field Epidemiology Training Programmes, are tested as non-vaccine strains and reduced aid heighten risk to supply chains and livelihoods under AfCFTA. The outbreak underscores the need for sustained corporate investment in health systems, workforce, and cross-border coordination to protect regional commerce and stability.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的な援助削減の時代における致命的なエボラ出血熱の流行：アフリカの企業経営陣が保健セキュリティプレミアムを捉える必要性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的流行でWHOおよびアフリカCDCが公式宣言。IHR基準4つ全て該当し、ワクチン未開発株による高い重症度と国境を越えた拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC（イトゥリ州）での発生とウガンダでの国境越境例が明記されている。ウガンダはGeoNames IDリストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOおよびアフリカCDCが公式に国際的懸念を宣言済み。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・承認治療がないという高リスク要因も認識される。

article.articleHeadline: O que se sabe sobre o caso suspeito de Ebola investigado em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is known about the suspected Ebola case under investigation in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, São Paulo authorities are evaluating a suspected Ebola case in a 37-year-old man from the Democratic Republic of Congo, a country with active Ebola transmission (Bundibugyo strain). The patient recently returned to Brazil and presented fever and symptoms meeting the suspected case definition. Although laboratory testing confirmed a bacterium causing meningitis, Ebola testing and genomic analyses are being conducted as part of differential diagnosis. He remains isolated at the Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, with preventive isolation, monitoring, and mandatory notification to epidemiological surveillance. The State Health Secretariat notes the risk of Ebola introduction into Brazil remains very low, given no transmission in South America, no direct flights between affected regions and the continent, and the virus’s transmission requiring contact with blood, secretions, or other bodily fluids of symptomatic cases. Vigilance for febrile travelers or contacts is advised; further updates will follow lab results.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで調査中の疑いエボラ症例について知られていること
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）の疑い症例であり、DRCからの帰国者からの導入リスクが存在するため監視対象。ただし、実験室検査で髄膜炎の細菌が確認され、ブラジル当局がエボラ導入リスクは非常に低いと評価しており、現時点では確認症例ではなく情報が限定的であるため。
triage.notes: DRCからサンパウロに帰国した患者の疑い症例。実験室検査では髄膜炎起因菌が確認されたがエボラ検査・ゲノム解析進行中。患者は隔離され監視下にある。ブラジル当局はブラジルへの導入リスク非常に低いと評価しているが、活動的なエボラ伝播国からの帰国者であり継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta ebola em paciente internado em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out Ebola in patient admitted to hospital in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Tests for Ebola in a 37-year-old man hospitalized in São Paulo were negative, though a repeat test will be performed to confirm against a false negative. The man, who had meningococcal meningitis confirmed two days earlier, had recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and presented fever, meeting the suspected case definition. Preventive epidemiological investigations were conducted under national and state protocols. In São Paulo, suspected cases must be promptly reported to municipal epidemiological surveillance and the state centre for epidemiological surveillance; 2014 saw three suspected cases that were later discarded. Officials say the risk of importation into Brazil remains very low, given no documented autochthonous transmission in South America, no direct flights from the region, and the disease's transmission requiring direct contact with blood, secretions, bodily fluids, or tissues of symptomatic patients.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの入院患者のエボラ検査が陰性と判定
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い例が検出されたものの、初期検査は陰性で追加確認が予定されている。ブラジルへのエボラ輸入リスクは低いと判断されているが、DRCとの関連と確認検査の結果待機中のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: エボラの初期検査は陰性だが、患者は確認されたムコイドリン髄膜炎症例であり、DRC渡航歴がある。確認検査の実施予定のため、結果が重要。ブラジル当局はリスクを低く評価しているが、検査結果まで監視継続推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-smittede sygeplejersker er kommet sig og spreder nyt h
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-infected nurses have recovered and are spreading new hope.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, a deadly virus, continues to spread in African countries and possibly Brazil. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a glimmer of good news has emerged: the Ebola infection was detected a little over two weeks ago after likely circulating for several weeks undetected. The article notes that nurses infected with Ebola have recovered, contributing to renewed optimism amid the outbreak. Citing AFP, the report underscores ongoing transmission risk and the challenges of early detection in resource-limited settings. While the excerpt does not provide case counts, the timing indicates recent laboratory confirmation and public health response. The mention of Brazil suggests possible imported cases or cross-continental spread, highlighting the need for international vigilance and coordinated containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染者である看護師たちが回復し、新たな希望を広げている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。エボラウイルスの複数国での発生と医療従事者への感染により、国際的な感染症危機管理対応が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生の確実な記述あり。ブラジルについては、記事サマリーで「possibly Brazil」と可能性言及されており、確定的な発生ではなく疑い例または輸入症例の可能性が示唆される。両国ともWPRO対象国であり、医療従事者の感染と回復という特異的な要素が報告されている。DRCでの数週間未検出での流行継続と早期発見の困難性が強調されており、国際的な封じ込め努力の必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : une église suspend ses activités après trois cas de décès - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: a church suspends its activities after three deaths - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola epidemic prompts the suspension of all activities at the La Louange church until further notice. The measure follows the death of three church members linked to Ebola. The suspension covers morning prayers, choir rehearsals, Sunday services, and other activities conducted within church cells; worshippers are urged to maintain home prayers while awaiting resumption. Church leaders ordered systematic disinfection of worship spaces under their responsibility and encouraged congregants to strictly follow health authorities’ guidance to reduce transmission. The decision comes amid strengthened Ebola response in Ituri, where authorities and partners continue awareness, epidemiological surveillance, and prevention efforts to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ：3人の死亡者が出た後、教会が活動を中止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例（死亡3人を含む）が報告されており、IHR基準で「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。DRCにおけるエボラ流行は国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として認識される。
triage.notes: DRCはエボラの風土病地域であり、イトゥリ州での流行は重大な懸念事項。教会での複数死亡例は地域社会への感染リスクを示唆。当該地域での公衆衛生対応強化が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil descarta un caso sospechoso de ébola y continúa otro en investigación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil rules out a suspected Ebola case and another remains under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Health Ministry ruled out Ebola in a Rio de Janeiro case: a Ugandan man who arrived May 22 with feverish symptoms; malaria diagnosed, but Ebola tests were negative; he remains isolated as officials finish inquiries. A second suspected case is in São Paulo: a 37-year-old man who had been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, arrived in grave condition with diarrhea and disorientation, was intubated, and tested positive for severe meningitis; he remains isolated during the Ebola investigation. The ministry says the risk of transmission in Brazil and South America is low. Separately, Africa reports over 1,100 suspected Ebola cases in DRC and Uganda; the Ituri outbreak in northeastern DRC was declared May 15, caused by the Bundibugyo strain; no vaccine or specific treatment; transmission via body fluids or blood; incubation up to 21 days; a regional $319 million response plan was adopted.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルが疑わしいエボラ事例を除外し、もう一つは調査継続中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の2例はいずれも確定診断に至っていない（1例は陰性、1例は調査中）。ただしDRC・ウガンダでの実患者イベント（1,100例超、Bundibugyo株）が並列記述されており、DRC領域でのシグナルとしての価値あり。情報不足のため経過観察段階。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内2例は確定診断に至っていないため即座のシグナルとはいえないが、DRC・Ituri地域の1,100例超の疑い症例・実患者イベント（Bundibugyo株、2026年5月15日宣言）が記事本体の主要内容。DRCは対象国に含まれるため記載。情報の詳細性が不足しており（発症日、確定症例数、死亡数等）、フルRRAへの進行には続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: بارقة أمل في الكونغو.. تعافي حالات مصابة بـ "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A glimmer of hope in Congo... Recovery of Ebola-infected patients.
article.articleSummary: On June 1, 2026, the World Health Organization reported progress in the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Four nurses treated for Ebola in Bunia, Ituri Province, have been discharged after recovering; a laboratory worker also recovered earlier, bringing total recoveries to five. Early diagnosis and adequate care are seen as key to improving outcomes. The DR Congo’s confirmed Ebola cases rose to 282, with 42 deaths, after 19 new positives were detected. Suspected cases were identified in Brazil and Italy linked to travel from affected areas, with Italy reporting a negative test. The outbreak, spanning Congo and Uganda, had previously been declared a public health emergency of international concern, though not all criteria were met. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed that, despite no licensed vaccine or treatment, survival is possible with good medical care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの希望の光...エボラに感染した患者の回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度と死亡率を示し、国際的な拡大リスク（ブラジル・イタリアで疑似症例）があり、公衆衛生上の影響は深刻。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの既知イベントの進展報告であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当するためフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラ発症例はDRC（ブニア、イトゥリ州）での発生が主題。ブラジル・イタリアでの疑似症例は旅行関連の「疑い」段階であり、確定的な発症地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。ウガンダはAPI発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー上では「ウガンダとコンゴにまたがる流行」と過去形で述べられており、現在の新規症例の詳細記載がないため除外。このイベントはWHO既知のPHEIC（公衆衛生上国際的に懸念される事象）であり、回復症例の報告は肯定的進展を示すが、新規確定症例282件・死亡42件という継続的な拡大を示すため、シグナル性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Протести в Кения срещу плановете за карантинен център за изложени на eбола американци
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protests in Kenya against plans for a quarantine center for Americans exposed to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In Nanyuki, Kenya, hundreds of youths protested plans to establish a quarantine center for people exposed to Ebola at Laikipia Air Base, two days after Kenya’s High Court temporarily halted the project and the entry of foreign patients pending review. Plaintiffs argued Kenya’s health system lacks capacity to quarantine foreign Ebola-exposed individuals. US officials said Washington plans to send citizens exposed abroad to the Kenyan facility rather than return home, and the center would host about 50 quarantine beds. Kenya’s health ministry said the facility would serve all in need, not only Americans. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced $13.5 million to help Kenya prepare for possible Ebola cases. Kenya has not reported Ebola cases; Uganda reports nine and has closed its border with DR Congo. In DR Congo, Bundibugyo strain has 282 cases, with over 1,000 suspected cases under investigation, and no approved specific treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ曝露者向け隔離センター計画に対する抗議活動
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（高致命性）の国際的な患者移送計画であり、IHR基準で「国際的拡大のリスク」「渡航制限のリスク」に該当。DRCでの活動的な流行（282症例、1000以上の疑い症例）と米国からの患者移送計画により、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの抗議活動であるが、感染症イベント自体はDRC（Bundibugyo株、282症例、1000以上の疑い症例）が主要な流行地。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ウガンダも9症例を報告しているが対象国リストに含まれない。DRCが対象国のため含める。国際的な患者移送計画と米国の支援（13.5百万ドル）が示唆する国際的関心度の高さは注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: La lutte contre Ebola vient de remporter une victoire cruciale dans son foyer le plus dangereux
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fight against Ebola has just won a crucial victory in its most dangerous epicenter.
article.articleSummary: Five recoveries have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of Congo, including four nurses and one laboratory technician discharged after treatment. The health ministry reports 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with 19 new positives. The World Health Organization notes remissions among early-treated patients but warns transmission chains remain active and cases rise. The outbreak has reached Uganda, prompting border closures. The epidemic concentrates in eastern DRC provinces, mineral-rich and conflict-affected, and is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which no vaccine or targeted therapy exists. WHO classified the situation as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern last month. Delays in identifying initial cases hinder contact tracing, and Africa CDC warns ten other countries are exposed: Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Congo Brazzaville, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia. International commitments total about 498.8 million USD (World Bank 160m, US 82m, Europe ~57m, UN 60m).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策は最も危険な震源地で重大な勝利を収めた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC指定済みの進行中エボラウイルス感染症。複数国への国際的拡大、高い致死率、活発な感染鎖が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドには11カ国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーで実際に確認された感染症イベントの主題国は、確認症例282件・死亡42件が報告されているDRCと、WHOの警告で露出危険国として明示されザンビアのみ。記事はWHO PHEIC指定、国際的な資金動員（約4億9880万USD）、ワクチン・治療法の不在、紛争地域での感染拡大リスク等を述べており、重大な国際保健上の脅威を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Пет пацијената опорављених од еболе напустило болницу у ДР Конгу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Ebola-recovered patients left the hospital in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola patients recovered and were discharged from a hospital in Bunia, Ituri Province, DR Congo, with four nurses among the group (three men and one woman). A ceremony awarded recovery certificates. The first recovered patient, a laboratory worker, left hospital last week; health officials note frontline workers are among the most exposed. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged that the outbreak can be stopped, expressing heartbreak for health workers who died and praising those returning to service. Officials say early detection, contact tracing, safe burials, and community trust are essential to containment. In DR Congo, the outbreak has registered over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths, with spread to neighboring Uganda and cases clustered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, and some in Kampala. Brazil is investigating two suspected Ebola cases in Sao Paulo.

triage.headline_ja: ザイール型エボラウイルス病から回復した5人の患者がコンゴ民主共和国の病院を退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク継続中で、DRC国内および隣国ウガンダへの拡大、ブラジルでの疑い例確認により、グローバルな懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した地域にはブラジル（サンパウロ）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではブラジルは「疑い例を調査中」との記載のみで、確定した発生地域ではない。したがってverified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。ウガンダについても拡大事例が記載されているが、本記事の主題はDRCの患者回復であるため、DRCのみを対象国として識別。エボラウイルス病は致命率が極めて高く、1,000件以上の疑い例と246名以上の死亡が確認されており、ヘルスワーカーを含む多くの感染者が存在する。早期発見、接触者追跡、安全な埋葬、コミュニティとの信頼構築が収束の鍵とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, la Puglia attiva la rete di sorveglianza sanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Apulia activates its health surveillance network.
article.articleSummary: Apulia activates its health surveillance network for Ebola virus disease. The Regione Puglia has implemented measures under the Health Ministry’s Ebola Virus Disease ordinance, establishing prevention, surveillance, and management procedures for suspected cases. The provisions target individuals arriving in Italy from the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Uganda, or who have been there within 21 days before entry; such persons must self-report to Prevention Departments within 24 hours of arrival. Regions must share email addresses publicly. Puglia has disseminated operative guidance to hospitals, prevention departments, infectious disease units, and authorities, and will use the regional IRIS platform for reporting suspected/probable/confirmed cases, with transmission to the national PREMAL system. Specialist clinical-epidemiological evaluation centers are Bari University Hospital’s Infectious Diseases unit and Giovanni XXIII Hospital in Bari; INMI Spallanzani offers 24/7 consultation. No alarm; measures are preventive and readiness-focused. Citizens arriving from DRC or Uganda should self-report and self-monitor.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：アプーリア州が保健監視ネットワークを発動
triage.triage_reason: イタリアでのエボラ関連の監視体制強化であるが、記事サマリーに「alarm（警報）なし」と明記されており、現在の患者発生報告なし。DRC・ウガンダからの入国者監視は予防的措置。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはイタリア・プーリア州・バーリが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はイタリアでの予防的監視体制であり、実際のエボラ患者発生はDRC・ウガンダである。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。イタリアは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。現時点で症例報告なく、予防的措置のため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Muyembe exige que seuls les cas confirmés en laboratoire soient comptabilisés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Muyembe demands that only laboratory-confirmed cases be counted.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompted calls for methodological rigor from Prof. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, director-general of INRB. He urged that only laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases be counted, arguing that including suspected cases risks inflating figures and misdirecting response teams toward illnesses like malaria or typhoid fever. With field-deployed laboratories, every suspected case should be sampled and confirmed without delay. 'The laboratory will tell us: this is a confirmed case. And that’s it,' he stated. Muyembe also emphasized the need for a reliable epidemic curve to precisely date the outbreak’s start and to monitor its true progression. The remarks advocate stricter data quality and real-time surveillance to guide public health actions in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：ムイエンベが検査で確認された症例のみをカウントすることを要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認患者が発生しており、DRC での深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的な拡大リスク（IHR基準2つ以上該当）、および異常性と重症度の観点からWPRO基準も該当。国家的な関心が高く、信頼できる疫学監視体制の確立が求められている。
triage.notes: 記事は検査確認症例のみをカウントする重要性を強調しており、DRCでのエボラ発生が進行中であることを示唆している。INRB所長ムイエンベの発言は、サーベイランス精度の向上とデータ品質管理の必要性を反映しており、公式な対応体制が構築されていることを示す。複合感染（マラリア、チフス）との鑑別診断の課題も言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: China ready to actively assist DRC, other African countries hit by Ebola: spokesperson
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts China to promise active assistance to Africa. On 2026-06-01, foreign ministry spokesperson Lin Jian said Beijing will provide emergency humanitarian aid to the DRC and send medical expert teams to deliver services and assistance on the ground. He noted China’s 2015 support to three West African countries during Ebola, and pledged to strengthen regional capacity through cooperation with Africa, including the African Union Commission, in epidemic prevention and control. Chinese medical teams are currently working shoulder to shoulder with African people, Lin said, and China will maintain close contact with the DRC and other affected nations to beat Ebola. He called on the international community to take concrete actions to defeat the outbreak at an early date.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ感染症に見舞われたDRCおよび他のアフリカ諸国を積極的に支援する準備ができていると報道官が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のDRCでの発生は公衆衛生に深刻な影響をもたらし、国際的な拡大リスクおよび多くの基準を満たすシグナルである。国際支援と関係省庁の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生を主題としており、中国の支援表明は対応コンテキストである。発生地域にはAngola、Chinaも列挙されているが、サマリーの主題はDRC発生に限定されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラは高い致死率、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性、入院・死亡リスク、および国際的な懸念が高い疾患であり、全てのスクリーニング基準およびIHR基準を満たす重大なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: تعافي مصابي إيبولا في الكونغو يمنح الأمل في مواجهة التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recovery of Ebola patients in the Democratic Republic of the Congo offers hope in the fight against the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak shows progress as four nurses at Bunia hospital and a laboratory worker have recovered, bringing total survivors to five. Confirmed cases reach 282 with 42 deaths, including 19 new lab-confirmed infections. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the third-largest since the virus was discovered. WHO had earlier declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Bundibugyo in DRC and Uganda. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed that the absence of a vaccine or approved treatment does not negate hope; early diagnosis and appropriate care can save lives. Africa CDC warns regional spread is a real risk, with over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. Internationally, Brazil reports two suspected cases among travelers from affected areas (Sao Paulo: suspected meningitis; Rio de Janeiro: malaria); Italy activated precautions in Cagliari for a returnee from DRC, but tests were negative and risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者の回復は流行対策への希望をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの活動的エボラ流行であり、複数国での患者検出とアフリカCDCの地域拡大リスク警告により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DRC/Uganda with confirmed PHEIC status by WHO。282確定症例、死亡42人、生存者5人報告。ブラジルは渡航者由来の疑い例2件。イタリアの疑い例は検査陰性。Africa CDCが地域拡大リスク（1,100以上の疑い例調査中）を警告。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta ebola em paciente internado em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test Rules Out Ebola in a Patient Hospitalized in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: A 37-year-old immigrant from the Democratic Republic of Congo hospitalized at Emílio Ribas, São Paulo, had Ebola ruled out by Instituto Adolfo Lutz; the test found no viral genetic material. The patient, diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis, initially presented at a UPA with fever, then developed diarrhea, disorientation, and rapid deterioration, requiring intubation and continued isolation. He is receiving antibiotics and hydration, with close monitoring of contacts from the flight and UPA. A decision on a repeat test (contraprova) is under consideration by health authorities. Officials emphasize the very low risk of Ebola introduction to Brazil or South America, given no endemic transmission on the continent, no direct flights from the affected region, and transmission requiring exposure to blood or body fluids of symptomatic cases. WHO declared an Ebola outbreak 15 days earlier in the DRC and Uganda (Bundibugyo strain): 18 deaths among 134 cases (13% CFR), with 223 deaths and 906 cases under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロに入院している患者のエボラを検査で除外
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者がエボラ疑いで入院したが検査で陰性と判定された事例。患者は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎と診断されており、エボラ感染は除外されている。ただしWHOが同時期にDRC/ウガンダでエボラ流行を宣言しており、国際的な関心と情報確度の観点から要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容：コンゴ民主共和国からの移民患者がサンパウロで入院し、エボラ疑いで検査されたが陰性判定。患者は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎と確定診断。ブラジルおよび南米へのエボラ流入リスクは極めて低いと評価されている。背景として、WHO は配信日時より15日前にDRC・ウガンダでエボラ流行を宣言（Bundibugyo株、134例中18死亡、CFR 13%）。本事例自体は終結（検査陰性）であるが、国際的なエボラ流行の背景と患者の渡航歴により、情報動向を継続監視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Exames descartam Ebola em paciente de SP; caso semelhante ocorreu no RJ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tests rule out Ebola in a patient from São Paulo; a similar case occurred in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Ebola ruled out in a São Paulo patient at Instituto Emílio Ribas after laboratory analysis by Instituto Adolfo Lutz found no Ebola virus genetic material. The 37-year-old had recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo and exhibited fever, diarrhea, and rapid deterioration, prompting isolation under biosafety protocols; prior malaria tests were inconclusive. Doctors diagnosed meningococcal meningitis and commenced antibiotics and hydration. National high-risk disease surveillance protocols guided the investigation, with close contacts monitored. A separate suspected Ebola case in Rio de Janeiro also tested negative; the patient, who arrived from Uganda, was at Evandro Chagas Institute. Saliva and urine samples were Ebola-negative; malaria confirmed. He landed in Brazil on May 22 (Guarulhos) and traveled to Rio; five cohabitants are under monitoring. Brazil maintains a low Ebola transmission risk; no autochthonous cases reported, while outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda are under international monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 検査によりサンパウロ患者のエボラを除外。リオデジャネイロでも同様の事例が発生
triage.triage_reason: 両患者ともエボラ検査陰性で確定、DRCおよびウガンダからの渡航者であるが既に除外診断されている。ブラジルでのエボラ伝播リスクは低く、国際的懸念の急進性は限定的。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジルでの疑い事例のエボラ除外確認である。DRCおよびウガンダは患者の渡航元として言及されているが、実際の発生地はブラジル（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ）。患者は既に診断・隔離され、追加の広がりはない。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎とマラリアが確定診断されている。

article.articleHeadline: الخطوط الجوية الملكية الهولندية تعلق رحلاتها إلى أوغندا بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines suspends flights to Uganda due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On June 1, 2026, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines suspended flights to and from Entebbe International Airport in Uganda after the WHO declared an Ebola outbreak in the Central Africa region. Although KLM states Entebbe is not presently an active risk, protective measures by several countries—especially the United States—bar crew who have visited Uganda or the Democratic Republic of Congo from entering for 21 days, threatening crew rosters and the global network. While KLM monitors suspension timelines, Belgian airline continues operations with targeted crew-schedule adjustments; Uganda Airlines had previously halted flights to Kinshasa to curb cross-border spread. Travelers are advised to review evolving health-entry requirements amid rapid changes. Bloomberg is cited for the report of these developments.

triage.headline_ja: KLM王妃オランダ航空、エボラの影響によりウガンダへの便を運休
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の中央アフリカ地域での流行宣言に伴い、複数国での国際航空便の運休・制限措置が取られている。IHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）を複数満たし、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOによる中央アフリカ地域でのエボラ流行宣言が報告されており、DRCおよびウガンダにおける発生が確認されている。複数の航空会社が国際便の運休・人員調整を実施しており、渡航制限が国境を越えて機能している。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: From Isolation To Celebration: Four Congolese Nurses Recover From Ebola, WHO Hails Milestone
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri province. Five patients recovered and were discharged after weeks of illness; a ceremony marked the discharge of four nurses, with the first survivor, a laboratory worker, discharged a week earlier. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged that survivors prove the outbreak can be stopped. The outbreak has killed nearly 250 people, while Congo's communications ministry tallies 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths. Declared by the WHO two weeks earlier, the outbreak spans three Congolese provinces and Uganda, signaling cross-border transmission. Médecins Sans Frontières warns the true scale is likely underestimated, citing gaps in testing and surveillance that hinder containment as response efforts struggle to keep pace with transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 隔離から祝い会へ：4人のコンゴ人看護師がエボラから回復、WHOが転機を称賛
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の東部DRC発生で、ウガンダへの越境感染確認、約250人の死亡、監視体制の脆弱性が明記されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「outbreak spans three Congolese provinces and Uganda」と越境伝播を述べており、主要な発生地はDRCのIturi州（Bunia中心）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ列挙。MSFの警告により実際の規模は過小評価されている可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Quatre malades d'Ebola guéris au CME de Bunia : un signal d'espoir dans la lutte contre l'épidémie - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Ebola patients cured at Bunia's CME: a sign of hope in the fight against the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola patients at Bunia's Evangelical Medical Center (CME) in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, have been cured and discharged, announced by World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on May 31 during a visit. These four, joined by a previously discharged patient, bring total recoveries from the current Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak to five. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Survivors experienced dizziness, vomiting, severe diarrhea, and marked weakness; care was predominantly supportive, including rehydration, antiemetics, and pain management. The outbreak continues to expand in eastern DRC, with challenges such as medical supply shortages, community mistrust, logistical hurdles, and insecurity from armed groups. In response, the Congolese government has opened several specialized treatment centers in Ituri, including Bunia, to improve care and limit transmission. Officials urge rapid healthcare seeking at early symptoms like fever, vomiting, or headaches.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア市のCMEでエボラウイルス病患者4名が完治：感染症流行との闘いにおける希望の光
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行が進行中のDRCで患者の完治という重要な臨床的進展が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的な拡大リスク）を満たし、また感染症流行における社会的・政治的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の流行は進行中であり、承認されたワクチンや治療法がない状況。医療用品の不足、コミュニティの不信、武装勢力からの不安定性など複数の課題が存在。WHO事務局長による視察報告であり、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: بارقة أمل في الكونغو.. تعافي حالات مصابة بـ "إيبولا" - ستاد الأهلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A glimmer of hope in Congo... Recovery of Ebola-infected cases - Al Ahly Stadium
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola patients have recovered in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, from Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with four nurses and one laboratory worker among the survivors; total recoveries rise to five. Confirmed cases in the DRC reach 282, with 42 deaths after 19 new positives. WHO notes that early diagnosis and adequate care can improve outcomes, despite no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. Brazil reports suspected Ebola-linked cases: a man in Sao Paulo with meningitis who recently visited Congo, and a second suspected case in Rio de Janeiro who had traveled to Uganda; diagnoses for both do not exclude Ebola. In Italy, a suspected case in Cagliari, Sardinia, yielded a negative test. The risk remains low; authorities monitor imported/exported cases. The outbreak in DRC and Uganda was previously declared a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者5人が回復 - 希望の光
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCで282確定例・42死亡のエボラ流行中で、複数国への輸入症例報告あり。過去にPHEIC宣言済みの継続的危機。
triage.notes: イタリアの疑い例は検査陰性で除外。ウガンダはAPI出力に含まれるが、記事ではブラジルの症例がウガンダ訪問履歴を有するという参考情報で、ウガンダ自体の新規発生イベントではないため除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事の主題であり、BrazilとDRCの結びつきが重要であるため、DRCは含める。ブラジルは対象国リスト内（3469034）。

article.articleHeadline: Pastor Ng'ang'a Reacts to Kenya-US Collaboration to Set Up Ebola Quarantine Centre in Laikipia
article.articleSummary: Kenya plans a 50-bed Ebola quarantine centre at Laikipia Air Base to isolate US citizens exposed to the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The US has reportedly committed about $13.5 million (≈KSh 1.75 billion) for Kenya's Ebola preparedness. The High Court temporarily suspended the project after a Katiba Institute petition citing public health risks and lack of transparency; nevertheless, reports say US military aircraft have landed at the airbase with personnel and equipment. Pastor James Ng'ang'a criticised the plan during a sermon, warning of public health risks and questioning why Kenyans would host such a facility instead of the US. Public reaction online was mixed. Health CS Aden Duale defended the collaboration, saying the Kenya Defence Forces will manage the facility and that the US role is primarily supportive, benefiting Kenyan citizens. Kenya has not reported any Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア-米国協力によるライキピアへのエボラ隔離センター設置計画にンガンガ牧師が反応
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病に関する地域的準備・対応計画の報道だが、ケニアでは未確認患者なし。DRCでの発生イベントは確認されるが、記事の主題はケニアの施設計画。社会的関心あるが、実際の流行拡大証拠が限定的。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、実際のエボラ発生は東部DRCに限定されており、ケニアでは確認患者なし。記事の主題はケニアの隔離センター計画だが、対象国リストではケニアは該当しない（GeoNames IDは1254556）。DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。発生地域にUSAが含まれているが、サマリーでは準備計画の舞台としてのみ言及され、実際の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de SP divulga resultado de novo exame de paciente com suspeita de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo state government releases the result of a new test for a patient with suspected Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease suspected in São Paulo: a 37-year-old immigrant from the Democratic Republic of the Congo was hospitalized with diarrhea, disorientation and deterioration, requiring intubation. A new test did not detect Ebola genetic material; Instituto Adolfo Lutz released the result on Monday, June 1, 2026, after collecting the sample at Hospital Emílio Ribas, where the case was under investigation following a weekend meningococcal meningitis diagnosis. A confirmatory repeat test (contraprova) will be considered by health authorities, following procedures used for a Rio case. The patient remains in isolation with biosafety protocols; contacts on the airplane and at the urgent care facility are being monitored. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda shows 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths, with 906 cases and 223 deaths under investigation; South America has no autochthonous transmission. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州政府がエボラ疑い患者の新しい検査結果を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ疑い患者の検出、複数国での確認、隔離・接触追跡実施中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラウイルス病の疑い患者がブラジル（サンパウロ）で検出され、DRCからの移民であることが述べられている。DRCでのBundibugyo株アウトブレイク（134確認例、18死亡）との関連があり、南米での自然発生的伝播がないことが確認されている。ウガンダも言及されているが、記事の主題はブラジルの疑い患者であるため、対象国リストの確認可能な国はBrazil（3469034）とDRC（203312）のみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le gouvernement et l'OMS réaffirment leur engagement commun à protéger les populations de l'Ituri et de l'ensemble du pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the government and the WHO reaffirm their joint commitment to protecting the populations of Ituri and the entire country.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, northeast DRC, caused by Bundibugyo strain, is ongoing. As of May 15, 2026, cases and deaths have been reported in Ituri, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu. On May 31, 2026, a mission to Bunia led by Health Minister Dr Samuel Kamba and Information Minister Patrick Muyaya, with WHO Director-General Tedros, reaffirmed joint commitment to protecting populations in Ituri and nationwide. The outbreak, without a licensed vaccine or specific treatment for this rare strain, has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO. The response prioritizes enhanced surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, infection prevention and control, patient care, and aggressive case finding and contact tracing, supported by the UN system, Africa CDC and partners. Community engagement is central; conflict and population movement complicate response. Over 26 million people face acute food insecurity, weakening health services.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のエボラ：政府とWHOがイトゥリおよび全国の人口保護への共同公約を再確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）の継続的な発生。進行中の複数州での患者報告、国際的な公衆衛生への深刻な影響、および対応能力への懸念から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの継続発生、複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での患者報告。2026年5月15日時点でのケース・死亡報告、5月31日にはWHO事務局長を含む高級政府代表団がBuniaを訪問。WHO PHEIC既に宣言済み。ワクチン・治療法の欠如、紛争・人口移動による対応困難、2600万人以上の食糧不安定性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Scares In Brazil, Italy Prompt Fears Of Global Spread (Live Updates)
article.articleSummary: June 1, 2026: Three people with Ebola-like symptoms in Brazil and Italy prompted alarms about spread from the Democratic Republic of Congo, but testing ruled out Ebola: one Brazil case with meningitis and another with malaria; the Italy traveler from Congo tested negative. Across Africa, suspected Ebola cases in Congo and Uganda exceed 1,100 with nearly 250 deaths; five patients have recovered. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccine or treatment, WHO says, stressing rapid healthcare seeking improves survival. In Kenya, protests over an American Ebola quarantine center at Laikipia Air Base coincide with a court suspension (May 29); officials say the plan will proceed May 30. The U.S. plans quarantine facilities in Kenya for Americans evacuated from DRC; JFK airport begins health screenings for travelers from Congo/Uganda/South Sudan. Uganda closes the DRC border; WHO urges ceasefire to aid response.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、イタリアのエボラ不安が世界的拡大の懸念を引き起こす（ライブ更新）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC/ウガンダでの疑い事例1,100件超・死亡250件、ワクチン・治療なしのBundibugyo変異体の存在、複数国への二次拡大警戒が確認される。

verified_locations.name: Uganda (note: Uganda listed in API but not in WPRO target list; included based on explicit mention in summary)

triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC/ウガンダが疑い事例の中心地（1,100件超、死亡250件）、ブラジル・イタリアではエボラ陰性で誤アラームだが、国際的二次拡大リスクと社会的・政治的関心が高い。JFKでの健康スクリーニング、ケニアの隔離施設計画、ウガンダによるDRC国境閉鎖など多層的な対応が進行中。ウガンダは対象国リストにないが、記事主題として明記されているため検証位置に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil investigó un posible caso de ébola en un hombre que viajó a África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil investigated a possible case of Ebola in a man who traveled to Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-suspected cases in Brazil were ruled out by June 1, 2026. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man recently from the Democratic Republic of the Congo was isolated with fever, diarrhea, disorientation and rapid deterioration; Ebola testing by Instituto Adolfo Lutz was negative, with a final diagnosis of severe meningococcal meningitis. In Rio de Janeiro, a man who arrived from Uganda on May 22 also tested negative for Ebola and was diagnosed with malaria; he remains under clinical follow-up. Brazilian health authorities stressed there are no confirmed Ebola cases and that surveillance protocols were activated, with a low importation risk due to transmission challenges and no direct Africa–South America flights. Global context: the Congo outbreak began mid-May, with over 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 deaths; Uganda reports additional cases. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo virus; there is no vaccine or specific treatment; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルはアフリカを旅行した男性における可能性のあるエボラケースについて調査した
triage.triage_reason: エボラの疑い例は陰性と判明し、確認例なし。しかし疾患多重性（髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎、マラリア）、国際的な文脈（Congo outbreak with 1,000+ suspected cases and 250 deaths、WHO PHEIC宣言），および複数国関連（ブラジル、DRC、ウガンダ）の存在により、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルの2件の疑い例は検査結果で除外された。しかし，コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ様アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo virus，1,000件以上の疑い例，約250死亡）の文脈においており，WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）が出されている。ブラジル側の対応能力は高く，アフリカ-南米間の直行便がないなどのリスク軽減要因がある。継続的な監視が必要。ウガンダは記事サマリーで言及されているが，イベントの主体としてはブラジル（検査）とDRCアウトブレイクの文脈が中心であるため，verified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC confirma la recuperación de cuatro pacientes de ébola y eleva a...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC confirms the recovery of four Ebola patients and raises to....
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports four additional Ebola recoveries at Bunia’s Evangelical Medical Center in Ituri province, bringing total recoveries to five from a current outbreak that has nearly 1,000 cases and more than 200 suspected deaths. The recovered were nurses on the front line when the outbreak was declared, about two weeks prior, as a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, so patients received symptomatic care and malaria treatment plus antibiotics. Ebola’s case fatality rate is around 50%, with early symptoms including fever, fatigue, muscle and throat pain, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rashes, and renal/hepatic impairment. The DRC, experienced in Ebola management, had declared the Kasai outbreak ended in December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）、エボラ患者4人の回復を確認し、回復者は計5人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：約1,000例の患者と200以上の疑い死亡；異常で予想外：WHO国際懸念公衆衛生上の緊急事態；国際拡大リスク：Bundibugyo株による高い致命率；渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 重大な懸念事項：Bundibugyo株は承認されたワクチンまたは特異的治療がなく、約50%の症例致死率を持つ。記事公開時点で約1,000例と200以上の疑い死亡が報告されており、WHO PHEIC（国際懸念公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言されている。DRCはエボラ管理経験が豊富だが、高い伝播リスクと国際的拡大の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Africa: 'The Church Is On the Front Line of the Ebola Response' - Anglicans Act to Tackle Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri, DRC, and Uganda, with WHO reporting 10 confirmed and 223 suspected Ebola deaths since declaration on 15 May, among more than 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases. Confirmed cases have reached eastern DRC diocese, while detection is hampered by symptoms differing from the Zaire strain and limited testing capacity. There is no specific treatment for Bundibugyo; a vaccine is months away at best. Misinformation and mistrust complicate response, with fears fueling attacks on centers and traditional burials that bypass safe-burial protocols. The Anglican Church reports extensive health centres as a trusted information source and front line in care. PPE shortages, scarce eye/face protection, and poor road infrastructure hinder diagnosis, patient transport, and care; funding for testing and universal health coverage is urged. Anglican networks and partners—AHCN, Anglican Alliance, Uganda Catholic Medical Bureau, Caritas, ACHAP, IMA World Health, World Vision, CCIH, Corus—coordinate response and messaging.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：『教会はエボラ対応の最前線にある』—英国国教会がエボラ感染症アウトブレイクに対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの複数国での同時発生、高い死亡率、対応能力の制限が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC の Bundibugyo/Ituri 地域を主要発生地としており、Uganda での確認事例が言及されているが、サマリー上の詳細はDRCに集中。Uganda は発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリーではDRCでの発生が主題であり、Uganda での検出は言及程度のため verified_locations は DRC のみとした。Bundibugyo型エボラは Zaire 株と異なる症状を示すため検査困難、ワクチンは数ヶ月先以降、医療資源・PPE 不足、医療不信などの重大な課題が複合。WHO 認定時点での死亡数は 233 件（確認10+疑い223）、1,000 件以上のケースが報告されている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Moderna and other groups get $60 million to develop Ebola vaccine - The Korea Times
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo: 282 confirmed cases, 42 deaths, ~1,100 suspected; 9 Ugandan cases with 1 death. Global agencies declare a public health emergency; no approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo. CEPI plans roughly $60 million to accelerate vaccine development: up to $50 million for Moderna, up to $8.6 million for a University of Oxford/Serum Institute of India candidate, and $3.2 million for IAVI’s vaccine. IAVI’s single-dose vaccine uses the same technology as Merck’s Ervebo (Zaire strain); Oxford’s ChAdOx1 Bundibugyro uses the same tech as the COVID-19 vaccine. Trials could be ready in weeks, a pace supported by recent Rift Valley Fever work in Mauritania/Senegal; security in eastern Congo complicates efforts. Access remains a hurdle, with 300,000 Ervebo doses cited for control in a similar outbreak. Gavi and the World Bank Pandemic Fund are also mobilizing funds (up to $50 million and $220.6 million).

triage.headline_ja: Modernaと他の団体がエボラワクチン開発に6000万ドルを獲得 - コリア・タイムズ
triage.triage_reason: Ebola Bundibugyoの確認例282件、死亡42件、疑い例約1,100件を報告。ウガンダへの国際的な拡大（9例、死亡1件）があり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とIHR基準の複数該当、さらにWPRO基準（重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）も満たす。国際的な支援動員（CEPI、Gavi、World Bank）が進行中で、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoはエボラウイルスの高致死性株であり、承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しない点が深刻。DRCの東部での発生を主要な流行地とし、ウガンダへの拡大が確認されている。インドはSerum Institute of Indiaがワクチン開発に参加しているため対象国として含める。マウリタニア、セネガルはRift Valley Fever言及の文脈で、主要な発生地ではないため除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Trei noi vaccinuri experimentale pentru virusul Ebola vor fi finanțate de Coaliția pentru Inovații în domeniul Pregătirii pentru Epidemii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new experimental vaccines for the Ebola virus will be funded by the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations.
article.articleSummary: CEPI will urgently accelerate development of three experimental vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, linked to the current outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The World Health Organization identified these three candidates as the most promising, developed by IAVI, Moderna, and the University of Oxford, with manufacturing at Serum Institute of India. Moderna’s candidate will receive up to $50 million for preclinical work and Phase 1 trials. Oxford and Serum Institute India will get up to $8.6 million for Phase 1 testing and related development. IAVI’s candidate will receive up to $3.2 million for Phase 1 activities and further development. The DRC outbreak has at least 282 confirmed cases, with more than 200 additional cases and roughly 1,000 suspected cases reported. WHO emphasizes stopping transmission using established tools while vaccines advance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス用の3つの新しい実験的ワクチンがアウトブレイク対策イノベーション連合により資金提供される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスのアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダで確認、282例以上の確定例）は重篤で異常なイベントであり、IHR基準2項目以上に該当。ワクチン開発への国際的資金投入は国際的対応を示唆し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事の主要なイベントはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ・ブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクに関するもの。インドはワクチン製造施設（Serum Institute of India）の所在地として記載されているため、実質的な発生地として verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bluedot APIがイギリスとインドをリストアップしているのは、CEPI本部やワクチン開発機関の所在地が理由と考えられるが、記事の主題であるアウトブレイク発生地としてはDRCのみが確定。ただしインドのSerum Instituteは製造を担当するため対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: CDC says containing the spread of Ebola is top priority
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain drives ongoing outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of Friday, 1,040 confirmed or suspected cases and 251 deaths, majority in DRC. CDC incident manager Satish Pillai says containment at the source is top priority, with supporting affected countries and neighbors next, and U.S. domestic readiness third; risk to Americans deemed very low. About 236 CDC staff are involved, with more volunteering. CEPI has allocated funding to three vaccine efforts against Bundibugyo: IAVI developing a vaccine akin to the Ebola Zaire shot; Moderna working on an mRNA candidate; and University of Oxford with Serum Institute of India handling manufacturing. The article notes Trump’s alterations to grant-making and the broader debate over outbreak response playbooks; also mentions Medicare’s temporary coverage for obesity drugs Wegovy and Zepbound starting July, with cost to taxpayers not disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: CDCはエボラの拡大封じ込めを最優先課題としている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCとウガンダで進行中のBundibugyo株アウトブレイク、1,040例以上、251死亡、複数国への拡大。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでの進行中のBundibugyo株エボラアウトブレイク。記事サマリーから、DRCが主要な発生地であり、ウガンダも確認されている。インドについては、Serum Institute of Indiaがワクチン製造に関与しており、産業的な役割として記載されている。Bluedot APIがUSAを発生地域に含めているが、サマリーでは米国内リスクが「非常に低い」と明記されているため、米国は実際の発生地ではなく、verified_locationsから除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 5伊波拉患者康复出院 为更多病人能被治愈带来希望 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Ebola patients discharged after recovery, bringing hope that more patients can be cured.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, the World Health Organization reported that four healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus have recovered and been discharged from Bunia Hospital in Ituri Province on May 31. Including a laboratory worker discharged on May 27 after two negative tests, total recoveries in this outbreak rise to five. The Bundibugyo strain is a rare form of Ebola virus. The update highlights improving outcomes amid an active Ebola outbreak in the DRC, illustrating progress in patient recovery even as transmission continues within the affected region. These recoveries provide cautious optimism for the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 5人のエボラ患者が回復して退院、より多くの患者が治癒できる可能性に希望をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の発生がDRCで継続中であり、IHR基準において「異常/予想外性」「国際的拡大リスク」「重症度」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数基準を満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はエボラウイルスの稀な株型である。記事は回復例を報告しているが、「継続的な伝播」が進行中とされており、アウトブレイク状況は依然として活動的である。DRCはWHO通知対象国であり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta ebola em paciente internado em estado grave | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out Ebola in a patient hospitalized in critical condition | A TARDE
article.articleSummary: June 1, 2026, São Paulo, Brazil: A 37-year-old man hospitalized at Instituto Emílio Ribas remains in grave condition after fever triggered a serious infection workup. Ebola suspicion prompted tests at Instituto Adolfo Lutz, which found no Ebola virus genetic material, ruling out Ebola infection. Earlier, the same institute confirmed Neisseria meningitidis as the cause of meningococcal meningitis in the patient. The man is from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and had recently traveled to Africa, prompting the investigation for a potential deadly infectious disease. Before transfer to Emílio Ribas, he sought care at a local urgent-care unit; malaria tests were inconclusive, guiding ongoing diagnostic protocols. No Ebola case or outbreak is reported; current concerns center on severe meningococcal meningitis and other differential diagnoses.

triage.headline_ja: 検査でエボラを除外 重篤な状態で入院中の患者 | A TARDE
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の確定患者がいるが、エボラは否定されており、現在の懸念は単一患者の重症髄膜炎に限定される。ブラジルでの孤立症例であり、アウトブレイク報告なし。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: エボラ疑いは検査で否定されている。確認されているのはNeisseria meningitidis による髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎で単一患者の症例。患者がコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者であるが、DRCでのアウトブレイク報告はサマリーに記載なし。記事の主題はブラジルでの個別症例であるため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: les ministres de l'UE feront le point vendredi sur l'épidémie en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: EU ministers will assess the Ebola outbreak in the DRC on Friday.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, EU health ministers will convene an extraordinary videoconference to assess the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Friday meeting will allow ministers to take stock of the Ebola epidemic in DR Congo and discuss the Ebola episode in Africa. The aim is to coordinate EU-level responses and public health measures across member states. The report provides no specific figures, case counts, dates of onset, or laboratory confirmation details. The emphasis is on high-level discussion of the ongoing Ebola situation in DR Congo as reported. EU concern and readiness to exchange information among member states are highlighted by the planned discussions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：EUの保健大臣が金曜日にコンゴ民主共和国での流行について検討
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の4基準すべてに該当する（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。EU全体の対応調整が必要とされており、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行について述べており、EU保健大臣による臨時ビデオ会議が予定されている。具体的な症例数や発症日などの詳細情報は記事に含まれていないが、EUレベルでの対応調整の必要性が強調されている。WPRO対象国リストにはDRCが含まれており、verified_locationsに追加。

article.articleHeadline: OMS e RD Congo trabalham para obter vacina contra cepa de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and DR Congo are working to obtain a vaccine against an Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: WHO and the Democratic Republic of the Congo government are pursuing a vaccine for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain fueling an eastern Congo outbreak. In Bunia, Ituri province (epicenter), health officials and Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus say joint efforts include rapid, controlled randomized trials of candidate vaccines and treatments. With no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo, established public-health measures remain essential to slow transmission and enable recovery when care is sought promptly. The Bundibugyo strain has a fatality rate of about 30–50%. Authorities are pushing for Ebola treatment centers and strengthened primary health services while urging communities to adopt protective behaviors, hygiene, early care-seeking, and information sharing. AU estimates 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths in the DRC; Uganda reports nine confirmed cases, including one death, from an imported Congolese case.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとコンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルス株に対するワクチン入手に向けて取り組んでいる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（高い重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）、社会政治的関心あり。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも9確認例（死亡1例）が報告されているが、これらはコンゴからの輸入症例であり、サマリーの主題はDRC東部のイトゥリ州での流行。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスは致命率30～50%で、ワクチン非承認の株。AU推定では1,077疑い例、246死亡。WHOトップとコンゴ政府による共同対応が進行中で、ワクチン・治療法の臨床試験が急速に進められている。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS investiga casos sospechosos de ébola en Brasil importados de África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO investigates suspected Ebola cases in Brazil imported from Africa.
article.articleSummary: WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to Bunia, Ituri, DRC to oversee the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, the largest in years, as cases surge and officials fear regional spread. More than 1,100 suspected infections are under investigation in the DRC and Uganda; the OMS reported 291 confirmed cases and 43 deaths, with Africa CDC tallying 263/43 by end-May, up from 128/18 a week earlier. Four nurses and a laboratory worker have recovered, bringing total recoveries to five; early treatment is emphasized as critical for survival. In Brazil, authorities are probing two suspected Ebola cases imported from Africa in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro; one patient tested positive for meningitis and the other for malaria, but Ebola cannot be ruled out. Europe reported a traveler in Sardinia with symptoms but tests were negative. The outbreak is a declared PHEIC but not a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはアフリカから輸入されたブラジルの疑わしいエボラ症例を調査している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。PHEICとして既に宣言されており、DRC・ウガンダでの大規模流行と複数国への国際的拡がり、高い重症度と死亡が確認されている。
triage.notes: イタリア（Sardegna）とウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは調査中の1,100件の疑い例地域として言及されており、イタリアは検査陰性の旅行者（輸入例）のみ。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCとBrazilのみ。PHEICとして既に宣言されており、多数の死亡例と確認症例が報告されている高リスク状況。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta caso ebola em paciente internado em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out Ebola case in a patient hospitalized in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, in São Paulo, a patient hospitalized with suspected Ebola tested negative for the virus by the Adolfo Lutz Institute. No viral genetic material was detected in the sample. The man remains hospitalized and in isolation at the Emílio Ribas Infectology Institute. The patient had a confirmed meningococcal meningitis diagnosis two days earlier. As a precaution, Ebola tests were performed per protocol. To rule out a potential false negative, a second Ebola test will be conducted. The article notes the information from UOL and provides no details on exposure or infection source beyond the meningitis diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 検査がサンパウロの入院患者のエボラ症例を除外
triage.triage_reason: 患者のエボラウイルス検査が陰性であり、確定診断は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎である。エボラ症例ではないため、シグナル基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はエボラウイルスの陰性結果であり、実際の感染症イベントではない。患者は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎と確定診断されている。予防的なプロトコルに基づくエボラ検査のみが実施された。二次検査の予定があるが、現時点では確定症例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: caso suspeito de paciente internado em São Paulo é descartado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: suspected case in a patient hospitalized in São Paulo is ruled out.
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected in a 37-year-old man hospitalized at Emílio Ribas, São Paulo, was ruled out on June 1, 2026 after sequencing found no Ebola virus RNA in his sample. The patient, with fever, diarrhea, disorientation, and intubation, had recently visited the Democratic Republic of Congo during an active outbreak; isolation and epidemiological/lab investigations were initiated under Brazil’s National Contingency Plan. A second Rio de Janeiro case, a Belgian who traveled to Uganda, tested negative for Ebola in saliva and urine on Sunday, though blood samples remain under analysis after malaria was confirmed. Separately, Neisseria meningitidis was identified in another São Paulo patient. Context: Ebola in the DRC (Bundibugyo strain) with no vaccine or specific treatment; as of late May 2026, 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths in DRC, with 134 confirmed cases (including 9 in Uganda and 18 deaths among confirmed) as of May 29, prompting a WHO International Health Emergency.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：サンパウロで入院した患者の疑似症例が除外される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの疑似症例は既に除外されているが、DRCでの活動的なエボラアウトブレイク（906疑似症例、223死亡、134確認症例）がWHOの国際保健緊急事態を発動させており、流入リスク監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルの2症例（サンパウロとリオデジャネイロ）は既に除外されているが、DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが活発（WHOが国際保健緊急事態を宣言）。対象国リストにはUganda（1269750）が含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外した。記事の主題はDRCのアウトブレイク関連の流入疑似症例であり、本体はDRCでのアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: शिवपुरी में पालतू बिल्ली के पंजा मारने से बच्चे की हालत बिगड़ी, दिखे रेबीज के लक्षण; ग्वालियर अस्पताल में भर्ती - child critical pet cat scratch causes rabies in gwalior
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Shivpuri, a child's condition worsened after being scratched by a pet cat; rabies symptoms observed; admitted to a hospital in Gwalior.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, a 13-year-old boy from Kareera village in Shivpuri district, Madhya Pradesh, developed rabies symptoms after being scratched by a pet cat and is critically ill in a government hospital in Gwalior. He presents with excessive drooling, altered behavior, confusion, hydrophobia (fear of water), and sensitivity to cold air. Doctors consider rabies; cat scratches are cited as a rare source. The family had first sought care at a private Shivpuri hospital, which reportedly refused admission, leading to transfer to the Government 1,000-bed hospital in Gwalior. The incident is estimated to have occurred on Friday before presentation. Public-health guidance urges anti-rabies vaccination (ARV) for anyone exposed—via bite, scratch, or saliva contact—and emphasizes cleaning and disinfection of saliva exposure to reduce infection risk.

triage.headline_ja: シヴプリの家畜猫の引っ掻き傷で子どもの容態が悪化、狂犬病の症状が見られるため、グワリオール病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の個別症例報告で、重症度と異常性は認められるが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし。スクリーニング基準は満たすが、社会的関心度が記事情報からは不明。単一症例の状況観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一の小児狂犬病症例。ペット猫からの感染は稀とされている。地域内での予防対策（ARV投与）が推奨されている。広域流行の兆候はなく、公式なスクリーニングアラートは発令されていない模様。続報で症例数の増加や地域蔓延の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola enciende alarmas en Brasil: Qué se sabe de los casos sospechosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola raises alarms in Brazil: What is known about the suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, Brazil reports two suspected Ebola cases being investigated. In Rio de Janeiro, a Ugandan traveler presented with chills, cough, and diarrhea; malaria confirmed and Ebola testing of saliva and urine negative, with blood sample still under analysis, patient cared for at Instituto Nacional de Enfermidades Infecciosas Evandro Chagas. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas arrived gravely ill with diarrhea and disorientation, requiring intubation after recent travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo; lab tests confirmed meningococcal meningitis, while the case is under investigation for possible Ebola. A Globo report indicates no Ebola genetic material detected in the São Paulo patient’s sample; confirmatory testing pending. Separately, the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak continues across three provinces, with 121 confirmed cases and 17 deaths, plus 1,077 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths, due to Bundibugyo lineage with no vaccines or specific treatments.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがブラジルで警報を鳴らす：疑いのあるケースについてわかっていることは何か
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での疑わしいエボラ症例報告と並行するDRC継続アウトブレイクにより、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジル（Rio de JaneiroおよびSão Paulo）における2例の疑いエボラ症例報告を主題としており、併行してDRCでの継続的アウトブレイク（121確定例、17死亡）も記載。ウガンダへの言及は患者の渡航歴のため、DRCとの異なる地理的文脈。対象国リストに含まれるのはBrazilとDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: തൃശ്ശൂരില്‍ മൂന്ന് പേരെ കടിച്ചു പരിക്കേല്‍പ്പിച്ച തെരുവ് നായക്ക് പേവിഷബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു | NEWS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies confirmed in a street dog that bit three people in Thrissur.
