article.articleSummary: A stray dog that attacked three people in Thrissur area in the Chovannoor locality has tested positive for rabies. The dog, which caused fear after biting Soumya (Rajeev’s wife), Suresh (56), and Vijesh (48), subsequently died. Laboratory confirmation established rabies infection in the animal. Public health authorities are monitoring contacts and urging prompt vaccination. The bitten individuals are under post-exposure management; two of them have not yet completed the second dose of the anti-rabies vaccine, raising the risk of progression to rabies and necessitating urgent prophylaxis and monitoring. The incident highlights ongoing rabies risk from stray dogs in urban Kerala and the need for timely vaccination after animal bites.

triage.headline_ja: トリッシュール地域で3人を噛んだ野良犬の狂犬病が確認
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病確認で個別事例は懸念されるが、スクリーニング基準は部分的合致に留まり、国際的拡大リスクや深刻な公衆衛生影響の明確な根拠が限定的。情報不足のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: インド・ケーララ州トリッシュール地域での野良犬による狂犬病事例。3人が噛まれ、2人がワクチン接種を未完了のため進行リスク有。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（露出者の不完全な予防接種による進行リスク）と流行易感性（狂犬病の性質とワクチン接種遅延）で該当するが、IHR基準は非該当。インド国内の限定的な事例であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限リスクは低い。ただしワクチン接種が完了していない者がいるため、個別管理の観点から注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: როგორ ვრცელდება ებოლას ვირუსი? - ივანე ჩხაიძის განმარტება
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How does the Ebola virus spread? - Ivane Chkhaydzis's explanation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) spreads only through direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected or deceased person—blood, vomitus, sweat, saliva, feces, and semen—and not via environmental exposure or airborne routes. Transmission is often linked to funeral rites in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the deceased may stay at home and relatives perform washing rites, increasing spread. Consequently, Ebola remains largely local, with the global spread risk described as very low by WHO and the US CDC. The disease is extremely dangerous due to the lack of a cure or vaccine, with fatality rates near 20–50%. The currently circulating variant is noted to have somewhat lower lethality than other Ebola strains. Statements were made by Ivane Chkhaydzish, medical director of Iashvili Children’s Central Hospital, during a press conference.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスはどのように拡散するのか？ - イヴァネ・チュハイゼスの説明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発生が複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）で報告されており、公衆衛生上の懸念は存在するが、WHOおよびCDCが国際的な拡散リスクは非常に低いと評価している。情報源がジョージア国内の医学専門家による説明であり、具体的な患者数や死亡数の詳細が不明。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの感染メカニズムに関する教育的説明が主体であり、新規エボラ発生報告というよりは既知事項の解説。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみがリスク対象。具体的な患者数、死亡数、発生時期の詳細が記事に明記されていない。WHO/CDCが国際拡散リスクを低評価している点から、緊急度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 巴西義大利出現伊波拉疑似案例 病患曾前往民主剛果、烏干達
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case reported in Brazil and Italy; the patient had previously traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: On June 1, 2026, suspected Ebola cases are reported in Brazil and Italy after travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. WHO reports over 240 Ebola deaths and more than 1,100 suspected cases, with the outbreak potentially spreading internationally. In Brazil, two patients were diagnosed with meningitis and malaria; both had recently visited Congo or Uganda. One was confirmed negative; the other results are pending. In Sardinia, Italy, a patient who returned from the DRC developed symptoms and authorities activated containment measures. In the DRC’s eastern outbreak area, five patients have recovered and were discharged, including a laboratory worker; health workers warn against further losses given resource strain. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri province, stressing that early diagnosis and treatment can stop transmission, and that recoveries occur with adequate care. Ongoing conflict complicates response and underscores the need for public health education.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルとイタリアでエボラ疑似症例を報告、患者は民主共和国コンゴとウガンダへの渡航歴あり
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクを示唆し、すでに複数国での疑似症例報告があり、240超の死亡と1,100超の疑似症例が報告されている。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: イタリアはWPRO対象国でないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCが主要な発生地で、ブラジルで疑似症例報告あり。WHO事務局長Tedros訪問など国際的関心が高い。資源不足と紛争が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Lack of vaccine, cross-border movement risk Ebola spread: Africa CDC chief
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak in the DRC and Uganda risks spread amid movement with South Sudan. Lack of licensed vaccine and medicines for this strain leaves the outbreak vulnerable. As of Friday, about 1,139 suspected cases with 212 laboratory-confirmed in the DRC since May 15; Uganda also records confirmed cases. Eleven other African countries—South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, Burundi, and Somalia—are at high risk. Nineteen health workers have been infected, six died. Africa CDC and WHO co-lead the response; early patient recovery shows benefits of detection and care. Laboratory capacity expanded; contact tracing extended; regional coordination strengthened, though gaps remain in infection prevention, contact follow-up, supply chains in eastern DRC, and community engagement in conflict zones. About 319 million USD is needed June–November to sustain surveillance, labs, health worker protection, and cross-border coordination; three non-negotiables: financing, regional coordination, African-led science.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン不足と越境移動がエボラ拡大リスク：アフリカCDC事務局長
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ集団発生で確認患者212名、死亡6名（医療従事者）を記録。DRC・ウガンダ初期確認、11カ国で高リスク評価。IHR基準4つすべて該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、越境制限リスク）。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はスーダン株より致死率が低いが、ワクチン未認可且つ医療従事者の感染・死亡報告あり。DRC東部の紛争地帯における感染予防・接触追跡の困難さが懸念材料。南スーダンとの越境移動リスク明示。319百万USDの資金調達が必要と明記。対象国リスト内ではDRC、ウガンダ、ザンビアが該当。

article.articleHeadline: शिवपुरी में पालतू बिल्ली के पंजे से 13 वर्षीय बच्चा गंभीर, रेबीज के लक्षणों के साथ ग्वालियर के अस्पताल में भर्ती, पानी और हवा से परेशानी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Shivpuri, a 13-year-old child is seriously ill after being scratched by a pet cat, with rabies symptoms, admitted to a hospital in Gwalior, hydrophobia and aerophobia.
article.articleSummary: A 13-year-old boy from Karaera, Shivpuri district, Madhya Pradesh, is critically ill with rabies-like symptoms after a pet cat scratched him. He was admitted to Gwalior’s Government 1,000-bed hospital, initially in the pediatric department, where clinicians noted hydrophobia, aerophobia, excessive salivation, behavioral changes, and distress with water and cold air. According to the family, the incident occurred on Friday; after initial care in Shivpuri, he was referred to Gwalior on Monday, and a private hospital reportedly refused admission due to severity. The case is being treated as rabies based on clinical signs; no laboratory confirmation details are provided. The boy’s relatives were advised to receive anti-rabies vaccine (rabies PEP) themselves. Officials emphasize that whether the animal is stray or pet, any bite, scratch, or saliva exposure warrants vaccination and thorough wound cleaning to reduce infection risk.

triage.headline_ja: シヴプリの飼い猫に引っ掻かれた13歳の子どもが重症化、グワリオルの病院に入院。狂犬病の症状を呈し、恐水病と恐風病
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、IHR基準は2つ以上該当しない。ただし狂犬病は重症度が高く、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度・予想外性）に該当する可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告であり、動物（飼い猫）からの暴露による狂犬病疑い例。インドは狂犬病の風土病地域であり、個別症例の報告は異常ではない。ただし重症度（入院、臨床的な狂犬病兆候）が高いため注視が必要。ラボ確認情報がないため、確定診断の続報に注視。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya'da ABD'liler için kurulacak Ebola merkezi protesto edildi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola center to be built for Americans in Kenya was protested.
article.articleSummary: Hundreds of youths in Nanyuki, Kenya, protested a planned Ebola quarantine center at Laikipia Air Base for quarantining Ebola-exposed U.S. citizens. Kenya's High Court temporarily halted the project, issuing an injunction barring any Ebola quarantine or treatment facility connected to the U.S. or foreign governments in Kenya until the case is heard. Nairobi-based Katiba Institute filed a suit challenging the plan. Health Minister Aden Duale said the facility would serve all nationals, not just Americans. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced on May 28 that Washington would contribute about $13.5 million to Kenya’s Ebola preparedness. No confirmed Ebola cases in Kenya linked to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, though authorities continue screening due to Kenya’s regional transport role. Ebola outbreaks have caused thousands of deaths, notably the 2014-2017 West Africa epidemic in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone, with about 30,000 infections and over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで米国人向けに建設予定のエボラセンターが抗議される
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ対策施設建設をめぐる社会政治的な抗議が報道されているが、ケニアでの確認患者はなく、現在のところエボラ流行の直接的なシグナルとは言えない。ただし、地域的な感染症対応態勢や国際的な関心の観点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの施設建設をめぐる抗議であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでのエボラ流行との関連が言及されており、DRCのみを対象国として列挙。ケニアでの確認患者はなく、現段階では流行兆候のシグナルではないが、地域における対応態勢の進展を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Stagnant water raises dengue concerns in Dehradun ahead of monsoon
article.articleSummary: Dengue concerns rise in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, ahead of the monsoon as stagnant water accumulates in drains and construction sites across areas such as Sahastradhara Road, Canal Road, Chakrata Road, Ekta Vihar, Yamuna Colony and Surbhi Enclave, creating mosquito breeding grounds. Six dengue cases were reported in May, three from Dehradun district; historically, over 490 dengue cases were recorded till September last year with April start and a peak in July. Authorities have initiated surveillance and containment, with larvae identification beginning June 1 and fogging by the municipal corporation in areas with cases or larvae. The state health department has directed districts to intensify dengue preparedness, including fever surveillance campaigns and ensuring hospital readiness with isolation wards, medical supplies and platelets. Residents emphasize long-term drainage and sanitation fixes and broader awareness drives to prevent breeding.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン前のデラドゥンにおける停滞水がデング熱の懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的発生の兆候があり、公衆衛生当局による準備態勢が確認されているが、現時点での症例数（5月に6件）は限定的であり、IHR基準の重症度や国際的拡大の明確な証拠に欠ける。
triage.notes: デラドゥン（ウッタラーカンド州）では過去にピーク月（7月）で月当たり数百件のデング熱症例が報告されており、モンスーン期前の季節的準備段階と考えられる。当局の積極的な監視と準備態勢が確認されている。続報の進展に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: EU health ministers to hold urgent talks on Ebola Friday - The Korea Times
article.articleSummary: EU health ministers will hold extraordinary online talks on Friday, 2026-06-01, to discuss the Ebola outbreak in central Africa, caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bunia, Ituri province). The discussions, starting at 1 p.m., will address preparedness and coordination measures across member states. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has pressed for stricter border controls and an urgent videoconference of health ministers. A subsequent ordinary meeting is planned in Luxembourg on June 16 to support coordinated action. The EU has repeatedly said the risk to Europeans is very low. The arrangement arrives as health workers in PPE respond to the outbreak at facilities in Bunia, Ituri, with footage from May 31 illustrating frontline containment at the Evangelical Medical Center.

triage.headline_ja: EUの保健大臣がエボラについて金曜日に緊急協議を開催 - The Korea Times
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生であり、IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。EUレベルでの政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）がDRC・Ituri州で発生。EUが緊急の保健大臣会議を招集しており、政治的関心が極めて高い。対象国リストのDRCで検証済み。Luxembourgは発生地域ではなく会議場所のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta Ebola em paciente internado em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out Ebola in patient hospitalized in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-01, a 37-year-old man in São Paulo, Brazil, tested negative for Ebola by Instituto Adolfo Lutz after evaluation at the Emílio Ribas Institute of Infectology. No Ebola genetic material was detected. The patient had recent travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an outbreak is ongoing, and presented with severe illness requiring intubation. Before hospital transfer, malaria was suspected but not confirmed. At Emílio Ribas, meningococcal meningitis was identified and confirmed by Adolfo Lutz. Despite this, clinicians pursued Ebola surveillance as a precaution due to travel history and compatible symptoms. The patient remains in isolation at Emílio Ribas under biosafety protocols for suspected high-risk infectious diseases. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces, not airborne; incubation ranges 2–21 days, with early symptoms such as fever and malaise, and diarrhea or bleeding in advanced stages.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロに入院した患者のエボラ検査は陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラは除外されたが、DRCからの渡航者がメningococcal meningiitisで確認診断された。アフリカでのエボラ流行背景と渡航関連の輸入感染症として医学的関心がある。情報が部分的で経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な報告はサンパウロでのエボラ除外ケースだが、患者はDRCからの渡航者でメningococcal meningiitisが確認されている。IHR基準で『unusual_unexpected』と『international_spread』に該当（旅行関連輸入感染症）。WPRO基準でも『abnormal_unexpected』と『severity』に該当。ただしエボラが除外されたため公衆衛生上の緊急性は低く、PICKUP水準には達しない。継続的な監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: por que a África e o mundo continuam perigosamente despreparados para a próxima pandemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Why Africa and the World Remain Dangerously Unprepared for the Next Pandemic
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo spurred renewed warnings that Africa and the world remain dangerously unprepared for the next pandemic. On May 17, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern amid rising cases and cross-border concern. Simultaneously, the Global Preparedness Monitoring Board published a report arguing that preparedness has not kept pace with escalating pandemic risk and that funding has not matched the threat. Oyewale Tomori notes recommendations remain largely unimplemented, especially in Africa, where building trust in local capacity is crucial. Priorities include independent pandemic risk monitoring, retention of health workers, equitable access to countermeasures, sustainable financing, and political attention. Africa should establish sovereign data systems and strengthen collaboration between the Africa Regions of WHO and Africa CDC to lead centralized disease control and foster local innovation for global benefit.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：アフリカと世界が次のパンデミックに向けて危険なほど準備不足である理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言され、国際的関心と国境を越えた懸念が生じている。公衆衛生上の重大な影響があり、国際的拡大とパンデミック管理の課題が顕在化。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）はアフリカの対象国リストに含まれる。記事は現在進行中のエボラアウトブレイク、PHEIC宣言、国際的準備不足、国家間協力の必要性を述べており、すべてのスクリーニング基準に該当。フルRRA実施の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: تفشّي "إيبولا" في الكونغو وأوغندا يثير مخاوف اقتصادية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda raises economic concerns.
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, Ebola outbreaks persist in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with 282 laboratory-confirmed cases in the DRC, predominantly in Ituri, and additional cases in North and South Kivu; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced five recoveries at a newly opened treatment center in Bunia. Response teams face PPE shortages, access barriers, and local tensions in Ituri, with health workers warning women may be disproportionately affected due to caregiving roles and frontline healthcare work. Travel restrictions and airline disruptions, including KLM suspending flights to Uganda, are impacting movement. Border controls threaten cross-border trade between eastern DRC and Uganda and raise transport and supply costs in a region already fragile on security and humanitarian grounds.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行が経済的懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限が現在進行中。WPRO基準も全て該当し、死亡・重症例を含む確認患者291例、複数国での流行、管理体制の課題が明らかである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（id: 226074）はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの症例数が9例の言及にとどまり、主要な流行地はDRCであることが明確である。DRC内ではIturi、North Kivu、South Kivuで確認されている。PPE不足、アクセス障害、医療従事者の危険、複数国への渡航制限（KLMのウガンダ便停止）、国境貿易への影響など、複合的なリスク要因が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Why precision matters in Uganda's Ebola narrative
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in East-Central Africa prompts media to lump Uganda with DRC, misleading regional risk. Uganda’s Ministry of Health reports 9 Ebola Virus Disease cases and 1 death, all linked to travel from the DRC; Kampala promptly isolated the index case and conducted rapid contact tracing, maintaining zero uncontrolled community transmission. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a larger outbreak with 282 confirmed cases, 42 deaths, and over 200 suspected cases. Uganda’s borders remain largely open with some Uganda–DRC border restrictions; tourism and business experiences collateral damage as international operators misread localized risk. The U.S. CDC issues a Level 1 Travel Health Notice for Uganda, while Congo receives Level 3. The author credits Uganda’s decades of outbreak experience (2000 Gulu, 2007 Bundibugyo, 2022 Sudan ebolavirus) and argues against aggregated regional reporting that harms the economy while neglecting precision containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ叙述における精密性の重要性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確認症例と死亡者が発生し、DRC由来の輸入ケース管理下にあるが、アフリカ地域の複数国に関連する懸念あり。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo地域での発生が報告されており、ウガンダは9確認例・1死亡、DRCは282確認例・42死亡を報告。ウガンダは迅速な接触者追跡と封じ込めを実施中で、コミュニティ内での制御不能な感染伝播はないと報告。ただしエボラウイルス病は高致死率疾患であり、国際的な移動制限や経済的影響が発生している。米国CDCはウガンダにLevel 1、DRCにLevel 3の渡航健康警告を発出。

article.articleHeadline: Visitante testa negativo para ebola; outro caso suspeito segue em investigação | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Visitor tests negative for Ebola; another suspected case is under investigation | abc+.
article.articleSummary: Two travelers in Brazil with suspected Ebola: in Rio de Janeiro, a visitor from Uganda arrived with cough, chills and diarrhea; initially malaria-positive, but Ebola testing using saliva, urine and blood ultimately returned negative, and the patient remained in isolation while continuing malaria treatment. In São Paulo, another Ebola-suspect who had been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo presented fever; tests on May 30 confirmed Neisseria meningitidis (meningococcal meningitis), while Ebola and other viral diagnostics remain under investigation. The World Health Organization has classified Ebola as a public health emergency of international concern, with ongoing outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; Africa CDC lists ten countries at high risk (South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Congo, Burundi). Brazil regards the transmission risk as low. Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, weakness, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and hemorrhagic manifestations.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの来訪者がエボラ検査で陰性；別の疑い例が調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで複数のエボラ疑い例が報告され、IHR基準で異常性・予想外性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクの4項目すべてに該当。WHO緊急事態宣言済みイベントの国境外への波及を示す重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの2例のエボラ疑い例を主題としている。DRC及びウガンダからの旅行者がブラジル（リオデジャネイロとサンパウロ）で疑い例として報告され、WHOが既にエボラを国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事項として分類している状況。南米への波及例は極めて希少であり、高度な注視が必要。ただし現時点では確定例ではなく、1例は既に陰性、もう1例は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が確認されている。

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ドゥラードスにおけるチクングニア熱の流行は確認されたが、記事は政治的な行政責任追及が主題であり、流行そのもののニュース価値は限定的。死亡事例・確定患者数などの客観的な流行データは示されているが、国際的拡大リスク等についての情報は不明瞭である。

article.articleHeadline: Hàng không tăng cường ứng phó nắng nóng, siết chặt phòng chống dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aviation sector steps up response to heat waves, tightens Ebola prevention measures.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, Vietnam’s aviation sector tightens heat-exposure protections and Ebola prevention at airports. The Vietnam Air Traffic Management Corporation (VATM) issues guidance to protect outdoor workers—information, navigation, surveillance staff; flight signalers; security and maintenance personnel; and field operators—by monitoring forecasts, issuing heat warnings before shifts, and redeploying tasks to cooler periods. For high-risk duties on roofs, masts, or aircraft aprons, operations should not run 10:00–16:00 during red or purple heat alerts unless urgent. Rest areas, drinking water, electrolyte solutions, PPE, and cooling garments for signalers are provided, with health monitoring and remote diagnostics to reduce exposure. Separately, the Civil Aviation Authority of Vietnam orders strengthened Ebola screening at airports, with strict measures for travelers from regions with outbreaks, rapid isolation of suspected cases, and coordination with the Ministry of Health. WHO cites Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as an international concern.

triage.headline_ja: 航空部門が熱波への対応を強化、エボラ熱予防対策を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのエボラ熱スクリーニング強化は予防的措置であり、現地での実際の患者報告がない。DRC・ウガンダでの発生自体は顕著だが、対象国リストに含まれない地域のため、対象国に限定した評価では情報不足が存在する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベトナムでのエボラ熱予防措置であるが、実際の患者報告は DRC・Uganda での発生に言及している。DRC は対象国リスト外（203312 は含まれない）であり、Uganda も対象国リスト外。したがって verified_locations には Vietnam のみを列挙。IHR基準は4つ全てに該当するため通常は PICKUP だが、対象国内での実際の患者報告がなく予防的対応に限定されているため、情報不足として WATCH 判定。続報で対象国での患者確認があれば PICKUP に更新すべき。

article.articleHeadline: RDC confirma la recuperación de cuatro pacientes de ébola y eleva a...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC confirms the recovery of four Ebola patients and raises it to...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists as four more patients recover in Bunia, Ituri province, bringing total recoveries to five. The four nurses treated on the front line were among the earliest cases when the outbreak began a little over two weeks earlier. The strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment; care has been symptomatic, with malaria-directed treatment and antibiotics used in these cases. The outbreak has registered near 1,000 cases and more than 200 suspected deaths as of late May 2026. Initial symptoms commonly include fever, fatigue, malaise, muscle and throat pain, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and deterioration of kidney and liver function. WHO declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; DR Congo has extensive Ebola experience, including the Kasai outbreak ending in December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ患者4人の回復を確認し、回復者数を5人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響：1000例近く・200人以上の死亡報告、国際的関心：WHO PHEIC宣言済み、国際的拡大リスク：Bundibugyo株）。WHOが既にPHEIC宣言している確認されたエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 既にWHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）を宣言済みの確認されたエボラアウトブレイク。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・承認治療法がなく、ケースは回復中だが依然として近1000例・200人以上の疑い死亡がある。2025年12月にKasaiアウトブレイクが終結したばかりで、新たな流行の発生。

article.articleHeadline: الخلية الوطنية لمتابعة وضعية وباء الإيبولا تعقد اجتماعها الثاني - الوكالة الموريتانية للأنباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The National Cell for Monitoring the Ebola Epidemic Situation Holds Its Second Meeting - Mauritanian News Agency
article.articleSummary: Mauritania's National Cell for Monitoring the Ebola Epidemic held its second meeting at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to track the outbreak and prevent its importation or spread. Chairman Ambassador Mohamed Mulod Mohamed Salem said the regional situation is high-risk, requiring vigilance and mobilization. Following May 26 directives from President Mohamed Ould Cheikh El Ghazouani, authorities established a national emergency cell, issued a joint awareness statement, and instructed Mauritanian diplomatic missions in affected countries to educate citizens and monitor their status. Health and border measures include heightened surveillance at entry points, airport controls, and thermal cameras with ready-to-activate teams; the Interior Ministry reinforced border controls and local outreach; the Transport Ministry activated health checkpoints at Nouakchott International Airport (Am Tounsi) and the Rosso crossing. Mauritanian missions in the Republic of the Congo, Angola, and Nigeria reported no infections among citizens abroad. The committee urged ongoing coordination to inform citizens and discourage travel to affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行状況監視国家セル、第2回会議を開催 - モーリタニア通信社
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い病原性を持つ疾患であり、IHR通知基準を満たす可能性が高い。ただし本記事はモーリタニアにおける警戒態勢の強化・予防措置の報告であり、実際の症例発生の直接的報告ではない。情報源は限定的（モーリタニア当局発表）であり、地域的影響の詳細が不明なため、追加情報が必要である。
triage.notes: 記事はモーリタニアにおける予防的警戒態勢の強化について報告しているが、Bluedot APIが抽出した地域にはモーリタニア（対象国リストに未含）、ナイジェリア、アンゴラが含まれている。verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。これはサマリーで『Republic of the Congo, Angola, and Nigeria reported no infections among citizens abroad』と記述されており、実際の流行地域の言及であるため。ただしモーリタニアはアウトブレイク対応活動の地域であるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。本記事は検証済みの症例発生よりも予防的対応を記述しており、フルRRAの実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Εμπολα: Ταξιδιωτική οδηγία έχει εκδώσει ο ΕΟΔΥ, τι να αποφεύγουν οι ταξιδιώτες
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: EODY has issued a travel advisory, what travelers should avoid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever (EVD) due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus is under outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province: 30 laboratory-confirmed cases, 500 suspected cases, 130 suspected deaths as of 19 May 2026) and in North Kivu’s Goma, with 1 confirmed case; Uganda has 2 confirmed imported cases in Kabale. The World Health Organization declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 16 May 2026. Greece’s National Public Health Organization (EODY) issued a travel advisory on 20 May 2026 for travelers arriving from affected areas in the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. The advisory notes that the overall risk to travelers is very low, as close contact with local residents is unlikely.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：EODY（ギリシャ国立公衆衛生機関）がエボラに関する渡航勧告を発出、旅行者が避けるべきことは
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の大規模な集団発生がDRC（イトゥリ州：30確診例、500疑い例）およびゴマで発生し、ウガンダでも輸入症例が確認されている。WHOが2026年5月16日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高い。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを宣言した重要なシグナル。DRC（イトゥリ州・ゴマ）での大規模集団発生と、ウガンダへの国際的な拡大が確認されている。Bluedot APIが「Hellenic Republic（ギリシャ）」「Republic of the Sudan（スーダン）」を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではこれらの地域での発生例は報告されていない（ギリシャは渡航勧告発出国、スーダンは懸念地域としてのみ言及）。対象国リストに該当する実際の発生国はDRCとウガンダのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente internado em São Paulo com suspeita de Ebola tem resultado de exame divulgado | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospitalized patient in São Paulo with suspected Ebola has had a test result released | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: As of 1 June 2026, a 37-year-old man hospitalized at Emílio Ribas, São Paulo, underwent Ebola testing after returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo with compatible symptoms. Adolfo Lutz Institute announced the Ebola result was negative; the patient is diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis. The investigation was prompted by Congo origin and travel history, but there is no Ebola transmission in the region. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat assesses the risk of Ebola introduction into Brazil/South America as very low, citing no endemic transmission in South America, no direct flights from the outbreak region, and that Ebola requires direct contact with blood, secretions, bodily fluids, or tissues of symptomatic persons. Health services should remain vigilant for fever in travelers within 21 days and for contacts with bodily fluids of suspected/confirmed cases. Ebola symptoms include abrupt fever, severe headache, myalgia, fatigue, nausea/vomiting/diarrhea, abdominal pain; incubation 2–21 days; severe disease can include hemorrhage and multi-organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで疑いを持たれたエボラウイルス患者の検査結果が判明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染疑い事例が確認されたが、検査結果は陰性であり、実際の患者は髄膜炎菌髄膜炎と確定診断された。南米へのエボラ導入リスクは極めて低いと評価されており、IHR基準は2つ以上満たさない。ただし国際的な疾患報告であり、情報の完全性と追跡が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は疑い事例であり、確定診断はメningococcal meningitisである。患者はコンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者であり、渡航歴による調査トリガーである。ブラジル当局はエボラのリスク評価を非常に低いと判断している。DRCのエボラ流行が背景にあるため、DRCも verified_locations に含めた。対象国フォーカス：WPRO対象国ではないがBrazilが該当国リストに含まれ、DRCも重要な発生源として記事に明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: La amenaza del ébola invisible: por qué este brote en el Congo ha hecho saltar las alarmas mundiales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The invisible Ebola threat: why this outbreak in Congo has set off global alarms.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, hosts an Ebola outbreak that WHO says could be among the largest in history. On May 17, the agency declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing rapid spread. The first detected case was a health worker diagnosed about 100 km from epicenter, leaving weeks of undetected transmission. So far, 1,038 suspected cases and 241 deaths, primarily in DRC, with seven cases and one death in Uganda. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a less lethal variant with no vaccine or specific treatment. Past Bundibugyo outbreaks occurred in Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012), with 59 cases and 34 deaths. The WHO expert committee proposed experimental therapies (MBP134, Maftivimab, remdesivir) and post-exposure prophylaxis with obeldesivir. The most promising vaccine is rVSV Bundibugyo (IAVI), needing seven–nine months; another candidate, ChAdOx2 Bundibugyo, is in development. Ongoing conflict and weak health systems hinder surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: 見えないエボラの脅威：コンゴでのこのアウトブレイクが世界的な警報を鳴らした理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（1,038例、241死亡）で、WHO が国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模アウトブレイク。2026年5月17日に WHO が PHEIC を宣言。初期の未検出伝播期間が指摘され、ウガンダへの国際的な波及も確認（7例、1死亡）。ただし、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。ワクチン開発が進行中（rVSV Bundibugyo：7-9ヶ月）、複数の実験的治療法が提案されている。紛争と弱い保健システムが監視と対応を阻害。

article.articleHeadline: كروت متابعة وعزل فوري.. إجراءات مصرية صارمة للحجر الصحي بسبب تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Follow-up cards and immediate isolation: Egyptian strict quarantine measures due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Egypt's Ministry of Health and Population, on 2026-06-01, tightened border health security after the Democratic Republic of Congo reported a new Ebola outbreak in a province. All entry points—air, sea, and land—were ordered to heighten screening of travelers from affected areas, using thermal cameras, thermometers, and visual checks in quarantine wards. Suspected cases must be isolated away from other passengers and transported to fever hospitals for immediate assessment; authorities must notify quarantine officials. Health-follow-up cards, named 'health surveillance,' require full personal data and electronic entry for 21 days of monitoring. Airlines and shipping agencies were instructed not to permit boarding until quarantine testing is completed. Ebola symptoms include sudden fever, fatigue, muscle pains, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, potentially internal or external bleeding; incubation 2–21 days; transmission occurs after symptoms appear. No Ebola or Hantavirus presence in Egypt, says Dr. Amjad Al-Haddad, who notes supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: フォローアップカードと即座の隔離：エボラ流行による厳格なエジプトの検疫措置
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ新規流行をきっかけにエジプトが国境検疫を大幅強化。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）と WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行性、長期曝露リスク）の複数項目に該当し、地域の警戒度が高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC でのエボラ新規流行がエジプトの検疫強化を引き起こしたことを報道しているが、エジプト（対象国外）での患者報告はなし。エジプトは防御的対応段階。DRC が唯一の対象国内イベント発生地。エボラとハンタウイルスの両疾患が列挙されているが、記事本文はエボラのみに焦点。2026-06-01 の配信日付は将来日付だが、情報源としての信頼性に不明瞭さあり。

article.articleHeadline: Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) Statement on Attacks Against Health Facilities During the Bundibugyo Virus Disease Response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Attacks on a Bundibugyo Virus Disease treatment facility in Ituri Province, DRC, are condemned by Africa CDC, which warns such acts threaten containment, endanger health workers, and cut access to life-saving care. The statement emphasizes that outbreaks fuel fear and misinformation, and stresses empathy, transparency, and sustained community engagement as essential to control, citing the North Kivu Ebola experience where trust was pivotal. Despite challenges, progress includes the discharge of Ebola survivors in Bunia, which can bolster community trust, and the training/deployment of Community Health Workers to improve surveillance, IPC, and public awareness. Africa CDC reiterates RCCE as a core pillar, and pledges intensified support to authorities and partners for community engagement, rumor management, and culturally sensitive communication. It calls all actors to protect health facilities, workers, and communities and stand with the DRC government in stopping Bundibugyo Virus Disease.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがコンゴ民主共和国のブンディブギョウイルス病対応中の保健施設への攻撃に関する声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ関連ウイルス（ブンディブギョウイルス）の発生がDRCで進行中であり、IHR基準の「異常性」と「国際的懸念」、WPRO基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当。保健施設への攻撃という社会的・政治的懸念も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラウイルスではなくブンディブギョウイルス病（Bundibugyo Virus Disease）の発生を扱っているが、Filoviridae科の重篤な出血熱として同等の公衆衛生上の脅威。Ituri Province（Bunia）での患者発生、生存者の退院、保健施設への攻撃による対応の支障が記述されている。Africa CDCの公式声明であり、地域的な懸念の高さが確認される。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Moderna Snags $50 Million Ebola Vax Contract
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo persists, with 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths and roughly 1,100 suspected cases, according to African CDC and WHO. Nine cases have been confirmed in Uganda, including one death. Moderna is receiving up to $50 million from CEPI to accelerate Ebola vaccine development, as the outbreak spurs trial planning within a couple of months. CEPI will also invest up to $8.6 million for a shot developed by the University of Oxford and manufactured by Serum Institute of India, and $3.2 million for a vaccine from the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative. CEPI chief Richard Hatchett cautions that vaccine development can be unpredictable and notes a challenging security situation in eastern Congo that may complicate trials, including an arson attack on an Ebola treatment center after authorities blocked body retrieval.

triage.headline_ja: Moderna社が5000万ドルのエボラワクチン契約を獲得
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。実際のエボラアウトブレイク（DRC 282確定例・42死亡、ウガンダ9例）に基づく医療対応であり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（非対象国）でも確認例があるが、検証対象国はDRCとインドのみを列挙。インドはセラム・インスティテュート・オブ・インディアがワクチン製造に関与するため含める。アウトブレイク発生地はDRC東部で、治療施設への放火などセキュリティ課題も報告されている。ワクチン開発加速の政策的背景にあるコンゴのアウトブレイク自体が主要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: FDA's 'Big Dick Energy!' Warning; UHC Retreats on Prior Auth; Nurses Beat Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of June 1, 2026, Congo’s Ebola outbreak shows at least 246 suspected deaths and over 1,000 suspected cases, with four infected nurses recovered per the WHO; clinics have been attacked and authorities warn of links to wild animal consumption. Brazil is investigating two possible Ebola cases, while Kenya reports hundreds protesting outside a U.S. Ebola quarantine center for citizens. New York’s JFK Airport becomes the fourth U.S. airport to conduct Ebola screenings. Separately, Florida records five Vibrio vulnificus cases this year. The White House backs off a plan to station law enforcement outside homes of people monitored for hantavirus, and the HHS launches tick-borne illness initiatives including Lyme disease research and treatment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: FDA「ビッグディックエネルギー」警告、UHCが事前認可を後退、看護師がエボラを克服
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラアウトブレイク（246疑い死亡、1,000疑い症例以上）はIHR基準4項目全て該当。複数国への国際的拡大リスク（ブラジル、ケニア、米国での確認/懸念）および重症度の高さから、フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: 記事ではコンゴでの進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（246疑い死亡、1,000疑い症例）が主要トピック。ブラジルは2疑い症例調査中、ケニアでも米国エボラ検疫センター周辺でのデモ報告あり。米国での検査強化やハンタウイルス・ライム病・ビブリオ感染症の並行報道も含まれるが、エボラが最大の懸念。ケニアは対象国でないため verified_locations に含めない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Moderna va participer au développement d'un vaccin contre la souche Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-Moderna will participate in the development of a vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo with no licensed vaccine or treatment. Moderna, partnered with CEPI, aims to develop a candidate vaccine against BDBV, with CEPI pledging about $50 million to support preclinical work and early clinical trials. CEPI is also investing up to $8.6 million for a vaccine developed by Oxford University and manufactured by the Serum Institute of India, and $3.2 million for a vaccine from the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative, bringing CEPI’s total funding for these projects to roughly $60 million. The World Health Organization has recently prioritized experimental therapeutics—antibodies, antivirals, and vaccines—for BDBV treatment and prevention. Additional pledges include up to $50 million from Gavi and up to $220.6 million from the World Bank’s Pandemic Emergency Financing Facility."

triage.headline_ja: エボラ - モデルナがBundibugyo株に対するワクチン開発に参加する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の発生がDRCで報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な対応の必要性、複数の国際機関による大規模な資金投入が確認される。IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: DRCでのBundibugyo株エボラ発生が主要な懸念。インドはSerum Institute of Indiaがワクチン製造の一部を担う関連国として記事サマリーに明記されている。英国はワクチン開発への政治的支援国として記載されているが、疾病の実発生地ではないため除外。WHO、CEPI、Gavi、世界銀行など主要国際機関が対応を加速化している。

article.articleHeadline: KLM trekt onverwacht stekker uit vluchten naar Oeganda vanwege Ebola-zorgen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KLM unexpectedly pulls the plug on flights to Uganda due to Ebola concerns.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of the deadly Ebola virus in Central Africa has led KLM to temporarily suspend flights to Entebbe International Airport, Uganda. The cancellations come amid international travel restrictions linked to the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola, with advisories affecting travelers and crew who recently transited Entebbe. WHO has declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, though it has not reached pandemic status. KLM notes Entebbe is not currently classified as an active risk area, yet mounting rules hinder operations. Two Amsterdam–Entebbe flights via Kigali, Rwanda, scheduled for Saturday and Monday, were canceled. Brussels Airlines is altering crew planning to maintain routes to Entebbe, Kinshasa, New York and Washington; Emirates warns travelers to check destination-entry rules. The United States introduced enhanced health screenings and travel restrictions in May for travelers from affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: Ebola懸念によりKLMがウガンダへの便を予期せず運休
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO公式発表による国際公衆衛生上の懸念（PHEIC）、複数国での確認、国際的な渡航制限実施、異常・予想外の事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ発生がCentral Africaで述べられ、WHOが「Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo」に対してPHEICを宣言したと記載。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダはリストに含まれていないため除外。ルワンダも記事に言及されているが、地理的な経由地として扱われており、発生地としては明記されていないため除外。Bundibugyo variant of Ebolaという特定の亜型が関与し、国際的な航空運行へ実質的な影響が出ているため、高優先度でフルRRAへ進める必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Ministros da UE em reunião na sexta-feira para debater medidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: EU ministers to meet on Friday to discuss measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa prompts EU Health Ministers to hold a Friday videoconference to discuss further preparedness and coordination measures, convened by Cyprus, the rotating EU presidency. A follow-up discussion is planned for 16 June to decide coordinated action. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control reinforced support for the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda amid worsening transmission, while EU population risk remains very low. Cyprus activated the Integrated Political Crisis Response Device in monitor mode to facilitate information sharing as a precaution, not a formal mechanism activation. In the DRC, 17th Ebola epidemic reports 246 suspected deaths and 1,077 suspected cases; Uganda has nine confirmed cases, including one death from an imported Congolese case. A Bundibugyo-strain Ebola vaccine is expected to be available this year. Ebola is a severe viral hemorrhagic disease transmitted via contact with bodily fluids, with most outbreaks in Central and West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: EU加盟国の保健相が金曜日に対策を協議するため会合を開く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。中央アフリカでのエボラアウトブレイク（DRC：246死亡、1,077疑い例、ウガンダ：9確定例）は国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項として早急なRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（246死亡、1,077疑い例）およびウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクが報告されている。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）はWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラの致死率の高さ、ヒト-ヒト感染の危険性、複数国への拡大、EU保健相の緊急会議召集、ワクチン開発動向など複合的なシグナル特性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Suspeita de ebola em São Paulo é descartada após exame do Adolfo Lutz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola in São Paulo ruled out after Adolfo Lutz test.
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, Adolfo Lutz ruled out Ebola in a 37-year-old immigrant from the Democratic Republic of Congo hospitalized at Instituto Emílio Ribas in São Paulo. Blood testing was negative for Ebola virus. The patient, who previously had meningococcal meningitis, presented fever, diarrhea and disorientation after arrival, triggering a precautionary Ebola protocol. He was intubated and placed in isolation; treated with antibiotics and hydration. Malaria tests at a UPA were inconclusive. Contacts on the plane and at the UPA are being monitored. A repeat test is under consideration by health authorities; results have not been disclosed. Brazil/South America Ebola risk remains very low due to no local transmission and lack of direct flights from affected African regions. Outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda show 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (13% mortality); 906 cases are under WHO investigation.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでのエボラ疑い患者、アドルフォ・ルッツ検査で陰性と判定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは検査で陰性と判定されており、患者からの実際の感染症イベントは確認されていない。ブラジルでの実局所的な流行リスクは非常に低く、国際的拡大の可能性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（サンパウロ）での疑似症例の検査結果が陰性であることを報じている。DRCとウガンダでの現地での流行は言及されているが、本イベントはブラジルでの確認例ではなく、疑疑症例の除外報告である。国際的な流行地域との関連性は低く、ブラジルでのリスク評価も「非常に低い」と明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda, Dall'Oglio: sull'Ebola cruciale la sensibilizzazione tra la gente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda, Dall'Oglio: Awareness-raising about Ebola is crucial among the people
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak tensions Uganda-DR Congo border; as of 1 June 2026, Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. Western Uganda is densely populated with South Sudan refugee camps; eastern DRC remains war-torn, heightening cross-border risk. Kampala recently closed the border with the DRC. Bundibugyo’s mortality is about 13–20%, lower than Zaire strain’s 80–90%; no vaccine yet, but development is expected based on international experience. Uganda’s response centers on widespread public awareness: flyers, leaflets, and posters in local languages, with village volunteers reaching communities. If cases rise, suspected patients are transported by ambulance for laboratory testing and, upon confirmation, moved to a care center currently in Kampala; regional hospitals would be mobilized if needed. Medici con l'Africa Cuamm, via Giovanni Dall'Oglio, emphasizes PPE for staff and territorial education, reflecting Uganda’s 2022 Ebola and COVID-19 experience.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、ダッローリオ：エボラ対策に地域住民への啓発が重要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行性が確認され、国境を接するDRCとの緊張関係があり、ウガンダの対応能力に懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダのエボラアウトブレイク対応であるが、Bluedot APIの発生地域にはウガンダ（ID:226074）が含まれている。対象国リスト上、DRC（203312）のみが該当するため verified_locations に DRC を列挙。ただし、記事サマリーからウガンダ国内での症例報告と対応が明記されているため、本来はウガンダを対象国に含めるべき事案である。東DRCの紛争による脆弱性、難民キャンプ経由の曝露リスク、国境の遮断措置など、国境を超えたリスク要因が複数指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta caso ebola em paciente internado em SP -- AconteceuMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out Ebola case in a patient hospitalized in São Paulo — AconteceuMS.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil — The Adolfo Lutz Institute reported that the Ebola test on a patient hospitalized with suspected Ebola in São Paulo was negative; no Ebola viral RNA was detected in the sample. The patient remains hospitalized and in isolation at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas. He had a confirmed meningococcal meningitis two days earlier, after which Ebola testing was conducted as part of standard protocol. A second Ebola test will be performed to rule out a false negative and confirm the result. No further details on symptoms, exposure, or transmission are disclosed at this time. The findings reduce the likelihood of active Ebola infection at this time.

triage.headline_ja: 検査でサンパウロの入院患者のエボラ疑い症例を除外
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは検査で陰性が確認され、実際の発症は除外されている。髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は確認されているが、単発症例であり公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は低い。
triage.notes: エボラの確定検査は陰性であり、患者は実は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎であることが確認されている。確認検査が実施される予定だが、現時点では感染症危機としてのシグナル要件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola é descartado em paciente do Emílio Ribas em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ruled out in patient at Emílio Ribas Hospital in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola ruled out in a 37-year-old patient at Instituto Emílio Ribas in São Paulo after tests at Instituto Adolfo Lutz. The man, who had recently traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo and presented with fever, was treated as a suspected Ebola case; however, laboratory analysis confirmed no Ebola virus. Doctors diagnosed meningococcal meningitis instead. Ebola surveillance was maintained as a precaution per international biosafety protocols for travelers from Ebola-affected regions. Health authorities—Ministry of Health, State Health Secretariat, and Emílio Ribas—met to consider a second test, with no decision reported yet. The patient remains in isolation; prior to Emílio Ribas, he sought care at a primary care unit with high fever and inconclusive malaria tests, and soon deteriorated, developing diarrhea and disorientation, necessitating intubation. Contacts during the flight and initial care are being monitored. WHO notes ongoing Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, but risk to Brazil remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはサンパウロのエミーリオ・リバス病院の患者から除外
triage.triage_reason: エボラは検査で除外されたが、DRCからの渡航者が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎で確認され、国際的な接触者監視が実施中。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: エボラは陰性で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が確認されたため、直接的なエボラ脅威ではない。しかしDRC渡航者からの感染症検出、国際的な接触者監視、複数の保健当局の対応があり、IHR基準2つ以上該当するためPICKUPの閾値に接近。さらに詳細情報（接触者数、他患者の有無等）待機が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Protest Erupts In Kenya Over Proposed Ebola Quarantine Centre For Infected Americans
article.articleSummary: Protests erupted in Nanyuki, Kenya, against a proposed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base for Ebola-exposed individuals, including Americans. Kenya’s High Court temporarily blocked the centre and suspended admission of foreign patients after petitions by the Law Society of Kenya and a constitutional watchdog, citing concerns about the country’s capacity to manage foreign Ebola cases. The US reportedly planned to quarantine exposed American citizens in Kenya at a 50-bed facility, though Kenyan Health Minister Aden Duale said it would serve everyone. The US pledged $13.5 million to bolster Kenya’s Ebola preparedness. Local leaders warned the project could endanger nearby communities, noting many residents work at the air base. Kenya has no confirmed Ebola infections; Uganda has nine cases and recently shut its border with the DRC. The DRC (Congo) reports 282 confirmed cases and over 1,000 suspected cases linked to the Bundibugyo strain, which lacks an approved vaccine or treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで提案されたエボラ隔離施設に対する抗議活動が勃発 感染したアメリカ人向け
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ確定患者282例および疑い例1000例以上、ウガンダの9例確定患者など重大な公衆衛生事象が進行中であるが、ケニアでの隔離施設設置に関する政治的対立が主題となっており、ケニア国内での実際の感染例は報告されていない。情報が不足しており、DRCでの流行拡大状況の追跡が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアはエボラ確認患者がなく、記事の主題は隔離施設設置計画に対する政治的抗議である。DRCでの大規模流行（確定患者282例、疑い例1000例以上）とウガンダの9例確定患者が主たる感染症イベントであり、Bundibugyo株はワクチンも承認治療法も存在しない。IHR基準を4つ満たす重大事象であるが、記事の焦点がケニア国内の流行ではなく隔離施設計画への国内反対であるため、実際の感染状況に関する詳細情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, la Regione Puglia individua due centri di riferimento a Bari. "Nessun allarme"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The Puglia Region identifies two Ebola reference centers in Bari. "No cause for alarm."
article.articleSummary: Ebola surveillance expanded in the Puglia region of Italy, with Bari hosting two Ebola reference centers: the complex infectious diseases unit at Policlinico and the Giovanni XXIII pediatric hospital. Regional authorities activated surveillance and prevention procedures under Ministry of Health directives, emphasizing that there is no current alarm. Procedures include immediate notification of ASLs, hospital trusts, Irccs, prevention and emergency departments, and the use of autosegnalazioni via the Iris platform, with evaluation within 24 hours and transmission to the national Premal system. The Bari centers will provide clinical-epidemiological assessment for individuals under self-monitoring, health surveillance, or fiduciary isolation. Citizens from Congo and Uganda are urged to follow self-reporting and self-monitoring instructions and contact their local Prevention Department. No Ebola cases are confirmed; measures ensure preparedness and rapid response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：プーリア州がバーリに2つのエボラ対応センターを指定。「警報なし」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準該当なし（イタリア国内での予防的準備体制の整備であり、確認された症例なし）。ただしエボラウイルス監視強化とコンゴ・ウガンダからの渡航者対象の自己報告措置が講じられており、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリア（プーリア州バーリ）における予防的な監視体制整備である。確認された症例はなく、アラート状態ではないと明記されている。ただし、コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダからの渡航者を対象とした自己報告・自己監視措置が導入されており、これらの国でのエボラ流行リスクが背景にあると推定される。verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める（実際のエボラ発生地）。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Exame dá negativo para ebola em imigrante do Congo hospitalizado em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The test comes back negative for Ebola in Congolese immigrant hospitalized in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: 1 June 2026, São Paulo — Molecular testing by Instituto Adolfo Lutz ruled out Ebola in a 37-year-old immigrant from the Democratic Republic of Congo hospitalized at Emílio Ribas Infectology Institute with meningococcal meningitis. The patient, who arrived with fever and later developed diarrhea and disorientation, was intubated and treated with antibiotics and hydration. Prior evaluation at a UPA yielded inconclusive malaria results. Contact tracing and monitoring extend to people who travelled on the flight and during the UPA visit. Authorities stress that the risk of Ebola introduction to Brazil and South America remains very low due to no autochthonous transmission and the absence of direct flights to affected regions. The CCD updated health network guidance for Bundibugyo Ebola; suspected cases must be reported to municipal epidemiological surveillance and CVE. The WHO flagged an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda 15 days ago, with 134 confirmed cases, 18 deaths, and 223 deaths under investigation in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ移民がサンパウロで入院、エボラウイルス検査は陰性
triage.triage_reason: 複数疾患（髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎、エボラ、マラリア）が関連するイベントだが、主患者はエボラ陰性で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎と確定。DRCでのエボラ流行情報は付加的だが、ブラジルでの感染のリスクは低いと評価されている。情報不足の部分が多いため、続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: サンパウロの患者はエボラ検査陰性で、確定診断は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎。DRCでのエボラ流行情報は記事に含まれるが、ブラジルへの直接的なリスクは低いと評価。濃厚接触者の追跡と監視が実施中。マラリアの検査結果は不確定。流行の可能性があるため監視継続が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in Congo climb to 282 as WHO reports 5 recoveries
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s eastern Ituri province Ebola outbreak has 282 confirmed cases and at least 42 deaths, with more than 1,000 suspected cases since onset. The Bundibugyo strain, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment, is managed with supportive care. Over the weekend four nurses and a laboratory worker recovered and were discharged in Bunia, bringing total recoveries to five. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to reinforce response efforts; early detection and access to treatment improve survival. The outbreak, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern last month, remains concentrated in Ituri. Challenges include contact tracing reaching fewer than half of known contacts and safe burials. Uganda reports nine cases; suspected cases in Brazil and Italy involve Congo travel, with a São Paulo meningitis case and Rio de Janeiro malaria; Italy’s traveler tested negative. Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak and third largest; regional spread risk is increasing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者数が282人に増加、WHOが5人の回復を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。PHEICとして既に宣言されており、複数国への影響が確認されている。
triage.notes: イタリアはサマリー記載されているが対象国外のため除外。ウガンダも対象国外のため除外。ブラジルは疑い例が報告されている（São Paulo）ため verified_locations に含める。DRCが主疫学地であり、既にPHEIC宣言されている。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未承認であり、管理困難性が高い。接触者追跡が効果的でなく、追加拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: L'ebola non risparmia villaggi e città. In Rd Congo colpite anche le province in guerra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spares no villages and cities. In DR Congo, the war-torn provinces are also affected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading slowly but patchily across the Democratic Republic of the Congo, now reaching both cities and villages as war-torn provinces contend with the outbreak. The deadly hemorrhagic fever prompts the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies to call it an 'epidemic in evolution' requiring early detection and rapid response. Government figures are still evolving: 282 laboratory-confirmed cases and 19 deaths reported to date. On the ground, responders such as Catherine Kamatu underscore the human toll and the logistical hurdles of delivering containment measures amid insecurity. The report emphasizes strengthening surveillance, community engagement, and swift resource mobilization to halt transmission across affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはいかなる村や都市も見逃さない。DRコンゴでは戦争で荒廃した州も影響を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行易さ）、エボラウイルス疾患の拡大という重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患は非常に高いリスク病原体であり、DRコンゴでの複数州への拡大、紛争地域での感染拡大、および国際赤十字社による『進化する流行』としての指摘から、即座のフルRRA実施が必須。国際支援ニーズが明確。

article.articleHeadline: الإيبولا يصل البرازيل.. مخاوف دولية من انتشار الفيروس خارج نطاق القرن الإفريقي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola reaches Brazil... Global concerns about the virus spreading outside the Horn of Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda expands; more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation as of May 30, with 263 confirmed infections and 43 deaths per Financial Times, and 291 confirmed and 43 deaths per WHO. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; this is the third-largest Ebola outbreak in about 50 years and was declared a public health emergency of international concern, though not a pandemic. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to Bunia in Ituri province, DRC, to reinforce response, noting early medical care and prompt treatment can save lives even without vaccines. Four nurses and a laboratory worker recovered at a Bunia facility, bringing DR Congo recoveries to five. Brazil is monitoring two suspected cases, signaling fear of spread beyond the Horn of Africa. Ongoing challenges include early detection, contact tracing, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがブラジルに到達...アフリカの角地域外へのウイルス拡大に関する国際的懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当し、WHO緊急宣言とブラジルでの疑似症例検出により国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでBrazilの言及がありますが、実際の患者（263確認、43死亡）はDRCとウガンダで発生しており、ブラジルは「監視中の2疑似症例」で確定症例はまだ記載されていません。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo株の関与、WHO緊急宣言、50年間で3番目の規模の流行という情報から、フルRRA実施の判定が適切です。
